title: Sairaanhoitaja, Laajasalon ja Jakomäen palvelutalo
description:
Arvostatko yhdessä tekemistä, uuden oppimista ja työympäristöä, jossa iäkkään asiakkaan aito kohtaaminen on keskiössä?

Meillä on auki kolme sairaanhoitajan tehtävää, joista yksi on Laajasalon palvelutalossa ja kaksi Jakomäen palvelutalossa. Aloitus tehtävissä on 14.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Laajasalon palvelutalossa sairaanhoitaja työskentelee ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen Majakka-tiimissä, jossa on 34-asukaspaikkaa.
Jakomäen palvelutalossa toinen tehtävä on kohorttiyksikkö Sinisiipeen, jossa on 26-asukaspaikkaa. Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa myös somaattiseen ryhmäkoti Usvaan, jossa on 26-asukaspaikkaa.

Palvelutalon asukkaat ovat kaikki monisairaita ikäihmisiä, joiden toimintakyky vaihtelee. Suurella osalla on käytössään erilaisia liikkumisen apuvälineitä. Tavoitteenamme on vaalia elämäniloa ja mahdollistaa kohtaamisia, jotka jäävät niin ikääntyneiden asukkaidemme kuin työntekijöidemme mieleen. Työtä tehdään yhdessä viikon jokaisena päivänä. Sairaanhoitaja tekee pääsääntöisesti kaksivuorotyötä, myös viikonloppuisin.

Meillä pääset kaikissa tiimeissä osaksi yhteisöä, jossa jokaisen työpanosta kunnioitetaan. Tiimeissä keskustellaan, ideoidaan ja tuetaan työkaveria. Jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä ja toteuttaa itseään työssään. Palvelutalojen toimintaa ohjaavat seniorikeskusten arvot ja toimintasuunnitelma. Pyrimme jokainen omalla toiminnallamme yhdenvertaisuutta ja tasa-arvoa. Yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, sillä arvokkaat kohtaamiset ja vaihteleva työ pitävät siitä huolen!

Sairaanhoitajan työtehtäviin kuuluu mm.:
osallistuminen asiakkaiden päivittäiseen perushoitoon
hoitotyön asiantuntijana toimiminen asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnin ja toimintakyvyn edistämiseksi
monipuolisesti sairaanhoidollisten tehtävien toteuttaminen esim. lääke- ja haavahoito
tiimin lähihoitajien työn tukeminen ja ohjaaminen
osallistuminen aktiivisesti lääkäri- ja omaisyhteistyöhön

Odotamme sinulta:
olet laillistettu sairaan- tai terveydenhoitaja
hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja
halua työskennellä lähellä asiakkaita, aidon arjen keskellä
kykyä suunnitella ja priorisoida omaa työtä yhteisöohjautuvasti
halua tuoda omaa osaamistasi osaksi tiimin toimintaa

Aiempi työkokemus ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi. Myös Apotti- ja RAI-osaamisesta on hyötyä, kuten voimassa olevista lääkeluvista.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:
merkityksellisen työn ikäihmisten parissa
arjen, jossa arvostus, yhteisöllisyys ja hyvät kohtaamiset ovat yhteinen päämäärä
toimintaympäristön kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja laajat koulutusmahdollisuudet
Helsingin kaupungin henkilöstöedut, kuten lounasetu ja Epassi Flex (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi ja työmatkat, max. 550 €/vuosi työsuhteen pituuden mukaan)
mahdollisuuden hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa, joka on markkinatasoa edullisempi ja johon työntekijämme ovat etusijalla.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Voit hakemuksella ilmoittaa, mitkä tehtävistä kiinnostavat sinua. Täytäthän hakemuksen suomeksi, sillä käsittelemme vain suomeksi täytetyt hakemukset. Olemme sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse hakemuksesi käsiteltyämme.

Voimme tästä hausta rekrytoida hakijoita myös muihin seniorikeskuksissa ja palvelutaloissa avautuviin sairaanhoitajan tehtäviin. Jos olet kiinnostunut myös muista tehtävistä eri puolilla kaupunkia, voit ilmoittaa siitä hakulomakkeella.

Kelpoisuusehto:

Sairaanhoitajan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aiempi opistotason tutkinto tai erikoissairaanhoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhoitajan tai kätilön tutkinto, johon sisältyy laillistus sairaanhoitajaksi.

Tehtävässä edellytetään terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain (559/1994, 1200/2007) mukaista laillistusta Suomessa.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsuhteen alkamista esitettävä työnantajalle huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään LOP/LOVe LOP-lääkeluvan hyväksytty suorittaminen viimeistään koeajan kuluessa.

Tehtävässä edellytetään iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustaotteen esittämistä (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

title: Wind Turbine Technician
description:
Join the change. Electrify your future!

We've been proudly Aussie since 1837, always finding new ways to innovate in energy and essential services. Now, we're moving towards a sustainable future through electrification and investing in renewable energy—and we’d like you to join us. Whether you're on-site, in the office, or somewhere in between, you'll find opportunities to grow your career here. You'll work with a team that's passionate about powering Australian lives, in a culture that values inclusivity, respect, and learning. Help us create a cleaner energy future, and we’ll back you every step of the way as you build your career.

Join the change. Electrify your future.

About the role

AGL’s Renewables team based at the Macarthur Wind Farm are looking for a Wind Turbine Technician to ensure the safe and efficient operation of our wind farms across Victoria, helping deliver AGL’s vision for a sustainable future.

Location: Based at the Macarthur Wind Farm, located in southwest Victoria, the site consists of 140 wind turbine generators with a total capacity of 420 MW, making it one of the largest wind farms in the Southern Hemisphere and a major contributor to clean, renewable energy generation in Australia.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on maintaining and servicing wind farm assets to ensure reliability, safety, and optimal performance.

What you will be doing

  • Perform routine and breakdown maintenance, servicing, inspection, and monitoring of wind farm assets

  • Prepare work records and reports, including input into SAP

  • Adhere to all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) systems and AGL’s safety standards

  • Conduct Hazard Risk Analysis and Job Safety Analysis as required

  • Ensure compliance with Safe Access Rules and participate in toolbox and safety meetings

  • Receive Access Authorities and progress to Recipient In Charge (RIC) if required

  • Supervise contractors and service providers to ensure safe and high-quality work

  • Provide and receive on-the-job training, mentoring team members to maintain high skill and safety standards

  • Demonstrate AGL values by collaborating across the business and contributing to overall success

What you will bring

You’re a skilled technician with a electrical background who is passionate about renewable energy and working safely as part of a team.

  • Electrical Trade qualification.

  • HV certification (preferred but not essential)

  • Experience working with HV/LV systems, hydraulics, or mechanical systems in industrial, commercial, or residential environments

  • Understanding of wind farm operations and maintenance that supports safe and efficient performance

  • Self-motivated with strong time-management skills

  • Enjoys working both independently and collaboratively

  • Holds a valid Victorian driver’s licence

  • Is comfortable working at heights and in confined spaces

Additional desirable qualifications:
GWO training, working at heights, manual handling, HV/LV rescue, fire awareness, first aid.

At AGL, we offer a wide range of benefits including:

  • Discounts on energy, telcos and solar plans.

  • Participate in Energise - our reward & recognition program.

  • Access 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary carer.

  • Play an active role in our diversity & inclusion initiatives.

  • Novated leasing and Electric Vehicle subscriptions.

  • Access to study assistance, AGL’s share purchase plan and insurance deals.

*Benefits may change over time and vary based on role type and location.

Inclusion at AGL

At AGL, we value diversity and welcome applicants from various backgrounds, including Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, individuals with disabilities, culturally diverse individuals, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. title: Senior Central Monitor
description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management. This position involves leading the development of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) plans, conducting study risk assessments, identifying study KRIs (in collaboration with Functional leads), performing ongoing centralized statistical monitoring, remote centralized data review, and facilitating monthly RBQM meetings. works independently and manages report review and issue escalation for more complex studies and/or portfolios of work. Further, the Central Monitor may mentor junior colleagues, and may support the development of processes, procedures and other documentation to ensure a high functioning team

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Lead Development of RBQM Plan: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement comprehensive RBQM plans tailored to each study's specific needs - including identification of critical data & process, definition of KRIs & QTLs and centralized monitoring approach
  • Study Risk Assessment: Conduct thorough risk assessments for clinical studies, identifying potential issues and developing mitigation strategies, in consultation with functional team leads and PM
  • Centralized Statistical Monitoring: Perform centralized statistical monitoring & data analysis on study data to detect anomalies, trends, and potential risks, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
  • RBQM Meetings: lead facilitation of monthly RBQM meetings by supporting review of study data, documenting findings, action plans and coordination of data cleaning activities to support study deliverables
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of data quality and integrity through proactive monitoring and timely interventions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and other departments to support proactive oversight and management and data cleaning for studies
  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on monitoring activities, findings, and recommendations for sponsors and study teams.
  • Operational Insights: Oversee operational study metrics, including data entry trends, SDV backlog, site health trending and proactively communicate issues to study team members to drive towards resolution & proactive remediation
  • Mentor and Support Junior Colleagues: Act as a mentor to more junior Central Monitors - sharing best practices, lessons learned, etc. to improve team performance
  • Sponsor Engagement and Communications: support discussions with Sponsors around risk management and proactive data cleaning

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 5 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and the clinical development process

Other Required:

  • Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English, including strong grammar and scientific vocabulary skills
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Strong understanding of RBQM principles and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems, clinical systems, dashboards, and to leverage these data to assess risk
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management
  • Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

  • CRO experience as a Central Monitor

Skills:

  • Statistical analysis and data monitoring
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Report writing and presentation
  • Collaboration and teamwork

title: Risk Advisor – Transport and Logistics Practice
description:

In this role, you will support a high-performing broking unit by co-managing a portfolio of high-profile Transport, Logistics, Warehousing and Machinery industry accounts. You will work closely with senior client executives and the NZ manager to deliver quality client service, strengthen relationships, and help drive profitable growth.

  • Co-manage a portfolio of Transport, Logistics, Warehousing and Machinery industry accounts, supporting client executives with service delivery and account management.
  • Assist senior client executives and the NZ manager with the presentation, management and maintenance of client accounts.
  • Take a proactive approach to identifying and meeting client needs in line with agreed service standards.
  • Prepare client placement and renewal reporting, insurer submissions and related spreadsheets.
  • Build and maintain effective long-term relationships with key client decision makers.

What you need to have:

  • New Zealand Certificate in Financial Services (Level 5).
  • Strong understanding of client risk management and insurance needs.
  • Experience supporting account management, claims reporting and policy administration.

What makes you stand out:

  • Experience in transport, logistics, warehousing or machinery accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong client and insurer relationships.
  • Background in leadership, negotiation, presentation, broking or project management.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille. title: OT Cybersecurity & Network Engineer
description:
OT Cybersecurity & Network Engineer

Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It

At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.

When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens. Where Growth Never Stops

About the Department:

The Global PlantLine Services Department at Fuller Technologies is a dedicated lifecycle services organization responsible for delivering comprehensive support, optimization, maintenance, and cybersecurity services for customers operating Fuller automation and digital solutions under PlantLine Agreements (PLA). The department provides 24x7 global remote support, proactive monitoring, performance optimization, lifecycle management, and cybersecurity services to maximize system reliability, availability, performance, and business value. With service agreements spanning more than 350 customer plants worldwide, the department plays a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, customer success, and long-term sustainability of automation investments.

About the Role: OT Cybersecurity & Network Engineer:

You will be part of our 24x7 Global Plantline Service Technical Support Team, responsible for securing, monitoring, and supporting Operational Technology (OT) networks and cybersecurity infrastructure for industrial automation systems deployed across global cement plants. The role includes management of cybersecurity solutions, network monitoring, endpoint protection, remote access security, firewall administration, incident response, compliance monitoring, and customer cybersecurity support activities.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring secure and reliable operation of plant automation systems, including process control systems, servers, operator stations, engineering stations, and industrial communication networks

Your responsibilities

OT Network Management

  • Monitor and maintain OT network infrastructure.

  • Support industrial Ethernet networks, VLANs, switches, routers, and firewalls.

  • Troubleshoot network communication issues impacting automation systems.

  • Monitor network availability, performance, and security events.

  • Support secured remote access solutions for customer plants.

  • Coordinate network changes with plant and customer IT teams.

  • Maintain OT network documentation and architecture diagrams.

Cyber Security Operations

  • Administer endpoint security platforms including Trellix ePO.

  • Implement and maintain cybersecurity policies and standards.

  • Monitor cybersecurity alerts and security events.

  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and security reviews.

  • Support implementation of defense-in-depth strategies for OT environments.

  • Manage antivirus, application control, and endpoint protection solutions.

  • Perform periodic cybersecurity health checks and compliance reviews.

Security Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor malware detections, policy violations, communication failures, and threat events.

  • Investigate cybersecurity incidents and coordinate remediation activities.

  • Perform root-cause analysis and corrective action follow-up.

  • Escalate critical cybersecurity events according to SLA requirements.

  • Maintain incident reports and lessons-learned documentation.

  • Support customer audits and cybersecurity assessments.

OT System Monitoring

  • Monitor health of automation servers and engineering workstations. Monitor Process Expert (PXP), ECS, QCX, historian, and related OT infrastructure.

  • Review system alarms, communication failures, and operational events.

  • Support proactive maintenance and system reliability programs.

  • Coordinate with PlantLine support teams for issue resolution.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure cybersecurity compliance across managed customer systems.

  • Review endpoint compliance and software update status.

  • Validate policy enforcement and security configurations.

  • Support cybersecurity governance meetings.

  • Maintain compliance reports and management dashboards.

  • Support implementation of cybersecurity best practices and standards.

Customer Support & Engagement

  • Provide remote cybersecurity and network support for global customers.

  • Participate in customer review meetings.

  • Support incident investigations and customer communications.

  • Provide recommendations for cybersecurity improvements.

  • Assist sales and service teams with cybersecurity solution deployment opportunities.

What you bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.

  • You bring 3–8 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • OT networking

  • Industrial automation

  • Cybersecurity operations

  • System administration

  • Industrial Control Systems (ICS)

Technical expertise

  • OT & Industrial Systems: Industrial Ethernet networks, OPC communications, automation system architecture, process control systems, Windows Server administration, and virtualization platforms.

  • Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching, VLAN configuration, firewall administration, and VPN management.

  • Cybersecurity: Trellix ePO administration, endpoint security, application control and whitelisting, malware analysis, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.

  • Tools & Technologies: Trellix ePO, endpoint security platforms, industrial firewalls, remote-access solutions, Power BI, Microsoft 365, and OT monitoring platforms.

Preferred certifications

Relevant certifications are an advantage, including Trellix Certified Professional, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Security+, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity, Microsoft Security certifications, or CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker).

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

title: UG Surveyor 1, 2, or 3
description:
Underground Surveyor


Location:

Stillwater Mine - Nye, MT

Schedule:

9 Hour days - 5x2, 4x3

Day Shift: 6:00am - 3:00pm


Job Responsibilities and Duties:

Responsibilities include but are not limited to: plan and execute surface and underground survey activities in a safe, efficient manner. Oversee and prepare maps and records of surveys; line and grade for UG excavations. Produce as-built drawings of excavations; measure excavation advances at determined intervals. Maintain and manage control point and survey files, both electronic and hard copy. Comply with State and Federal safety and environmental regulations and company policies and standards.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • Proficient in the use of AutoCAD, Excel, and Word.
  • Ability to multi-task and work efficiently with minimal supervision.
  • Leadership qualities including character, teamwork, communication, business sense, and vision.
  • Complete understanding/compliance of Company safety policies and procedures and ability to maintain a strong focus on safety while completing all tasks.
  • Can perform survey calculations such as two-point resection, horizontal & vertical curves, inverse between points, coordinate points, and grade/slope calculations.
  • Ability to do or learn to perform volume calculations using Vulcan Software, calculate stope and development contracts, as well as calculate incentive bonus.
  • Compile end-of-month development report without supervision.
  • Ability to assume some of the responsibilities of the Chief Surveyor in their absence.

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of underground mining methods/terminology.
  • Basic awareness and understanding of the day-to-day mine operations.
  • Ability to use TDS COGO software to perform survey calculations.
  • Ability to prepare azimuth tables and maps, set grade chains, and process CMS data.
  • Ability to survey and process GPS survey equipment.

Education & Experience

  • Survey crew experience, preferably underground and surface, AND/OR 1 to 2 years of college education in survey related field.

Sibanye-Stillwater is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions at Sibanye-Stillwater are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation or preference, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, age, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

title: Staff Network Engineer, Google Distributed Cloud
description:
Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) is designed as a converged hardware and software solution for customers, i.e. Public Sector, Enterprise, Telco, Retail. GDC includes dedicated hardware, network fabric, operating systems, and a curated set of Google Cloud services, providing a consistent cloud experience in tightly controlled environments. GDC network fabric consists of multiple layers including physical network, overlay network, host and Kubernetes network.

In this role, you will support the most stringent data residency, security, compliance, and privacy requirements, operating completely disconnected from Google Cloud.

GDC connected (GDCc) is a hardware and software product that brings Google Cloud to customer edge environments without compromising on latency or connectivity.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Drive impact for GDC across a combination of large project leadership, or solving very deep and ambiguous technical problems.
  • Provide deep insight and efficient resolution of complex operational issues that may arise in production, and would then follow that up with the design and development of processes that make sure that those issues don’t re-occur.
  • Anticipate scaling bottlenecks, software inefficiencies or shifts in usage, improve network planning and quantitative models, simplify and standardize existing solutions, increase availability and reliability, or make data-driven optimizations and adjustments.
  • Coordinate or lead efforts involving multiple teams organizations across multiple medium-large projects in a collaborative manner.
  • Drive significant improvements in performance of a team, through leadership, mentorship, and application of good engineering principles.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with network routing protocols, design and troubleshooting, with network equipment providers.
  • Experience with planning and designing networks (e.g., multiple sites, multiple products, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience with developing performance infrastructure, distributed systems, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
  • Experience in one or more programming languages such as C++, Go, or Python.
  • Experience with data center Networking with in-depth knowledge of routing protocols and overlay networks such as EVPN-VXLAN and IPv6.
  • Proficiency in coding, scripting, networking system health, diagnosis and resolution, network and software testing.

title: Technologist
description:
Join Envalior – Imagine The Future!

At Envalior, we are shaping the future of high-performance materials through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. For our Genk site, we are looking for a Technologist who will play a key role in optimizing production processes, introducing new products, and driving continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

At Envalior, the future is not only imagined—it is pioneered. We foster an environment where every voice is heard and ideas are valued. Empowerment is at the heart of our culture, enabling our people to take ownership, innovate, and make a lasting impact.

Join us and become part of an organization where technology, quality, safety, and collaboration come together to shape the future of advanced materials.

IMAGINE THE FUTURE AT ENVALIOR

As a Technologist, you are responsible for developing, communicating, and applying process engineering and product knowledge to optimize manufacturing performance. You ensure that formulations, raw materials, and production processes meet the highest standards for quality, safety, and efficiency while supporting the successful introduction of new products and technologies.

Working closely with Production, R&D, Maintenance, Project Engineering, SHE, Supply Chain, and Site Management, you will act as the technological expert for one or more production lines and lead improvement initiatives that enhance plant performance, product quality, and operational excellence.

You will make an impact by:

Process & Product Development

  • Introduce new formulations, raw materials, and product specifications while ensuring compliance with Envalior, customer, and regulatory requirements
  • Support R&D in assessing the manufacturability of new and modified products and processes
  • Lead product scale-up from development to routine production
  • Translate formulations into production recipes and maintain them in SAP
  • Support the implementation of new technologies and drive fast, efficient implementation of new products and processes

Process Optimization

  • Optimize production processes to improve yield, product quality, and cost efficiency
  • Define and optimize Key Operating Parameters (KOPs), operating windows, and processing windows
  • Analyze structural production issues related to quality, output, process performance, and SHE
  • Organize and facilitate FMEA, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Six Sigma improvement activities
  • Lead multidisciplinary continuous improvement projects and support small capital projects
  • Take ownership of improvement initiatives from concept through implementation
  • Lead the Ready-To-Operate (RTO) phase of construction projects below €5 million

Quality & Safety

  • Maintain and improve quality management systems in accordance with GMP, ISO/TS and customer requirements
  • Release compliant production batches and determine the disposition of non-conforming products
  • Evaluate product deviations together with R&D and customers
  • Lead customer audits and participate in internal quality audits
  • Prepare and maintain Control Plans, FMEAs, Process Charts, and other quality documentation
  • Investigate customer complaints using the TOPS 8D methodology
  • Organize and participate in process safety studies, including HAZOP and Risk Inventory & Evaluation
  • Provide technical expertise during SHE- and quality-related investigations and meetings

Requirements

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Master's degree in Chemical Engineering (Industrial Engineering) or equivalent through relevant experience
  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in a production, process engineering, or technology role
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, formulations, and raw materials
  • Experience with process optimization, continuous improvement methodologies, and data analysis
  • Good knowledge of SAP and reporting tools
  • Excellent understanding of SHEQ procedures, process safety, HAZOP, and manufacturing best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to decision-making
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary improvement initiatives and influence stakeholders across departments
  • Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to balance quality, safety, cost, and operational performance
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

Benefits

WHY ENVALIOR?

Competitive Compensation:
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.

Comprehensive Benefits:
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility:
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.

Training & Development Opportunities:
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.

Diversity & Inclusion:
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.

APPLY NOW!

Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.

Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Eray.Kasmet@Envalior.com

Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.

OUR HERITAGE

With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.

We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: HSE Advisor
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced HSE Advisor to join our Energy Networks team within the Utilities division. Reporting to the Senior HSE Advisor, you will partner with operational leaders, project teams, contractors and clients to drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health, safety and environmental requirements across our operations.
This is a hands on role where you will provide expert guidance and support across risk management, incident investigations, auditing, training, injury management and continuous improvement initiatives. You will play a key role in implementing and maintaining health, safety and environmental management systems while championing our commitment to Zero Harm.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Supporting operational teams to maintain compliance with legislative, client and company HSE requirements.
  • Coaching leaders and project teams on HSE management plans, risk registers and contractor management requirements.
  • Conducting field inspections, audits, observations and critical risk verification activities.
  • Coordinating incident investigations, corrective actions and lessons learned activities.
  • Monitoring HSE performance data, identifying trends and implementing improvement initiatives.
  • Supporting injury management and return to work processes.
  • Delivering HSE training, inductions and awareness programs. [
  • Assisting with internal and external audits and supporting certification requirements.

What We're Looking For

To be successful, you will bring:
  • Certificate IV in Work Health and Safety as a minimum.
  • ICAM Incident Investigation qualification or equivalent.
  • Construction Industry White Card.
  • Return to Work Coordinator certification.
  • Minimum two years' experience in a health and safety role.
  • Experience supporting HSE functions across project based environments and high risk operational activities.
  • Knowledge of relevant health and safety legislation, standards and management systems.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and relationship building skills.
  • Experience with incident investigations, risk management and injury management processes.
  • Intermediate Microsoft 365 skills and the ability to analyse data and identify safety trends.
Desirable qualifications include:
  • Certificate IV Training and Assessment or similar.
  • Quality or Safety Lead Internal Auditor qualification.
  • Drug and Alcohol Testing qualifications.

What We Offer

At Downer, we invest in our people and provide opportunities to build meaningful and rewarding careers.
Our employees benefit from:
  • A strong safety culture focused on Zero Harm.
  • Career development and growth opportunities.
  • Exposure to large scale utility and infrastructure projects.
  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Access to employee benefits, wellbeing programs and professional development opportunities.
  • The opportunity to work for a leading integrated services provider delivering essential infrastructure solutions across Australia and New Zealand.

About Energy & Utilities

Downer's Energy & Utilities business delivers integrated solutions across the utilities, power generation, renewable energy, gas and industrial sectors. We support our customers through the design, construction, maintenance and operation of critical infrastructure that keeps communities connected and industries moving.
At Downer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and encourage diversity in our workforce.

How to Apply

To apply for this opportunity, click the Apply Now button and submit your resume and cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
Downer is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Agency Disclaimer

Downer Group does not accept unsolicited resumes, fees or costs from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Downer or its employees will become the property of Downer and no fee will be payable in relation to such submissions.

title: Säsonga som kock och souschef på Liseberg
description:
Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie! Sedan 1923 har vi fått människor att mötas, skratta och trivas tillsammans. Snart är det din tur att vara med. Hos oss jobbar du inte bara i en nöjespark – du jobbar i en hel värld av upplevelser: Karuseller, musik, god mat, hotell, show, trädgårdar, camping – och snart ett helt nytt vattenvärld. Vi har öppet året om, i olika säsonger och olika tempo – men glädjen finns alltid där. Och det är just du som är med och skapar den. Här är jobbet både stort och smått, vardagligt och wiiie, fullt av fart men med plats för eftertanke. Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie!

Vi ger dig detta (och lite till!)

  • Vardag och wiiie. Här är jobbet både kul och på riktigt. Du gör skillnad – oavsett om du jobbar mitt i pulsen eller bakom kulisserna.

  • Kollegor och kvarterskänsla. Här finns experter på allt från snurrande åk till smarta excel-dokument. Olika jobb, olika hörn av samma varma kvarter.

  • Värde före vinst. Vi ägs av staden. Det du gör bidrar till något större än oss själva.

  • Mod och metod. Vi testar nytt – men alltid med hållbarhet i fokus. Att ligga i framkant kräver både idéer och eftertanke. Här finns båda.

Du är en i gänget Som medarbetare på Lisebergs restauranger blir du en del av ett stort engagerat team som skapar minnesvärda upplevelser för våra hungriga och törstiga gäster.

Till våra restauranger välkomnar vi dig som har lång erfarenhet eller kanske utbildning inom restaurang, men också dig som är nyfiken och vill ta dina allra första steg in i yrket. På våra restauranger finns alla möjliga roller; allt från köksbiträden och diskare, till kockar och souschefs.

Du arbetar i en unik miljö med service i toppklass och samarbetar dagligen med kollegor inom kök, servering, disk och värdskap – alla med samma mål: att skapa minnesvärda upplevelser för alla våra gäster.

Så ser en vaaanlig dag ut Dagens to-do: skapa magi. Det gör du genom att:

  • Laga smakrika rätter av hög kvalitet och bidra till en matupplevelse som får gästerna att vilja komma tillbaka.

  • Planera, förbereda och säkerställa ett effektivt flöde i köket – med fokus på kvalitet, tempo och noggrannhet i varje servering.

  • Samarbeta tätt med köksteamet för att leda det dagliga arbetet, stötta kollegor och skapa en positiv arbetsmiljö där alla kan prestera på topp.

  • Säkerställa att köket håller hög standard när det gäller hygien, livsmedelssäkerhet, ordning och reda, samtidigt som du bidrar till en trygg och trivsam arbetsplats.

Passar vi ihop? Hos oss på Liseberg är ensam inte stark och att sätta kollegor och gäster i första rummet är för dig en självklarhet. Vi söker dig som delar våra värdeord; omtanke, kreativitet, säkerhet, kvalitet och glädje och med dessa vill du vara med och skapa Liseberg.

Har du vad som krävs för åkturen?

  • Du har ett genuint intresse för matlagning, restaurangbranschen och att skapa fina upplevelser för gäster.

  • Du är uthållig, slutför det du åtagit dig och trivs med tempoväxlingar

  • Du uppskattar att ge ett gott bemötande till både gäster och kollegor

  • Du har goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska

  • Som kock och souschef söker vi dig som har utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av att arbeta som kock.

  • Som köksbiträde eller servicemedarbetare söker vi dig som är driven, engagerad och nyfiken på restaurangbranschen.

Bra att veta

  • Anställningsform: Särskild visstidsanställning, alt. säsongsanställning med varierande sysselsättningsgrad

  • Kollektivavtal: HRF

  • Bakgrundskontroller kan bli aktuellt senare i processen

  • Sista ansökningsdag är 27 september men vi rekryterar löpande hela säsongen - så skicka in din ansökan redan nu!

Fackliga kontakter

  • HRF: hrf-gc@liseberg.se

  • Unionen: Ewa Woldemar - unionen@liseberg.se

Om du har frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Lisebergs TA team via jobb@liseberg.se.

På vår hemsida www.liseberg.se kan du läsa mer om oss som arbetsplats.

Ta första steget och skicka in din ansökan!

title: Legal Coordination Assistant

The position requires someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and dependable in following through on responsibilities.
You will also communicate directly with clients, ensuring missing information is collected and questions or requests are handled professionally.

title: Maison Marunouchi Commis 2
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Nestled in the vibrant Marunouchi district, just minutes from Tokyo Station and Ginza, the newly renovated Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi offers a rare sense of intimacy. With only 57 rooms and suites, the hotel welcomes guests into a tranquil sanctuary in the heart of Japan’s iconic capital. Reimagined as a contemporary manor, it combines elegant design with the warmth of home, offering an elevated expression of residential living. Highly personalised service, bespoke experiences and tailored itineraries unlock Tokyo’s endless possibilities for exploration, while memorable dining awaits at SÉZANNE, the award-winning French restaurant, and Maison Marunouchi, the hotel’s all-day bistro.

Position Summary

The Commis I / Commis II position is based in the Main Kitchen, Pastry, or Banquet Department and reports directly to the Assistant Pastry Chef or Junior Sous Chef. The primary responsibility of this role is to prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu items according to guest orders while adhering to established production requirements, quality standards, and food safety procedures. The role requires maintaining a safe, clean, and sanitary working environment at all times.

Education and Experience Requirements

Candidates should possess a high school diploma or equivalent qualification. A minimum of two years of culinary or related work experience is required. Advanced culinary knowledge is expected for this position, and previous supervisory experience is considered an advantage. Practical working knowledge is generally acquired through hands-on experience in a professional kitchen environment. No travel is required for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Teamwork and Professional Conduct

The Commis is expected to maintain positive and professional relationships with colleagues, supervisors, and employees across all departments. The role requires full compliance with Four Seasons' work rules, standards of conduct, and company policies. Employees are also expected to assist in other areas of the department whenever operational needs require support.

Food Preparation and Kitchen Operations

Key duties include preparing food items according to guest orders while following recipe specifications, production standards, portion controls, and presentation guidelines. The Commis is responsible for completing mise en place and preparing stations for breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.

The position requires preparing ingredients in advance while avoiding unnecessary overproduction. Employees must operate, maintain, and properly clean all kitchen equipment, including fryers, broilers, stoves, steamers, food processors, mixers, slicers, ovens, steam tables, tilt kettles, waffle irons, and flat-top grills.

The Commis is also responsible for proper food storage and inventory management. This includes labeling and dating food containers, rotating stock according to company policies, monitoring food temperatures, checking inventory levels, identifying shortages, and ensuring unused food is returned to designated storage areas. Food waste, loss, and usage must be controlled according to company standards, and any losses or waste must be reported to the direct supervisor. The role may also involve assisting with food cost control initiatives and corrective action plans.

Additional tasks assigned by the Chef de Partie, Sous Chef, Assistant Pastry Chef, or Junior Sous Chef must be completed as required.

Asset and Resource Management

The Commis must help ensure that hotel facilities, equipment, and other physical assets are properly maintained. Hotel resources should be used efficiently, responsibly, and with cost awareness at all times.

Required Competencies

Behavioral Competencies

Successful candidates should demonstrate:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong ethical judgment and professionalism
  • Effective planning and resource management abilities
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • A safe, organized, and detail-oriented approach to work
  • A strong commitment to guest service excellence

Technical Skills and Knowledge

The position requires:

  • Flexibility to work various schedules as operationally required
  • Proficiency in operating office equipment such as telephones, scanners, copiers, and calculators
  • Working knowledge of computer systems and Microsoft Office applications
  • The ability to read, write, and speak both English and Japanese
  • Competence in operating, maintaining, and cleaning commercial kitchen equipment
  • Strong knife skills and culinary techniques
  • Effective multitasking capabilities

Functional Competencies

Employees in this role should possess:

  • A clear understanding of internal controls and compliance requirements
  • Knowledge of hotel quality standards and service standards
  • The ability to assist with preparation work for subsequent shifts, including vegetables, condiments, and other ingredients
  • A strong service-oriented mindset focused on operational excellence and guest satisfaction

Key Internal Stakeholders

The Commis regularly collaborates with the following positions:

  • Executive Chef
  • Executive Sous Chef
  • Chef de Cuisine
  • Pastry Chef
  • Banquet Chef
  • Sous Chef
  • Assistant Pastry Chef
  • Junior Sous Chef
  • Chef de Partie
  • Chief Baker

Overall Purpose of the Role

The Commis I / Commis II position plays a vital role in supporting the hotel's culinary operations by delivering high-quality food, maintaining food safety and hygiene standards, managing food costs responsibly, and contributing to a collaborative and service-focused kitchen environment. Through consistent execution of culinary standards and effective teamwork, the position helps ensure an exceptional dining experience for guests.

About Netwealth

Netwealth isn't just a company. We're shaping the future of wealth in Australia. Our award-winning platform and NextGen technology empower advisers and investors to achieve more, and we're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's most innovative FinTech businesses.

Since 1999, we've grown rapidly by challenging the status quo. We move fast, think big, and stay agile. Free from unnecessary bureaucracy so we can deliver smarter solutions for our clients and create real impact.

The Opportunity

Our People & Culture team plays a pivotal role in attracting, developing and supporting the people who make Netwealth successful. We're looking for a highly organised People & Learning Coordinator to provide essential operational support across both Learning & Development and People Operations.

This is a role for someone who loves organisation, process and getting things done. You'll help coordinate training programs, manage learning records and compliance, maintain shared inboxes, support employee benefits, and keep a wide range of people processes moving forward.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and reduce manual effort

This role offers strong development opportunities. As your knowledge grows, you'll build exposure across both Learning & Development and People Operations, creating pathways into broader P&C and specialist roles.

About you:

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds. What matters most is your ability to stay organised, manage multiple priorities, follow through, and maintain a high level of accuracy and discretion.

You enjoy bringing order to complexity and take pride in keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes. You're proactive, reliable and comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once, ensuring deadlines are met and nothing falls through the cracks.

We're proud of our inclusive and diverse workforce and encourage everyone to bring their genuine selves to work. It's one of our core values. And we're certified by WORK180, Family Friendly Workplaces and Great Places to Work.

title: Lead Electronic Hardware Engineer (PCB Layout)
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Create and maintain PCB component libraries, including schematic symbols, PCB footprints, and related design attributes in accordance with industry standards and company guidelines.

  • Extract mechanical, electrical, thermal, and assembly-related information from component datasheets to develop accurate library parts and design constraints.

  • Validate component footprints and land patterns against manufacturer recommendations and applicable IPC standards.

  • Design and develop high-density multilayer PCB layouts (6-22 layers) for analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power electronics designs.

  • Define PCB stack-ups, component placement, routing strategies, and design constraints.

  • Apply EMI/EMC design practices to ensure robust product performance and regulatory compliance.

  • Implement clearance, creepage, and safety requirements to support UL and related certifications.

  • Generate manufacturing-ready PCB documentation and release packages.

  • Collaborate with hardware, mechanical, manufacturing, and sourcing teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Ensure designs meet DFM, DFA, and DFT requirements for efficient assembly, testability, and production.

  • Support prototype builds, design reviews, and resolution of fabrication and assembly issues.

  • Periodically review, update and develop Check lists, Process documents, PCB specs, Knowledge base and Quality documents in line with latest technology trends.


Who You Are:

  • Detail-oriented and passionate about delivering high-quality PCB designs.

  • A strong collaborator who works effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

  • A proactive problem solver with a focus on quality, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • An effective communicator with strong verbal and written communication skills.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • 8-12 years of hands-on PCB layout experience.

  • Proven experience designing high-density multilayer PCBs (6-22 layers).

  • Strong knowledge of EMI/EMC design principles and PCB design best practices.

  • Good understanding of clearance, creepage, insulation coordination, and safety requirements for UL-certified products.

  • Experience with PCB fabrication, assembly processes, and DFM/DFA/DFT requirements.

  • Proficiency in PCB design tools such as Altium Designer and Mentor Graphics Expedition/Xpedition.

  • Ability to work from schematics and collaborate closely with hardware design engineers.

  • Strong ability to interpret component datasheets and extract package, electrical, assembly, and design-rule information required for PCB implementation.

  • Hands-on experience in creating and maintaining schematic symbols, PCB footprints, and component libraries.

  • Good understanding of IPC footprint standards and component package technologies including QFN, BGA, LGA, fine-pitch SMT, and through-hole components.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Experience in industrial automation, instrumentation, embedded systems, or power electronics products.

  • Knowledge of high-speed PCB design considerations, signal integrity, and power integrity concepts.

  • Familiarity with IPC standards and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Experience working directly with PCB fabrication and EMS partners.

  • Ability to mentor junior designers and contribute to PCB design best practices.


Our Culture & Commitment to You:
  • At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, specifically the ability to identify manual bottlenecks and propose automated solutions.

title: Bergarbetare till tillredningen
description:
Vill du arbeta nära produktionen och bidra till en säker och effektiv vardag under jord? Vi söker nu en bergarbetare till tillredningen.

Den hållbara omställningen börjar med oss

Vi står inför vår största utmaning hittills – att se till att Sverige och Europa har det som krävs för att ställa om. Så att vi kan leva det liv vi vill, nu och imorgon. På samma sätt som vi vill förbättra framtiden, vill vi utveckla alla som är med oss på resan, personligt och professionellt. Vill du vara med och lägga grunden för det liv vi lever och som bygger världen omkring oss?

Din roll

Som bergarbetare i tillredningen är du en viktig del av produktionen där du arbetar med både borrning och skrotning i ortdrivningen. Du ingår i ett team som samarbetar tätt med andra funktioner för att säkerställa ett effektivt och säkert arbetsflöde.

  • Borrning inför sprängning i ortdrift
  • Skrotning för att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö
  • Daglig tillsyn och enklare underhåll av maskiner
  • Samverkan med kollegor och andra yrkesroller i området
  • Bidra till en säker och effektiv produktion

Arbetet ger dig variation i vardagen och möjlighet att utveckla både din tekniska kompetens och samarbetsförmåga.

Det här har du med dig

Vi söker dig som tar ansvar för ditt arbete och bidrar till en säker och stabil verksamhet. Du har ett gott säkerhetstänk och arbetar strukturerat även i högt tempo. Med ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt och god samarbetsförmåga bidrar du till teamets gemensamma mål, samtidigt som du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt när det krävs.

Krav: ​

  • Gymnasial utbildning
  • B-körkort​ för manuell växellåda
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift ​

Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet från arbete i gruva
  • Maskinvana inom exempelvis borriggar eller lastmaskiner
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!​

Vi strävar efter en rättvis och objektiv rekryteringsprocess. Därför ber vi vanligtvis inte om personliga brev. I stället ber vi dig att svara på frågor relaterat till den specifika tjänsten du söker. Dina svar hjälper oss att förstå din kompetens och erfarenhet, så ta dig tid att svara så tydligt och utförligt som möjligt.

Ansökningar behandlas löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Start: Enligt överenskommelse.

Plats: Malmberget, under jord

Omfattning: Skiftgång k2.3

Kontakt: För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Mattias Lantto via mattias.lantto@lkab.com

Facklig kontakt:

IF Metall (Kiruna), Anders Elenius anders.elenius@lkab.comIF Metall Gruv 4:an (Malmberget), Tomas Larsson Thomas.L.Larsson@lkab.comIF Metall 135:an (Svappavaara), Peter Nordström Peter.Nordstrom@lkab.comIF Metall Malmhamnen (Luleå), Johan Ömlén johan.omlen@lkab.com

LKAB är en internationell gruv- och mineralkoncern med norra Sverige som bas och hela världen som arbetsplats. Vileder vägen mot koldioxidfri produktion och vi gör det tillsammans – i en öppen, varm och säker arbetsmiljö medteknologi och utveckling i fokus. Vi välkomnar utmaningar, innovativa idéer och initiativförmåga, alltid medjämställdhet och mångfald i fokus.

title: Associate Scientist Chem - Analytical (R)
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Pfizer’s purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. At the core of fulfilling this purpose is our commitment to Research and Development, where we strive to translate advanced science and technologies into the therapies and vaccines that matter most. Whether you are involved in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, you will leverage cutting-edge design and process development capabilities to accelerate and deliver best-in-class medicines to patients globally.

What You Will Achieve

As an Associate Scientist – PAT Specialist, you will be a key member of the cross-functional PCMM (Pfizer Continuous Manufacturing Module) team, providing technical expertise for Process Analytical Technology (PAT) instrumentation within a clinical solid oral dose GMP manufacturing environment. You will provide analytical support to manufacturing campaigns, manage & maintain analytical instrumentation, and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of drug product manufacturing processes. Your role will blend hands-on instrument management with analytical method development, data analysis, and cross-team collaboration.

In this role, you will:

  • Maintain PAT analytical instrumentation (e.g., NIR, FBRM Instruments, APC Software) for manufacturing campaigns, including preparation, installation, calibration, and performance checks.
  • Monitor instrumentation output during campaigns using advanced process control software & real-time dashboards & analytics.
  • Contribute to system life cycle (SLC) documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical reports.
  • Effectively interact with project team members for various tasks including presentation of data and critical review of data and preparation of technical reports.
  • Interact effectively with peers and leaders as part of a multi-disciplinary team and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, strong organizational skills, the ability to multitask and meet project timelines.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Analytical Chemistry or related field, 0 to 2 years relevant experience either in a lab/manufacturing environment, or an academic or industrial research lab.
  • Ability to meet project milestones under general supervision, support expectations for specific projects, ensure delivery of technology/transfer/submission-ready technology, data and documents.
  • Experience in problem-solving skills and instrument troubleshooting.
  • Ability to adhere to safe laboratory practices.
  • Good oral and written communication skills with high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, team oriented, effective interpersonal and communication skills.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience with PAT instrumentation (NIR, FBRM), APC software, and/or data analysis in a GMP environment.


Relocation support available

Work Location Assignment: On Premise


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $60,200.00 to $100,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.

title: Lead Instructional Designer
description:
We are on the lookout for a Lead Instructional Designer to join our team.

Our Workforce Experience team assists clients in advancing digital and IT transformation by identifying and addressing gaps in employee knowledge, behaviors, and mindset. We conceive, produce, and deploy a wide variety of solutions for both online and in-person learning, including videos, articles, podcasts, interactive eLearning, coaching, experiential learning, instructor-led training, and assessments, all informed by the latest research in the learning sciences. In short, we go beyond "training" to craft learning experiences that truly make an impact.

Responsibilities

  • Team up with Subject Matter Experts to identify the learning and enablement needs of the intended audiences
  • Establish learning objectives that align with learner traits and program goals
  • Review, refresh, or build content that clearly supports learning objectives and preferred delivery formats
  • Shape compelling learning activities that reinforce and enrich the overall learning journey
  • Produce storyboards and work hand in hand with multimedia developers to bring concepts to life as engaging instructional materials
  • Picture the instructional graphics, user interfaces, and complete product experiences before production begins
  • Craft assessment methods to measure the impact of individual elements, modules, or full courses
  • Maintain well-structured project documentation and course folders across the entire delivery cycle

  • Hands-on background with authoring tools such as Captivate, Articulate Storyline and RISE, or Evolve for producing sophisticated adaptive learning content
  • Working knowledge of instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, backward design, e-learning blueprint, design thinking, and interactive learning experiences
  • Firm understanding of adult learning theory alongside multimedia design fundamentals
  • Keen sense for visual design and layout composition
  • Ease working in a dynamic and quickly changing environment
  • Confident English communication abilities at B2 level or above, in both writing and speech, along with attentive listening and clear expression
  • Enthusiasm, motivation, an upbeat outlook, and a "can-do" attitude when tackling challenges
  • Skill to handle several projects at once, set priorities well, work independently, and meet tight deadlines

  • Ability to build rapport and cultivate trust and confidence with clients and coworkers alike
  • Flexible thinking and agile approach to deliverables, with the capability to adjust style for varied stakeholder groups
  • Resilience and the ability to remain effective under time pressure while balancing workload and priorities

Nice to have

  • Strong capabilities in multimedia development and graphic design to elevate the quality of learning materials
  • Experience creating AI-driven learning and enablement solutions or AI-powered agents
  • Understanding of content compliance requirements linked to usability standards, Section 508, and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses

  • EPAM Employee Groups
  • Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

Taiwan

title: Deputy/Assistant Director, Financial Advisers Supervision
description:
[What the role is]

The Financial Advisers Supervision Department (FAS) is responsible for admitting and supervising financial advisory intermediaries (including banks and insurers that provide financial advisory services) and insurance brokers.

FAS supervises and administers rules and regulations under the Financial Advisers Act and Insurance Act (on parts relating to insurance intermediaries) to uphold standards of market conduct among intermediaries and their representatives.

[What you will be working on]

  • Part of a team responsible for the supervision of financial institutions conducting financial advisory and insurance broking activities. This includes banks and insurers which carry out financial advisory activities, as well as licensed financial advisers.

  • Involved in assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of financial institutions’ risk management systems and internal controls, and market conduct practices, through both onsite inspection and offsite review.

  • Involved in reviews related to the supervision of financial institutions, legislative changes, and current processes.

  • Involved in conducting data analytics, such as refining or developing supervisory indicators, or performing such analysis as part of your supervision of financial institutions.

  • Opportunities to interact with other departments in MAS, as well as external parties such as audit firms, industry bodies, foreign regulators, and other government agencies.

[What we are looking for]

  • Strong audit and analytical skills, and ability to pay attention to details, as well as identify broad trends and issues

  • Possess knowledge and experience in the use of AI to solve business and operational problems

  • Comfortable and familiar with working with data, including using data visualisation tools to analyse and present findings effectively. Knowledge and experience in advanced analytics is an advantage.

  • Possess good written and verbal communication skills

  • Good working knowledge and experience in financial institutions conducting financial advisory activities

  • Ability to multi-task and keep to tight timelines

  • Self-motivated and driven

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

title: Tekninen myyjä sähkötekniikan pariin, Stenbacka
description:
Tekninen myyjä - Oy T. Stenbacka Ab

Nautitko tien päällä työskentelystä tutustuen asiakkaiden muuttuviin tarpeisiin? Tunnetko sähkötekniikan toimialan ja sen tuotteiston? Innostutko asiakassuhteiden kehittämisestä ja myynnin tehostamisesta?

Voit olla kaipaamamme henkilö!

Etsimme teknistä myyjää vahvistamaan Stenbackan tiimiä Pornaisiin 15 minuutin päähän Järvenpäästä. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten tuotteiden ja asiakkuuksien parissa sekä kehittämään myyntiä aktiivisesti koko Suomen sekä Baltian alueella.

Stenbacka on palvellut asiakkaitaan sähköteknisen alan agentuuri- ja tukkuliikkeenä jo kuudenkymmenen vuoden ajan. Stenbacka toimittaa raaka-aineita, tuotteita ja tarvikkeita teollisuudelle, kunnossapidolle, korjaamoille ja tukkuliikkeille sekä tarjoavat räätälöityjä valmistus- ja alihankkijapalveluita sähkömoottoreiden, muuntajien, kaapeleiden ja muiden kojeiden valmistajille. Ainoana yrityksenä Suomessa Stenbackalla on oma sähkömoottoreiden hiiliharjojen tuotanto. Stenbackalle tärkeää työskentelyssä on vastuuntuntoinen ote ja yhteisen tekemisen meininki, oli käsillä sitten mikä työtehtävä vaan.

Stenbacka on yksi Star Works Group Oy korsenin kuudesta yhtiöstä. Konsernilla on toimintaa ja tuotantolaitoksia Suomessa, Virossa sekä Puolassa sähköteknisellä alalla.

Tehtävässä

Toimit teknisenä myyjänä vastaten sekä nykyisten asiakassuhteiden ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä että uusien mahdollisuuksien löytämisestä.

Tyypillinen työviikkosi sisältää muun muassa:

* asiakaskäyntejä ja aktiivista yhteydenpitoa Suomen ja Baltian asiakkaiden kanssa

* asiakkaiden tarpeiden ymmärtämistä ja teknisten ratkaisujen tarjoamista

* uusien asiakkaiden kartoittamista ja myynnin kasvattamista

* tarjousten tekemistä ja tilausten hoitamista alusta loppuun

* yhteistyötä myyntitiimin ja tuotannon kanssa

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa asiakaskentällä tai Stenbackan toimistolla Pornaisissa. Etätyöskentelyä on mahdollista toteuttaa tällä hetkellä kahtena päivänä viikossa.

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos

* osaat johtaa ja ottaa vastuuta omasta työskentelystäsi

* haluat kehittää asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti

* viihdyt tien päällä ja asiakastyön parissa tehden omat aikataulusi

* uskallat ehdottaa ja rakentaa uudenlaisia ratkaisuja asiakkaille

* työskentelet itsenäisesti hyödyntäen Stenbackan osaavaa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* teknistä korkeakoulutaustaa, kuten sähkö- tai konetekniikan insinööriopintoja tai teknisen myyjän koulutusta

* tuntemusra sähkötekniikan toimialasta ja tuotteistosta

* aiempaa työkokemusta B2B-myynnistä ja asiakassuhteiden hallinnasta, erityisesti liikkuvasta myyntityöstä

* oma-aloitteista, itsenäistä ja proaktiivista työotetta

* mahdollisuutta matkustaa töiden yhteydessä Suomen ja Baltian alueella asiakastapaamisissa

* hyvää englannin ja ruotsin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa

Eduksi katsotaan

* Aiempaa kokemusta asiakkuuksien ja myynnin kehittämisestä

Tehtävässä et tarvitse vuosikymmenien myyntikokemusta - tärkeintä on ymmärrys sähkötekniikan alasta sekä oma-aloitteinen asenne myyntityötä kohtaan!

Mitä Stenbacka tarjoaa?

* pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden vakaassa ja ammattitaitoisessa teollisuuden yrityksessä

* kansainvälisen työroolin

* kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään roolin edeltäjältä

* monipuolisen ja itsenäisen työnkuvan

* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa roolia ja asiakkuuksia

* palkkaus: 3200 - 3800 € / kk + bonusmallin

* vapaa autoetu tai kustannukset oman auton käytöstä

* hyvät työterveyspalvelut ja työsuhde-edut

* työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan kesän aikana

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi työpaikkailmoituksen Hae paikkaa -linkin kautta ja kerro meille, miksi olisit juuri sopiva henkilö rooliin!

Hakemuksesi tallentuu järjestelmäämme. Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lisätietoa tehtävästä sähköpostitse osoitteessa aino@wellpack.fi [aino@wellpack.fi].

Wellpack toimii Stenbackan yhteistyökumppanina tässä rekrytoinnissa. Wellpack on vuonna 2013 perustettu korkealaatuisia henkilöstöpalveluita tarjoava yritys. Wellpack tunnetaan erityisesti teollisuuden ja puolustusteollisuuden luottokumppanina. Yhdistämme osaavat työntekijät laadukkaisiin työpaikkoihin ja rakennamme kotimaista työllisyyttä.
