title: Strategic Insurance Producer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Insurance Producer based in the United States.

This remote leadership role is focused on driving insurance sales performance, premium growth, and product adoption within a commercial lending environment.
You will take ownership of insurance production while connecting commercial financing with risk mitigation solutions.
The role combines direct sales execution, business development, strategic program growth, and insurance expertise.
You will work closely with branch teams, executive leaders, legal and compliance stakeholders, and external insurance partners.
Your insights will help shape product roadmaps, improve embedded insurance experiences, and strengthen portfolio risk management.
The position offers significant autonomy and an entrepreneurial environment where measurable commercial impact is highly valued.
Success will be measured through premium growth, market penetration, revenue generation, and sustained insurance coverage across financed dealer assets.

Accountabilities

  • Drive insurance production: Own insurance sales performance across the branch network, actively increasing product penetration, closing opportunities, and maximizing premium growth.
  • Execute market strategies: Partner with branch teams and sales leadership to implement insurance distribution strategies, communicate value propositions, and remove barriers to adoption.
  • Enable sales teams: Train and support field teams on insurance solutions, risk mitigation benefits, customer positioning, and effective sales practices.
  • Accelerate product adoption: Drive the rollout and adoption of insurance features embedded within digital floorplan checkout and financing workflows.
  • Shape product strategy: Provide field-level insights that inform insurance product roadmaps, growth strategies, and market opportunities.
  • Manage insurance partnerships: Collaborate with carriers, underwriters, fronting partners, managing general agents, reinsurers, and actuarial partners.
  • Optimize financial performance: Monitor premium volume, non-interest revenue, program penetration, claims efficiency, and portfolio loss-ratio performance.
  • Strengthen risk management: Help mitigate credit exposure by supporting continuous, high-quality insurance coverage across financed dealer assets.
  • Maintain compliance: Ensure sales execution, marketing materials, product delivery, and customer interactions comply with applicable multi-state insurance regulations and internal standards.
  • Improve customer and operational workflows: Establish consistent frameworks for product delivery, claims routing, retention, and embedded insurance experiences.

    • Requirements

    • 7+ years of experience in commercial insurance production, insurance program management, bank-embedded insurance, or a comparable insurance leadership environment.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
    • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) producer license, or the ability to obtain one within an agreed-upon timeframe.
    • Demonstrated success scaling commercial insurance programs within banking, lending, automotive finance, or another complex financial services environment.
    • Deep knowledge of commercial P&C insurance, collateral protection insurance (CPI), dealer open-lot structures, and commercial risk management.
    • Strong understanding of commercial lending, automotive floorplan financing, banking frameworks, insurance underwriting principles, policy structures, and regulatory requirements.
    • Experience managing relationships with insurance carriers, fronting partners, reinsurers, MGAs, and program administrators.
    • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including premium modeling, revenue optimization, penetration analysis, claims performance, and loss-ratio assessment.
    • Familiarity with insurance agency management systems, risk management platforms, loan origination systems, and digital embedded-insurance workflows.
    • Strong data fluency and ability to translate performance metrics into actionable commercial strategies.
    • Excellent communication, prioritization, influencing, and executive presentation skills.
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build, scale, and manage programs in a complex, cross-functional environment.
    • Collaborative approach and demonstrated ability to work effectively across sales, finance, credit, legal, compliance, technology, and external partner teams.
    • Preferred: Advanced insurance designations such as CPCU, CIC, or CRM.
    • Preferred: Experience with digital marketplaces, wholesale automotive ecosystems, or floorplan management platforms.

      • Benefits

title: Kiipulan ammattiopisto
description:
Haluatko työskennellä nuorten parissa? Haemme Janakkalan toimipaikkaan OHJAAJAA TELMA-koulutukseen. Pääset tekemään ihmisläheistä ja arvokasta työtä hyvässä työyhteisössä.

Ohjaajan tehtävänä on opiskelijoiden ohjaus opetus- ja työtilanteissa sekä päivittäistoiminnoissa.

Arvostamme kehittävää ja itsenäistä työotetta, hyviä yhteistyö- ja tiimitaitoja sekä kykyä työskennellä erilaisissa oppimisympäristöissä ja tilanteissa. Hyvät edellytykset toimia tehtävässä antaa joko koulutusalaan liittyvä tai muu soveltuva tutkinto sekä työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Eduksi katsotaan myös kokemus erityisryhmien ohjaamisesta ja alueellisen palveluverkoston tuntemus.

Työ alkaa 14.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävä on määräaikainen 16.12.2026 asti. Työaika on keskimäärin 38,25 h/vko. Käytössämme on tasoittumisjaksojärjestelmä eli viikoittainen työaika voi vaihdella. Palkkaus on yksityisen opetusalan työehtosopimuksen mukainen. Tehtävässä on 1,5 kk koeaika ja koulun loma-aikoja koskeva keskeytysehto. Valitun henkilön tulee ennen tehtävässä aloittamista esittää lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Kiinnostuitko? Laita hakemuksesi mieluummin meille jo tänään, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään maanantaihin 31.8.2026 mennessä. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi osaamisestasi, taustastasi ja mielenkiinnon kohteistasi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa koulutuspäällikkö Sari Rautiainen p. 040 655 0485 sari.rautiainen@kiipula.fi.

Tämä on meidän yhteinen duuni! Tervetuloa mukaan joukkoon!






Tarjoamme


- Liikunta- ja kulttuuri (ePassi)

- Lounasetu (ePassi)

- Hyvinvointi (ePassi)

- Ajasta ja paikasta riippumaton työterveyshuolto



Kiipulan ammattiopisto

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä yhdessä alan ammattilaisten kanssa? Me Kiipulassa tarjoamme sinulle paikan, jossa merkityksellinen työ ja hyvät työsuhde-edut kohtaavat.

Kiipulan ammattiopisto on ammatillinen erityisoppilaitos. Järjestämme valmentavaa koulutusta ja ammatillista perustutkintokoulutusta erityisopetuksena. Meille hakevalla opiskelijalla tulee olla opiskeluun liittyvä erityisen tuen tarve. Opinnot suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti ja opintoja tehdään pienryhmissä, tekemällä ja työssä oppien.

Kiipulan ammattiopisto toimii viidessä maakunnassa, nyt jo yhdeksällä paikkakunnalla. Toimipaikkamme ovat Janakkala, Hämeenlinna, Forssa, Tampere, Nokia, Lahti, Kouvola, Sastamala, Valkeakoski ja Vantaa.

Ammattiopistoa ylläpitää Kiipulasäätiö. Kokonaisuuteemme kuuluu ammattiopiston lisäksi Kiipulapalvelut, Kiipula Gardens sekä Avire Oy. Palveluksessamme on noin 520 alan ammattilaista. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Kiipulassa unelmana on yhdenvertainen ja esteetön yhteiskunta, jossa työn tekeminen ja hyvä elämä ovat mahdollisuutena kaikille. Toimimme vastuullisesti ja olemme siitä ylpeitä! Olemmekin saaneet [Yhteiskunnallinen yritys -merkin](https://www.kiipula.fi/kiipulasaation-organisaatio-ja-toiminta/yhteiskunnallinen-yritys/).

Arvomme ovat aikaansaavuus, ihmisyys ja kumppanuus. Toivomme, että toimintamme on lähellä omia arvojasi ja tulet toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa. Löydät lisää toiminnastamme [verkkosivuiltamme](https://www.kiipula.fi/).

Millaista on työskentely Kiipulassa?

Tutustu työntekijätarinoihimme ja -videoihimme [Töihin Kiipulaan -sivulla](https://kiipula.fi/toihin-kiipulaan/). Sivulta löydät myös lisätietoa arvoistamme ja työsuhde-eduistamme.

Sähköposti: rekry@kiipula.fi Sijainti: Kiipulantie 507, Turenki

title: Bergarbetare till tillredningen
description:
Vill du arbeta nära produktionen och bidra till en säker och effektiv vardag under jord? Vi söker nu en bergarbetare till tillredningen.

Den hållbara omställningen börjar med oss

Vi står inför vår största utmaning hittills – att se till att Sverige och Europa har det som krävs för att ställa om. Så att vi kan leva det liv vi vill, nu och imorgon. På samma sätt som vi vill förbättra framtiden, vill vi utveckla alla som är med oss på resan, personligt och professionellt. Vill du vara med och lägga grunden för det liv vi lever och som bygger världen omkring oss?

Din roll

Som bergarbetare i tillredningen är du en viktig del av produktionen där du arbetar med både borrning och skrotning i ortdrivningen. Du ingår i ett team som samarbetar tätt med andra funktioner för att säkerställa ett effektivt och säkert arbetsflöde.

  • Borrning inför sprängning i ortdrift
  • Skrotning för att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö
  • Daglig tillsyn och enklare underhåll av maskiner
  • Samverkan med kollegor och andra yrkesroller i området
  • Bidra till en säker och effektiv produktion

Arbetet ger dig variation i vardagen och möjlighet att utveckla både din tekniska kompetens och samarbetsförmåga.

Det här har du med dig

Vi söker dig som tar ansvar för ditt arbete och bidrar till en säker och stabil verksamhet. Du har ett gott säkerhetstänk och arbetar strukturerat även i högt tempo. Med ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt och god samarbetsförmåga bidrar du till teamets gemensamma mål, samtidigt som du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt när det krävs.

Krav: ​

  • Gymnasial utbildning
  • B-körkort​ för manuell växellåda
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift ​

Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet från arbete i gruva
  • Maskinvana inom exempelvis borriggar eller lastmaskiner
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!​

Vi strävar efter en rättvis och objektiv rekryteringsprocess. Därför ber vi vanligtvis inte om personliga brev. I stället ber vi dig att svara på frågor relaterat till den specifika tjänsten du söker. Dina svar hjälper oss att förstå din kompetens och erfarenhet, så ta dig tid att svara så tydligt och utförligt som möjligt.

Ansökningar behandlas löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Plats: Malmberget, under jord

Omfattning: Skiftgång k2.3

title: QC Engineer
description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities :

As a QC Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to deployment. You will be responsible for ensuring that our products and services are of the highest quality when we deliver them to our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Requirement clarification: understand both the functional and non-functional requirements of the software by collaborating with stakeholders to ensure all aspects are well-defined, documented, and aligned with project goals.
  • Develop Test Strategy & Test Case: create and apply testing strategies by designing detailed test cases that address all functional and performance aspects of the software.
  • Executing Tests: execute test cases to assess the functionality, performance, and security of the product. This can include both manual and automated testing, based on the product's technical and functional requirements.
  • Defects Management: identifying, tracking, and resolving defects in a software. It includes prioritizing defects, assigning them for fixes, re-testing after fixes, and closing resolved issues.
  • Improvement: continuously improve the testing infrastructure to enhance its reliability and scalability.
  • Collaboration: coordinate with developers and other stakeholders to address issues and improve product performance and quality improvement.

    Pre-Requisites :

    Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
    • At least 2 years of experience as a QC engineer.
    • Experience in testing APIs, Web Services, and Database.
    • Experience with testing tool: Postman, JMeter.
    • Experience in doing automation tests for API, and UI by using automation libraries such as Selenium, Playwright
    • Expertise in various types of testing, including penetration testing, functional testing, automation testing, and performance testing.
    • Strong analysis and design skills, capable to develop testing framework and integrate solutions.
    • Have experience working testing methods, with white box, black box, etc.
    • Strong knowledge and ability in using and setting up test environments
    • Based in Ho Chi Minh city

    Plus:

    • ISTQB or equivalent testing certificate.
    • Working experience in game publishing industry.

title: Stödassistent
description:
1 plats(er).

Verksamhets- och arbetsplatsbeskrivning

Är du en trygg, engagerad och flexibel person med ett hjärta som klappar för att stötta personer med olika funktionsnedsättningar? Då kan du vara den vi söker till DV Gruvgatan!

Vi letar efter dig som:

  • Har ett genuint intresse för människor och tycker om att ha många bollar i luften.
  • Är lösningsfokuserad och tycker om att skapa struktur.
  • Trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och har lätt för att bygga goda relationer.
  • Gillar att leda aktiviteter och skapa meningsfulla stunder samt har fingertoppskänsla för vår målgrupp.

Låter det här som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Arbetsuppgifter

Som stödassistent hos oss arbetar du med att stötta deltagare i deras dagliga verksamhet utifrån individuella behov och våra gruppaktiviteter. Du planerar och genomför aktiviteter – både i grupp och enskilt – med målet att skapa en meningsfull och glädjefylld dag.

I arbetet ingår mycket samarbete med andra aktörer som HSL, Kommunrehab, MOS och Mark och service.

Du samarbetar nära kollegor, vilket kräver god samarbetsförmåga, flexibilitet och ansvarstagande. Dokumentation och uppföljning av genomförandeplaner är också en viktig del av ditt uppdrag.

Vi erbjuder

  • Ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad varje dag.
  • Ett kreativt och stöttande arbetslag.
  • Flexibelt arbete ute i vårt vackra Falun.

Kvalifikationer

För rollen krävs:

  • Utbildad undersköterska eller utbildning och/eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta utifrån lågaffektiv metod
  • Erfarenhet inom LSS som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten
  • Erfarenhet av att hantera stressfyllda situationer
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort för manuell växellåda

Personliga egenskaper

Din närvaro är stabil och trygg, vilket skapar förtroende hos deltagaren. Du är flexibel och lösningsorienterad, och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Du hittar glädje i att skapa aktiviteter som får deltagarna att känna sig delaktiga och engagerade, och du gör detta med omsorg och ett empatiskt bemötande.

Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som samarbetar väl med både kollegor och chef. Du bidrar till att verksamheten håller fokus på deltagarnas bästa och du är med och skapar en positiv arbetsmiljö.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Utbildning eller erfarenhet av arbete inom området intellektuell funktionsnedsättning samt autism
  • Utbildad i lågaffektivt bemötande/Studio 3
  • Vana av att köra minibuss och flakbil

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med tillträde efter överenskommelse. Tjänsten är en dagtidstjänst måndag-fredag kl.7.45-15.45.

Bifoga gärna utbildningsintyg i din ansökan då det kommer att efterfrågas om du blir aktuell för tjänsten. Alternativt lämnas intyg i samband med intervju.

För att få anställning måste du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret vilket kommer att efterfrågas om anställning blir aktuell. Beställ gärna detta i samband med ansökan så att det finns tillgängligt om du blir aktuell för tjänsten.

Uppvisa B-körkort i samband med eventuell intervju.

Övrigt

När du skickar in din ansökan kommer du att få besvara urvalsfrågor som är ställda utifrån de krav som gäller för tjänsten. Dina svar är en viktig del av det första urvalet, så se till att svara utförligt och tydligt. I din ansökan ska du bifoga ditt CV, men du ska inte skicka in ett personligt brev – urvalsfrågorna ersätter detta.

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och därför undanber vi oss ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR. Vid problem med att genomföra din ansökan är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringscenter@falun.se

title: Quality Control Technician
description:
Disclosure

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Quality Control Technician to support digitization accuracy for the Bureau of Trust Fund Administration’s (BTFA) American Indian Records Repository (AIRR) by reviewing, validating, and correcting scanned document data. This role ensures compliance with SOPs and standards for metadata, coding, and document integrity.


Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

• Conduct quality control reviews of digitized documents to verify accuracy and completeness.
• Rescan documents when necessary to correct issues or improve clarity.
• Perform data validation, including updating and correcting metadata, coding, and database entries.
• Extract information from documents to support accurate metadata application.
• Follow SOPs for Quality Control Procedure and Quality Control Policy.
• Collaborate with digitization and document preparation staff to resolve data discrepancies.


Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

· High school diploma or equivalent.

· 1 year of relevant experience such as:
• Records management
• Document handling or digitization environments
• Administrative or clerical support roles involving data entry, file maintenance, or metadata correction

· Basic data entry and computer skills, including comfort working in databases, updating metadata, and following standard formats.

· Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and maintain consistency in quality control processes.

· Ability to work collaboratively with digitization and document preparation teams to address data discrepancies.

· Ability to obtain and maintain a moderate Public Trust adjudication and a PIV card.

· Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport to undergo commercial airfare travel

· Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license


Working Environment

This position primarily operates in a professional office setting with standard office equipment and a quiet, climate-controlled environment. While in the office, there is no regular exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery.


This role also requires periodic travel to project sites, including locations undergoing renovation or active construction. During site visits, the employee may be exposed to non-temperature-controlled environments, construction noise, dust, and other typical conditions found on job sites. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required during these visits, depending on site conditions. While on site visits, an individual in this role will be required to work atypical hours at the request of the client or role demands.


Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This is not a sedentary role. This role requires the ability to be on your feet moving around a construction site for most of the day interacting with contractors, contractor representatives, and inspecting the construction work that is being performed.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about outside in various geographic and building terrains to access a construction site to provide quality assurance services.

title: Product Manager
description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities :

The ideal candidate will play a key role in driving product strategy, planning, and execution. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, business, operations, sales, and customer support, to deliver high-quality products that align with business objectives and customer needs.

Key responsibilities include defining product requirements and roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, coordinating cross-functional project execution, prioritizing product enhancements, gathering and analyzing customer and market feedback, and ensuring successful product delivery while continuously improving product performance and user experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for payment solutions (Payment Gateway, Payouts, B2B/B2C Transfers, P2P, Collections, Recurring Payments, Card Acceptance, Digital Wallets, API/developer platform).
  • Conduct market, competitor, and customer research including emerging trends like embedded finance and cross-border payments to shape the roadmap and identify new opportunities.
  • Identify and scope AI/automation use cases (e.g., fraud detection, KYC/onboarding, customer support) with clear business impact.
  • Drive go-to-market execution with Sales and Marketing: positioning, pricing, launch, and customer enablement.

Delivery & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: ideation, business case, requirements, design, build, testing, launch, and optimization.
  • Prepare PRDs, user stories, and process flows; drive backlog prioritization and release planning.
  • Define and monitor product KPIs (transactions, adoption, reliability, revenue) and act on operational gaps and risks.

Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure products comply with regional/country regulations (AML/CFT, PCI DSS) and card scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard, and local networks).
  • Partner with Compliance and Risk teams early in the lifecycle to design compliant solutions.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

  • Partner cross-functionally (Engineering, Data Science/ML, Ops, Compliance, Risk, Sales, BD, Support) to deliver high-quality products.
  • Build relationships with banking partners, payment schemes, regulators, and tech/payment vendors; manage ongoing vendor communication.
  • Communicate roadmap, progress, risks, and delivery status to management and stakeholders.

Team & Culture

  • Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years in payments, fintech, or financial services.
  • Proven track record owning the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery to launch and post-launch optimization.
  • Working knowledge of payment infrastructure, Payout, card schemes, and digital payment methods (gateways, wallets, transfers, or acquiring).
  • Familiarity with regional financial regulations and compliance frameworks (e.g., AML/CFT, PCI DSS, KYC).
  • Skilled in product documentation PRDs, BRDs, user stories, and process flows.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to work across Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Operations.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Familiarity with agile/scrum methodologies and product management tools.



Pre-Requisites :

We are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and fair workplace for every employee across all the countries we operate in. title: Myyjä
description:
Pentik on liikekonseptiltaan poikkeuksellisen laaja-alainen ja rohkea perheyritys. On kokeiltu, saatu aikaiseksi sekä todettu, että lisääkin voi tehdä. Yritys on vuosien varrella kohdatuista haasteista ja joskus liiankin sinisilmäisestä periksiantamattomuudesta huolimatta noussut yhdeksi alansa johtavaksi tekijäksi. Pohjoisen karuudesta pyrimme jatkossakin löytämään kauneuden. Väriloiston syksystä, rauhallisuuden talvesta, kasvun keväästä ja elämän kesästä. Ja ohjaamaan kaiken kokemamme tuotteisiimme. Kiinnostaako sinua kaupan ala ja myyntityö? Nautitko asiakaskohtaamisista? Haluatko tarjota asiakkaille päivän parhaita hetkiä?

Me Pentikillä uskomme, että koti on paikka, jossa on hyvä olla! Haluamme luoda asiakkaillemme mielihyvää arkeen ja juhlaan. Myyjänä, olet etulinjassa kertomassa asiakkaillemme Pentikin upeaa tarinaa. Parasta myyjän työssä on se, että jokainen päivä ja asiakaskohtaaminen on erilainen. Työssäsi palvelet asiakkaitamme kokonaisvaltaisesti, etsien ratkaisuja heidän vaihteleviin tarpeisiinsa. Tuet ostopäätöksen tekoa niin tuotetiedolla kuin tarinoilla tuotteiden taustalla. Vastaat kollegoidesi kanssa siitä, että Posion logistiikkakeskuksestamme tulevat kuormat puretaan, että myymälä on houkutteleva, siisti ja valmiina alkaviin kampanjoihin.

Tällaisia asioita toivomme sinulta:

  • Iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta - hymysi ei hyydy kiireenkään keskellä

  • Motivoidut myyntitavoitteista ja niiden saavuttamisesta

  • Oma-aloitteellisuutta ja kykyä toimia yksin sekä ryhmässä

  • Kykyä työskennellä yksin myymälässä

  • Pystyt palvelemaan asiakkaita suomeksi

Jos sinulta löytyy edellä mainittujen lisäksi halua oppia sekä innokkuutta, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö! Tarjoamme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaa 10 h/vko sopimusta 15.9.2026 alkaen (tai aloitus sopimuksen mukaan), työvuoroja aukioloaikojemme puitteissa, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Sopimustunnit ovat keskimääräisiä viikkotuntimääriä, joten olethan varautunut viikoittaisten tuntimäärien vaihteluun. Työssäkäyntialue on Mikkelin talousalue.

title: ER DU DEN VOKSNE, DER KAN GÅ FORREST I GUMMISTØVLER, SYNGE HØJT, TØRRE TÅRER OG SKABE MAGISKE BØRNEØJEBLIKKE?
description:
Så læs lige med her… 🌿

Junglehuset søger en pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent 35–37 timer om ugen til vores skønne børnehave.

Hos os tror vi på, at børn udvikler sig bedst gennem nærvær, relationer, leg, grin og omsorg – og voksne, der virkelig VIL dem.

Vi holder til i hjertet af Bankager, omgivet af natur, bevægelse og fællesskab. Her har vi i gennemsnit 44 børnehavebørn, som er fordelt på to stuer.

Cirka en tredjedel af børnene er vores kommende skolebørn. De har deres helt egen stue og deres eget fællesskab, hvor vi skaber de bedste rammer for det sidste vigtige år inden skolestart.

Hverdagen i Junglehuset byder blandt andet på:

⚽ fodboldbaner og bevægelsespark
🐴 ture til rideskolen
🔥 bål, natur og udeliv
🎨 kreative læringsmiljøer
💚 små fællesskaber med plads til ALLE børn

Hos os er ingen dage ens.

Den ene dag bygger du motorikbane på gangen, den næste læser du historier under et træ – og pludselig står du midt i en dinosaurleg, et børnekram eller en meget vigtig snak om livet set fra en 4-årigs perspektiv.

🌿 VI ER PRIVATE – OG DET MÆRKES

I Junglehuset er der kort vej fra idé til handling.

Vi har en nærværende ledelse, korte beslutningsveje og plads til, at du kan sætte dit eget faglige aftryk på hverdagen.

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes tæt på børnene. Derfor får du hos os medindflydelse, faglig frihed og plads til initiativ og kreativitet – altid med børnene og deres fællesskaber i centrum.

🌱 VI SØGER DIG, SOM:

🌱 møder børn med varme, tydelighed og anerkendelse
🌱 skaber tryghed, udvikling og glæde
🌱 tør være fjollet, nysgerrig og nærværende
🌱 arbejder struktureret uden at miste fantasien
🌱 tror på relationer som det vigtigste fundament
🌱 har lyst til både at bidrage med dine egne idéer og være en del af et stærkt fællesskab

✨ HOS OS FÅR DU:

✨ et hus fyldt med liv, grin og høj faglighed
✨ kollegaer, der hjælper, løfter og spiller hinanden gode
✨ fantastiske rammer både inde og ude
✨ nærværende ledelse og reel medindflydelse
✨ frihed til at omsætte gode idéer til handling
✨ mulighed for at sætte dit faglige præg på børnenes hverdag
✨ løn og ansættelsesvilkår med udgangspunkt i gældende løntabeller hos BUPL og FOA

💚 I JUNGLEHUSET SKAL BØRN MÆRKE:

“Her hører jeg til. Her er jeg vigtig. Her bliver jeg set.”

Kan du se dig selv som en del af Junglehuset?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne møde dig. 💌

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller komme forbi og mærke huset og stemningen, er du også meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

📩 Ansøgning og CV sendes til Pia: pia@junglehuset.dk

Vi afholder løbende samtaler – så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

title: Regional Medical Advisor
description:
Job Summary
We are looking for the Primary scientific face of the organization to ‘Thought Leaders’ & physicians for a given therapy area. You will be responsible for Identification, mapping and profiling of thought leaders of given geography and therapy area, on an ongoing basis.

Roles & Responsibilities
• You will be responsible for the engagement of identified key thought leaders through medical affairs activities, in alignment with the overall strategic plan
• You will be responsible to execution of strategic medical affairs plan including but not limited to medical education, product education, medical evidence generation, advisory boards, pre-license activities and special projects
• You will be a therapeutic area scientific expert, responsible for discussing the scientific data pertaining to products on proactive and reactive basis, patients’ treatment trends and studies in the therapeutic areas in which the Company is involved, with defined audience of leading specialists (Physicians, Pharmacists, Hospital Managers, Board Members of Scientific Societies, and other Stakeholders) and to be considered a trusted scientific counterpart
• You will be responsible with therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals
• You will have to represent the organization in various internal & external scientific platforms
• You will have to gather deep insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders and conveying them back to the therapy lead and commercial teams.
• You will need to proactively conduct disease trend analysis in identified disease segments and contribute effectively to the development of annual Medical Affairs Strategy Plan
• You will be receiving and processing scientific information requests received from physicians
• You will have to ensure that all activities in the region are conducted in alignment to organisation’s COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines.
• You will need to collaborate with thought leaders to conduct therapy specific reviews, meta-analysis, case studies, case series, patient reported outcomes and publish them in reputed journals.
• You will be responsible for devising an optimal training plan to ensure the flow of the latest medical developments to the sales and marketing teams.
• You will jointly be responsible with the therapy area lead to support optimal patient outcomes through communication of data, information, knowledge, and insights in support of healthcare professional needs and organizational goals.
• Representing the organization in various internal and external scientific platforms will be among your responsibilities.
• You will be responsible for developing the Medical Affairs strategic plan for identified therapeutic areas and products.
• Your ability to convert insights on disease trends and treatment patterns from key thought leaders into viable and formidable strategic plans to shape the therapeutic areas of interest will be vital.
• You will be responsible for identifying knowledge gaps, practice gaps, and data gaps and developing strategic medical action plans, including but not limited to medical education, product education, evidence generation, and special projects, will fall under your responsibility.
• Collaborating with thought leaders to conduct therapy-specific reviews, meta-analysis, case studies, case series, patient-reported outcomes, and publishing them in reputable journals will be part of your role.
• Handling complex questions from healthcare professionals related to GGI products or disease areas to satisfaction will be a key responsibility.
• You will be responsible for ensuring that all activities in the therapeutic area are conducted in alignment with Dr. Reddy's COBE (Code of Business Ethics) Policy and compliance guidelines will be essential.
• You will be responsible for ensuring that all promotional, physician, and patient education materials are approved within stipulated timelines and in alignment with Dr. Reddy's Promotional Material approval policy.
• As a product pipeline champion, you will have the ability to identify unmet needs through active stakeholder interactions and actively contribute to the new product ideation and development of differentiated products.

Educational Qualification- MBBS with full time post-graduate qualification of at least 2-years’ duration in any discipline of medicine/ M.B.B.S with M.B.A. from a reputed institute

Minimum work experience- Fresh postgraduate or up to 2 years of experience in Field based Medical Affairs.

Skills & attributes –
Technical Skills
• Strong academic record with deep knowledge of the therapeutic area, strength in research with knowledge of research methodologies and interpretation of medical data
• Experience with scientific acumen and communication skills in order to be accepted by leading specialists in peer-to-peer relationship
• Experience with complex business environments preferred
• Strong track record of success as demonstrated through annual performance ratings and/or professional accomplishments and awards.
Behavioural Skills
• Integrity driven decision making skills
• Collaboration and teaming with ability to work in a matrix environment
• Strategic thinking & sound analytical skills
• Big picture orientation with attention to detail
• Sense of urgency & desire to excel
• Intellectual curiosity
• Self-awareness and adaptability
• Result oriented and performance driven
• Excellent interpersonal & communication skills to effectively interact with a broad range of audience.

About the Department
Global Generics India
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.

Benefits Offered
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

Our Work Culture
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/

title: Model Based Developer- LVEM
description:
About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities


· Develop unit test specifications for MBD/C components based on software requirements and design documents.

· Design and implement automated unit tests using TPT (Time Partition Testing) and Google Test (GTest) frameworks.

· Collaborate with software developers and system engineers to understand functional requirements and model behavior.

· Perform test execution, debugging, and analysis of test results to identify issues and ensure quality.

· Maintain and enhance test frameworks and infrastructure for continuous integration and automated testing.

· Document test cases, results, and coverage metrics to support software verification and validation.

· Participate in code reviews, model inspections, and test strategy discussions.

· Ensure compliance with automotive standards such as ASPICE (SWE 4.5.6) , ISO 26262, and MISRA where applicable.


Required Qualifications


· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, or related field and 3 to 7 years of working experience in Software Testing.

· Strong experience in Model-Based Design (MBD) using tools like MATLAB/Simulink.

· Hands-on experience with TPT/ vectorcast and GTest for unit testing in MIL/SIL environment.

· Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Shell).

· Experience with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, VT System)

· Familiarity with embedded systems, real-time software, and automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, etc.).

· Understanding of software development lifecycle and unit testing methodologies.

· Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


· Experience with HIL testing

· Experience with Continuous Integration (CI) tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).

· Knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety processes.

· Exposure to AUTOSAR architecture and tools.

· Experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g., DOORS, Polarion).

• Employees of Embitel are partners of our excellence and growth. And they are at the core of
organization’s Mission and Vision

title: Lead Brand and Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Brand and Product Designer based in Brazil.

This is a high-ownership design role combining brand, product, UX, and emerging AI-native workflows.
You will shape the visual identity customers experience across marketing, communications, and the digital product.
The role spans everything from early concepts and user flows to high-fidelity designs and working, near-production prototypes.
You will help evolve the design system, identify new tools, and raise the quality and consistency of design across the organization.
AI is embedded deeply into the creative process, with tools used for ideation, prototyping, animation, image generation, and agentic development.
You will work closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-moving environment where designers are expected to take ideas from concept to something tangible.
This is an ideal opportunity for a highly autonomous designer with exceptional taste, strong product instincts, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of AI-assisted design.

Accountabilities:

  • Own and evolve the visual identity across brand, product, marketing, paid media, social content, landing pages, sales materials, and other customer-facing experiences.
  • Lead product design initiatives from initial concepts and wireframes through user flows, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and final handoff.
  • Create functional, near-production prototypes using Figma AI, Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design, and other agentic design and development tools.
  • Produce prototypes that communicate interactions and functionality clearly enough for engineering teams to build without unnecessary ambiguity.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve the product design system, proactively identifying inconsistencies and closing design gaps before they become technical or visual debt.
  • Research and evaluate emerging AI design, development, animation, and image-generation tools, introducing those that can meaningfully improve team workflows.
  • Use AI throughout the design process to accelerate exploration, prototyping, iteration, and production while maintaining a high standard of design quality.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering stakeholders to understand user needs, technical constraints, and business objectives.
  • Bring strong design judgment and clear opinions to product and brand decisions, balancing visual excellence with usability and practical execution.
  • Help establish efficient, repeatable design practices that enable the team to move quickly without compromising consistency or quality.

    • Requirements

    • Several years of professional design experience in a product, SaaS, agency, or similarly fast-paced environment.
    • Exceptional visual design taste and strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, interaction, and visual hierarchy.
    • Expert-level proficiency with Figma and Figma AI.
    • Expert-level experience using Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Design as part of a real, day-to-day design workflow.
    • Strong experience with AI-powered animation and image-generation tools such as Higgsfield, plus familiarity with motion design tools such as After Effects.
    • A strong portfolio demonstrating both brand/visual design and product/UX work, including evidence of creativity, problem-solving, product thinking, and strong design judgment.
    • Ability to create working, high-fidelity prototypes and comfort navigating a codebase or using agentic coding tools to bring designs closer to production.
    • Strong product sense, including an understanding of users, journeys, interactions, and how design decisions affect usability and business outcomes.
    • Excellent professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
    • High degree of autonomy, initiative, accountability, and comfort working with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities.
    • Ability to work effectively under deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and design quality.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with confidence sharing and defending design perspectives.
    • Experience with performance marketing and creative testing is a plus.
    • Familiarity with analytics and user behavior tools such as Mixpanel or Hotjar is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position available in Brazil and across Latin America.
      • Full-time contractor engagement.
      • Daily working-hour overlap with EST, CST, or PST time zones.
      • Compensation of $15–$20 USD per hour.
      • 15 days of paid time off (PTO).
      • Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
      • High level of ownership and autonomy over brand and product design.
      • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI tools across the entire design and development workflow.
      • Fast-paced environment with significant scope to influence design systems, processes, and product experiences.
      • Opportunity to help shape a new AI-native category and work alongside highly motivated, technically curious teammates.

title: Director of Software Architecture
description:
Would you like to join a team working across the software technology components used by hundreds of millions of users across multiple platforms and market segments globally? As a Software Architect in the Software Organisation, you will work with our key software ecosystems to define software solutions to enable Arm technology and develop strategies to have those solutions adopted and enabled for users.

Our Central Engineering Software group delivers support for Arm technologies across a wide variety of software projects and creates example software solutions to demonstrate real world applications. You will join a team of software solution architects addressing the growing demand for software to support Arm systems.

The position will be based at Arm offices in Cambridge, Budapest, or Bangalore.

Job Overview:

As a member of a large software engineering team you will help evolve our software strategy across all computing segments, including data centre, automotive, mobile, robotics, networking, home, laptops, TVs, embedded and IoT. You will drive adoption of new features and trends in core processing, accelerators, and system hardware, focusing on improved security, reliability, and performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding new Arm architecture and IP features, their implementation and what that means for existing software components and tools. Devising how to promote their benefits to software ecosystems and resolve issues that arise in their adoption.

  • Analysis and deep understanding of software solutions currently deployed in products, in particular the major open-source software projects such as Linux.

  • Delivering software improvements back to the relevant open-source projects as a reference for Arm customers to create their own systems from.

  • Working with Arm’s OS, OEM and Silicon Partners to drive standards that enable the optimisation, differentiation, and fast evolution benefits of Arm’s Partner model

  • Building new software paradigms onto Arm reference hardware designs

  • Profiling the performance of the system and innovating ways to improve

  • Leading validation of the functionality, security and safety

  • You can expect to be working closely with some of the greatest household names in our industry to help develop, optimize, and deliver the software needed to support Arm's pioneering IP, as well as helping Arm grow its role in new market segments.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Knowledge of Arm based computer Architecture and the range of SoCs and devices that are created using Arm hardware IP.

  • Experience of software profiling, instrumentation, and optimization for real world applications and workloads such as AI stacks, run-time compilers and multimedia processing.

  • Strong understanding of complex multi-component computing systems with demonstrable low-level OS/device driver development or integration experience

  • Authoritative knowledge of C or C++ development with proficiency with optimizing applications, workloads, and compilers

  • Understanding of how to rigorously test software and design software for test

  • Experience of the software lifecycle: has taken complex software from concept to production and maintenance

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Experience with Android, ChromeOS or Windows software and systems

  • Experience with Linux, Linux distributions, Cloud/Edge applications and networking software

  • Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence software stacks, algorithms and tooling

  • Knowledge of multimedia system designs involving GPUs, compositing display processors and image signal processing

  • Familiarity with System-on-a-Chip architectures

In Return:

Our UK offices are outstanding places to collaborate. If you are interested but unsure whether you tick all the boxes, we still would love you to reach out! We are keen to welcome versatile people into Arm!

Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

If skilled worker sponsorship is required, Arm will meet costs associated with sponsorship for the employer only. All fees associated with the individual’s application e.g. visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, will be the responsibility of the successful candidate.

title: Tapahtumapäällikkö
description:
Tule tapahtumapäälliköksi asfaltinkorpiseen kulttuurikaupunki Kajaaniin!

Kajaani tunnetaan omaleimaisesta, rohkeasta, saavutettavasta ja yhteisöllisestä kulttuuristaan. Meillä moninainen kulttuurielämä on kaupungin elinvoiman ja kaupunkilaisten hyvinvoinnin ydintä. Monipuolinen tapahtumatarjonta varmistaa, että kaupungissa on jatkuvasti jotain uutta ja kiinnostavaa koettavaa.

Kaukametsän kulttuuri- ja tapahtumapalveluiden tapahtumapäällikkönä vastaat Kaukametsän konsertti- ja kokoustoiminnasta, Kajaanin kaupunkitapahtumista ja Kaukametsän suuremmista festivaaleista, joita tällä hetkellä ovat Kajaani Tanssii -festivaali ja Kajaanin Runoviikko. Olet aktiivisesti mukana myös Kajaanin kaupungin tapahtumaohjelmatyössä ja yleisessä tapahtumien kehittämisessä. Osallistut kulttuuri- ja nuorisopalveluiden johtoryhmätyöskentelyyn.

Tapahtumapäällikkönä toimit lähiesihenkilönä tiimille, johon kuuluvat tapahtumakoordinaattori, tapahtumatuottaja, valaistus- ja äänimestari ja vahtimestareita. Vastaat tiimin sisäisestä tehtävänjaosta, työvuorosuunnittelusta ja yhteistyöstä. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu viestinnän ja markkinoinnin suunnittelu, toteuttaminen ja verkostoyhteistyö. Lisäksi talouden suunnittelu ja seuranta, hankerahoitusten hakeminen ja raportointi, turvallisuusjohtaminen ja innovatiivinen toiminnan kehittäminen ovat tehtävän olennaisia osa-alueita. Osallistut myös tapahtumien toteuttamiseen tarpeen mukaan.

Edellytämme kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä, taloushallinnosta ja tapahtumatuottamisesta. Arvostamme monipuolista viestintä- ja markkinointiosaamista sekä innovatiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta. Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen vaatii hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja verkostotyötaitoja, kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia ja viedä useita rinnakkaisia, eri kokoisia prosesseja tuloksekkaasti eteenpäin yhtä aikaa.

Tehtävässä noudatamme KVTES:iä. Työaika on 36,25h viikossa eli toimistotyöaika. Tehtävään kuuluu jonkin verran myös ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä ja matkustamista kotimaassa.

Kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. kulttuurituottaja AMK/YAMK).

TYÖNANTAJA KUVAUS

Sivistystoimialalla pääset tekemään työtä, joka vaikuttaa suoraan lasten, nuorten ja aikuisten arkeen sekä koko kaupungin tulevaisuuteen. Sivistyspalvelut edistävät elinikäistä oppimista, osaamista ja mielekästä vapaa-aikaa, ja kulttuuri- ja nuorisopalvelut vahvistavat yhteisöllisyyttä, hyvinvointia ja myönteistä ilmapiiriä Kajaanissa.

Sivistystoimialaa johtaa sivistysjohtaja. Toimiala jakaantuu viiteen tulosalueeseen: varhaiskasvatus, perusopetus, ammatillinen koulutus, lukiokoulutus sekä kulttuuri- ja nuorisopalvelut. Tulosalueisiin sisältyvät päiväkodit, peruskoulut, ammattiopisto, lukio, kansalaisopisto, musiikkiopisto, kulttuurikeskus, kaupunginteatteri, museot, kirjastot ja nuorisopalvelut.

Työnantajana sivistystoimiala tarjoaa laajan kirjon tehtäviä pedagogiikasta ja oppilashuollosta kulttuuri-, kirjasto- ja nuorisotyöhön. Meillä teet merkityksellistä työtä yhdessä moniammatillisten tiimien kanssa ja pääset kehittämään palveluja, jotka tukevat kaupunkilaisten oppimista, osallisuutta ja hyvinvointia läpi elämän.

Kajaanin kaupunki on monialainen työnantaja, joka arvostaa työn ja perhe-elämän tasapainoa. Perheiden monimuotoisuus nähdään vahvuutena, ja haluamme kehittää jatkuvasti käytäntöjämme entistä perheystävällisemmiksi.

Lue lisää Kajaanin kaupungista työnantajana kohdasta Tutustu työnantajaan.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Hae meille viimeistään 04.09.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä! Hakemukset ensisijaisesti Kuntarekryn kautta. Postitse toimitetut hakemukset osoitteeseen: Kajaanin kaupunki, kirjaamo, PL 133, 87100 Kajaani, kuoreen merkintä "Tapahtumapäällikön vakituinen tehtävä".

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä 30 päivän kuluessa valitsemispäätöksen tiedoksisaannista lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote ja lääkärintodistus terveydentilasta (T-todistus). Erikseen pyydettäessä esitettävä todistus huumausainetestistä. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta.

Tule osaksi osaavaa joukkoamme!

description:

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Internal Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. Reporting to the Head of Internal Audit, you will provide high-quality internal audit and assurance services across Watercare, helping the organisation strengthen controls, manage risk and make well-informed decisions. You will evaluate the effectiveness of our internal controls, support compliance with policies and legislation, and help ensure operational effectiveness and the safeguarding of company assets.

This is a broad and influential role where you will work closely with senior leaders across the whole business. You will lead audit assignments from planning through to reporting, provide pragmatic recommendations that support better decision-making, help develop the wider team, and contribute to special projects outside the traditional audit programme.

In this role, you will:

  • Plan and coordinate audit assignments to support the delivery of the internal audit plan

  • Deliver financial, operational and compliance audits across the organisation

  • Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of business processes, risk management practices and internal controls

  • Assess compliance with company policies, procedures, professional standards and relevant legislation

  • Identify control weaknesses and recommend practical improvements

  • Prepare clear, concise and value-adding audit reports for senior stakeholders

  • Use data analytics and other innovative approaches to identify trends, control issues, potential fraud indicators and emerging organisational risks

  • Work collaboratively with Watercare staff to understand business processes, test controls and agree practical improvement actions

  • Support the documentation and testing of internal controls relating to company compliance activities

  • Contribute your expertise to special projects and non-audit advisory assignments.

You will be joining a small, trusted team with visibility across one of New Zealand’s most essential infrastructure organisations. This role will suit someone who enjoys variety, values constructive challenge, and wants to use internal audit to make a practical difference to how the business manages risk.

Ngā pūkenga e rapu nei mātou | About you

You will be an experienced audit professional who can combine strong technical expertise with sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving. You will be comfortable engaging with senior leaders, explaining complex issues clearly and constructively challenging the way things are done.

You will bring:

  • A recognised professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant, Certified Internal Auditor or an equivalent qualification

title: ROV Supervisor (Offshore) - Offshore Energy Fleet management ROV department
description:
Make your mark as ROV Supervisor (Offshore) at Boskalis Offshore Energy Fleet Management ROV Department. You will be accountable for the safe, effective, and compliant delivery of remotely operated subsea tasks from the vessel. This leadership role involves supervising ROV pilots and senior pilots, coordinating live operations and ensuring that all activities are executed in line with project plans, regulatory requirements, and company procedures.

As the primary operational focal point during ROV missions, the Supervisor provides technical guidance, ensures mission readiness, oversees shift performance, and escalates any operational risks or anomalies. The role is safety-critical and aligned with IMCA C005 Job Category R01 – ROV Supervisor. Competence must be demonstrated and maintained in accordance with the Boskalis Competence Management Scheme.

Your responsibilities as a ROV Supervisor:

The main responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to;

  • Lead, coordinate, and supervise all ROV activities during assigned shift operations, ensuring safe and effective execution.
  • Oversee the piloting and operation of inspection / light Work-Class ROV systems including associated tooling and sensors to support the safe and efficient execution of inspection, survey, maintenance, and light intervention scopes.
  • Ensure operational compliance with project work packs, client specifications, company procedures, and applicable IMCA guidance.
  • Review execution plans, pre-dive checklists, system readiness verifications, and operational reporting documentation.
  • Monitor ROV system status, telemetry, and video feeds; for diagnostics and issue resolution possible in consolidation with the Base.

Qualifications

You can make your mark as an ROV Supervisor if you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years ROV experience.
  • At least 180 days’ operational time as a Senior Pilot/Technician (IMCA R02)
  • Demonstrated leadership of ROV operations, including shift supervision, task planning, and coordination
  • Proven track record of piloting and overseeing complex subsea operations such as intervention, tooling deployment, and inspection tasks
  • IMCA ROV Supervisor logbook with verifiable entries evidencing supervisory responsibilities and digital operations exposure
  • Technical Qualification: Diploma or degree in marine, mechanical, electrical, or electronic engineering (preferred).
  • Technical Proficiency: High level of competence in ROV systems, subsea tooling, fault-finding, and inspection methodology.
  • Competence: IMCA-recognised Competence Certificate or Portfolio for ROV Supervisor (R01).
  • Communication & Coordination: excellent communication skills across dispersed teams and shift patterns.
  • Decision-Making & Adaptability: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure and adapt to dynamic offshore scenarios.
  • All modules GWO or OPITO approved BOSIET with CA-EBS, and OEUK Medical (including Bi-Deltoid shoulder measurements).
  • High voltage certification / awareness training (preferred).
  • Experienced with Plant Maintenance Systems (marad) (preferred).

What you can expect

  • A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact.
  • Rewarding conditions: Besides a competitive salary, you will be part of a contributory pension scheme, private medical insurance and death in service benefit.
  • Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself for example through (online) courses at our Boskalis academy.

Extra information

  • Your team: you will report to the ROV Manager with the following Direct Reports: ROV Pilot Technician Trainees, ROV Pilot Technician and ROV Senior Pilot Technician.
  • Where you will work: You will mainly work offshore on one of the systems and occasionally ad hoc you will work in the base for maintenance / preparing the ROV systems for a project.
  • Full/part- time job: The position of ROV Supervisor is a permanent role and will be offered on a Guaranteed Days Contract basis.
  • Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of ROV Supervisor. Please contact Catherine Buenaagua, corporate recruiter via +971 54 706 4243.

Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.

Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies

We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contribution

title: Metrology, Calibration and Receiving Inspection Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

Provides metrology and calibration engineering support to customers and lab staff. Develops processes and systems in the application of the science of measurement.

Key Responsibilities:

Designs and develops measurement processes, methods, and procedures. Performs Measurement Systems Analysis using the principles of traceability and analysis of accuracy and precision requirements. Employs statistics to analyze calibration and testing processes, and interprets results. Provides general consultation on metrology issues. Supports the development and execution of capability studies. Provides technical training on calibration processes and procedures. Monitors compliance with laboratory quality system requirements.Competencies:
Product Function Test System Design - Interprets test equipment specifications from test standards or lab customer requirements; selects and integrates appropriate equipment, instrumentation and software to control boundary conditions and collect measurement data; assesses capability of the lab equipment against the requirements and support infrastructure.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Technical Function Processes and Tools - Executes, improves, trains, coaches and/or manages the Technical processes and tools including standards and best practices that enables knowledge to be re-used and functional deliverables to be met in a quality and productive manner.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Chemical Metrology - Applies chemical measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer, and product requirements.

Dimensional Metrology - Applies dimensional measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer and product requirements.

Electrical Metrology - Applies electrical measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer and product requirements.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Mechanical Metrology - Applies mechanical measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer, and product requirements.

Optical and Ionized Radiation Metrology - Applies optical and ionized radiation measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer, and product requirements.

Physical Metrology - Applies physical measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer, and product requirements.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Physics or Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject required.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Intermediate level of relevant work experience, including team leadership experience, required.

1. Managing the receiving inspection work for all incoming components for Motor and Inverter product which includes to create the inspection plan and ensure the data review after inspection;
2. Managing the inspection activities for new product development with 3rd party. May need consider to build the CMM competency to enhance our capability.
3. Play as the liasson engieer for mfg. quality planning for new product development
4. Provide the metrology/Measurement competency supports for new product development and failure analysis

title: Administratief (juridisch) medewerker grondzaken
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Samen met een team van enthousiaste en ambitieuze collega’s ben jij degene die inzicht heeft in de processen m.b.t. het verwerven en beheer van eigendommen. Hierbij werk je veel samen met de grondverwervers/rentmeesters.

Wij staan open voor kandidaten met ervaring, maar de functie kan ook ingevuld worden als een ontwikkelfunctie waarbij we je uiteraard zullen begeleiden.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit het opbouwen van de werkdossiers het opstellen van diverse soorten overeenkomsten (koop/verkoop/ruil, zakelijke rechten, kwalitatieve verplichtingen etc.), het maken van diverse overzichtskaarten in ArcGis Pro en de notariële afwikkeling hiervan. Je zorgt voor publicaties in het kader van het Didam-arrest.

Ook ben je verantwoordelijk voor het proces van openbare verpachting, stel je pacht-, huur- en gebruiksovereenkomsten op Daarnaast ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor het beheer van het vastgoedregistratiesysteem P8. Tot slot handel je ook, waar mogelijk zelfstandig, privaatrechtelijke verzoeken af die gaan over gebruik en huur van onze eigendommen.

Je werkt veel samen met 2 collega's administratief juridisch medewerker. De werkzaamheden worden verdeelt op basis van dossiers of benodigde kennis. Ook heb je een takenpakket wat je zelfstandig oppakt en waar je zelf je planning en deadlines beheert.

Dit ben jij

Je hebt MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau. Je bent deskundig (administratief en juridisch) op het gebied van grondzaken. Deze deskundigheid heb je o.a. opgedaan door enkele jaren ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie. Of je hebt affiniteit met grondzaken en bent bereid je te ontwikkelen tot een administratief en juridisch medewerker grondzaken en je te verdiepen in diverse applicaties. Wij hechten veel belang aan ontwikkeling binnen je functie en bieden daar ook voldoende ruimte voor.

Daarnaast heb je een creatieve, proactieve en oplossingsgerichte werkhouding, goede contactuele eigenschappen, ben je in staat om onder tijdsdruk accuraat te blijven werken én kun je snel schakelen tussen verschillende taken. Het is als deskundige een pré als je over kennis van het programma P8 en ArcGis pro beschikt

Dit bieden wij jou!

We vinden het belangrijk dat je met plezier werkt en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Daarom kun je bij ons rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en veel mogelijkheden om werk en privé in balans te houden.

Een salaris in functieschaal 8 (€ 3.539,- tot € 4.626,-) of functieschaal 9 (€ 3.893,- tot € 5.199,-) bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring;

Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 21% van je brutosalaris waarmee je onder andere extra verlofdagen kopen of je salaris mee kan aanvullen;
  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget én toegang tot de Brabant Aquademie met een breed aanbod aan trainingen en cursussen;
  • 144 verlofuren + 7,2 bovenwettelijke verlofuren bij een werkweek van 36 uur.
  • Flexibele werktijden en goede faciliteiten om thuis te werken zoals een laptop, telefoon en thuiswerkvergoeding;
  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij het ABP;
  • Het betreft een vaste functie waarbij we starten met een jaarcontract. We hebben de intentie om het daarna om te zetten naar een vast dienstverband;
  • Het betreft een functie voor 28-32 uur per week.

Enthousiast? Reageer!

Spreekt deze functie je aan en herken je jezelf in het profiel? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Upload uiterlijk 6 september je cv en motivatie. Voel je vrij om voor je motivatie een vorm te gebruiken die bij je past.

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Edwin Verhees, Manager vergunningen en grondzaken, 0411-661073. Wil je meer weten over de sollicitatieprocedure dan kun je contact opnemen met Miriam van der Linden, Personeelsconsulent 0411-618598.

De eerste gesprekken vinden plaats op dinsdag 15 september. De tweede gesprekken worden gepland op dinsdag 22 september.

Waterschap De Dommel vraagt bij indiensttreding een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG). Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Junior GIS Specialist
description:
We are looking for a motivated Junior GIS Specialist to support the development, maintenance, and analysis of geospatial data and GIS applications. The ideal candidate will assist in delivering GIS solutions, creating maps, performing spatial analysis, and supporting BIM-GIS integration initiatives under the guidance of senior team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the creation, maintenance, and management of GIS databases and geospatial datasets.
  • Support spatial analysis, mapping, and data visualization activities for various infrastructure and urban development projects.
  • Prepare high-quality maps, layouts, dashboards, and geospatial reports.
  • Assist in BIM-GIS integration workflows and support data exchange between GIS and BIM platforms.
  • Support data conversion, migration, and transformation activities using tools such as FME.
  • Perform data quality checks, validation, and updates to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining GIS applications, tools, and workflows.
  • Work with project teams to collect, organize, and analyze spatial and non-spatial data.
  • Support remote sensing and imagery interpretation tasks where required.
  • Document GIS processes, standards, and project deliverables.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including planners, engineers, architects, and environmental specialists.
  • Stay updated on emerging GIS technologies and best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree/master's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Geoinformatics, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant GIS experience.
  • Basic understanding of GIS concepts, spatial analysis, cartography, and geospatial data management.
  • Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro and/or QGIS.
  • Familiarity with coordinate systems, projections, and geospatial data formats.
  • Working knowledge of FME is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of BIM-GIS integration concepts.
  • Knowledge of spatial databases and SQL.
  • Basic scripting knowledge in Python is desirable.
  • Familiarity with remote sensing datasets and imagery interpretation is an advantage.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Domain expertise in urban planning, environmental management, or natural resource management is advantageous
  • Willingness to travel within India as required for project work
