title: ServiceNow IRM DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Purpose

The ServiceNow IRM DevOps Engineer will support the development, deployment, operation and continuous improvement of ServiceNow Coordinated Risk Management solutions used across LSEG’s Anti-Financial Crime and Operational Risk and Controls functions. This is a hands-on engineering role passionate about maintaining stable ServiceNow IRM environments, enabling controlled and repeatable software delivery, supporting platform upgrades and releases, and working closely with developers, product owners, architects and third-party suppliers. The role holder will combine practical ServiceNow IRM development knowledge with strong DevOps, release management and operational support capabilities. They will help ensure that changes to existing workflows and new IRM capabilities are delivered safely, consistently and efficiently across development, test and production environments.

Key Responsibilities

 Support the configuration, development and maintenance of ServiceNow IRM solutions.  Work across IRM capabilities, control assessments and testing, issues and remediation actions, operational events and incidents, evidence collection and attestations, policy and compliance workflows, risk and control reporting, case management and partner concern.  Support development teams with environment configuration, technical solving and deployment preparation.  Configure and maintain ServiceNow forms, tables, workflows, notifications, business rules, access controls and integration components.  Diagnose and resolve platform defects, configuration issues, failed deployments and data inconsistencies.  Support enhancements to existing AFC and Operational Risk and Controls workflows and contribute to the technical implementation of new workflows and IRM capabilities.

DevOps and Release Management

 Develop and maintain reliable release, deployment and environment management processes for ServiceNow IRM.

 Coordinate the promotion of configuration and code across development environments.  Manage update sets, prioritised applications, source control branches and deployment packages.

 Support adoption of ServiceNow Application Repository, source control and automated deployment practices where appropriate.

 Ensure releases are traceable, repeatable and supported by appropriate approvals and evidence.

 Maintain release calendars, deployment records, implementation plans and rollback procedures.

 Support production releases, post-deployment validation and early-life support.

 Identify deployment risks, configuration gaps and missing dependencies before changes are promoted.

 Improve deployment automation and enable continuous integration and continuous delivery practices for ServiceNow.

Environment Management

 Configure, maintain and support ServiceNow development, test and production environments.

 Monitor environment stability, availability, performance and configuration consistency.

 Support instance cloning, data refreshes, environment resets and post-clone remediation activities.

 Maintain environment-specific configuration, credentials, integrations and access controls.

 Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and restricted access across environments.

 Coordinate environment usage across multiple development teams and suppliers.

 Support platform upgrades, patches, hotfixes and ServiceNow family releases.

 Assess upgrade impacts on existing IRM applications, workflows, integrations and customisations.

 Coordinate regression testing and remediation of upgrade-related defects.

Operational Support

 Provide technical support for live ServiceNow IRM applications and workflows.

 Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests, defects and recurring platform issues.

 Perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.

 Monitor failed workflows, integrations, scheduled jobs, notifications and data loads.

 Support problem management and find opportunities to improve service reliability.

 Build & Maintain operational runbooks, fix guides and support documentation.

 Participate in production support arrangements and major incident resolution where required.

 Work with Service Management teams to ensure incidents and changes are handled in line with agreed processes. Technical Development

 Perform hands-on ServiceNow configuration and development where required.

 Develop and maintain Flow Designer flows and subflows, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies and UI Actions, Access Control Lists, notifications and approvals, scheduled jobs and data imports, REST integrations and IntegrationHub spokes.

 Support developers with technical investigations, environment defects and deployment issues.

 Review code and configuration for deployment readiness.

 Ensure solutions are supportable, maintainable and aligned with ServiceNow development standards.  Promote use of standard ServiceNow IRM capabilities and minimise unnecessary customisation.

Testing and Quality Assurance

 Support unit, system, integration, regression and deployment testing.

 Help define technical acceptance criteria and release validation checks.

 Maintain and improve automated testing using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework where appropriate.

Ensure changes are validated before promotion between environments.

 Support defect triage, prioritisation and resolution.

 Maintain evidence of testing, approvals and deployment outcomes.

 Identify recurring quality issues and recommend improvements to development and release practices.

Requirements and Design Support

· Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts and developers to understand technical and operational requirements.

· Review requirements and designs for deployment, supportability and environment impact.

· Identify non-functional requirements relating to resilience, monitoring, auditability, access control and maintainability.

· Challenge designs that create unnecessary operational complexity or unsupported customisation.

· Review third-party deployment plans, technical outputs and environment changes.

· Highlight missing dependencies, weak controls and release risks.

· Support technical design reviews and contribute practical platform and operational insights.

Agile Delivery and Teamwork

· Work as part of an Agile delivery team supporting backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.

· Estimate DevOps, release and platform engineering activities.

· Coordinate dependencies between development, testing, infrastructure and support teams.

· Provide regular updates on release readiness, environment status, risks and blockers.

· Work closely with ServiceNow developers, technical leads, architects and product teams.

· Guide less experienced engineers on environment management, release controls and ServiceNow operational practices.

· Drive & input to team standards, reusable deployment patterns and continuous improvement initiatives.

Governance, Risk and Controls

· Ensure platform changes follow LSEG change, release and security controls.

· Maintain appropriate audit trails for configuration changes, testing and deployments.

· Support access reviews, segregation-of-duties controls and privileged access management.

· Ensure production changes are appropriately approved, tested and documented.

· Support internal audit, assurance and regulatory evidence requests for IRM.

· Identify and lead technical debt, unsupported customisation and operational risks.

· Ensure sensitive AFC and risk data is handled in accordance with security, privacy and retention requirements.

Required Experience and Capabilities

· Typically 5-9 years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps or ServiceNow delivery.

· Strong hands-on experience supporting or developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

· Practical experience with ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management or Governance, Risk and Compliance applications.

· Experience leading ServiceNow environments, releases and deployment processes.

· Experience with update sets, scoped applications, Application Repository, ServiceNow source control integration, instance cloning, post-clone activities, platform upgrades and regression testing.

· Good technical knowledge of Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies and UI Actions, Access Control Lists, ServiceNow tables and data models, REST APIs, IntegrationHub, Import Sets, Transform Maps, scheduled jobs and notifications

Experience supporting live, business-critical applications and investigating incidents, defects and deployment failures.

· Knowledge of software development lifecycle, transformation and release management practices.

· Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

· Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

· Strong analytical, solve and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and third-party suppliers.

Desirable Experience

· Experience supporting ServiceNow IRM capabilities such as Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management, Operational Risk Management, Business Continuity Management or Third-Party Risk Management.

· Experience supporting Anti-Financial Crime processes.

· Understanding of risk and control concepts including risk assessments, control design and operating effectiveness, RCSA, issues and remediation actions, operational events and losses, and key risk and control indicators.

· Experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework, Git-based source control and CI/CD tooling.

· Experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent delivery tooling.

· Experience using ServiceNow HealthScan, Instance Scan, platform monitoring or Performance Analytics capabilities.

· Relevant ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer or Certified Implementation Specialist - Risk and Compliance.

· Experience working in a regulated financial services organisation. Key Behaviours

· Be hands-on, delivery-focused and comfortable working across development and production environments.

· Take ownership of platform stability, release quality and operational outcomes. · Identify risks and issues early and communicate them clearly.

· Challenge weak deployment practices and unsupported technical solutions.

· Balance delivery speed with control, reliability and maintainability.

· Work multi-functionally across development, product, architecture and service management teams.

· Continuously look for opportunities to automate manual activities.

· Maintain solid attention to detail in environments where traceability and audit-ability are essential. · Support and guide colleagues while continuing to develop their own technical expertise.

Key Partners

· Anti-Financial Crime

· Operational Risk and Controls

· ServiceNow IRM Product Owners

· ServiceNow Developers and Technical Leads

· Platform Engineering and DevOps teams

· Enterprise and Solution Architects

· Quality Engineering and Testing teams

· Production Support and Service Management

· Information Security and Data Privacy

· Change and Release Management

· Internal Audit and Assurance

Success Measures

· Stable and consistently configured ServiceNow environments.

· Reliable and controlled deployment of platform changes.

· Reduced release failures, deployment defects and production incidents.

· Improved automation of testing, deployment and environment management activities.

· Effective support for ServiceNow IRM developers and delivery teams.

· Timely resolution of production issues and recurring platform problems.

· Successful delivery of ServiceNow upgrades and application updates.

· Strong traceability of changes, testing, approvals and deployments.

· Reduced manual effort and improved release predictability.

· Improved resilience, supportability and operational maturity of the ServiceNow IRM platform

title: Shift Engineer
description:
Capacity Shift Engineer

Location: City of London

Shift: Continental Shift, 7-7, Days and Nights

Purpose of Job

To ensure all environmental conditions are maintained at all times with regard to critical building systems. To carry out PPM tasks and reactive and breakdown works to all M&E systems within the site. Engineers must be able to demonstrate relevant knowledge of Air conditioning, UPS, Generators, LV systems, which will include the ability to fault find using the production of graphical information and the utilisation of current alarm data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure that routine PPM is carried out to all mechanical & Electrical plant in accordance with Site task schedules and asset lists.
  • Ensure that reactive tasks throughout the building are completed and be proactive in highlighting areas where improvements can be made. These reactive calls to also include concessionary stores and fabric related items.
  • Ensure that sub-contractors perform to meet the requirement of the contract. Administer sub-contractor work approvals and safe operation while repair or service is carried out on site.
  • To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with BGIS Quality, Health & Safety procedures and client requirements.
  • Ensure that plant faults and defects are swiftly remedied to maintain plant in serviceable order at all times.
  • Ensure that suitable spares are available to carry out both maintenance and reactive works. To provide parts lists and estimated timescales to carry out remedial works.
  • Ensure that all relevant paperwork is completed regarding reactive and breakdown works and that it is passed without delay to the contract administrator.
  • Ensure that Method Statements and Risk Assessments are prepared and used for all tasks undertaken to ensure safe working practices at all times.
  • To develop a good working relationship with all members of BGIS staff, subcontractors and the client representatives.
  • Ensure the provision of a Safe and Healthy working environment. To include the wearing of uniform and PPE at all times.
  • Ensure the professional image of BGIS is presented to clients at all times
  • Ensure that all plant rooms under the responsibility of BGIS are locked at all times and are kept in a clean and tidy condition.
  • Supervising and monitoring of sub-contractors works whilst they are on site undertaking maintenance.
  • Ensure assigned tasks are actioned and completed as appropriate.
  • To ensure tasks as directed are completed with the appropriate H&S awareness/implementation.
  • Ensure an awareness and compliance to the contractual KPI’s/SLA’s.
  • Ensure Computer Based Maintenance system, e.g. Maximo, is kept up to date and that PPM and reactive tickets are closed out with accurate data captured.
  • To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with BGIS Quality, Health & Safety procedures and client requirements (or approved client system).
  • Any other task as directed by the Site management team.
  • Ensure the engineering team on site produce required near miss reports, dynamic risk assessments and detailed records of site activities, and ensuring any non-compliance is challenged and escalated where necessary.
  • To proactively check the operation of the LOTO system in accordance with BGIS Quality, Health & Safety procedures and client requirements.
  • Overview the buildings environmental conditions using the BMS System and utilise same to maintain acceptable internal conditions.

title: Senior Specialist, Global Payment Operations- Sydney
description:
We are seeking a highly capable Senior Specialist, Global Payment Operations to support the execution of critical payment processing activities within a controlled, deadline-driven environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely processing of payment transactions across multiple channels, while maintaining a strong focus on risk management, operational control, regulatory compliance, and service delivery.

The successful candidate will play an important role in managing day-to-day payment activities, resolving operational exceptions, supporting escalations, and contributing to ongoing process improvement and automation initiatives. This role also provides guidance to junior team members and supports operational resilience across the broader payment function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and oversee daily payment processing activities across domestic and international payment channels.
  • Monitor payment queues and workflow tools to ensure transactions are processed, investigated, and released within required timeframes.
  • Manage priority, urgent, and high-value payments in line with cut-off times, market deadlines, and business requirements.
  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions, failed transactions, unmatched items, and operational breaks within agreed service standards.
  • Perform operational control checks and approvals in accordance with internal procedures, delegated authorities, and compliance requirements.
  • Escalate issues, incidents, and system disruptions in a timely manner, ensuring appropriate stakeholder engagement and resolution support.
  • Work closely with internal teams, technology partners, correspondent banks, and external stakeholders to resolve processing issues and improve service outcomes.
  • Support audit, risk, regulatory, and compliance activities by maintaining accurate records, providing evidence, and adhering to required procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual intervention, strengthen controls, and support automation initiatives.
  • Contribute to change initiatives, system testing, implementation activities, and process redesign impacting the payments operating model.
  • Provide day-to-day support and subject matter guidance to junior team members to promote consistency, control awareness, and service quality.
  • Assist in preparing operational updates, issue summaries, management reporting, and service performance commentary as required.
  • Support business continuity, contingency activities, and peak processing periods to ensure ongoing service stability.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience in payment operations, cash operations, transaction processing, or a related banking operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payment processing, including investigations, exception handling, and settlement deadlines.
  • Experience working in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment with strong control and risk discipline.
  • Sound knowledge of operational controls, escalation practices, and incident handling.
  • Ability to assess issues, prioritize effectively, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across teams and functions.
  • High attention to detail, with strong accuracy and accountability in transaction execution.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and support practical enhancements.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with SWIFT payments, global payment messaging, and correspondent banking workflows.
  • Experience with local payment systems and Austraclear preferred.
  • Familiarity with sanctions screening, and compliance-related payment controls.
  • Exposure to automation, workflow optimization, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working across regional or global support models, including coordination with offshore teams.

Qualifications

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience in banking, financial services, or payment operations roles preferred.
  • Tertiary qualification in finance, commerce, business, or a related field is preferred.

title: Liikuntakeskuksen asiakaspalvelu ja toimistotyö (osa-aikainen iltatyö)
company: Combat Academy Helsinki Oy ja Combat Academy Vantaa Oy
description:
Etsitään salin sydäntä – Osa-aikainen respanhoitaja

Syyskausi on käynnistynyt ryminällä, kurssit ovat täynnä ja matoilla on mahtava meininki! Etsimme nyt tiimiimme jämäkkää, hymyilevää ja organisoitunutta asiakaspalvelijaa ottamaan salimme vastaanoton haltuunsa.

Työ on osa-aikaista iltatyötä. Tehtävä sopii loistavasti esimerkiksi opintojen oheen tai toisen osa-aikatyön kaveriksi. Työskentelet sekä Sörnäisissä että Myyrmäessä.

Mitä työ käytännössä on? Tämä ei ole pelkkää tietokoneen takana istumista ja puhelimen selailua. Respassa olet salimme käyntikortti ja yrityksen kasvot niin alkeiskurssilaisille kuin kokeneille treenaajille.

  • Vastaanotat asiakkaat, hoidat kurssi-ilmoittautumiset ja kassa/maksujärjestelmät.

  • Vastaat tiedusteluihin ja opastat uudet harrastajat oikeisiin tiloihin.

  • Pidät huolta yleisestä siisteydestä ja edustat salimme rehtejä arvoja.

  • Työajat sijoittuvat pääasiassa iltoihin ja lauantaihin, jolloin salilla on suurin vilske.

Oletko etsimämme tyyppi? Etsimme henkilöä, jolla pysyy hymy huulilla ja langat käsissä silloinkin, kun 30 ihmistä yrittää kirjautua sisään samaan aikaan varttia ennen treenien alkua.

  • Sujuva englannin kieli on välttämättömyys: Meillä treenaa paljon ulkomaalaisia, joten kansainvälinen asiakaspalvelu on arkipäiväämme.

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen ja jämäkkä – et hätkähdä pientä kiirettä tai ääntä.

  • Pystyt sitoutumaan säännöllisiin iltavuoroihin sekä lauantaitöihin.

  • Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on plussaa, mutta oikea asenne ratkaisee. Kamppailulajitaustaa et välttämättä tarvitse, kunhan jaat arvomme: kunnioituksen, rehtiyden ja hyvän yhteishengen.

Miten haet? Haluamme löytää ihmisen, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut juuri meistä. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen: info (at)combat.fi.

HUOM! Jotta tiedämme sinun lukeneen tämän ilmoituksen ajatuksella, aloita sähköpostisi vastaamalla lyhyesti tähän kysymykseen:Mikä tekee mielestäsi asiakaspalvelukohtaamisesta onnistuneen? Vastaamme vain hakemuksiin, joista tämä vastaus löytyy.

Huomautus sähköposteista: Koska lajimme ja salimme nimi sisältää kamppailusanastoa, sähköpostivastauksemme ja Teams-kutsumme ohjautuvat toisinaan automaattisesti roskapostikansioon (Spam/Junk). Muistathan tarkistaa roskakorisi säännöllisesti hakuprosessin aikana!

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Specialist based in United States.

This role offers an opportunity to lead the architecture and modernization of enterprise cybersecurity data platforms supporting large-scale federal operations.
You will design secure, scalable data pipelines and integrations across cloud and on-premises environments.
The position combines cybersecurity, data engineering, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology modernization.
You will help strengthen data governance, security, observability, and compliance across complex technical environments.
The role also provides technical leadership through solution architecture, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will contribute to analytics and executive reporting that turn complex security data into actionable operational insights.

  • Develop secure REST APIs and enterprise integrations that enable high-volume data exchange and interoperability between systems.
  • Establish and improve DevSecOps and CI/CD practices to automate deployments, strengthen release quality, and support multi-environment hosting.
  • Optimize database performance, data models, and platform scalability to support terabytes of daily data processing and thousands of concurrent users.
  • Implement data governance, quality, security, and observability standards aligned with FISMA, RMF, NIST, and other applicable federal requirements.

  • Develop executive dashboards, analytics, and data visualizations that provide actionable insights for senior leadership and operational decision-making.
  • Support business development and proposal activities by developing technical solutions, architecture documentation, proof-of-concepts, and RFP/RFI responses.
  • Contribute to cybersecurity operations, including incident response workflows, detection tuning, malware analysis processes, vulnerability management, and security data correlation.
  • Support SOP lifecycle management and configuration standardization across enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders using tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint to facilitate communication, documentation, and knowledge management.

title: Senior Release Engineer
description:
Job Description

We're looking for an exceedingly talented Senior Release Engineer to work as part of the Risk Intelligence Engineering Support team.

As a Senior Release Engineer, you’ll be responsible for defining and driving the release strategy for our products, ensuring efficient, reliable, and secure delivery across environments. You will lead initiatives to optimize CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, and leverage AWS services to improve scalability and operational efficiency. Collaborating closely with Development, QA, and Operations teams, you’ll ensure that release processes align with architectural standards and business objectives, enabling faster time-to-market and enhanced customer value.

This role requires participation in a shift-based to support critical release activities and production deployments outside of regular business hours. Candidates should be prepared to monitor release windows, respond to deployment issues, troubleshoot failures in CI/CD pipelines, and coordinate with development, QA, and operations teams to ensure smooth releases, service continuity, and minimal downtime.

Mentoring members of the team also forms a crucial part of the role, working alongside the team management to ensure that the team has the capabilities it needs to deliver.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Release Management: Own and manage the end-to-end release process for multiple applications and services.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Deploy and manage applications on AWS, leveraging services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, CloudFormation, and IAM.
  • Automation: Drive automation for build, deployment, and monitoring processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement best practices for security, compliance, and governance in release processes.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Set up monitoring tools and troubleshoot release issues promptly.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear documentation for release processes, pipelines, and configurations.

Key Relationships:

  • Release Manager
  • Development Manager

Preferred skills:

  • Experience: 6+ years in Release Engineering or DevOps roles, with at least 2 years in a lead capacity.

  • Version Control: Expertise in Git and branching strategies.
  • Containerization: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Knowledge of blue-green deployments, canary releases, and feature toggles.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

A good relevant Engineering degree is desirable, but experience and the right approach to work are just as important.

description:
I rollen som Warehouse Manager får du det fulde ejerskab over vareflowet og muligheden for at opbygge en høj grad af indkøbsautomatisering i ERP-systemet. Virksomheden er en innovativ og international vækstvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Viby J, der udvikler og producerer avancerede højteknologiske robotter. Kulturen

Randstad er verdens førende partner full-service HR-hus. Randstad har hovedkontor i Holland, opererer på 39 markeder og beskæftiger cirka 38.000 medarbejdere på verdensplan. I 2025 hjalp vi knap 150.000 kunder og over 1,7 millioner talenter, hvilket resulterede i en omsætning på 23,1 mia. euro. Randstad N.V. er noteret på Euronext Amsterdam. title: System Engineering Intern
description:
Systems Engineering Intern

Engineering internship supporting vehicle architecture, technical readiness and systems integration.


Function / reporting

Electronics Integration / Systems Engineering | Lead Engineer - Electronics Integration

Location / mode

Bengaluru | on-site

Qualification

Pre-final/final-year B.E./B.Tech students in a relevant discipline; recent graduates may also apply


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Electronics Integration team works across electronic subsystems to help move individual components from working in isolation to operating together reliably at vehicle level. The team supports system architecture, staged integration, technical-risk reviews, validation and structured debugging.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will assist engineers in understanding, documenting, integrating and assessing vehicle-level functions across multiple subsystems. The internship spans three related areas.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

  • System architecture and documentation: join structured walkthroughs with subsystem teams and prepare or update vehicle-level block diagrams, interface maps, data/control flows, sequence diagrams, state machines and fault-response flows.

  • System understanding: record inputs, outputs, interlocks, timing assumptions, fallback behaviour, source references and open questions; route unclear or conflicting information to the appropriate engineer for review.

  • FMEA and evidence support: maintain traceability among observations, Bug IDs, FMEA items, root-cause/corrective-action records and validation evidence, and prepare factual inputs for engineering reviews.

  • Technical readiness: update feature-readiness views with feature presence, test status, open bugs, blockers and validation status, while keeping technical readiness separate from the master program schedule.

  • Integration testing: execute approved tests on vehicles, benches or partial setups; record prerequisites, configuration, software versions, steps, results and supporting evidence.

  • Debugging support: capture CAN/diagnostic logs and test notes, perform approved electrical or interface checks under supervision, support structured issue isolation, and assist with regression and fix verification.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Currently in the pre-final or final year of B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Automotive, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems or a related discipline; recent graduates may also apply.

  • Systems thinking, curiosity, enthusiasm and the ability to follow one function across multiple controllers and interfaces.

  • Basic understanding of embedded systems, CAN, sensors, actuators, state machines, diagnostics and fault logic.

  • A methodical working style: separates facts from assumptions, documents evidence clearly and escalates uncertainty.

  • Comfort with Excel and diagramming tools; hands-on laboratory, Formula Student/BAJA, robotics, EV or embedded-project experience is useful.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Exposure to FMEA, verification/validation, requirements or interface documentation, CAN tools, oscilloscopes, Python or MATLAB.

title: Kontaktsjuksköterska till Onkologimottagning 2 i Lund
description:
Gör skillnad. Varje dag.

Är du sjuksköterska med erfarenhet av onkologisk vård? Vill duarbeta i vår verksamhet där vi bedriver högspecialiserad vård? Vi söker nu en kontaktsjuksköterska som vill jobba i vårt team. Du kommer att få arbeta tillsammans med glada, kompetenta och trygga kollegor med mångårig erfarenhet av cancersjukvård. 

Inom Verksamhetsområde onkologi och strålningsfysik bedrivs högspecialiserad vård för patienter med många olika diagnoser. Du kommer i första hand att arbeta som kontaktsjuksköterska för patienter som behandlas för cancer i huvud-hals regionen men även andra diagnoser förekommer. Den vanligaste behandlingen för patientgruppen är extern strålbehandling men andra onkologiska behandlingar kan vara aktuella. 

På enheten finns flera team för olika diagnoser och vi samarbetar för att ge patienter bästa möjliga vård och ett evidensbaserat omhändertagande. Som kontaktsjuksköterska kommer du att ingå i ett av teamen. Arbetet präglas av ett nära samarbete mellan olika professioner men också gentemot andra enheter inom verksamhetsområdet och i regionen. 

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i en lärorik miljö där målet är att alla medarbetare ska känna arbetsglädje och kunna utvecklas.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som kontaktsjuksköterska träffar du patienter och närstående genom hela behandlingsförloppet och under uppföljning efteråt. Du är med och planerar för behandlingar och säkerställer patientens inflytande och delaktighet i vården. Du träffar patienterna i samband med besök på mottagningen och i arbetet ingår även rådgivning och bedömning via telefon, uppföljning av symtom samt stöd till patienter och närstående under och efter sjukdom och behandling. 

På mottagningen arbetar vi utifrån ett personcentrerat förhållningssätt och söker dig som har en väl utvecklad empatisk förmåga. Det är viktigt att du kan bemöta människor med omtanke, respekt och lyhördhet, och har förmåga att skapa trygghet i möten med människor som befinner sig i kris på olika sätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med behörighet att verka inom svensk sjukvård. Språkkunskap i svenska lägst motsvarande nivå C1 enligt Europarådets nivåskala är ett krav. 

Det är meriterande med:
- Specialistsjuksköterskeutbildning inom onkologisk vård
- Utbildning som kontaktsjuksköterska
- Erfarenhet inom onkologi
- Erfarenhet av IT-systemen Melior, Pasis, Min vårdplan eller 1177.

Som person är du ansvarstagande, flexibel och har ett stort engagemang. Vi värdesätter att du har ett helhetsperspektiv där både patientens, de närståendes och verksamhetens behov beaktas. Du trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar aktivt till ett gott samarbete genom god kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga. Samtidigt är du trygg din yrkesroll och van vid att arbeta självständigt, fatta egna beslut och göra professionella bedömningar. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. 

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi tillämpar löpande urval. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

Region Skåne ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik och en hållbar utveckling i hela Skåne. Vårt högsta beslutande organ är regionfullmäktige, som väljs direkt av invånarna i Skåne. Region Skåne är en värderingsstyrd organisation som arbetar med värderingarna välkomnande, drivande, omtanke och respekt i allt vi gör. 

Skånes universitetssjukhus (Sus) finns i Lund och Malmö och är landets tredje största sjukhus. Sus är ett kunskapsnav för hälso- och sjukvård i livets alla skeden på regional, nationell och internationell nivå. Våra 12 000 medarbetare är med och driver utvecklingen inom universitetssjukhusets tre uppdragsområden: vård, forskning och utbildning. Hos oss får du arbeta i en värderingsstyrd organisation som utvecklar hälso- och sjukvården tillsammans med patienter och deras närstående. Välkommen!

På https://www.skane.se/ledigajobb  kan du se i vilket skede Region Skånes rekryteringar befinner sig och hur många som har sökt tjänsterna. 

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta den kontaktperson som finns angiven i annonsen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner.

När du söker ett jobb hos Region Skåne blir din ansökan en allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR).

Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Team Leader Aquatic Operations - Broadmeadows Aquatic Leisure Centre (BALC)
description:
• Full Time - Fixed Term Contract for 10 months
  • $83,714 per annum plus superannuation
  • Join the Active Living team

Hume City Council is one of Australia’s fastest growing and culturally diverse councils. We put the customer and our community at the centre of all that we do, ensuring our services are efficient and accessible. The active living team exist to empower, activate and connect our community.

This position is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and coordination of aquatic operations at Broadmeadows Aquatic and Leisure Centre, including the supervision, development and support of Pool Lifeguards and Duty Supervisors. The role oversees aquatic safety, pool operations, water quality, emergency preparedness, compliance, and service delivery to ensure a safe, efficient and high-quality experience for all facility users.

The position of Team Leader Aquatic Operations is a 10-month contract role based at Broadmeadows Aquatic and Leisure Centre(BALC). It's responsible for ensuring high quality aquatic and recreation opportunities to residents and visitors in a safe, friendly, and welcoming environment through the development and promotion of excellence and professionalism in aquatic services and operations.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Ensure the health and safety of all members of the public using the facilities by adhering to the Royal Lifesaving Society ‘Guidelines for Safe Pool Operation’, and ‘Safer Public Pools Code of Practice’ and other applicable guidelines and regulations.
  • Foster and promote a safety focused organisational culture by ensuring compliance with relevant guidelines and regulations.
  • Ensure the highest quality standards are maintained relating to water safety and aquatic operations.
  • Ensure the appropriate recruitment, training, supervision and rostering of all Pool Lifeguards to ensure the highest standards of safety, service delivery and cleanliness are maintained.
  • Supervision of facility maintenance work undertaken by contractors and staff to ensure safe work practices are maintained, work is completed in a satisfactory manner, and required documentation is provided and retained on file.
  • Ensure compliance with all administration procedures. These include the development and communication of staff rosters, completion of timesheets, work arrangements, recording of maintenance work, cleaning, safety, staff training and other information as may be requested by the Aquatic Services Coordinator.
  • Assist the Aquatic Services Coordinator to develop and implement a Pool Lifeguard staff training plan to ensure a high standard of expertise in aquatic services is maintained.

The skills and experience you’ll bring to the role:

  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of Royal Lifesaving Society ‘Guidelines for Safe Pool Operation’, and other relevant guidelines and regulations.
  • Skills in the development, administration and evaluation of a wide range of recreation programs and services.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in the promotion of services, marketing and public relations relevant to Aquatic Facilities.

  • Excellent communication skills including effective community liaison.

Required Certifications & Qualifications:

  • Current Pool Lifeguard Award
  • Provide First Aid Certificate

title: Channel Performance Strategist
description:
The Cross-Channel Performance Strategist is responsible for developing and executing strategies to drive the performance and effectiveness of paid marketing campaigns across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads. They are experts in cross-channel paid advertising and utilize their knowledge to optimize campaigns, increase conversion rates, and improve ROI (Return on Investment). The Cross-Channel Performance Strategist stays up to date with industry trends, platform algorithms, and best practices to ensure the success of campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, and Programmatic channels.

Note: This role requires working night shift hours from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute cross-channel strategies: Plan, create, and implement effective campaign strategies across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads to drive traffic, increase conversions, and achieve business goals.
  • Google Ads campaign management: Plan, build, and optimize Search, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube campaigns, including keyword strategy, bidding, asset groups, audience signals, and creative variations to maximize ROAS and deliver against client KPIs.
  • Meta Ads campaign management: Plan, build, and optimize campaigns across Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram) covering objectives from awareness to conversion, leveraging audience segmentation, lookalikes, custom audiences, dynamic creative, and Advantage+ campaigns.
  • Programmatic campaign management: Set up, run, and optimize programmatic campaigns across display, video, and native channels, including bid strategy, creative rotation, audience targeting, contextual targeting, inventory selection, and viewability monitoring.
  • Google Tag Manager implementation: Implement, configure, and maintain Google Tag Manager (GTM) deployments — including triggers, variables, tags, dataLayer configuration, and custom events — to ensure accurate data capture across all marketing channels and platforms.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) management: Set up, audit, and maintain GA4 properties, including event configuration, conversion tracking, audience setup, custom dimensions, and cross-channel attribution to inform optimization decisions.
  • Keyword research and audience targeting: Conduct comprehensive keyword research, audience analysis, and targeting strategy across Search, social, and programmatic channels to identify relevant and high-performing opportunities.
  • Campaign optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns across all channels to improve performance metrics such as click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates, cost per acquisition (CPA), and return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Ad copy and creative direction: Write compelling ad copy and provide creative direction that aligns with channel best practices and campaign objectives across Search, social, and programmatic placements.
  • Landing page and conversion optimization: Collaborate with the marketing and web development teams to optimize landing pages and conversion paths for better user experience and conversion rates.
  • A/B testing: Design and execute A/B tests to evaluate different ad variations, audience segments, creative assets, landing page layouts, and campaign strategies, and implement data-driven optimizations.
  • Performance analysis and reporting: Track and analyze campaign performance metrics across channels, generate regular reports, and provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends: Keep abreast of the latest cross-channel paid media trends, platform updates (Google Ads, Meta, programmatic DSPs), algorithm changes, and industry best practices to ensure the use of cutting-edge strategies and techniques.
  • Budget management: Monitor and manage budgets effectively across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads, ensuring optimal allocation of resources to achieve desired results.
  • Collaboration and communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, development, and data analytics, to align cross-channel strategies with broader marketing initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field with 3–8 years of working experience in cross-channel performance strategy and optimization.
  • Proven experience in managing and optimizing paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube), Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram), and Programmatic DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM) implementation — including container setup, tags, triggers, variables, and dataLayer configuration.
  • Proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — including property setup, event tracking, conversion configuration, audience definition, and cross-channel attribution analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions across multiple channels.
  • Proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms, such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, programmatic DSPs, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and bid management software.
  • Excellent understanding of platform algorithms, audience targeting, bid strategies, and attribution models across Search, social, and programmatic.
  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work within deadlines.
  • Knowledge of SEO principles and how they align with paid strategies is a plus.
  • Willingness to work night shift hours (6:30 PM – 3:30 AM).

description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoomme lääkäreitä Lohjan päivystysosaston viikonloppukierroille. Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!

Mitä työ Lohjan päivystysosastolla pitää sisällään?

Terveystalo on voittanut Lohjan osastopalveluiden kilpailutuksen ja vastaa Lohjan sairaalan päivystysosaston viikonloppukierroista ja geriatrisen osaston toiminnasta. Kyseessä ei ole yksittäinen lääkärivuokraus, vaan Terveystalo vastaa kyseisten osastojen kokonaistoiminnasta toistaiseksi voimassa olevalla sopimuksella.

Päivystysosastolla on 18 potilaspaikkaa ja osaston potilasvaihtuvuus on nopeaa. Potilaat tulevat päivystysosastolle HUS-alueen päivystyksistä. Päivystysosaston ydinosaamista on akuuttigeriatria. Keskeisimpiä hoidon syitä päivystysosastolla ovat mm. akuutit infektiot, TULES-vaivat, neurologiset akuuttisairaudet tai äkillinen toimintakyvyn heikentyminen.

Terveystalo tuottaa päivystysosastolla viikonloppukierrot. Kierrot toteutetaan joka viikonloppu ja pyhäpäivisin. Osastokierto alkaa klo 10. Päivystyskierto aloitetaan lähityönä päivystysosastolta siirtyen geriatriselle osastolle 5, jonka jälkeen puhelinkierto osastolle 2 ja Villa Auraan. Kotisairaala voi konsultoida päivystävää lääkäriä klo 10–14 välillä. Tarvittaessa päivystävä lääkäri käy toteamassa vainajat Lohjan päivystysosastolla, osastolla 5 sekä Lohjan keskustan terveysasemalla (osasto 2 ja Villa Aura). Vainajien toteamiset voidaan sopia tarvittaessa ennen kierrosta (klo 8-10) tai sen jälkeen (klo 14-16).

Potilastietojärjestelmänä toimii Lifecare. Päivystysosaston viikonloppukierrot ovat startanneet Terveystalolla toukokuussa ja uusia päivystäjiä mahtuu rinkiin lokakuusta alkaen! Sopimuksemme Lohjan sairaalan osastotoimintaan on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva.

Terveystalo tarjoaa monipuolisia Henkilöstöpalveluita hyvinvointialueille ja yksityisille yrityksille lyhytaikaiseen sekä pitkäaikaiseen tarpeeseen. Terveystalon Henkilöstöpalveluissa räätälöimme sinulle sopivan työkokonaisuuden, joka voi sisältää esimerkiksi pidemmän työkokonaisuuden yhdessä toimipaikassa, viikoittaisia vakiovuoroja tietyissä toimipisteissä tai satunnaisia keikkavuoroja silloin, kun sinulle sopii. Kauttamme voit tehdä töitä esimerkiksi terveysasemilla, vuodeosastoilla ja päivystyksissä. Tarjoamme sinulle aina omiin ammatillisiin kiinnostuksenkohteisiisi ja omiin kehitystavoitteisiisi sopivia työkokonaisuuksia. Yhteyshenkilömme ovat ammattilaisten keskuudessa todella pidettyjä (lääkärikollegojesi suositteluindeksi-NPS 4,6/5). Et jää missään vaiheessa yksin, ja yhteyshenkilösi huolehtii kaikista käytännön asioista, jotta sinä voit keskittyä olennaiseen.

Lue lisää lääkäreiden kokemuksista Terveystalon Julkisissa palveluissa työskentelystä!

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailmaa muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kilpailukykyinen palkitseminen ja monipuoliset edut. Meillä palkitseminen ja palkkiomallit ovat kilpailukykyiset, ja tarjoamme työsuhteisille ammattilaisillemme monipuoliset työsuhteen edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, mm. lyhytpsykoterapian. Ammatinharjoittajille tarjoamme vaihtuvat kumppanietumme ja muun muassa mahdollisuuden sopimushintaiseen työterveyshuoltoon. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Pätevyysvaatimuksena Lohjan sairaalan osastokierroille on lisensiaatin tutkinto ja vähintään yksi vuosi osastokokemusta tai työkokemusta ikääntyneiden parissa.

Työn menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää lisäksi hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa. Ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta tai ota yhteyttä suoraan yhteyspäällikkö Nenna Rissaseen (nenna.rissanen@terveystalo.com, 0505304528).

title: Full-spectrum Doula (California)
description:
Loula is seeking experienced full-spectrum doulas to join our growing network of independent doula providers! You must complete this interest form to move forward in our process! We're excited to hear from you!

✨ About Loula

With a network of over 500 experienced and diverse doulas, Loula is building the leading provider network for birth and postpartum doula care. We partner with both Medicaid and commercial health insurance plans to make it easier for doulas to accept health insurance without the administrative burden.

Loula offers full-service support for Medicaid enrollment, credentialing, insurance verification, medical billing, and payment to doulas in California. By taking on the operational complexity, Loula empowers doulas to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care.

We believe every birthing person deserves access to high-quality doula support, not just those who can afford to pay out of pocket. Our mission is to help doulas build thriving practices while making it possible for insured families to access the care they deserve.

💰 Why Partner with Loula?

We partner with our doulas every step of the way:

  • How much can I make? Up to $134/hour of billable time, with rates varying by payer and plan.

  • Direct deposits twice a month. Don't worry about denied claims! We pay you regardless of claim outcomes, so you're never left waiting on payers to get paid.

  • Free, hassle-free credentialing: We get you credentialed with major Medicaid and commercial insurance plans in California, at no cost to you.

  • Client referrals, not cold outreach: Get referrals to insured clients through our client referral/doula matching program. Let our Care Navigator introduce you to amazing clients, no marketing spend required on your end.

  • Build your own practice, your way: You're an independent contractor in a non-exclusive network, so keep your own clients and practice alongside your work with Loula.

  • No minimums, no pressure: There are no client minimums or visit requirements. You decide how much or how little to take on.

  • Admin? Handled: We manage insurance verification, billing, and payment so you can spend your time with clients, not paperwork.

  • You're not alone: Join a network of experienced doulas with access to shared resources, community, and ongoing support.

🛠 Minimum Qualifications

You'll need one of the following:

  • Completed 16 hours of birth doula training AND attended 3 births as a doula, OR

  • 5 years of experience as a doula, with 3 letters of recommendation

You'll also need:

  • Adult and infant CPR training

  • HIPAA training

  • Liability insurance

If you don't yet have CPR training, HIPAA training, liability insurance, or the letters of recommendation, you can still reach out! We can support you in getting set up with these requirements.

Please note that if you are not located in California and/or do not meet the minimum qualifications listed above, we will be unable to move forward with an introductory meeting.

📝 Application Process

How can I learn more about partnering with Loula?

  1. Click this link to submit an interest form and start the process

  2. You'll be prompted to complete a few basic screening questions

  3. If you meet the minimum qualifications, you'll be invited to schedule a call with our team

  4. During this conversation, we'll get to know you, your experience, and your practice goals, and share more about how Loula works. This is meant to assess whether a partnership is a strong mutual fit.

Loula is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

description:
Senior Specialist - Data Modelling

Location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

Workplace: on_site

Description

JOB PURPOSE

Responsible for analyzing and improving current data models and building an organizational data model that represents the CB and its relationships to the Licensed Financial Institutions. Focused on reducing data redundancy, improving data migration, or facilitating data retrieval. Works with other professionals like data scientists and database administrators to design critical data models that help the organization's decision-making and customer experience processes. Understands how CBUAE uses its core data and maintaining data integrity by eliminating redundancy.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

  • Support informed and data-driven decision making by defining conceptual, logical and physical data models to support the core data for departments in the Central Bank and its subsidiaries
  • Develop and implement the core data model in the new Enterprise Data Management platform, improving quality of data, integrity, access, and security
  • Develop modelling standards
  • Oversee the development of conceptual models to deliver bank's tech platforms, including data lake and analytics, working with data modelers and business leads
  • Maintain up-to-date personal knowledge and understanding of banking and financial laws and regulations along with practices of international organizations
  • Ensure examiners and other BSD staff are trained and skilled at using and understanding the data platforms and processes
  • Embody the brand and be an ambassador in all internal & external customer transactions, communications and process applications

Self-Management Responsibilities

  • Defines performance goals at the start of the year in discussion with the reporting manager and ensures that the goals are achieved during the course of the year
  • Identifies training and development requirements for self & team with the reporting manager to ensure that the required trainings are arranged and attended
  • Strives to achieve the highest levels of proficiency on all the competencies and skills required to perform the role
  • Keeps abreast of professional developments, new techniques and current issues through continued education and professional growth

Threshold Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree

Years & Nature of Experience

  • Min 10+ yrs in Data Architecture, Data Modelling, inc min 5 yrs in Financial Services
  • Experience in one or more DB technologies, vendors and models, including RDBMS, Snowflake, Star schemas or HDFS
  • Experience understanding business needs, gathering requirements, then modelling that
  • Knowledge & Experience of a variety of Financial and Banking systems & Applications
  • Ability to influence effectively at all levels
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • A data certification such as CMDP or CIMP is a plus

title: Wellbeing Navigator Peer
description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

If you’d like to know more about our reconciliation commitment, click here Reconciliation | Wellways

  • Utilise your real-life experience to engage, support and empower people in our community
  • Full time opportunity to join until 30 June 2027 | Secondment coverage
  • NFP values based company + salary packaging up to $15,899 + 17.5% leave loading

About the opportunity

This role has become available as a result of an internal career development opportunity within our team.

This role will see you working alongside participants to support and enable them, their families and carers to address their psychosocial, emotional and alcohol and other drug support needs. You will be walking alongside participants at every step of their time in the program; from the initial conversation, to delivering one on one service navigation, care planning, education and capacity building.

This is a rewarding opportunity to join a new and progressive mental health program – where you will play a vital role in ensuring participants, carers and their families receive valuable and supportive care.

Please click here to download a copy of the position description to see further details relating to this role.

This role provides support across our three program sites in Benalla, Wangaratta and Mansfield, so the successful candidate will be willing and able to work from each location as required.

About you
This role is identified for someone who feels comfortable to draw on their personal lived experience of mental health challenges and recovery to empower their peers on their own recovery journey.

You’re empathetic and relish opportunities to make a meaningful difference in the lives of people in our community. You will also have the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team, including alongside team members who have lived and living experience of mental health challenges or as carers of loved ones who do.

You will also need:

  • Certificate IV/Diploma in Mental Health, AOD or tertiary qualification in social science or 1+ year relevant work experience in the Mental Health Sector or Intentional Peer Support Training
  • 100 points of identification
  • Evidence of right to work in Australia
  • Satisfactory National Police Records Check, NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check
  • NDIS Workers Orientation module certificate – free online course

About the service

Wellways, Albury Wodonga Health and Australian Community Support Organisation (ACSO) are working together to provide mental health and wellbeing supports in Benalla & Wangaratta to ensure everyone can access treatment and care closer to home.

The Benalla, Mansfield & Wangaratta (BWM) Mental Health and Wellbeing Local will provide welcoming and inclusive support for people aged 26 years and over who are experiencing mental health challenges, including people with co-occurring alcohol and drug addiction treatment and care needs.

More than ever before, we are working with the local community and people who have a personal experience of mental health issues and recovery to build these services so they are the best they can be. Our services are co-designed by consumers, carers and the local community.

What we will offer you…

  • A purpose driven culture where people can thrive, everyone is respected, and differences are valued
  • An equitable, diverse, and socially inclusive work environment
  • Salary packaging up to $15,899 enables you to spend a portion of your salary before it is taxed to pay for things like rent, mortgage repayments, car leasing
  • Meal and Entertainment allowance via salary packaging up to $2,650 per annum
  • Receive 17.5% leave loading every time you take annual leave
  • Paid parental leave after 12 months of ongoing employment
  • Access for you and your family to our Employee Assistance Program

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Kirby Snowdon, Senior Peer Wellbeing Navigator on 0419 015 821 or via ksnowdon@mentalhealthwellbeing.org.

We'd love to get to know you!

Please include a cover letter as well as a resume/CV in your application.

We encourage early applications are assessed as they are received and interviews may commence prior to the closing date.

Wellways is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. Successful applicants must undergo a comprehensive screening process prior to their commencement.

Rewarding opportunity to work alongside individuals, carers and families to ensure they feel heard and supported in our community.

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential. We know that people are unique and the experts on their life and are not defined by impairments, diagnosis or labels. We aim to specifically promote safety and inclusivity for LGBTIQ+ and First Nations communities.

title: CNC-operatör
description:
Hos Töreboda Mekaniska erbjuds du en varierad roll som CNC-operatör där du arbetar i produktionen och successivt får växa in i ett större ansvar. Här kombineras praktiskt arbete i maskin med teknisk utveckling och möjligheten att följa detaljen hela vägen från ritning till färdig produkt.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som CNC-operatör på Töreboda Mekaniska får du arbeta med hela CNC-processen – från programmering och riggning till produktion, kvalitetskontroll och färdig detalj. Här följer du arbetet från start till mål och har en viktig roll i att säkerställa hög kvalitet genom hela tillverkningsprocessen.

Du kommer främst att arbeta med CNC-svarvning i Traub-maskiner.

Inledningsvis ansvarar du för den dagliga driften av maskinerna, där du övervakar produktionen, mäter och kontrollerar detaljer samt utför gradning vid behov. I takt med att du kommer in i rollen får du successivt utvecklas och lära dig mer avancerade moment som programmering, riggning, omställning och inkörning av maskiner med målet att självständigt kunna ansvara för hela tillverkningsprocessen, från ritning till färdig produkt.

Utöver arbetet vid maskinerna kan även andra produktionsrelaterade arbetsuppgifter förekomma, såsom tvättning av detaljer, kontrollräkning, paketering av färdiga artiklar samt övriga förekommande moment i produktionen. Har du truckkort kan du även komma att arbeta med lastning av in- och utgående gods.

Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid, måndag-fredag.

Du blir erbjuden en anställning hos Töreboda Mekaniska med start omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.

title: Senior Central Monitor
description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management. This position involves leading the development of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) plans, conducting study risk assessments, identifying study KRIs (in collaboration with Functional leads), performing ongoing centralized statistical monitoring, remote centralized data review, and facilitating monthly RBQM meetings. works independently and manages report review and issue escalation for more complex studies and/or portfolios of work. Further, the Central Monitor may mentor junior colleagues, and may support the development of processes, procedures and other documentation to ensure a high functioning team

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Lead Development of RBQM Plan: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement comprehensive RBQM plans tailored to each study's specific needs - including identification of critical data & process, definition of KRIs & QTLs and centralized monitoring approach
  • Study Risk Assessment: Conduct thorough risk assessments for clinical studies, identifying potential issues and developing mitigation strategies, in consultation with functional team leads and PM
  • Centralized Statistical Monitoring: Perform centralized statistical monitoring & data analysis on study data to detect anomalies, trends, and potential risks, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
  • RBQM Meetings: lead facilitation of monthly RBQM meetings by supporting review of study data, documenting findings, action plans and coordination of data cleaning activities to support study deliverables
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of data quality and integrity through proactive monitoring and timely interventions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and other departments to support proactive oversight and management and data cleaning for studies
  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on monitoring activities, findings, and recommendations for sponsors and study teams.
  • Operational Insights: Oversee operational study metrics, including data entry trends, SDV backlog, site health trending and proactively communicate issues to study team members to drive towards resolution & proactive remediation
  • Mentor and Support Junior Colleagues: Act as a mentor to more junior Central Monitors - sharing best practices, lessons learned, etc. to improve team performance
  • Sponsor Engagement and Communications: support discussions with Sponsors around risk management and proactive data cleaning

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 5 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and the clinical development process

Other Required:

  • Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English, including strong grammar and scientific vocabulary skills
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Strong understanding of RBQM principles and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems, clinical systems, dashboards, and to leverage these data to assess risk
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management
  • Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

  • CRO experience as a Central Monitor

Skills:

  • Statistical analysis and data monitoring
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Report writing and presentation
  • Collaboration and teamwork

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

Equal Employment Opportunity Information

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.
