  • Strong knowledge of Electronic Miscellaneous Documents, including associated and standalone EMDs, issuance, exchange, refund, usage, status control, interline EMD, and links between EMDs, tickets, passengers, segments, and services.
  • Practical knowledge of airline ancillaries such as paid seats, baggage, meals, lounge access, priority services, flexibility products, and other optional services across booking, fulfilment, servicing, airport, and distribution channels.
  • Experience with Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport, TravelSky, or comparable reservation and ticketing platforms; SabreSonic PSS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of industry messaging and interfaces used for ticketing, IET, EMD, and ancillary fulfilment, with the ability to analyse transaction flows and troubleshoot integration or data issues.
  • Proven ability to elicit and document requirements, define solution and configuration needs, prepare test strategies and scenarios, manage defects, obtain customer sign-off, and assess implementation readiness.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex airline business and technical concepts to customer, product, engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders.

  • Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end service delivery for PNR, ticketing, IET, EMD, and ancillary initiatives across multiple airline customers, ensuring scope, milestones, quality, and customer expectations are managed effectively.
  • Act as the primary functional and technical subject matter expert for airline fulfilment, advising customers and internal teams on solution design, configuration, operational processes, and industry-aligned practices.
  • Own discovery and requirements workshops, identify dependencies and prerequisites, validate business scenarios, and translate customer needs into implementation-ready requirements and delivery plans.
  • Coordinate solution activities across Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Project Management, Operations, Airport, Distribution, Revenue Accounting, and third-party or interline partner teams.
  • Lead PNR, e-ticket, IET, EMD, and ancillary configuration reviews, test preparation, integration validation, partner certification, cutover planning, production activation, and post-implementation support.
  • Define and oversee end-to-end test coverage for booking, ticketing, exchanges, refunds, coupon control, EMD fulfilment, ancillary servicing, schedule changes, codeshare, and interline scenarios.
  • Lead investigation of complex production and testing issues, analyse application and message flows, coordinate specialist teams, track corrective actions, and provide clear status and risk communications.
  • Maintain delivery governance through status reporting, risk and dependency management, escalation, decision tracking, readiness reviews, and alignment with project milestones and customer commitments.
  • Review release documentation and product changes, assess impacts to customer processes and integrations, and ensure operational, support, and training materials are complete and accurate.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer, workshops, and training for airline and internal teams on PNR servicing, ticketing, IET, EMD, ancillary fulfilment, and related troubleshooting practices.
  • Coach engineers and delivery specialists, promote reusable playbooks and quality standards, and contribute to continuous improvement across service delivery processes

title: Senior Software Engineer, Test
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Our Vertical Search team's mission is to deliver the best TV search experience: fast, comprehensive, and reliably relevant. For REA Vertical Search, that means helping users discover the right content across typed, voice, and assistant-driven experiences while supporting a growing set of subscription services and Roku Channel discovery surfaces. We partner with search engineers, ML engineers, product managers, and data partners to define quality strategy for relevance-sensitive experiences, build scalable automation and evaluation frameworks, and apply agentic automation to keep pace with expanding catalog breadth and use cases.

What is the role?

We are looking for a Lead, Search Relevance Quality to work closely with the Roku Vertical Search Team to define, measure, and improve Search and Assistant relevance quality. This person will lead quality strategy for relevance-sensitive experiences, build scalable automation and evaluation frameworks, and apply agentic automation to keep pace with expanding catalog breadth and use cases. The role requires balancing automated quality systems with pragmatic human-in-the-loop review where needed until confidence and coverage are high. Quality for Vertical Search will be measured with clear, trusted metrics rather than inferred only from downstream engagement signals. Search and Assistant launches will have reusable relevance-evaluation coverage, stronger release confidence, and faster debugging loops. The team can scale quality across a growing number of subscription services and Roku Channel experiences without linear growth in manual effort.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents, setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.

At Roku, we're embracing AI as a powerful tool to amplify human creativity, accelerate innovation, and deliver better results for our customers. Across teams, we're exploring how AI can enhance our work and we're only looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to grow alongside these technologies.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Define the quality strategy for Vertical Search and Assistant relevance across Roku Premium subscription services, Roku Channel search journeys, and related discovery experiences
  • Build scalable frameworks to measure search quality across query understanding, retrieval, ranking, result presentation, and assistant response quality
  • Create automated evaluation pipelines for offline, pre-launch, and continuous post-launch quality monitoring using modern test infrastructure and agentic workflows
  • Partner with search engineers, ML engineers, product managers, and data partners to define KPI hypotheses, guardrails, and learning plans for quality-related launches and experiments
  • Develop quality signals and gold-standard datasets for vertical search, including subscription-service discovery, entity matching, ranking relevance, and assistant answer quality
  • Use agentic automation to generate, maintain, and expand test coverage and evaluation assets while ensuring governance, traceability, and reliability of the resulting workflows
  • Introduce the right mix of manual review and automation for ambiguous or high-impact experiences until the automated system is proven and trusted
  • Drive root-cause analysis for relevance regressions and quality escapes, and convert findings into durable frameworks, dashboards, and release gates
  • Lead end-to-end test and quality architecture for relevance-heavy search and assistant systems
  • Design evaluation methodologies for search result quality, assistant response quality, and discovery experience consistency
  • Build APIs, tools, datasets, and automation harnesses for offline and online quality validation
  • Establish CI/CD quality gates for ranking, retrieval, and assistant-related regressions
  • Partner with engineering to instrument systems for observability, diagnosis, and actionable quality telemetry
  • Translate vague quality concerns into measurable test plans, labeled datasets, and scalable automation workflows
  • Mentor engineers on quality engineering best practices and raise the technical bar for automation design, signal quality, and testability

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 8+ years in relevance quality engineering, or software engineering roles with significant ownership of automation and system quality
  • Strong coding skills in Python, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to build production-grade test frameworks and internal tooling
  • Deep experience with API, integration, service, and UI automation in complex distributed systems
  • Experience defining test strategy, test design, and quality architecture for large-scale products
  • Strong analytical ability to define metrics, interpret results, and isolate root causes across data, ranking logic, and system behavior
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and data stakeholders
  • Experience introducing scalable automation in environments where quality must be measured, not assumed
  • Experience with search relevance, ranking systems, information retrieval, recommendations, NLP, ASR/NLU, or LLM/assistant evaluation
  • Experience building quality frameworks for user-intent-heavy products where correctness is subjective and must be inferred through labels, rubrics, or review processes
  • Familiarity with agentic AI tooling for test generation, evaluation orchestration, or QA workflow automation
  • Experience supporting experimentation-driven teams where every meaningful change has KPI hypotheses and guardrails
  • Experience with subscription, media, streaming, or catalog discovery products
  • You have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks, and you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools; you know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you
#LI-DN1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit .

If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Ohjaaja (AMK), Nuorten palvelut
description:
Jos haluat olla osana antirasistisia ja aidosti kaikkien saatavilla olevia sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluita ja vaikuttaa merkittävästi maahanmuuttajataustaisten perheiden hyvinvointiin Helsingissä, hae Helmi-palveluun ohjaajaksi!

RRP-hankkeena kehitetty ja vuodenvaihteessa 2026 vakinaistettu Helmi-palvelu toteuttaa maahanmuuttajataustaisten nuorten ja perheiden monialaista toimintamallia ja pyrkii vastaamaan lastensuojelun ja perhesosiaalityön asiakkaana olevien päihteillä tai mielenterveydellä oireilevien 7-17-vuotiaiden maahanmuuttajataustaisten lasten ja nuorten ja heidän perheidensä tarpeisiin monialaisen ja nuori- ja perhekohtaisesti räätälöidyn työskentelyn keinoin.

Helmi-palveluun haetaan yhtä uutta ohjaajaa. Ohjaajana työskentelet toimintamallimme mukaisesti n. 10-15 nuoren ja heidän perheensä perhetyöntekijänä vahvassa työpari- ja tiimityössä aikuissosiaalityön sosiaaliohjaajan ja terveydenhoitajan kanssa. Ohjaajan tehtävä on suunnitelmallista ja tavoitteellista muutostyötä perheissä. Lisäksi vastaat asiakasprosessin etenemisestä ja koordinoit monialaista työskentelyä muiden ammattiryhmien kanssa. Esihenkilönäsi toimii tiimin johtava ohjaaja. Tiimimme työtä tuetaan työnohjauksella ja tiimin omalla case-työskentelyrakenteella.

Toimintamallin tarjoama apu ja tuki pohjautuu sosiaalityöntekijän laatimaan asiakassuunnitelmaan ja perhetyön toteuttamissuunnitelmaan. Toimintamallissa keskeistä on antirasistinen ja systeeminen työote. Työskentelyn ydinelementit rakentuvat nuoren ja vanhemman kanssa tehtävästä jalkautuvasta yksilötyöstä sekä perheen vuorovaikutussuhteita vahvistavasta työskentelystä.

Työ on liikkuvaa ja tapahtuu asiakkaiden toimintaympäristöissä. Toimistomme sijaitsee Herttoniemessä Silkkikutomolla. Työaika on 38,25 tuntia viikossa asiakasperheiden tarpeen mukaisina aikoina. Tämän takia työtehtäväsi voi sisältää satunnaisesti ilta- tai viikonlopputöitä, vaikka tavallinen työpäiväsi sijoittuukin n. klo 9-17 välille.

Rekrytointiprosessi alkaa ensimmäiseen haastatteluun valittujen kesken ryhmähaastatteluilla iltapäivällä 3.9.2026, varaathan kalenteriisi mahdollisuuden osallistua. Ryhmähaastattelusta kutsutaan menestyneimmät hakijat yksilöhaastatteluihin, jotka pyritään pitämään viikolla 37. Työhaastatteluihin osallistuu rekrytoiva esihenkilö toisen Nuorten palvelujen esihenkilön sekä Helmi-palvelun ohjaajan kanssa.

Helsingin kaupunki arvostaa yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eritaustaisia henkilöitä, kuten eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolta olevia ja eri kieli-, kulttuuri- tai vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia. Palkattavan työntekijän valinnassa voidaan toteuttaa positiivista erityiskohtelua monipuolisen henkilöstörakenteen edistämiseksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn lisäksi laajat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Koska elämä ei ole pelkkää työtä, meillä huolehditaan myös työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainosta. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden sisältäen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Etua voi saada korkeintaan 550 euroa kalenterivuodelta. Käytettävissä oleva saldo määräytyy työsuhteesi pituuden perusteella. Lisäksi käytettävissäsi on lounasetu. Saat käyttöösi henkilöstöetuna myös kaupunkipyörän ja voit halutessasi vierailla kaupungin työntekijöiden omalla virkistyssaarella.

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä, jos sinulla herää kysymyksiä työtehtävästä! Anonyymin rekrytoinnin vuoksi lisätietojen antaja ei osallistu haastateltavien valintaan.

Katri Horuz, johtava sosiaaliohjaaja
katri.horuz@hel.fi
040 5768721

Kelpoisuusehto:

Sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilölain 817/2015 (8§) mukainen sosiaalialalle soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (sosionomi tai kuntoutuksen ohjaaja) tai terveydenhuollon ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (sairaanhoitaja) tai yhteisöpedagogi, tai aikaisempi sosiaali- ja terveysalan opistoasteinen tutkinto. Edellytämme rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston ammattihenkilörekisteriin (pois lukien yhteisöpedagogi).

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Muu kielitaito lasketaan eduksi.

Edellytämme työkokemusta lastensuojelusta, perhetyöstä tai muusta perheiden kodeissa ja arkiympäristöissä tehtävästä työstä sekä dokumentointitaitoja.

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä sekä huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Luemme eduksi:
- kokemus maahanmuuttajataustaisten asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelemisestä
- kokemus monialaisesta yhteistyöstä
- lastensuojelun ja sosiaalihuollon avopalveluiden ja lainsäädännön tuntemus
- kokemusta perhetyöstä
- menetelmälliset koulutukset (esim. neuropsykiatrinen osaaminen, perhearviointimenetelmät tai kognitiivinen käyttäytymisterapia) ja muut näyttöön perustuvat menetelmät
- ymmärrys systeemisestä ja antirasistisesta työotteesta

Mistä on kyse?

Rakennussiivoojana työtehtäviisi kuuluu monipuoliset saneeraustyömaan rakennussiivoojan työtehtävät. Työ sisältää muun muassa yleisestä siivoudesta huolehtimista sekä raivausta ja roudaamista. Työt alkavat heti sopivien tekijöiden löydyttyä, ja työn arvioitu kesto on n. 2 vko.

Toivomme sinulta jonkin verran aiempaa kokemusta rakennusapulaisen tai rakennussiivoojan työtehtävistä. Käytännön osaaminen, oma-aloitteisuus ja hyvä asenne ratkaisevat. Palkkaus määräytyy talonrakennusalan työehtosopimuksen sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.

Kerro hakemuksessasi, millaisissa rakennuskohteissa olet työskennellyt, millaista työtä etsit sekä halutessasi palkkatoiveesi. Mikäli työkielesi on jokin muu kuin suomi, mainitsethan siitä myös hakemuksessasi.

Kuinka haen Carrotille?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa, ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin työhakemuksen jättäneisiin. title: Neuroscience Specialist, Health and Science Professional - Pensacola, FL
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues can grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged; and can impact the health and lives of millions of people. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.

Pfizer is advancing in Neuroscience, and an integral part of the Migraine Team’s mission is to promote a breakthrough therapy for patients suffering from migraine.

The Neuroscience Health & Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for increasing territory sales and relationship development with assigned customers and accounts by engaging in product promotion and determining the best strategies to manage their business.

The HSP should possess customer, market, and business acumen, analytical skills, and strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate ability to drive sales, promotional and strategic business development and management skills, and in-depth customer engagement expertise both in-person and virtually; demonstrate outstanding communication and teamwork skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools; and be effective at working remotely in collaboration with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drives sales in assigned territory

  • Engages with customers both face to face and virtually

  • Develops and implements effective business and territory call plans; effectively identifies and implements live/virtual engagement strategies with customer to maximize overall effectiveness and impact

  • Effectively builds rapport and relationships with customers in both live and virtual environments; uses judgment to maintain customer engagement by successfully utilizing existing and ever-changing digital tools effectively for successful customer engagement

  • Understands and leverages internal reports and analytics to assist with identifying, developing, and implementing strategic business opportunities

  • Compliantly leverages product and disease state knowledge to appropriately educate providers on unbranded and branded product value proposition for relevant patient populations and effectively and strategically utilizes approved clinically oriented disease state information and patient resources, as applicable

  • Demonstrates strong teamwork capabilities to collaborate effectively and compliantly across the organization to address customer inquiries and advance Pfizer objectives.

  • Completes all administrative expectations on time and compliantly.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in one or more of the following OR an associate’s degree with 6+ years of experience; OR high school diploma (or equivalent) with 8+ years of relevant experience:

  • Professional Sales or Promotional Activity

  • Small Business Owner or other Entrepreneurial experience, Marketing, Customer Service and/or Account Management

  • Relevant Healthcare/Scientific roles (e.g., RN, Pharmacist, PT, OT, etc.)

  • Educator (e.g., Teacher, Principal)

  • Full Time Military experience

  • Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory.

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 1 year of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical sales and/or medical related marketing.

  • Strong track record of sales or marketing success, strong territory management skills, outstanding communications skills, as well as demonstrated teamwork, leadership ability and accountability.

  • Experience with applicable disease states, therapeutic area, and products.

  • Knowledge of posted territory customers and markets (prescribers/HCPs/institutions/organizations).

  • Reside within the territory boundaries.

Other Job Details

  • Last Date to Apply: September 05, 2026.

  • Geography Includes: Pensacola, Fort Walton Beach - FL & South Alabama.

  • Work Location Assignment: Remote - Field Based.

title: Osastofarmaseutti, kirurgian vuodeosasto R3, Lahti
description:
Haemme osastofarmaseuttia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Päijät-Hämeen keskussairaalaan, Lahteen.

Päijät-Hämeen keskussairaalan yhteydessä toimiva sairaala-apteekki huolehtii hyvinvointialueen lääkehuollon palveluista. Sairaala-apteekissa työskentelee noin 55 alan ammattilaista, joista osastoilla työskentelee lähes 30 henkilöä. Lääketoimitusten lisäksi painopisteitämme ovat mm. lääkkeenvalmistus, solunsalpaajien käyttökuntoon saattaminen ja osastofarmasia.

Haemme farmaseuttia osaksi moniammatillista tiimiä! Työskentelet kirurgian erikoissairaanhoidon vuodeosastolla R3 (ortopedia ja traumatologia, 25-30 potilaspaikkaa). Tehtävä muutetaan tässä yhteydessä kliinisen farmasian asiantuntijatehtäväksi ja pääset siis luomaan uudenlaista tehtävänkuvaa yksikköön yhteistyössä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Tehtävässä päivitetään potilaiden lääkelistat potilastietojärjestelmään ajantasaisiksi sekä tehdään tarvittavia lääkityksen tarkistuksia ja arviointeja. Työllä tuetaan osastohoidon sujuvuutta ja potilaan turvallista siirtymistä jatkohoitoon tai kotiin. Lisäksi potilaita neuvotaan lääkkeiden oikeassa käytössä ja heidän lääkehoitoonsa liittyviä haasteita ratkaistaan yhteistyössä heidän kanssaan. Näin edistetään turvallista, onnistunutta ja vaikuttavaa lääkehoitoa yhteistyössä osastojen henkilöstön ja potilaiden kanssa.

Lääkehoidon prosessien kehittäminen on keskeinen osa tehtävääsi. Työhön sisältyy lisäksi i.v.-lääkkeiden käyttökuntoon saattamista, lääkehoidon näyttöjen vastaanottamista, hoitohenkilökunnan kouluttamista sekä erilaisten lääkeinfojen pitämistä, mikä tekee työstä monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan.

Kirurgian vuodeosastoilla R4 ja R5 työskentelee kaksi muutakin osastofarmaseuttia, joten kollegiaalista tukea on tarjolla. Yksikössä työskentelee myös osastolääketyöntekijä lääkelogistiikan tehtävissä. Ja uutta teknologiaakin on otettu käyttöön eli älylääkekaapit.

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa kliinisen farmasian osaamista, itsenäistä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta, hyviä itsensä johtamisen taitoja sekä erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta uuden oppimiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen, joten ole rohkea ja hyppää kliinisen farmasian kiehtovaan maailmaan!

Sinä olet meille tärkeä, ja siksi meillä on työhyvinvointisi tueksi kattavat työterveyspalvelut ja henkilöstöedut.
Työyhteisömme jäsenenä saat:
- Ammatistaan ylpeän työyhteisön ja kannustavan ilmapiirin, joka auttaa pitämään motivaation kohdallaan
- Työelämän sujuvaa yhteensovittamista arjen kanssa, olemme mukana Väestöliiton Perheystävällinen työpaikka -ohjelmassa
- Työterveyspalvelut ja niihin kuuluvan Terveyssovelluksen

Arvostamme myös laadukasta vapaa-aikaa. Tarjoamme lomaetuja sekä työyhteisön tapahtumat ja virkistyspäivät. Jokainen työntekijämme on työntekijäyhdistys Pähe ry:n jäsen. Pähellä on useita vapaa-ajanosastoja kuorosta salibandyyn, ja se onnistuu usein neuvottelemaan meille edullisempia lippuja alueen tapahtumiin sekä alennuksia erilaisiin palveluihin.

Päijät-Hämeen maakuntakeskus Lahti on lahes täydellinen kaupunki lähellä kaikkea. Lahti on lahtelaisten lisäksi tunnettu hiihdosta ja Suomen toiseksi suurimmasta keskussairaalasta. Hyppyrimäkien ja radiomastojen kaupungin kesäisenä olohuoneena toimii Sibeliustalon ja Vesijärven maisemoima satama-alue. Salpausselän harjumaisemista ja kulttuuritarjonnasta nautiskellaan ympärivuotisesti.Luonto on meille päijäthämäläisille tärkeä elementti ja sanotaankin, että jokaisella lahtelaisella on kaupunki etupihalla ja luonto takapihalla.

Edellytämme sinulta terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/94) mukaista farmaseutin laillistusta sekä tartuntatautilain 48 §:n edellyttämää rokotussuojaa. Tehtävään valittu henkilö on velvollinen esittämään todistuksen terveydentilastaan ja huumausainetestiä koskevan todistuksen. Valitulle tehdään hänen suostumuksellaan turvallisuusselvitys (Turvallisuusselvityslaki, 726/2014). Tehtävässä noudatamme 6kk koeaikaa. Työskentelykielemme on suomi, joten odotamme sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.

Kiinnostuitko? Kysy lisää!
Haethan kuitenkin pian, sillä tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Yleislääkäri, Iisalmi
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt tärkeimmän tekijöiden osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoomme Yleislääkäriä Iisalmeen. Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!

Mitä työ yleislääkärinä Iisalmessa pitää sisällään?

Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva yleislääkäri tai jo kokenut osaaja. Yleislääkärinä teet ajanvarauksellista vastaanottotyötä, jossa asiakkaat asioivat vastaanotollasi yleislääkäritasoisissa asioissa. Asiakkaitasi ovat esimerkiksi yksityisasiakkaat, työterveyshuollon sairasvastaanoton asiakkaat, vakuutusasiakkaat ja Kelan valinnanvapauskokeilun 65 vuotta täyttäneitä asiakkaita.

Syyskuussa käynnistynyt valinnanvapauskokeilu tuo 65 vuotta täyttäneille mahdollisuuden asioida yksityisellä yleislääkärillä julkisen terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksun hinnalla.

Mitä palveluja valinnanvapauskokeilu kattaa?
- Yleislääkärin 20 min. vastaanotot toimipaikassa tai etänä (video- ja puhelinvastaanotot). - Tietyt yleislääkärin määräämät tutkimukset, kuten tietyt verikokeet, virtsatutkimukset, sydämen EKG ja keuhkokuvat. - Kokeilu kattaa loppuvuonna 2025 kaksi ja vuosina 2026 ja 2027 kolme vuosittaista yleislääkärikäyntiä. - Kokeiluun kuuluvat tutkimukset näet Terveystalon verkkosivuilta: Valinnanvapauskokeilu 65 vuotta täyttäneille | Terveystalo.
Voit työskennellä joustavasti osa- tai kokoaikaisesti, kuukausipalkalla tai ammatinharjoittajana. Autamme sinua tarvittaessa sopivan työskentelymallin valinnassa. Työt suunnitellaan sinun aikatauluihisi sopivaksi. Terveystalo Iisalmi on avoinna maanantai ja torstai klo 17:30 ja tiistai, keskiviikko ja perjantai klo 17:00. Meillä voit myös suorittaa erikoistumista työterveyshuoltoon tai pätevöityä työterveyslääkäriksi Terveystalolle räätälöidyllä pitkällä kurssilla.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Me teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Tavoitteenamme on olla inhimillinen työntekopaikka, jossa ammattilainen voi keskittyä olennaiseen. Meillä arki on sujuvaa, välitämme toinen toisistamme ja teemme vaikuttavaa työtä.
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kilpailukykyinen palkitseminen ja monipuoliset edut. Meillä palkitseminen ja palkkiomallit ovat kilpailukykyiset, ja tarjoamme työsuhteisille ammattilaisillemme monipuoliset työsuhteen edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, työsuhdepyöräedun (riippuen työsuhteen muodosta ja kestosta), kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, mm. lyhytpsykoterapian. Ammatinharjoittajille tarjoamme vaihtuvat kumppanietumme ja muun muassa mahdollisuuden sopimushintaiseen työterveyshuoltoon. - Oma lääkäri- ja asiantuntijavastaava. Meillä lääketieteellisen tuen lisäksi työtäsi helpottaa ja tukee oma nimetty lääkäri- ja asiantuntijavastaavasi Riina, joka tukee sinua arkesi suunnittelussa, huolehtii perehdytyksestäsi Terveystaloon, järjestelmiimme ja toimipisteeseen. Hän varmistaa, että arkesi on sujuvaa ja voit keskittyä ydinosaamiseesi. - Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet. Tarjoamme osaajillemme omat laadukkaat koulutuksemme, Terveystalon Lääkäripäivät, viikoittaiset Tiedosta taidoksi -koulutukset, eri erikoisalojen koulutukset ja Terveystalo Academyn monipuolisen kurssivalikoiman. Meillä voit suorittaa useita eri erityispätevyyksiä sekä pätevöityä ja erikoistua työterveyshuoltoon. Terveystalossa on myös paljon uran alkutaipaleelle räätälöityjä koulutusjaksoja, ja voit suorittaa useita YEK-osioita kauttamme. Pyrimme tukemaan kouluttautumista myös talon ulkopuolella jokaisessa uran vaiheessa.

title: Business Analyst - Business Process & Requirement Specialist
description:
Department Information

This position is open only to Colorado state residents.

Find a rewarding career making a difference: Join the Office of the Attorney General!

If you're looking for an opportunity to use your business analysis expertise to improve government services and support the legal work that serves the people of Colorado, consider joining the Colorado Department of Law. As an IT Business Analyst, you'll partner with attorneys, business professionals, technical staff, and executive stakeholders to analyze business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology solutions that enhance efficiency, security, accessibility, and customer service. This role offers the opportunity to lead business process improvement initiatives, translate complex legal and operational needs into practical technology solutions, evaluate modern software and SaaS applications, and support projects from requirements gathering through implementation and user adoption. If you enjoy solving complex business problems, building collaborative relationships, and making a meaningful impact through technology, we encourage you to apply.


WHO WE ARE

The Office of the Attorney General/Department of Law is the "People's Lawyer." The Attorney General, Phil Weiser, was elected by the people of Colorado and is the State's chief lawyer and law enforcement official. Our vision for the Department of Law is: "Together, we serve Colorado and its people, advancing the rule of law, protecting our democracy and promoting justice for all." Our core values and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, drive our actions and demonstrate our focus on being principled public servants who are innovative and better together.
Learn more about the Colorado Attorney General’s Office here.

Description of Job


The Information Technology (IT) Unit delivers user-friendly, reliable office automation, legal research, and information management solutions to enable the Department to represent client agencies and the State of Colorado in legal matters with competence and cost-effectiveness. The Unit provides system design, programming, implementation, training, technical assistance, secure technology operations, and business process support while maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and accessibility of Department systems and data.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The IT Business Analyst serves as the primary liaison between Department of Law business units, Information Technology, project teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to improve business operations through technology and process innovation. The position analyzes business needs, operational workflows, and organizational challenges to identify opportunities for business process improvement and technology solutions that support the Department's legal and administrative functions.

This position leads business analysis activities throughout the project lifecycle by eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements; evaluating commercial software and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions; supporting application modernization initiatives; and facilitating communication between business and technical teams. The IT Business Analyst coordinates user acceptance testing, change management, user training, and implementation activities while ensuring technology solutions align with business objectives, regulatory requirements, security standards, accessibility requirements, and Department technology strategies. The position also develops business cases, prepares analytical reports and recommendations, and promotes standardized business analysis practices that improve organizational effectiveness and customer service

Specific duties include but are not limited to the following:

Business Process Analysis & Improvement
  • Partner with business units to analyze business processes, operational workflows, and organizational needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline operations, and enhance customer service through business process improvements and technology solutions.
  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and interviews to understand business challenges and recommend practical solutions.
  • Serve as the liaison between business stakeholders and IT to ensure technology initiatives align with business objectives.
Business Analysis & Requirements Management
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and document business, functional, technical, and reporting requirements for new and existing technology solutions.
  • Translate business needs into clear business requirements, user stories, process maps, workflow diagrams, functional specifications, and other project documentation.
  • Evaluate commercial software and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions to determine business fit and compatibility with Department technology standards.
  • Ensure proposed solutions meet requirements for security, accessibility, interoperability, records retention, and regulatory compliance
Project Support & Solution Implementation
  • Participate in technology projects from concept through implementation by supporting project planning, stakeholder engagement, testing, training, and change management.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, defect tracking, validation, and implementation readiness.
  • Develop user documentation, procedures, job aids, and training materials to support successful adoption of new systems and business processes.
  • Collaborate with Department staff, vendors and consultants to implement technology solutions that meet business needs.
Customer Service & Continuous Improvement
  • Build collaborative relationships with business partners, project teams, vendors, and technical staff to deliver high-quality customer service.
  • Prepare reports, recommendations, and presentations by analyzing business information, trends, and project outcomes.
  • Support the development of standardized business analysis practices, templates, and documentation.
  • Stay current with business analysis methodologies, emerging technologies, accessibility standards, and industry best practices to continuously improve Department services.

This recruitment may be used to fill other similar positions within the Administration section at the Department of Law.


Salary note: Although a salary range is listed, salary will be set commensurate with the successful candidate's qualifications and in compliance with the Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Salary will be paid on a biweekly basis.


Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Residency Requirement:

This posting is only open to residents of the State of Colorado at the time of submitting your application.


Class Code & Classification Description:

T1F3XX

IT BUSINESS ANALYST III



Minimum Qualifications and Substitutions: Please document all relevant experience in detail on your application. Experience will not be inferred or assumed. Any part-time experience listed will be prorated.
Experience Only:

Three (3) years of professional experience performing business analysis, business process improvement, requirements gathering, systems analysis, project coordination, application implementation, process improvement, or a closely related function supporting business operations and technology solutions.

Experience must have included one or more of the following:

  • Eliciting, analyzing, documenting, or validating business, functional, or technical requirements;
  • Analyzing and improving business processes or operational workflows;
  • Serving as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to identify business needs and recommend technology or process solutions;
  • Preparing business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, workflow diagrams, user stories, use cases, or other business analysis documentation;
  • Participating in software implementation, application modernization, system enhancements, user acceptance testing, change management, or technology projects.

OR

Education and Experience

A combination of related education, professional certifications, and/or professional experience equal to three (3) years may substitute for the required experience.

Examples of related education include:

  • Information Technology
  • Business Administration
  • Computer Information Systems
  • Management Information Systems
  • Computer Science
  • Public Administration
  • Project Management
  • Or another closely related field.

Examples of applicable certifications include:

  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA)
  • PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA)
If you are qualifying under the Education and Experience option listed above, you must submit a copy of your transcripts and certification at the time of application. Unofficial transcripts are acceptable. Applicants who failed to provide transcripts and/or certification will not be considered for the position.

Note: Candidates possessing a foreign degree must submit a translation (evaluation) of their degree from an accredited institution, such as The National Association of Credential Evaluations Services in order to be given credit for the degree.


Preferred Qualifications: In addition to the minimum qualifications, if you possess any of the following specifically include the details on your application. This information will be used to assess your qualifications and may be used to determine a top group of applicants. Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following:


  • Experience working as an IT Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Functional Analyst.
  • Experience supporting technology projects within a government, legal, regulatory, or public-sector environment.
  • Experience evaluating Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews, or business process mapping sessions.
  • Experience using business analysis methodologies such as BABOK, or Business Process Management.
  • Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, implementation planning, and change management activities.
  • Experience preparing business cases, technical documentation, process maps, workflow diagrams, and executive reports.
  • Experience working with accessibility standards, records management requirements, data governance, privacy, or information security requirements.
  • Experience working with vendors, consultants, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Experience supporting software procurement, application modernization, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Professional certifications such as:
    • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
    • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA)
    • PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA)
Required Competencies:

  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate experience in one or more of the following:

    • Business analysis, business systems analysis, or business process analysis supporting technology or operational improvement initiatives.
    • Eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business, functional, or technical requirements.
    • Analyzing business processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and recommending practical business or technology solutions.
    • Serving as a liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and project teams to facilitate communication and deliver technology solutions that meet business needs.
    • Developing business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, workflow diagrams, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, or other business analysis documentation.
    • Participating in technology projects involving software implementation, application modernization, system enhancements, or process improvement.
    • Coordinating or facilitating User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, defect tracking, validation, and implementation readiness.
    • Preparing business cases, reports, recommendations, training materials, or user documentation to support organizational change and technology adoption.
    • Communicating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and presenting complex information in a clear, organized manner.
    • Managing multiple assignments, balancing competing priorities, and working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
    • Experience tracking workloads, case assignments, or operational metrics across teams or projects
    • Consolidating information from multiple sources (case management systems, spreadsheets, reports)
    • Developing dashboards or visual reports

Conditions of Employment:
  • Applicants must pass a thorough background investigation prior to appointment.
  • Colorado Department of Law participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

HOW TO APPLY

Applicants must establish an account with and complete the online application.

Required Application Materials: Applicant may redact information that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

  1. A completed State of Colorado Application: Applicants are responsible for ensuring that the application provided is fully completed and clearly describes their education, training and experience as it relates to this position. Applications left blank or marked “See Resume” will not be considered.
  2. Current Resume: A detailed resume outlining your background, skills and experiences including previously held positions and academic background, is required at the time of application. This document will be used to assess candidates during the comparative analysis process.
  3. Cover Letter: A detailed cover letter stating why you are interested in this position and what skills you possess that would make you a strong applicant for this position. This document will be used to assess candidates during the comparative analysis process. ?

Veteran’s Preference: In order to be considered for veteran’s preference you must attach a copy of your DD214 forms as well as any documentation required to prove disability or marital status.

Your application will be reviewed by a qualified Human Resources Specialist to determine if you meet the minimum qualifications for this position. If your application does not demonstrate that you meet the minimum requirements, you will be notified that you will not proceed in the selection process for this position. If your application is rejected and you have questions, you may contact Mercedes Chansisourath, at mercedes.chansisourath@coag.gov.


The Office of the Attorney General offers challenging, interesting, and meaningful work. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that a diverse workforce adds quality and perspective to the services we provide to the public. Candidates with diverse qualities and backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Assessment Information:

Colorado Revised Statutes require that all state employees be hired and promoted through comparative analysis of merit and fitness. Upon meeting the minimum qualifications, the next phase of the process is typically a structured application/resume review by a panel of subject matter experts against the job duties and/or preferred qualifications in this job announcement to determine technical competence, depth and breadth of experience and potential job fit.
  • Technical Competence – Technical experience as it relates to the duties outlined in this job announcement.
  • Depth and Breadth of Experience – Experience that covers multiple areas outlined in this job announcement and demonstrates the level of responsibility assigned.
  • Job Fit – Experience will be evaluated to determine how well experience aligns with and meets the business needs of this position. Current experience is preferred.

It is imperative that the “Work Experience” section of your application is complete and specifically addresses your qualifications, experience, work product, and accomplishments as they relate to the Description of the Job, Minimum Qualifications, and Preferred Qualifications as listed above. Failure to include adequate information or follow instructions by the closing date may result in your application not being accepted and/or may affect your inclusion in the final pool of eligible applicants as the materials may be used to identify a top group for additional assessment or establish an eligible list for referral to the hiring manager for final consideration.

Appeal Rights:

An applicant who has been removed from an employment list or removed from consideration during the selection process may request a review by the State Personnel Director.

As an applicant directly affected by the results of the selection or comparative analysis process, you may file a written appeal with the State Personnel Director.

Review of the completed, signed, and submitted appeal will be timely on the basis of written material submitted by you, using the official appeal form signed by you or your representative. This form must be completed and delivered to the State Personnel Board by email at dpa_state.personnelboard@state.co.us within ten (10) calendar days from your receipt of notice or acknowledgment of the Department’s action.


For further information on the Board Rules, you can refer to 4 Colorado Code of Regulations (CCR) 801-1, State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, Chapter 8, Resolution of Appeals and Disputes, at .

title: Senior Technical Product Manager, US Prime Video
description:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you'll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you'll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We'll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to lead the Product-Tech function within Prime Video's US Planning & Audience Insights team. This team defines Prime Video's audience objectives and delivers the customer intelligence, analytics, and AI-powered solutions to optimize the PV US customer experience.

You'll own the product vision and technical roadmap for a portfolio of AI-powered tools and data platforms that shape the end-customer experience — directly influencing what content millions of Prime Video customers discover, when they see it, and how it's personalized to their preferences. Your products will drive measurable improvements in customer engagement, retention, and content satisfaction by powering smarter programming decisions, audience targeting, and marketing optimization.

You'll develop deep expertise in how content programmers, marketers, and leadership make decisions — spending time observing their workflows firsthand, identifying unarticulated needs, and translating those insights into product direction. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with data engineers, data scientists, and BI/analytics teams to bring that vision to life. You will also manage a small team of product managers.


Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy & Vision
- Own the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of customer-impacting tools spanning release planning, experimentation automation, GenAI-powered content analysis, and audience segmentation — from vision through delivery.
- Define clear product tenets, make deliberate "what not to build" decisions, and measure success by downstream impact on viewer engagement, content performance, and audience growth.
- Drive the team's AI strategy: GenAI-powered content gap identification, natural language data interfaces, automated experiment analysis, and AI-generated dashboard summaries.

Customer Understanding & Discovery
- Develop recognized segment expertise across Prime Video's internal customer base (content programmers, marketers, audience strategists) — building a structured discovery cadence and "voice of the customer" mechanism that regularly surfaces insights which change the roadmap, including deciding what NOT to build based on direct observation of workflows and unarticulated needs.
- Own audience infrastructure products including demographic prediction models and audience segmentation frameworks that power PV's growth strategy — closing the loop between internal tool usage and end-customer behavioral outcomes.

Technical & Product Ownership
- Act as the primary product owner across a team of data engineers, data scientists, researchers, and BI engineers — defining the product vision that drives their work, setting success metrics, and influencing execution priorities through strategic clarity rather than positional authority.
- Partner with an SDE team to define requirements, prioritize the backlog, and ship features for the team's flagship planning tool — acting as the primary product voice for a platform used daily by content programmers and leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Influence
- Lead cross-functional programs spanning analytics, research, data science, marketing, and programming stakeholders — grounding product direction in direct observation of customer workflows, and translating unarticulated needs into clear product requirements.
- Establish a structured discovery cadence that regularly surfaces insights which change the roadmap.
- Establish audience intelligence standards (e.g., segmentation taxonomy, experimentation governance frameworks) adopted by teams beyond US Planning & Audience Insights — positioning your products to an audience across Prime Video US.

Senior Leadership & Strategic Influence
- Shape VP-level decision-making through QBRs, CPRs, and roadmap reviews — proposing and defending strategic trade-offs (including what to deprioritize or kill), not just reporting status. Influence organizational priorities beyond the immediate team.

About the team
The US Planning & Audience Insights team is where strategy meets data meets AI: we build the tools and intelligence that power programming decisions, audience growth, and marketing optimization for our Prime Video streaming service. If you want to work at the intersection of GenAI, customer science, and entertainment strategy and see your work directly influence what millions of people watch, this is the role.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
What If You Could Do the Kind of Work the World Needs?

At WSP, you can. Here, you’ll work alongside some of the brightest minds in energy, contribute to nation‑shaping infrastructure, and help deliver secure, reliable and future‑ready power solutions. From solar, wind, hydropower and battery storage through to transmission, distribution and complex grid automation projects—your work will directly support Australia’s transition to a more sustainable energy future.

We value curiosity, diverse perspectives and people who thrive in collaborative environments. If you meet most (not all) of the criteria below, we still encourage you to apply—training and support will be provided for the right candidate.

What You’ll Do

As an Assistant Project Manager within our Power & Energy Project Delivery team, you will support and drive end‑to‑end delivery of transmission, substation, renewable and generation projects. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Support end‑to‑end project delivery and engage with clients and stakeholders.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation (PMPs, risk registers, HSE plans).
  • Assist with project setup, budgeting and financial tracking in ERP systems.
  • Monitor progress, update budgets, forecast costs and analyse variances.
  • Support monthly invoicing, purchase orders and creditor approvals.
  • Coordinate with the Project Finance Specialist on budgets and WBS updates.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules aligned with milestones.
  • Manage project changes, variations and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with mobilisation, travel logistics and document control.
  • Prepare health & safety documents, proposals and ad‑hoc project materials.
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders as a project representative.
  • Organise meetings, take minutes and track action items.

About You

We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic project environment and brings a combination of technical, financial and stakeholder management capability.

You’ll Bring:

  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting and project controls.
  • Previous experience in a project management environment (Power & Energy or Mining/Industrial environments highly advantageous).
  • Ability to build strong client relationships and communicate effectively.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both collaboratively and autonomously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP systems (e.g. Oracle, SAP, ProjectWise, etc.).
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to manage priorities and support multiple Project Managers.

Our Offer

At WSP, you’ll have the scale, support and flexibility to do meaningful work while growing your career your way. You’ll be part of an inclusive team that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact.

  • Competitive pay and salary continuance insurance
  • Hybrid working and the option to purchase up to 8 additional weeks of leave
  • Leadership development, mentoring, secondments and global mobility
  • Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave with tailored return‑to‑work support
  • A culture that celebrates diverse voices and thrives on collaboration
  • Purpose‑driven work that builds sustainable, resilient communities

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

An employee Share Purchase Plan is available to all our permanent employees who wish to become owners and vested partners in WSP’s collective success. To find out more about our commitment to the health and wellbeing of our people, and the programs we’ve designed to help you thrive, go to our Employee Benefits page.

With us, you can. Apply today.

title: Data Integration Engineer - Fabric
description:
We’re looking for a Data Integration Engineer to join a scale up lending business, where you’ll be the person who keeps data moving cleanly and reliably across the core systems.

This is a genuinely hands—on data engineering role, not a BI role in disguise. You’ll spend most of your time building and orchestrating pipelines on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, connecting systems via APIs, and working through some seriously large tables and legacy code that’s ready for a rebuild. If you like untangling messy, high-volume data problems as much as building clean new pipelines, this is for you.

What you’ll be doing

Building and orchestrating data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, with active work migrating parts of our stack from Azure to Microsoft Fabric

Designing and maintaining a Medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and semantic models that the rest of the business can actually rely on

Writing and optimising SQL, including database functions, across some very large tables

Building API—based integrations between our lending platform, CRM, and other core systems

Working through legacy codebases with heavy exception handling — improving reliability as you go, not just patching around it

Contributing to automation where it makes sense (Power Automate / Logic Apps), and lending a hand on reporting when it’s genuinely needed — though that’s a small part of the role, not the focus

About you

Strong SQL skills, you’re comfortable writing and optimising complex queries and database functions, not just SELECT statements

Hands—on experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Microsoft Fabric, ideally you’ve been part of an Azure-to-Fabric migration or integration

Practical experience building or consuming APIs to move data between systems

You’re not precious about \"clean\" codebases, you’ve worked in complex, real—world systems and know how to bring order to them

Experience with data modelling (Medallion architecture, semantic models, dimensional modelling) is a strong plus

Financial services, lending, or other regulated-industry experience is a bonus, not a requirement, we care more about what you can do than where you’ve done it

Role nuance

Office is based in Double Bay and due to the scale up nature of the business, our team is onsite 4-days a week.

The business is growing and we’re expanding our capabilities to match. This role can wear multiple hats and has significant influence on our roadmap for not only Data engineering, but also AI Engineering, Cloud/Platform and Analytics/Bi.

Flat structure with key business stakeholders sitting on the same floor. Unrestricted access to SME knowledge and the expectation that you engage with the business.

title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i centrala Umeå
description:
Vill du ha ett jobb där du gör skillnad – på riktigt, varje dag?
Vi på Aleva söker nu en trygg och engagerad personlig assistent till en kvinna i 30-årsåldern som bor i en egen lägenhet i ett stadsnära område i Umeå.

Här får du chansen att bidra till en lugn, trygg och meningsfull vardag där relation, tillit och livskvalitet står i fokus. Ingen dag är den andra lik, vilket gör arbetet både varierande och meningsfullt. Vissa dagar fylls av aktiviteter och sociala sammanhang, andra av ett lugnare tempo hemma. Det viktigaste är att du är uppmärksam, flexibel och ser kundens behov.

"För mig är det viktigt att du är lyhörd, flexibel och att du vill bidra till en lugn och trivsam vardag. Har vi dessutom ett gemensamt intresse för musik och smink ser jag det som ett stort plus." – Kunden

Om tjänsten
Som personlig assistent stöttar du kunden i hennes vardag. Arbetet innefattar bland annat personlig omvårdnad samt hushållssysslor såsom städning och matlagning. Tjänsten kan även innebära att du följer med kunden i olika sammanhang utanför hemmet, och i framtiden kan det eventuellt förekomma resor i samband med detta. Kunden har assistans dygnet runt och arbetstiderna omfattar dag, kväll, journatt och helg.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som är varm, lyhörd och trygg i dig själv. Du har ett naturligt sätt att skapa lugn omkring dig och trivs med att arbeta nära en annan människa. Det är viktigt att du har god samarbetsförmåga och ett respektfullt bemötande samt att du är ansvarstagande och pålitlig. Eftersom kundens behov och vardagens innehåll kan variera är det viktigt att du är flexibel, anpassningsbar och har lätt för att ställa om när situationen kräver det.

Erfarenhet från vård och omsorg är meriterande, men det viktigaste är personkemi och din inställning.

Krav
• B-körkort (du kör kundens bil i tjänsten)
• Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska
• Tobaksfri
• Doftfri (med hänsyn till kundens känslighet)

Övrigt
Omfattning: 75 - 100 %
Tillträde: Start omgående enligt överenskommelse
Rekrytering sker löpande

Din ansökan läses av personal på Aleva, kunden och dennes anhöriga.

Vad kan du förvänta dig av oss
Hos Aleva får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad i en annan människas vardag. Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och erbjuder bland annat:
• Trygga anställningsvillkor via kollektivavtal
• Generöst friskvårdsbidrag
• Ett nära och engagerat stöd från arbetsledning
• Möjlighet att utvecklas inom personlig assistans

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Om oss
Aleva är ett växande företag med stora visioner. Vi vill skapa framtidens omsorg genom nytänkande och ett tydligt fokus på att leva - inte bara överleva. Företaget grundades 2013 och bedriver idag hemtjänst i Umeå tätort, Holmsund-Obbola, Vännäs samt Nordmaling och personlig assistans i hela Västerbotten. För att passa hos oss är det viktigaste att du är prestigelös, engagerad och har en genuin vilja att arbeta med människor. Hos oss råder en personlig atmosfär med korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet till stor frihet under ansvar. Vi är ett ambitiöst team med positiv atmosfär som arbetar tillsammans för att leverera omsorg i världsklass. För mer information gå in på www.alevaomsorg.se

title: Sr. Operations Program Manager, Product Operations
description:
Echo Product Operations team is looking for a Sr. Operations Program Manager (Sr. OPM) to work within the Device Operations group to develop innovative, new to world Amazon devices. You will lead product development during pre-concept stage, and balance a mix of strategic, programmatic, and operational responsibilities to optimize new product cost, quality, and time to market. The individual will have experience in New Product Introduction in an Operations/Manufacturing role pertaining to Consumer Electronics (or similar) and have proven communications skills and ability to influence.

As a Pre-Concept Sr. OPM, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive, design and develop innovative consumer products. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment. This role drives leaders and cross-functional teams across a dynamic organization and requires excellent leadership skills to build trust and drive alignment across all levels of the organization.

Key job responsibilities
This role is specifically in Echo Pre-concept space, to work on early stage scoping and definition for our new roadmap programs. The Operations Program Manager is a key member of the tight-knit cross-functional pre-concept team, responsible for and representing all facets of Device Operations. On top of normal pre-concept activities, as this role is based in Shenzhen, we expect this person to be a leader in early-stage prototyping and technology discovery.

• Delivers results on pre-concept programs as the single-threaded Operations owner to lead product development across internal teams and external development/manufacturing partners
• Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies to meet product requirements.
• Support product concept development as Operations lead. Including ownership of product schedule, manufacturing strategy, product BOM+MVA cost, supplier sourcing strategy, Operations fixed cost drivers, and any Operations risk call-outs.
• Contribute to and influence new product design and architecture
• Arbitrate and drive to resolution organizational tension and competing goals in order to deliver a clean set of requirements for NPI execution
• Execute development builds by overseeing technical issue resolution and production schedule.
• Regular written and verbal communication to Leadership.
• Coordinate information flow across teams in support of manufacturing/operations.
• Drive alignment of processes and initiatives throughout Device Operations organization.
• Define and guide decisions on type of Variable Engagement Module (VEM) appropriate for the specific product, customer need, and launch schedule.
• Bring in and incorporate industry best practices into the Product Operations group.
• Travel as required to accomplish business needs.


A day in the life
As a Pre-Concept Operations Program Manager, your day begins coordinating cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Finance, Product Management and others to drive pre-concept program forward. You'll influence product design decisions, develop manufacturing strategies, resolve technical issues, and communicate progress to leadership. In the afternoon, you're talking to teams in China and contract manufacturers, diving into manufacturing feasibility, design proposals, and build and material readiness. Throughout, you're the single-threaded owner ensuring innovative Echo products move from concept to reality.

About the team
We are a team of high-performing, motivated, and collaborative individuals dedicated to defining and launching personalized devices that delight our customers and feed the broader Amazon ecosystem, especially the Alexa AI voice assistant. We provide product operations leadership and collaboration across all functions. As supply chain partners to the broader Amazon Devices organization, we work together to drive product roadmaps and guide portfolio direction.

title: Associate Real Time Operator - Contract to Hire
description:
Company Description

Hunt Energy Network is a Dallas-based developer and operator of distributed energy resources. The company utilizes its TraDER platform to site distributed energy resources, integrate those resources into competitive markets, and operate those resources as optimized portfolios. HEN was created and incubated within Hunt Energy Enterprises, Hunt's energy technology venture business unit. It is part of a larger privately-owned group of companies managed by the Ray L. Hunt family that engages in oil and gas exploration, refining, power, real estate, ranching and private equity investments.

Job Description:

Hunt Energy Network is seeking an Associate Real Time Operator to support the asset optimization and arbitrage strategies for our growing pipeline of distributed power generation resources at its Network Optimization Center. The Network Optimization Center will be Dallas-based and serve as the interface between HEN and the market. This dynamic role will be critical in the creation and execution of profitable dispatch strategies as well as optimizing asset operations, performing real-time analysis, and event reporting for the desk and HEN management. This role follows the DuPont rotating twelve-hour personnel schedule. This role is contract-to-hire following the successful completion of the NERC System Operator exam.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize the traDER Max platform to efficiently optimize the dispatch of the network of power generation assets.
  • Be able to profitably react to changes in ERCOT dispatch instructions as well as changes in the supply/demand balance in accordance with ISO and market procedures.
  • Efficiently operate the fleet of power generation assets, including battery storage resources.
  • Execute Real Time dispatch and trading strategies set forth by the commercial team.
  • Participate in the incubation and generation of revenue enhancing strategies for the portfolio.
  • Interface with current and future Market Participants that enroll in HEN asset management solutions.
  • Collaborate with HEN Software and operations teams to ensure reliability and compliance for the portfolio of assets.
  • Obtain a NERC System Operator Certification and complete relevant training.
  • Perform real-time fundamental analysis and reporting for the desk and management.
  • Must complete exchange and ISO training, certifications, and continuing education as applicable.
  • Provide training and support for new real-time team members.

Required Skills:

  • The desire to be a part of an entrepreneurial start-up that will execute the future of the renewable energy model in the U.S.
  • Strong work ethic, team attitude, critical thinking skills and character.
  • Proven ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and inquisitive mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-energy environment where multitasking and organizational skills are a must.

Required Experience:

  • Flexibility to work rotating twelve-hour shifts 24/7/365 utilizing a DuPont schedule.
  • Analytical experience required for pricing, risk assessment and transaction structuring.
  • Undergraduate degree in engineering, accounting, finance, economics or equivalent.

Company Highlights:

  • For 90 years, we have nurtured creative ideas and turned them into successful realities using three core strategic pillars – creativity, excellence, and people.
  • 401K – 12% employer contribution with no vesting period (6% Match and 6% non-matching contribution)
  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Hybrid work options available for most roles
  • Five to eight weeks of PTO annually based on years of experience; eleven additional holidays per calendar year
  • All Medical/Dental/Vision benefits start day one with the company; low employee premiums
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Free covered employee parking for Dallas HQ based employees
  • Free specialty coffee bar in the Dallas HQ
  • Onsite breakfast and lunch area in the Dallas HQ
  • Commitment to the following ideals:
    • Work/Life Balance
    • Ongoing professional development opportunities
    • An exceptional employee experience

Hunt is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Hunt is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
