title: Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, RQA, Vice President
description:
About this role

Business Overview

Managing risk is central to BlackRock’s investment process. Risk & Quantitative Analysis provides independent oversight of investment and enterprise risks and helps strengthen risk management across the firm.

Core Risk Governance team which sits in RQA India as part of Core Risk Management team, brings together risk governance, analytics and exception management capabilities to deliver scalable and resilient risk oversight across BlackRock’s investment risk platform.

The team focuses on making processes more consistent, controlled, automated, and easy to use through better data, reporting, analytics, and technology solutions.

Core Risk Management is extending its location strategy to Mumbai. This role will be the first senior hire supporting teams expansion in new location and will play a critical role in establishing the leadership, culture, operating discipline, and technical capability needed to build a successful Mumbai presence.

Job Purpose / Background

The Vice President, Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, will be the senior Core Risk Management leader based in Mumbai and a key member of the Core Risk Governance team.

This is a highly visible leadership role combining people management, technical delivery, risk expertise, and location build-out. The successful candidate will establish and lead the initial Mumbai team, create strong connectivity with the Gurgaon organization, and help build a cohesive, high-performing, and scalable multi-location operating model.

The role requires a seasoned leader with more than 10 years of experience managing teams, strong hands-on technical capabilities, and meaningful experience in risk management or financial services. The Vice President will lead the design and delivery of technology, data, analytics, reporting, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that strengthen risk governance and oversight.

The VP will combine strategic judgment with the ability to engage deeply in solution design and execution. The successful candidate will set high standards for talent, technology delivery, controls, operational resilience, and stakeholder outcomes while helping shape the long-term growth of Core Risk Management in Mumbai.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior Core Risk Management leader in Mumbai and establish a strong local presence aligned with the wider Gurgaon-based organization.

  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team across technology, data, analytics, and risk-governance capabilities.

  • Create an inclusive and connected team culture, ensuring strong collaboration, consistent standards, and effective knowledge sharing between Mumbai and Gurgaon.

  • Support the phased development of the Mumbai location, including talent strategy, hiring, onboarding, capability building, workforce planning, and leadership development.

  • Provide direct or matrix leadership to Mumbai-based analysts, associates, interns, and future hires, ensuring clear accountability and effective integration into their respective Core Risk Management teams.

  • Help shape the Core Risk Governance technology, data, automation, and AI roadmap, translating business and risk priorities into scalable solutions.

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology and analytics initiatives from problem definition and solution design through testing, implementation, adoption, and production support.

  • Provide strong technical leadership across Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud and enterprise data platforms, automation, analytics, application development, and AI-enabled workflows.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to review solution architecture, challenge technical approaches, resolve complex delivery issues, and raise engineering and analytical standards.

  • Partner with Risk, Investment, Data, Technology, Compliance, and Control teams to understand business requirements and deliver practical, controlled, and sustainable outcomes.

  • Apply risk-management expertise to the development of reporting, analytics, controls, monitoring, and governance solutions that support investment-risk oversight and senior decision-making.

  • Establish disciplined delivery standards covering software and product development lifecycles, testing, documentation, code quality, access management, issue tracking, release governance, and operational resilience.

  • Build robust data-quality checks, monitoring, exception management, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, and escalation processes for risk analytics and AI-enabled applications.

  • Ensure solutions are accurate, transparent, explainable, secure, user-focused, and aligned with relevant risk, data, technology, privacy, and control expectations.

  • Assess emerging technologies and AI capabilities, balancing innovation and speed with reliability, safety, governance, and appropriate human oversight.

  • Communicate priorities, risks, delivery progress, and key decisions clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership forums.

  • Act as a role model for ownership, collaboration, sound judgment, technical excellence, and talent development.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • More than 10 years of relevant experience across technology, data, analytics, risk management, investment management, or financial services.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams for at least 5 years, including people management, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and building leadership depth.

  • Proven ability to establish or significantly scale a team, capability, or location while maintaining strong connectivity with a broader global or multi-location organization.

  • Strong hands-on technical capability in Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud platforms, enterprise data solutions, automation, analytics, or application development.

  • Experience designing and delivering complex technology, data, analytics, or AI-enabled solutions in a controlled production environment.

  • Strong understanding of modern solution architecture, data pipelines, system integration, secure development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

  • Meaningful experience in risk management, investment management, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, governance, controls, or a closely related financial-services discipline.

  • Ability to connect technical design with risk context, business outcomes, user needs, and control requirements.

  • Proven experience translating complex business and risk requirements into clear technical strategy, delivery priorities, and executable plans.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, including ownership, data quality, lineage, reconciliation, metadata, access controls, and audit-ready documentation.

  • Experience with artificial intelligence, large language models, agentic workflows, search, document intelligence, workflow automation, or AI governance is highly desirable.

  • Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex risk and technology topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Attributes

  • A senior people leader who can create followership, develop talent, and build a strong local culture from the ground up.

  • A credible technical leader who can operate at both strategic and detailed levels.

  • Strong risk judgment and an appreciation for independent oversight, governance, controls, and operational resilience.

  • A builder’s mindset, with the ability to establish new capabilities and convert ambiguity into a clear operating model.

  • High standards for quality, transparency, accountability, and execution.

  • Strong ownership and the ability to lead through influence across teams, locations, and seniority levels.

  • A collaborative and inclusive approach that strengthens connectivity between Mumbai, Gurgaon, and global partners.

  • A pragmatic innovator who balances speed and ambition with safety, sustainability, and control.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

About

UNIVERSITY / COMMUNITY

WHY BEMIDJI:

It’s more than a job. It’s an opportunity for the extraordinary.

On the idyllic shores of Lake Bemidji, cradled among the limitless natural beauty of the North Woods and neighbored by Minnesota’s three largest Indigenous nations, Bemidji State University offers opportunities for the extraordinary.

Bemidji State University has been ranked as one of the top 30 public institutions in the Midwest region by U.S. News & World Report each year since 2019. BSU offers its diverse student body a comprehensive spectrum of opportunities with nearly 120 undergraduate degrees and emphasis areas in more than 50 areas of study, 14 pre-professional programs, and 14 graduate programs and certificates.

As Bemidji State continues its second century of service, our vision is simple: we educate people to lead inspired lives. To achieve this, BSU centers diversity, equity and inclusion as a core value and strives to create a campus culture in which all members are free to be their authentic selves. BSU also proactively engages with Indigenous communities in northern Minnesota and nationwide toward its goal of becoming a destination university.

BSU is a member of the Minnesota State system of colleges and universities, the third-largest system of higher education institutions in the United States. It shares a unique alignment with Northwest Technical College, with administration and student services generally having dual responsibilities to serve both campuses. Through this alignment, NTC students can take advantage of services, support, activities, and opportunities at BSU that expand and enhance their college experience — such as full access to BSU’s library and the ability to live in BSU’s on-campus resident housing.

For the first time, a joint strategic planning process will guide the future directions for both institutions. The schools are pursuing four shared strategic priorities: student success, the Nisidotaading initiative, northern distinction, and telling our story. These priorities will serve as the foundations for master planning processes for facilities, academic programs, fundraising, information technology, intercollegiate athletics, and diversity, equity, and inclusion, among others.

The Nisidotaading initiative — named for an Ojibwe phrase meaning “building mutual understanding” — is creating a statewide center of excellence. It will develop communities of practice meant to help Minnesota State colleges and universities better educate their campus communities on historical trauma and lived experiences of their Indigenous populations, and how to most effectively guide Indigenous students toward their educational goals. In addition, BSU is the first university in the United States to expose all of its students to a course on Indigenous people before graduation.

Bemidji State University acknowledges that it is located on land and water that is the current and ancestral homeland of the Ojibwe and Dakota. We acknowledge the painful history of genocide, forced assimilation, and efforts to alienate the Indigenous inhabitants from their territory here. We honor and respect the many diverse Indigenous peoples still connected to this land, retained tribal sovereignty, treaty rights, and cultural resilience. Indigenous people are spiritual and physical caretakers of this land to which we all belong. Bemidji State University respects these sacred lands, stands with the community members from these Nations, and will fight injustice in all its forms.

At Minnesota State, the work we do is more than just a job. In their pursuit of purpose, connection, and growth, our employees play a critical role on our campuses. They develop policies, provide essential services, and work to improve the well-being and quality of life for our students and for all Minnesotans. Minnesota State is committed to equity and inclusion, and we invest in our employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities. Unlock your potential through possibility.

The City of Bemidji

Bemidji State University and Northwest Technical College lie amid the lakes and forests of northern Minnesota. Bemidji State occupies a wooded campus along the western shore of Lake Bemidji while Northwest Technical College lies just three miles east, near Bemidji’s robust industrial district.

The city sits between Minnesota’s three largest American Indian tribal nations: the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe, the Red Lake Nation and the White Earth Nation. When settling the Bemidji area in 1750, the Ojibwe people named the lake Bemidjigamaag, which means “a lake with crossing waters” as the Mississippi River flows in from the south and exits on the east. Today, a city proper with a population of around 15,000 serves as a regional economic and cultural hub for about 100,000 Minnesotans.

Located just minutes away from a thriving downtown Bemidji, both the BSU and NTC campus communities have convenient access to affordable restaurants, fine-dining experiences, cozy coffee shops, grocery stores — including a natural foods co-op — city parks, and nearly unlimited outdoor recreational opportunities. Small, locally-owned shops and art sculptures line Bemidji's downtown streets, while national chains are also found in and around the area. The historic Paul Bunyan Playhouse has a calendar of classic shows, restaurants offer weekly live music performances, the First Friday Art Walk provides a tour of new monthly art exhibits, and annual festivals bring the community together throughout the year.

Additionally, the North Woods setting means students, staff, and faculty have a variety of activities available at their fingertips year-round. With more than 400 lakes — and a 240-acre research forest owned by BSU — within 25 miles of the city, there is easy access to kayaking, canoeing, swimming, boating, paddle boarding, hunting, hiking, biking, foraging, fishing, and more. An expansive network of multi-use trail systems is available for running, cross-country skiing, single-track or fat-tire biking, and skijoring. Further, downhill skiing, snowboarding, and tubing lie just north of Bemidji at the Buena Vista Ski Area.

Bemidji is also near two of Minnesota’s 66 state parks: Lake Bemidji State Park, which sits along Lake Bemidji’s northern shore, and Itasca State Park, home to the majestic Mississippi River Headwaters. Both parks are popular recreational and camping destinations where locals and tourists gather for sailing, swimming, and fishing during the summer months, and skating, hockey, curling, and—yes—more fishing in the winter.

Of course, no tour of Bemidji is complete without a visit to — and a selfie with — its two most famous residents: the iconic statues of Paul Bunyan and his trusty companion, Babe the Blue Ox. The famed duo, which has greeted visitors to Bemidji since 1937, is on the National Register of Historic Places and was once ranked by Kodak as the second most-photographed statue in America.

title: Product Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
haddock is looking for a Product Engineer (Mid/Senior Full Stack) with 3+ years of experience


¿Posee las habilidades y la experiencia adecuadas para este puesto? Siga leyendo para descubrirlo y envíe su solicitud.

Hybrid in Barcelona (at least two days per week at their office in Poblenou)

Vacation & perks: All AI tooling that you wish to experiment with, a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, flexible working hours, a bright modern office, PayFlow, and many more (see below)

haddock is the market leader solution for point of control in restaurants, handling all back-office vital operations like product management, inventories, purchases, price tracking, document conciliation, bank conciliation, paychecks, clocking in/out, P&L reports, etc.

Not only they have a system of record that helps operate restaurants with control and clarity, but they are also the leaders in offering AI Agents, starting with Fina. They work 24/7 doing the heavy, tedious work that their customers don't have time to do well.

This is no AI hype. haddock's customers obtain visible value from their AI Agents, both in money and time saved. They are becoming strategic partners in the design of their businesses.

Their mission is to empower millions of restaurateurs to level up their business.

Their vision is to lead the market through innovation, strong relationships and by becoming the go-to tech partner for restaurant success.

haddock is backed by Y Combinator, the accelerator behind Airbnb and Twitch. they are growing fast with support from top-tier investors like JME, Decelera, Extension Fund, Wayra, and Zone2Boost.

Why are they hiring?

They are hiring because their ambitions are increasing: more customers, more AI automation, more product surface, more value and quality, and more internal tooling to support their growth.

Their engineers don’t wait for a project to be defined. They create momentum, propose ideas, and are a key part of the growth of the company.

To keep their speed and quality high, they need one more strong engineer who can lead initiatives independently and collaborate closely with product and customers.

If you’re excited by ownership, autonomy, and building technology that directly impacts real businesses every day, this is the right moment to join, when they are still one cohesive team and before they evolve from startup to scale-up.

About Product Engineers at haddock

Engineers at haddock are action-oriented, curious, autonomous, and take full ownership of their work. They are champions of figuring out the unknowns. They talk to customers, deliver quality work, improve their internal tooling, and are ambitious. They look for people with these same motivations and ways of working.

They strongly adhere to the Lean Startup and Agile principles, favoring action over analysis, imperfect iteration over perfect delivery, face-to-face communication, and a fast-paced environment.

Each of us leads initiatives, planning and executing in small mission-oriented squads of 2 or 3 people.

As a Product Engineer, you'll work across the stack (frontend, backend, and infrastructure) to deliver outcomes that bring real value to restaurateurs. Between frontend and backend, their time right now is likely spent 50% backend, 20% AI workflows, 10% frontend and 20% infrastructure architecture.

Everyone has different strengths and preferences, and they aim to align projects with what you love doing most.

Their processes and tools are constantly improving, and everyone contributes to making them better.

Keep-the-lights-on work is shared, like bug fixing, monitoring and dependency management. They succeed at this by having a rotating squad of Defenders that tackles this kind of maintenance work.

Bonus: You’ll be just a step away from the people using what you build. Many of their restaurants are based right here in Barcelona, and they love haddock.

As part of their product team, you’ll build and ship features that make a real difference in restaurants' day-to-day operations:

Build product: Design, build, and maintain their full-stack platform and AI Agents.

Solve challenges: Focus on outcomes, not obstacles.

Think ahead: Architect scalable solutions as they grow fast.

Improve process: Help us move from scrappy to smart.

Mentor others: Share your knowledge and shape the culture.

Some example objectives that you could work towards in your first months are:

  • Enabling Fina to handle even more administrative work for their customers.
  • Making it effortless for their customers to make purchase orders to their suppliers directly from haddock.
  • Automating operational work in restaurants via developing AI Agents that work on their Point of Control.
  • Help their customers understand the health of their business directly in haddock, via reports, dashboards, data aggregations and insights.
  • Streamline internal operations at haddock by making Sales, CX, Finance and Product collaborate smoothly over shared AI-powered tools.

At least 4 years of engineering experience working on SaaS applications in Agile environments.

Experience building products end to end: discovery, infrastructure, backend, frontend, testing, etc.

  • Familiarity with TypeScript, React and Node.
  • Experience designing and/or implementing architectures that solve product problems (for example, using services, databases, external APIs, caches, queues, events, etc.)
  • Experience in environments using Microservices or some flavor of service oriented architecture.
  • You've already been developing with AI.
  • You have developed good judgement (criterio) on using it with good results, and you don't delegate basic understanding to the AI.
  • You'll stand out if you've already built AI workflows for production.

Fluency in Spanish and comfortable in English. They tend to speak in Spanish at the office and in Slack, and write documentation and projects in English.

They are building something ambitious, and they are looking for someone ready to grow with us, take real ownership, and shape the product’s future.

This is more than a job. It’s a chance to leave your mark on an industry that’s ripe for transformation. Their best perk is honestly their work environment and the opportunities you'll get to learn and grow at haddock.

Their Tech Stack

TypeScript, Node, React, React Router, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Google Cloud Platform, Langfuse, PostHog and several AI integrations.

They heavily use AI workflows and agents for their development, but also to empower the entire organization to be 10x productive. What a time to be alive!

They have an architecture that kind of looks like microservices, with one main service that is more monolith than microservice. Most of their stack is serverless though, and they can rapidly upgrade and evolve their infra.

What they offer?

A competitive salary (€47–55k gross/year), that will increase as haddock and you grow.

A bright modern office in Barcelona, in Poblenou. Probably the best office you've ever worked at.

->
They currently spend atleast 2 days per week at the office, because they believe that in-person frequent interaction helps us communicate better, gain trust with each other faster, and achieve better outcomes. The other 3 days, they usually work from home to have more focus and get things done.

All AI tooling that you wish to experiment with.

Enjoy benefits when spending part of your salary, thanks to Playflow.

Their Hiring Process

They move fast and communicate openly. Their goal is to wrap up the process within a week. Here's what to expect:

  • Intro call with Guillermo (Head of Technology), 25 mins.
  • Call with Pol (co-founder, CEO), 25 mins. xhfqzwm
  • Technical interviews with Guillermo and another engineer (2 hours). Part 1: architectural solution thinking, and part 2: AI-assisted live coding of an MVP.

Ramp Bus Driver -tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään lentoaseman monipuolisissa henkilökuljetustehtävissä ainutlaatuisessa ja kansainvälisessä työympäristössä Helsinki-Vantaan lentoasemalla. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat matkustajien kuljettaminen lähtöporteilta lentokoneille, saapuvien matkustajien kuljettaminen lentokoneilta tuloporteille, lentävän miehistön kuljetukset sekä matkustajavalvonta tehtävät. Työvuorojen pituus on 4–13 tuntia, ja ne määräytyvät lentoliikenteen mukaisesti. Kyseessä on vuorotyö, jota tehdään myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Hakijalta edellytämme

- D-ajokorttia
- vähintään vuoden kokemusta linja-auton kuljettamisesta tai muista raskaan liikenteen kuljetustehtävistä
- sujuvaa suomen kielen ja tyydyttävää englannin kielen taitoa
- nuhteetonta taustaa (valituista henkilöistä tehdään Perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys)

Eduksi katsomme

- Aiemman kokemuksen lentokenttäympäristöstä ja kyseisestä työtehtävästä

Lentoaseman hektisessä työympäristössä hyvä paineensietokyky ja tiimityötaidot auttavat sinua menestymään tehtävässäsi. Arvostamme myös asiakaspalvelualttiutta sekä tarkkuutta ja täsmällisyyttä. Toimintaympäristön tunteminen katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia henkilöstökuljetustehtäviä sekä mielenkiintoisen ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän työympäristön. Saat perehdytyksen lentoaseman liikennesääntöihin ja koulutuksen tehtävään. Sinua odottavat myös mukavat työkaverit. Kuljettajana olet osa Airpron ainutlaatuista palveluketjua, ja kohtaat tuhansia matkustajia työvuorosi aikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Supervisor Mikko Manner sähköpostitse mikko.manner@airpro.fi.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, täytä sähköinen hakulomake 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Lsätietoja:

Seuraa meitä TikTokissa, Instagramissa ja Youtubessa: @airproofficial

Airpro mahdollistaa matkasi tuottamalla ilmailualan palveluita Suomessa Helsingistä Ivaloon. Yli 30 vuoden kokemuksella ja 1500:n omistautuneen ilmailualan ammattilaisen voimin varmistamme, että lentoliikenne ja matkustajat liikkuvat turvallisesti ja luotettavasti vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Joustavuus ja avoimuus ohjaavat yhteistyötämme – kumppanimme voivat luottaa siihen, että toteutamme lupauksemme. Airpro Journey on lupauksemme elää arvojemme mukaisesti: kannustamme, toteutamme ja kehitymme. Olemme samalla rohkeita muuttumaan, kokeilemaan ja oppimaan. Yhdessä luomme merkityksellisiä hetkiä. Your journey is our destination.

Airpro on osa Finavia-konsernia.

Arvojemme kautta sitoudumme edistämään tasa-arvoa, yhdenvertaisuutta sekä rakentamaan työyhteisöä, jossa on mahdollisuus osallistua ja tulla kuulluksi. Toivotamme kaikki taustasta riippumatta tervetulleiksi hakemaan osaksi Airpron tiimiä ja osallistumaan yhteiselle polullemme. Sitoudumme oikeudenmukaisuuteen ja kunnioitukseen, emmekä hyväksy syrjintää.

Through our values, we are committed to promoting equality and equal treatment, and to building an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to participate and be heard. We welcome people from all backgrounds to apply to become part of the Airpro team and join us on our shared journey. We stand firmly for fairness and respect, and we do not tolerate discrimination.

title: Kassa-myyjiä Vantaa Kivistön uuteen myymälään (vakituisia ja määräaikaisia 15-30 h/vko)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Etsimme loppuvuonna avautuvaan uuteen Tokmannin Vantaan Kivistön myymälään asiakaspalveluhenkisiä ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttivia työkavereita! Haluatko päästä mukaan avaamaan uutta myymälää ja luomaan sen tarinaa aivan alusta alkaen?

Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdessä uusien työkavereidesi kanssa rakentamaan toimivaa työyhteisöä, luomaan unohtumattomia asiakaskohtaamisia ja valmistautumaan myymälän avajaisiin.

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä. Hamme useita vakituisia myyjiä 15, 25 ja 30 h/vko sopimuksilla. Lisäksi haemme kahta määräaikaista myyjää, joiden työaika on 25 h/vko ja sopimus tehdään 31.12.2026 asti. Kaikki työsuhteet alkavat lokakuun aikana sopimuksen mukaan. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi.



Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

- Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
- Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
- Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
- Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Yhdessä tekemistä ja onnistumista
- Avointa, kannustavaa ja mukavaa työyhteisöä
- Ihmisistä ja ympäristöstä välittämistä
- Kilpailukykyistä palkkaa ja henkilöstöetuja
- Valmennus- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- Uusia haasteita ja urapolkuja
- Kehittymiseen kannustamista virheitä pelkäämättä
- Monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia työtehtäviä
- Työhyvinvointia ja -turvallisuutta

GDIT is seeking a Cloud DevSecOps Engineer in support of the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Global Video Services (GVS) business area to enable the integration of video services into the Department of War.

title: Analyst - Pricing and Reporting
description:
Job Purpose

We are currently seeking a Pricing and Reporting Analyst to join our Contract Logistics team, based in Docklands, Melbourne. In this role, you will support pricing, commercial analysis and reporting to drive business growth and profitability, working closely with Commercial, Account Management, Operations, Finance, Billing and Technology teams. You will play a key role in customer tenders and quotations, profitability analysis, pricing models, rate cards, fuel levies and annual pricing reviews. This is a full-time position, with hours of work in accordance with the employment agreement.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain pricing models, rate cards and commercial solutions across a range of transport services, including parcel, LTL, FTL, dedicated fleet, courier, rail, intermodal and specialist transport.

  • Prepare pricing responses for customer tenders, RFQs and RFPs by analysing operational, financial and commercial data to develop competitive and profitable solutions.

  • Analyse customer and carrier profitability, revenue, margins and operational performance to identify commercial risks, cost reduction opportunities and revenue growth initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate pricing records, contract information, rate cards, version control and audit trails to support pricing governance and data integrity.

  • Lead and support annual pricing reviews, including rise-and-fall adjustments, fuel levy reviews and contractual rate updates.

  • Provide commercial analysis, reporting, guidance and recommendations to stakeholders nationally to support informed business and customer decisions.

Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Commerce, Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics or a related discipline.

  • 3–5 years’ experience in transport pricing, commercial analysis, logistics, supply chain analytics or a similar role, preferably within a 3PL, 4PL, transport, freight forwarding or contract logistics environment.

  • Experience supporting tenders, RFQs, RFPs, carrier sourcing activities and commercial negotiations.

  • Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to analyse large datasets and identify profitability drivers and improvement opportunities.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with experience using Power BI, Transport Management Systems and other reporting tools.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a high level of attention to detail, data accuracy, accountability and problem-solving capability.

title: AI Developer
description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

India:

Hybrid:
This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Noida/Bengaluru/Hyderabad (4times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

Remote:
Our [TITLE] are integral parts of our [TEAM NAME] team at TELUS Digital. This role can be fully remote for candidates based in Argentina. If you are located in Buenos Aires, you may choose to work from our Buenos Aires office on a flexible, optional basis, due to team distribution and occasional in-person opportunities.

The Opportunity

  • Build agentic systems: tool/function calling, multi-step orchestration, MCP servers, browser and workflow automation, and end-to-end agent observability.

  • Own the AI production concerns most teams skip: AI gateway, model tiering and routing for cost control, semantic caching, rate limiting, latency reduction (distillation, batching), prompt-injection defence, PII discovery and masking, bias and toxicity screening.

  • Microservices architecture in production service decomposition, REST/GraphQL API design, versioning, resilience patterns, multi-tenancy and data isolation.

  • AWS at depth compute (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), messaging (SQS), IAM, and observability (CloudWatch).

  • Containers & orchestration Docker and Kubernetes in production (deployments, services, manifests, scaling).

  • CI/CD ownership — Jenkins, in production service decomposition, REST/Graph QL API design, versioning, resilience patterns, multi-tenancy and data isolation.

  • Infrastructure as Code — CloudFormation/CDK or equivalent.

  • Event-driven systems — Apache Kafka or AWS-native messaging; retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling.

  • Databases — a relational store (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server) and a NoSQL store (MongoDB, DynamoDB); comfortable with query tuning.

Responsibilities

  • Must have overall 5+ years of experience in the IT Domain

  • Primary Skills: Java (8/17+), Python or Node.js with Spring Boot microservices on AWS — plus hands-on AI in real delivery, either AI-assisted development (Amazon Kiro, Cursor, Amazon Q) or applied GenAI (AI agents, RAG, MCP servers, Bedrock).
    Secondary Skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka and CI/CD. Good to have: migration and modernization experience, cloud security and compliance, and Telecom domain exposure.

Qualifications

  • B.Tech./M.Tech, B.C.A./M.C.A.

description:

Haemme nyt asiantuntevaan joukkoomme ympäristötarkastajaa vakinaiseen virkasuhteeseen terveydensuojelun valvontatehtäviin.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu
Asumisterveyden neuvonta- ja valvontatehtävät,
mahdollisesti myös muiden oleskelutilojen (esim. palveluasunnot ja muut sosiaalialan valvontakohteet) terveellisyyteen liittyvät viranomaistehtävät.
tarkastukset ja mittaukset asunnoissa ja muissa oleskelutiloissa,
asiakirja- ja päätösvalmistelu sekä
yhteydenpito mm. toiminnanharjoittajiin, asukkaisiin ja kiinteistöjen omistajiin.

Kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto, esim. DI (rakennustekniikka, kemia) ja FM (luonnontieteet, ympäristötiede). Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen hyvää suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä ruotsin kielen tyydyttävää suullista taitoa.

Odotamme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja aktiivista työotetta. Edistät myönteistä työilmapiiriä hyvillä yhteistyötaidoillasi. Lisäksi tarvitset hyviä viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja tarkastuskäynneillä, neuvotteluissa, neuvontatyössä sekä asiakasyhteydenpidossa. Kohteita on eri puolilla Helsinkiä, joten ajokortista on hyötyä tarkastusten toteuttamiseksi.

Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen asumisterveyden viranomaistehtävistä ja englannin kielen taidon. Eduksi on myös valmius tarkastusten tekemiseen virka-ajan ulkopuolella.

Mukavat ja osaavat kollegat sekä moniammatillisen yhteisön tuen.
Joustavat työajat ja monipaikkaisen työn - toimipisteemme sijaitsee Kalasatamassa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella ja työskentelemme esteettömissä toimitiloissa. Haluamme varmistaa, että jokaisen on helppo tulla meille töihin.
Laajat henkilöstöedut, kuten Epassin kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun, lounasedun ja työmatkalippuedun sekä kattavan henkilöstöliikuntatarjonnan. Työntekijöiden käytössä on myös kuntosali ja saunatilat.
Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja kouluttautua - meillä on monipuolinen koulutustarjonta ja urapolkuja ison organisaation sisällä.
Yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisen työn, jossa hyvä työ palkitaan.
Ymmärrämme, että elämässä on muutakin kuin työ - siksi pyrimme löytämään yhdessä ratkaisuja, jotka sopivat eri elämäntilanteisiin.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Cybersecurity Information Assurance (IA)/Security Assessor to provide support on our Defense Enterprise Office Solution (DEOS) Cloud Service Offering contract.

This position is a combination of remote (20%) and onsite (80%) support at either Chantilly, VA or Fort Meade, MD. Please be advised that no travel costs will be provided.

Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:

  • Provide cybersecurity support and guidance for overall confidentiality, availability, and integrity of capabilities in Microsoft (MS) Azure environments. This role works closely with the Cybersecurity Lead, as well as the other areas supporting the customer (e.g., Threat Hunting, Engineering, Operations) and is expected to represent the customer in various briefings and meetings with senior leadership.

  • Participate in risk assessment during the Accreditation and Authorization process.

  • Design, develop, test, implement, and integrate IA architecture, system, or system components.

  • Participate in information systems (IS) risk assessments and design security countermeasures to mitigate identified risks.

  • Ensure the architecture and design of Department of War (DoW) IS are functional and secure.

  • Design and develop IA or IA enabled products, interface specifications, and approaches to secure the environment, as necessary.

  • Utilize experience and judgment to plan and accomplish the organization's security related goals.

  • Support system or network designs that encompass multiple boundaries to include those with differing data protection/classification requirements.

  • Report to IA issues with separate reporting to other senior management for network operational requirements, as necessary.

  • Provide support services for protecting the Department of Defense Information Network (DoDIN) from cyber threats, both foreign and domestic, using cybersecurity systems, in combination with Techniques, Tactics, and Procedures (TTP) and information sharing with DoW, Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and other federal agencies.

  • Support cyber threat hunt initiatives to search for signs of malicious activities or security vulnerabilities within an organization’s network and/or digital infrastructure.

  • Support cybersecurity operations, including incident detection, triage, and response.

  • Analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify suspicious activity.

  • Conduct thorough investigations of security incidents and provide high-quality reports on findings and strategies of mitigation.


What You’ll Need to Succeed (Required):

Education: Bachelor’s Degree.

Certification: Current 8570 IAT Level II (Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or SSCP) required.

Clearance: Active Top Secret security clearance with ability to obtain SCI.

Experience: 5+ years of related experience.

Technical skills:

  • Must have 3+ years’ experience supporting MS Azure in a large-scale environment.

  • Expert knowledge of commonly used cybersecurity systems to include, but not limited to, DoW Host Based Security System (HBSS), Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), Continuous Monitoring and Risk Scoring (CMRS), Joint Incident Management System (JIMS), and Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS).

  • Experience in cybersecurity program policies and implementation for DoW Impact Level 6 (IL6) and Impact Level 7 (IL7).

  • Expert knowledge implementing heightened security controls for sensitive systems (i.e., Access Control [AC], Physical and Environmental Protection [PE], IA, Audit and Accountability [AU], and Personal Security [PS]).

  • Experience in Cyber Network Defense (CND).

What You’ll Need to Succeed (Desired):

  • IAT Level III preferred (CISSP, CASP CE, CCNP, CISA).

  • Experience with Azure Sentinel, Lighthouse and Defender Advanced Threat Protection (ATP).

  • Hands-on experience with MS Sentinel (Azure Sentinel), including:

  • Creating, tuning, and maintaining analytics rules, workbooks, and dashboards.

  • Writing advanced Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries for detection, threat hunting, and reporting.

  • Building and maintaining playbooks/automation (e.g., Logic Apps) to orchestrate response.

  • Integrating Sentinel with diverse data sources (on-prem, cloud, and third-party security tools).

  • Hands-on threat hunting experience, including:

  • Conducting proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across endpoints, networks, cloud, and identity.

  • Using threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK to guide hunting and improve detection coverage.

  • Analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify and investigate suspicious activity.

  • Experience with commercial cloud services (i.e., Amazon Web Services [AWS], Azure, and Google Cloud Platform [GCP]) is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, growth-focused environment.

title: Senior SAP HANA Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Senior SAP HANA Developer to join our team at a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing and high-tech innovation. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and maintaining cutting-edge data models, pipelines, and backend solutions to support complex business processes and analytics needs in manufacturing, engineering, and operations environments. If you are passionate about data optimization, scalable systems, and delivering high-impact data solutions, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize SAP HANA native models, such as Calculation Views, CDS Views, Stored Procedures, and SQLScript to support backend data processing and aggregations
  • Build and maintain efficient ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from SAP and non-SAP systems, including SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and other third-party sources
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable data flows and data architectures, enabling robust analytics and operational reporting
  • Develop end-to-end data workflows, ensuring high data quality while identifying and resolving data discrepancies through monitoring and troubleshooting processes
  • Work alongside frontend teams to enable real-time insights and interactive dashboards via SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and other visualization tools
  • Support and enhance business processes with custom analytics, KPI tracking, and actionable insights, all powered by SAP HANA backend solutions
  • Optimize data processing performance for large datasets and complex workflows, leveraging SAP HANA in-memory database capabilities
  • Contribute to cross-team projects by working collaboratively with engineers, business analysts, and solution architects to gather requirements and deliver high-quality, tailored solutions
  • Actively participate in Agile (SAFe) workflows, including sprints, planning, and retrospectives, while delivering incremental value to stakeholders
  • Document and maintain technical best practices, processes, and knowledge sharing for key SAP HANA solutions

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP HANA development or equivalent roles in the SAP space
  • Proven expertise in SAP HANA native modeling, including strong hands-on experience with Calculation Views, CDS Views, Procedures, and SQLScript
  • Experience in designing and maintaining ETL workflows and data pipelines, with specific experience in SAP environments like HANA
  • Familiarity with the integration of SAP systems such as SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, or other legacy systems into data workflows
  • Expertise in data performance optimization, database tuning, and ensuring scalability for large-scale datasets
  • Experience working in SAP BW environments is a plus, including familiarity with InfoObjects, DSOs, Process Chains, and data transformations
  • Strong understanding of data architecture principles and hands-on experience with SAP Web IDE and BW/4HANA tools
  • Proficiency in Agile methodologies and the use of collaboration tools like Jira and Confluence
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset

Nice to have

  • Background in the manufacturing or engineering industries, especially in areas such as quality assurance or supply chain analytics
  • Experience with SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Intelligence, or related modern SAP integration tools
  • Knowledge of advanced visualization platforms like Tableau or Power BI in addition to SAC

Benefits

We believe that the greatest strength of the company is its people. EPAM is fully committed to help its employees to reach their full potential and achieve their professional goals through continues learning. With this in mind, we would like to introduce to you few of the many opportunities and services which we believe will help you expand your current knowledge:

  • Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
  • All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
  • Free English classes
  • Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
  • Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
  • Friendly team and comfortable working environment
  • Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Opportunities for self-realization

title: Credit Officer
description:
Sydney (Eastern Creek or CBD office location)

Permanent and Fixed-term positions available

Working at Transurban is different; it’s a place where you can see the benefits of your work play out in real life, every day. We create city-sized solutions- building and operating safer, smarter, and more sustainable roads—to solve pressing transport challenges that are slowing cities down.

Are you an experienced contact centre professional looking for an immediate start?

We are seeking highly motivated, phone-based customer service and/or collections specialists to join our Credit team. These are permanent and 6- month fixed term opportunities (with a potential for extension or permanent conversion for high-performing individuals).

What’s in it for you?

Before we dive into the role, here is why you’ll love working with us:

  • Attractive salary package

  • Permanent or fixed-term positions

  • Flexible, hybrid work arrangement after training completion

  • No weekends and no late evening shifts! Enjoy a fortnightly roster of Monday–Friday shifts (8.30am-4.30pm, 9.00am-5.00pm, or 9.30am-5.30pm)

  • 6 weeks of comprehensive, fully paid onsite training delivered at our Eastern Creek office (or CBD office)

  • Following your training, the role can be based in either Eastern Creek or CBD office

About the role

As a Collections Officer, you’ll support strong customer outcomes while helping optimise cash flow and manage credit risk within a structured, professional contact centre environment.

  • Manage a combination of inbound and outbound customer calls, with calls averaging around 20 minutes per call, designed to support quality conversations and effective resolution

  • Negotiate outstanding payments and deliver fair, compliant, outcome focused resolutions

  • Review and assess customer accounts to identify risk, next actions, and appropriate outcomes

  • Support customers experiencing financial hardship by identifying fair and sustainable solutions

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including Customer Service, Account Managers, and Credit leaders

  • Manage relationships with external Debt Collection Agencies, including referrals, progress updates, and supporting performance reviews.

  • Maintain strong compliance with credit policies, privacy obligations, legislative requirements, and risk‑minimisation practices.

Core Requirements

This role is fast‑paced and dynamic, requiring strong competency skills — including navigating multiple systems, managing several screens at once, and confidently talking while typing. You’ll also be operating on a dialer and managing high‑volume call activity, which means strong multi-tasking and attention to detail are key.

We’re looking for someone with a curious mindset and transferable skills who can grow and thrive in our team. Ideally, you will bring:

  • Must have experience working in a fast-paced call or contact centre environment (exposure to credit, debt collection, or financial services is highly regarded but not essential)

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with customers and internal teams

  • Confidence working across multiple systems, policies, and data in a fast-paced environment

  • A positive, adaptable mindset, with the resilience to manage challenging conversations and openness to feedback and development

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook and Excel)

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Must have Full Working rights in Australia

  • Must be able to successfully complete and clear all required background and criminal history checks

Comprehensive training will be provided, ensuring you are fully supported in developing the necessary technical and operational skills to succeed.

What happens next?

  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis as part of our active recruitment process.

  • Suitable candidates will be invited to complete an initial video interview.

  • Shortlisted candidates will then be progressed to an in-person interview should they meet the requirements of the role

For more information about our Teams and Benefits:

We embrace diversity with a foundation of safety, wellbeing and inclusion; where everyone belongs. We treat everyone with fairness, consideration and respect, regardless of gender, gender identity, marital or family status, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity, religious beliefs, cultural or socio-economic background, perspective, and experience – whether they work for us or not. We want to ensure everyone feels comfortable and safe to express ideas, questions and concerns.

We strongly encourage applications from candidates of diverse backgrounds and lived experiences, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people living with disability.

title: Servicetekniker i Zinkgruvan
company: Xylem Water Solutions Global Services AB
description:
Vill du arbeta med att tillhandahålla våra kunder med lösningar inom pump- och vatteninstallationer? Vill du hitta ett företag som du kan utvecklas tillsammans med? Nu söker vi dig som är teknikintresserad, har en erfarenhet av rörmontage och el-kunskap och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vi söker nu en Servicetekniker med erfarenhet av VA-och/eller Markentreprenad till vår pumpverkstad i Zinkgruvan. Som Servicetekniker arbetar du med att utföra allt från service och underhåll av befintliga pumpstationer, installation av nya pumpstationer och installation av tillfälliga lösningar. Du ingår i serviceteamet i Norrköping men utgår ifrån vår pumpverkstad som är belägen på 800 meters nivå i Zinkgruvan.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även rondering och skötsel av gruvans pumpstationer samt reparation av dränkpumpar.

Man han ha sin hemort omkring Zinkgruvans plats.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig

  • En gedigen introduktion och interna utbildningar för att lära känna företaget och våra produkter
  • Kompetensutveckling för alla och god möjlighet till vidareutbildning. Du behöver inte kunna allt från start utan vi utbildar dig gärna!
  • En trevlig och schysst arbetsmiljö med olika kompetenser där du snabbt känner dig hemma
  • God ersättning och förmåner, exempelvis lunchförmån
  • Välutrustad servicebil med alla nödvändiga verktyg och utrustning som behövs
  • Tillgång till personliga IT hjälpmedel (PC, Smartphone och IPad)

Vad du kan bidra till oss

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad och trivs i en roll där du hjälper kunder. Du vågar att ta egna initiativ, gillar problemlösning och tar ansvar för ditt arbete. God samarbetsförmåga är en annan egenskap som utmärker dig.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Tekniskt/mekaniskt intresse
  • Erfarenhet av VA- och/eller Markentreprenader
  • B-körkort

Meriterande är även om du har:

  • BE-körkort
  • C-körkort

Om oss

Vi är ett globalt team på 23 000 personer som är enade runt ett gemensamt mål; att skapa lösningar för världens vattenutmaningar. Visste du att vi levererar produkter till de Olympiska spelen? Visste du att de spektakulära minnesfontänerna vid Ground Zero i New York drivs av våra produkter? Visste du att våra produkter hjälper flera av Kinas största städer att ta vara på de stora mängder vatten som regnar ner under tyfonsäsongen? Visste du att Flumrider och Colorado på Liseberg är byggda på våra produkter? Vårt arbete är inriktat på att utveckla nya tekniker som förbättrar hur vatten används, bevaras och återanvänds i framtiden. Våra produkter och tjänster förflyttar, behandlar, analyserar, övervakar och återför vatten till miljön för allmännyttiga företag, industri, bostäder och kommersiella byggnader.

Serviceorganisationen finns på 12 platser i Sverige, från Gällivare i norr till Malmö i söder. Tillsammans med våra kvalitetsprodukter ger vår serviceorganisation våra kunder en garanterat långsiktig lösning för deras pumpbehov. Vi hjälper kunderna med bland annat: Reparationer av produkter, installationer, idriftsättningar, montage, svetsjobb samt el & automatik.

Information

Arbetstiden är vardagar 7-16 och jourtjänster på kvällen/helgen kan förekomma.

Vid frågor eller för mer information så är du välkommen att kontakta Leila Sayyad, leila.sayyad@xylem.com.

Ansökan sker via länken.

Fackrepresentant är Mikael Lövås, Unionen, och Rocio Piazuelo-Carrasco , Sveriges Ingenjörer, tel: + 46 8 475 60 00.

title: Liikuntapaikanhoitaja (oppisopimuskoulutus)
description:
Hei sinä tuleva liikunta-alan ammattilainen!

Oletko aina haaveillut liikunta-alan opinnoista? Kiinnostaako työ Helsingin kaupungin liikuntapaikoilla, jossa mahdollistat niin kaupunkilaisten liikkumisen kuin luot myös olosuhteita huippu-urheilun tarpeisiin? Jos vastasit kyllä, hae meille liikuntapaikka-alan oppisopimuskoulutukseen, jossa opiskelet itsellesi uuden ammatin työn ohessa!

Haemme Helsingin kaupungin liikuntapaikat ja ulkoilupalveluihin kuusi (6) oppisopimusopiskelijaa opiskelemaan liikuntapaikka-alan ammattitutkintoa 2.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Opiskelu alkaa työssäoppimisella marraskuussa 2026 ja lähiopinnot tammikuussa 2027. Opiskelu ja tutkinnon suorittaminen tapahtuvat pääkaupunkiseudulla. Lähiopetuspäiviä on 2-3 päivää kuukaudessa.

Valitut opiskelijat tekevät liikuntapaikanhoitajan töitä eri toimipisteissämme. Työkohteet tulevat vaihtelemaan eri opintojaksojen mukaisesti. Helsingin kaupungin liikuntapalvelut tarjoavat monipuolisesti liikuntapaikkoja, ulkoilualueita sekä merellisiä palveluita eri puolilla Helsinkiä.

Liikuntapaikka-alan ammattitutkinto valmistaa sinusta erilaisten liikuntaolosuhteiden ammattilaisen. Tutkinnon aikana opit hallitsemaan asiakaspalvelun sekä kattavasti eri liikunta- ja urheilulajien liikuntapaikoille asettamat vaatimukset, kiinteistötekniikan käytön ja päivittäiset hoitotoimenpiteet, erilaiset työkoneet sekä liikuntavälineistön huollon. Liikuntapaikanhoitajan työ on ajoittain fyysistä ja sitä tehdään kaikkina vuodenaikoina, joskus haastavissakin olosuhteissa.

Liikuntapaikka-alan ammattitutkinto koostuu kolmesta pakollisesta tutkinnon osasta (kesä-, talvi- ja sisäliikuntapaikkojen hoitaminen) sekä yhdestä valinnaisesta osasta.
Liikuntapaikkojenhoitajan ammattitutkinnon perusteet löydät täältä: https://eperusteet.opintopolku.fi/#/fi/ammatillinen/666690/tutkinnonosat

Opinnot kestävät noin vuoden. Tarkempi opintosuunnitelma tehdään jokaisen opiskelijan kanssa erikseen. Oppisopimusopiskelijat ovat määräaikaisessa työsuhteessa Helsingin kaupungin liikuntapalveluihin koko opintojen ajan.

Tarjoamme sinulle tutkinnon lisäksi monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn viihtyisässä ympäristössä ja mukavassa porukassa. Työlläsi on yhteiskunnallista merkitystä ja palkitsemme mielellämme hyvistä työsuorituksista.

title: Account Development Executive - SBS
description:
The SBS Account Development Team is a key part of American Express International Card Services and maintains relationships with small and medium clients in Australia & New Zealand, supporting business owners with products and services to help them run and grow their businesses.

The SBS Account Development Executive position is responsible for managing a dynamic Small Business Services portfolio, with the goal of growing billing, lending and acquisition revenues whilst focusing on customer retention via effective pipeline management. The role is also responsible for identifying, qualifying and converting Internal Acquisition (IA) opportunities to support customer growth and achieve broader business objectives.

To be effective, the ADE is required to interpret information from a variety of sources including customer conversations, internal data and analytics resources and external sources to uncover and convert growth opportunities. Ensuring a positive customer experience with every interaction is paramount. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong sales execution, pipeline discipline, and accountability for achieving portfolio growth, acquisition, retention, and product penetration objectives.

  • Drive billings growth through application of consultative selling skills to identify and secure spend expansion opportunities.
  • Identify, qualify and convert Internal Acquisition (IA) opportunities to drive new business growth and increase customer acquisition outcomes.
  • Cross-sell additional products and solutions to support customer growth and increase product penetration.
  • Drive lending growth by identifying customer financing needs and referring or fulfilling opportunities as appropriate.
  • Maximise retention to meet defined overall portfolio targets for growth and customer engagement.
  • Effectively manage and maintain a robust sales and acquisition pipeline to ensure achievement of growth objectives.
  • Utilise internal data, analytics and customer insights to prioritise opportunities and maximise sales effectiveness.
  • Maintain a high level of knowledge for related products, underwriting policy, systems and processes.
  • Think conceptually and analytically to ensure we are maximizing the most positive customer experience.
  • Demonstrate individual accountability for achieving sales, acquisition, retention and productivity metrics while maintaining strong risk and compliance standards.
  • Performance Expectations & Success Measures
  • Deliver growth across billing, product penetration, acquisition and cross-sell, including MGM referrals and supplementary cards.
  • Drive pipeline health, opportunity conversion, customer engagement and sales productivity while meeting individual and team targets.
  • Proven relationship management and consultative sales experience, with a strong record of exceeding growth targets.
  • Strong portfolio, acquisition and pipeline management, including identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge the status quo.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with business owners and financial stakeholders, including accountants, financial controllers and CFOs.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including working capital and cash flow conversations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and organisational skills, with effective prioritisation.
  • Collaborative team player who shares ideas, works independently and takes ownership of business, customer and acquisition outcomes.
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer focus, accountability, risk, compliance and quality standards.
  • Core capabilities: Consultative Selling, CRM, Business Development, Portfolio & Pipeline Management, Commercial Acumen, Data-Driven Decision Making, Influencing and Collaboration.

title: Anestesiahoitaja, Oulu
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt anestesiasairaanhoitajaa perhevapaan sijaisuuteen 5.4.2027 saakka Ouluun.

Mitä työ anestesiasairaanhoitajana Oulun Terveystalon sairaalassa pitää sisällään?

Terveystalo Oulussa leikkaustoiminta koostuu mm. ortopediasta, tekonivelkirurgiasta, käsi- ja jalkateräkirurgiasta, neurokirurgiasta, gastro- ja plastiikkakirurgiasta, gynekologiasta, knk- ja kaihikirurgiasta. Leikkaukset ovat pääsääntöisesti päiväkirurgisia tai lyhytjälkihoitoisia leikkauksia. Potilaiden ikäjakauma on vauvasta vaariin.

Sairaanhoitajana Oulun Terveystalossa olet tärkeässä asemassa mahdollistamassa leikkauspalvelujamme. Sairaalassamme pääset työskentelemään, hyödyntämään sekä kasvattamaan osaamistasi usean eri erikoisalan parissa. Työtehtävät koostuvat potilaiden valmistelusta leikkaukseen, leikkauksen aikaisesta anestesiavalvonnasta sekä potilaiden hoidosta ja kotiuttamisesta samana tai seuraavana päivänä. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa noin 40 hengen työyhteisössä.

Työsuhde on kokoaikainen, määräaikainen perhevapaan sijaisuus 5.4.2027 saakka. Sairaala on viikkosairaala eli avoinna maanantaista perjantaihin. Työhön sisältyy aamu-, ilta- ja yövuoroja. Viikonloput ja juhlapyhät olemme suljettuina. Työvuorosuunnittelua ohjaa sairaalamme aukioloajat, se tapahtuu kuuden viikon jaksoissa työyhteisöllisenä työvuorosuunnitteluna.

​​Terveystalon kokonaispalkitseminen muodostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta ja mahdollisesta henkilökohtaisesta palkanosasta sekä työsuhde-eduista.​

  • Työtehtävässä noudatetaan yksityisen terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES), jonka mukaan tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu. Tehtävä on määritetty Terveystalossa vaativuusryhmään VR 4, jonka mukainen vähimmäispalkka sairaanhoitajalle on 2808,72 €/kk, ja palkka voi nousta kokemuksen, osaamisen ja työn sijainnin mukaan.​
  • Lisäksi palkkaan vaikuttavat mahdollinen henkilökohtainen osuus (erityinen osaaminen, aiempi työkokemus) ja erityistekijälisät (lisävastuut työssä) sekä vuosisidonnaisuus (4 vuotta +6 %, ja 7 vuotta +11 % tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta). Tämän päälle maksetaan TES:n mukaiset vuorolisät.​
  • Terveystalon tärkeimmän tekijät pääsevät myös nauttimaan monipuolisista työsuhde-eduista, joihin kuuluvat lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, kumppanialennukset sekä kattava työterveyshuolto. Työterveyshuolto sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, kuten lyhytpsykoterapian.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

  • Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä.
  • Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
  • Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
  • Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.
  • Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Pätevyysvaatimuksena on sairaanhoitajan tutkinto ja useamman vuoden työkokemus anestesiatyöstä. Aiempi kokemus lapsipotilaiden hoitamisesta, osastotyöstä ja/tai valvovan hoitajat työstä katsotaan eduksi. Toivomme, että sinulla on lääkeosaamisen luvat jo suoritettuna.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta viimeistään 31.8.2026. Meille jokainen hakija on tärkeä. Siksi meillä jokaisen hakemuksen lukee aina ihminen. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaa mielellään palveluvastaava Minna Kaiponen (p. 050 529 7907, minna.kaiponen@terveystalo.com).

title: Software Developer - CAD API Integration | AU | WFH

  • Computational geometry, Revit solids and connectors, fabrication parts, STEP files or other manufacturing-oriented outputs.

Benefits

description:
Disclosure

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Document Preparation Technician to support digitization activities at the American Indian Records Repository (AIRR) and other Bureau of Trust Fund Administration (BTFA) locations. This role focuses on preparing records for digitization by identifying documents, inserting barcodes, removing fasteners, and organizing files according to BTFA Standard Operating Procedures.


Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com


Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

• Prepare boxes and files for digitization following the Box Prep Guide and SOPs.
• Insert barcodes to properly identify documents, boxes, or electronic files.
• Remove paperclips, staples, tape, sticky notes, binders, and similar items.
• Conduct light clerical tasks including filing, copying, inventory creation, and basic record handling.
• Collaborate with digitization and quality control staff to maintain workflow consistency and accuracy.
• Follow NARA and DOI records policies during document preparation activities.

Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 1 year of related experience in a role involving document preparation, records management, clerical work, or other detail-oriented administrative tasks.

• Ability to obtain and maintain language a moderate public trust adjudication.

• Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport to undergo commercial airfare travel

• Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license


Working Environment

This position primarily operates in a professional office setting with standard office equipment and a quiet, climate-controlled environment. While in the office, there is no regular exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery.


This role also requires periodic travel to project sites, including locations undergoing renovation or active construction. During site visits, the employee may be exposed to non-temperature-controlled environments, construction noise, dust, and other typical conditions found on job sites. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required during these visits, depending on site conditions. While on site visits, an individual in this role will be required to work atypical hours at the request of the client or role demands.


Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This is not a sedentary role. This role requires the ability to be on your feet moving around a construction site for most of the day interacting with contractors, contractor representatives, and inspecting the construction work that is being performed.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about outside in various geographic and building terrains to access a construction site to provide quality assurance services.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: This role requires stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and ladder climbing to inspect all aspects of building construction to foundations, crawlspaces, and roofs.

Using Hands/Fingers: This role constantly operates technological office equipment such as laptop, mouse, keyboard, computer monitors, telephones, and scanners, copiers, and fax machines.

Talking/Hearing: This role requires constant communication with others in the organization to exchange information, review information, and make decisions about information.

Seeing: This role requires the ability to see, view, and distinguish all aspects of construction to ensure quality control.

Carrying/Lifting: This role requires lifting up to 30 lbs to transport technological office equipment, safety equipment, and other needed construction items to and from various workspaces.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.


Bodwé Group Companies engage in federal contracting. Therefore, we would be thrilled to accept applications or referrals to hire veterans.

Targeted preference is in the following order:
