title: Personlig assistent, 50%, sökes till tjej i Örnsköldsvik!
description:
På Kura Omsorg arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi söker nu en engagerad kollega till en positiv 26-årig tjej i Örnsköldsvik. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på ca 50%. Under natten är det vaken natt som förekommer.

Arbetstiderna som förekommer:

  • Kl. 07:00 - 22:00 vardagar

  • Kl. 22:00 - 07:00 vardagar

  • Kl. 09:00 - 22:00 helger

  • Kl. 22:00 - 09:00 helg

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse där vi gärna ser att du kan påbörja introduktion omgående.

OM KUNDEN

Kunden är en sprallig tjej i 26-årsåldern som bor strax utanför centrala Örnsköldsvik. Hon söker dig som vill vara ett stöd i en vardag fylld av både rutin och nöjen. Arbetsuppgifterna innebär att du finns behjälplig vid personlig hygien, förflyttningar och på- och avklädning, men även stöttar med kommunikation och hushållssysslor. Du följer även med på meningsfulla aktiviteter, exempelvis att åka och bada. Under dagarna är hon på sin dagliga verksamhet, men på fritiden växlar hon gärna mellan att gå på konserter och evenemang och att njuta av lugna stunder i lugn och ro hemma.

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Vår kund söker dig som är ansvarsfull, varm, omtänksam och har ett positivt synsätt. Vidare söker vi dig som är lyhörd när det kommer till att lyssna, kommunicera och känna av kundens signaler och önskemål. Erfarenhet inom området är inte det viktigaste, vi utgår främst i från personkemi och personlig lämplighet för uppdraget. Utifrån kundens önskemål ser vi positivt på kvinnliga sökanden.

KRAV

  • Ej allergisk mot pälsdjur

MERITER

  • Simkunnig och tål klorerat vatten

  • Körkort & tillgång till bil

Sysselsättningsgrad: 50%

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Kura Omsorg, kund och anhörig. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

För anställning hos oss på Kura Omsorg behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida. På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att jobba som personlig assistent.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och de nya regler som trädde i kraft den 1 mars 2026.

ATT ARBETA PÅ KURA OMSORG

Som anställd personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal samt avtalspension. Du är försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag till alla våra anställda. Dessutom anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med. Vi är måna om att du som medarbetare ska trivas hos oss!

DELA KANDIDATER MELLAN BOLAGEN

Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia. Du ger ditt medgivande i ansökan.

FÖR DIG MED ANSTÄLLNINGSSTÖD

Om du som söker har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd tar vi som arbetsgivare på Kura Omsorg även detta i beaktning vid en eventuell anställning. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Senior Security Tools Engineer
description:
Sr. Security Tools Engineer - HashiCorp Vault & AppViewX

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Workplace: on_site

Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Tools Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise security platforms, particularly HashiCorp Vault and Certificate Management/AppViewX.

The role will focus on the deployment, integration, operationalization, automation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise security tools across technology platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong security engineering fundamentals, excellent scripting and automation skills, experience working with large-scale infrastructure environments, and the ability to collaborate with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Development, and business stakeholders.

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in at least two primary security tool areas, with exposure to additional IAM, PAM, certificate management, database security, HSM, or tokenization technologies considered an advantage.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, integrate, operationalize, and maintain enterprise security tools and platforms.
  • Develop secure, reliable, scalable, and highly available security solutions.
  • Customize and automate security tools and workflows using modern scripting and API-based integrations.
  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles to the operation and maintenance of security platforms.
  • Work closely with Infrastructure, Architecture, Security, Development, Change Management, and application support teams.
  • Participate in solution design, implementation, migration, troubleshooting, and production support activities.
  • Research emerging security technologies and contribute to security standards, policies, and technical baselines.
  • Assess security risks and provide appropriate mitigation options to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Support security operations and incident response activities when required.
  • Ensure privileged identities, secrets, certificates, and other security assets are securely managed throughout their lifecycle.
  • Participate in Agile delivery frameworks and contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives.
  • Manage technical deliverables, dependencies, implementation timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

Primary Security Tool Expertise

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in at least two primary security tool areas, with particular preference for AppViewX and HashiCorp Vault.

1. Certificate Management – AppViewX

Strong hands-on experience in:

  • Certificate Lifecycle Management.
  • Automated certificate renewal, revocation, provisioning, and deployment.
  • SSL/TLS, SSH, and X.509 certificates.
  • CSR generation and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) hierarchies.
  • Integration with internal and external Certificate Authorities.
  • Experience integrating with Certificate Authorities such as:
    • Microsoft CA
    • Venafi
    • DigiCert
    • Entrust
  • Certificate deployment and management across enterprise infrastructure.
  • Linux and Windows Server administration.
  • Python scripting and REST API integrations for automation and custom workflows.
  • Basic understanding of network infrastructure and certificate deployment across:
    • Load Balancers
    • Firewalls
    • Web Servers
    • F5 BIG-IP
    • NGINX
    • Apache
    • IIS

2. Secrets Management – HashiCorp Vault

Strong hands-on experience in:

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining centralized secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Installation and operationalization of HashiCorp Vault and Consul/Raft storage components in on-premises and cloud environments.
  • HashiCorp Vault integration with target applications for secure secrets management.
  • Authentication methods including:
    • LDAP
    • AppRole
    • Kubernetes
  • Installation, administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of HashiCorp Vault.
  • Migration of storage from Consul to integrated Raft storage.
  • Integration of Vault with Jenkins and Kubernetes for secure credential injection.
  • Deployment of HashiCorp Vault Enterprise on Linux servers.
  • High-availability deployment using OpenShift and VMware environments.
  • Troubleshooting production issues involving:
    • AppRole
    • Secrets
    • Namespaces
    • KV secrets engine
    • Transit secrets engine
    • Authentication methods
  • Hardening HashiCorp Vault according to industry security standards.
  • Vault High Availability and Disaster Recovery strategies.
  • Basic understanding of:
    • Load Balancers
    • Data-center affinity
    • Network infrastructure
  • Understanding of encryption, vulnerability assessment, SIEM, and broader security controls.

Secondary Security Technologies – Good to Have

Exposure to one or more of the following will be an advantage:

  • CyberArk – Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • SailPoint – Identity Services / Identity Governance
  • Ping Identity – Single Sign-On / SSO
  • Imperva – Database Access Monitoring
  • Thales PayShield HSM
  • Thales Luna HSM
  • CipherTrust Manager (CTM)
  • CTVL / Tokenization Engine
  • Enterprise IAM and privileged identity management solutions.

Development, Scripting & Automation

Strong development and automation capability is required, including experience with:

  • Python
  • PowerShell
  • Bash / Shell scripting
  • Java
  • .NET
  • REST APIs
  • API-based integrations
  • Workflow automation
  • Security tool customization and enhancement

Candidates should demonstrate the ability to identify manual security processes and develop automated solutions to improve operational efficiency and security.

Security & Infrastructure Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

  • Enterprise security concepts.
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM).
  • Privileged Identity Management.
  • Secrets management.
  • Certificate and PKI management.
  • Encryption and cryptographic concepts.
  • Vulnerability assessment.
  • SIEM and security monitoring.
  • Security hardening and security baselines.
  • High Availability and Disaster Recovery.
  • Linux and Windows Server environments.
  • Load balancing and basic network infrastructure.
  • Cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.

Delivery & Stakeholder Management

  • Work with business and process owners to understand requirements and deliver secure technology solutions.
  • Collaborate with Infrastructure teams to ensure consistency and operational readiness.
  • Partner with Architecture teams to align solutions with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Work with Security teams to ensure compliance with security standards and controls.
  • Coordinate with Development, Change Management, and application support teams.
  • Manage technical dependencies, implementation timelines, and project deliverables.
  • Communicate technical risks, threats, issues, and mitigation options clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Contribute to Agile delivery, sprint planning, technical implementation, and continuous improvement activities.

Key Success Areas

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Design and implement secure, reliable, and scalable security platforms.
  • Maintain high availability, stability, and efficiency of security tools.
  • Deliver high-quality technical designs and implementation recommendations.
  • Improve security automation and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain strong security standards, baselines, and controls.
  • Ensure secure lifecycle management of certificates, secrets, and privileged identities.
  • Support Cyber Security Operations during security incidents.
  • Identify and mitigate technical and security risks.
  • Maintain strong stakeholder satisfaction and communication.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience working with security technologies in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with enterprise security tools and platforms.
  • Strong expertise in HashiCorp Vault and/or AppViewX, with experience across at least two relevant primary security tool areas preferred.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills.
  • Experience working with large-scale infrastructure and production environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident-resolution capabilities.
  • Experience collaborating with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Development, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Certifications

The following certifications are advantageous:

  • CISSP
  • CISA
  • CISM
  • Relevant HashiCorp certifications
  • Relevant IAM / PAM / Cybersecurity certifications

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong security mindset.
  • Highly organized and process-oriented.
  • Innovative approach to automation and technical enhancement.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable taking ownership and accountability.
  • Strong team player who actively collaborates and listens to others.
  • Clear, concise, and effective communication.
  • Ability to work across organizational boundaries.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management capability.
  • Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to evolving security technologies.

title: Kundmottagare, Staffanstorp
description:
Vill du bli en del av ett marknadsledande företag och utvecklas tillsammans med ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken inom anläggningsmaskiner – Volvo? Då kan det här vara din nästa utmaning!

Vi söker nu en engagerad och serviceinriktad kundmottagare med teknisk kompetens och god administrativ förmåga till vår serviceanläggning i Staffanstorp. I denna nyckelroll blir du vårt ansikte utåt – den viktiga länken mellan våra kunder och vår skickliga servicepersonal. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en dynamisk miljö där kundfokus, kvalitet och laganda står i centrum.

På Swecon är mångfald, jämlikhet och inkludering mer än ord – det är ett åtagande. Vi tror att genom att omfamna olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och bakgrunder blir vi starkare.

Dina viktigaste arbetsuppgifter

Som kundmottagare ansvarar du för att planera och fördela det dagliga arbetet i verkstaden, samtidigt som du säkerställer att våra kunder och leverantörer får bästa möjliga service. Du är en viktig länk mellan verkstadsteamet och våra externa kontakter – och en nyckelperson i att skapa ett effektivt och välfungerande arbetsflöde.

Tillsammans med våra servicechefer leder du serviceteknikerna och ser till att de har rätt stöd och förutsättningar för att leverera service- och reparationsarbeten av högsta kvalitet. Vid behov kliver du även in och stöttar plats- eller servicecheferna vid frånvaro.

Utöver det operativa ansvaret ingår även administrativa uppgifter såsom:

  • Verkstadsadministration och fakturering
  • Hantering av reklamationer och leverantörsfakturor
  • Tidsrapportering
  • Kundmottagning via telefon och på plats i verkstaden

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

  • En relevant bakgrund och gärna flera års erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter
  • God kunskap i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
  • God vana och kunskap av arbete med datorer i digitala system
  • B-körkort
  • En stark administrativ förmåga

Har du dessutom erfarenhet från fordonsbranschen och goda fordonstekniska kunskaper? Så är det ett stort plus!

Vi tror att du är en person som:

  • Trivs med att ha många bollar i luften och gillar ett högt tempo
  • Är serviceinriktad, strukturerad och har ett öga för detaljer
  • Har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändringar och kan prioritera när det behövs
  • Är lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra

Vi erbjuder dig

Ett spännande, utvecklande och fartfyllt arbete som ger utrymme för initiativtagande och eget ansvar. En arbetsmiljö där säkerhet står högst på agendan. Många kontaktytor, både externt och internt. Ett engagerat och välkomnande team som ser fram emot att få en ny kollega.

Så här ansöker du

Du ansöker till tjänsten online. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och lämplighet.

Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten så snart vi hittar rätt person skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt dock senast 2026-09-07

title: Senior Automation QA Engineer
description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities :

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automated test frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of software applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify test requirements, create automation strategies, and enhance continuous integration and deployment processes. Your role involves maintaining test scripts, analysing results, and driving improvements in automation efficiency while mentoring junior engineers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks – Design, implement, and optimize scalable test automation solutions for functional and regression test
  • Create and Execute Automated Test Scripts – Develop automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium and PHPUnit.
  • Collaborate with Development Teams – Work closely with developers, and product team to identify test scenarios and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Enhance Test Coverage – Identify gaps in test coverage and improve automated testing for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Perform Code Reviews and Debugging – Review automation scripts, troubleshoot test failures, and suggest improvements.
  • Monitor and Analyze Test Results – Track test execution, analyze failures, and report defects while ensuring timely resolution.
  • Deployment monitoring – To ensures that applications function correctly after deployment, minimizing risks and ensuring system stability
  • Mentor and Train Team Members – Provide guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in software testing, with a strong focus on test automation.
  • Proficiency in automation frameworks such as Selenium and PHPUnit
  • Strong programming skills in Java, PHP or C# for test automation.
  • Experience with API testing tools like Postman.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab).
  • Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to changing requirements.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members is a plus.

Pre-Requisites :

Razer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diverse teams drive better ideas, better products, and a stronger culture. We are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and fair workplace for every employee across all the countries we operate in. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, colour, nationality, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected under local laws. Where needed, we provide reasonable accommodations - including for disability or religious practices - to ensure every team member can perform and contribute at their best.

title: Mekaanikko
description:
Hei, Sinä autoalan ammattilainen tai sellaiseksi haluava! Haluatko päästä osaksi huippuorganisaation tiimiä ja varmistaa paikkasi alan parhaiden osaajien joukossa?

Haemme nyt Vantaan Scania-keskukseen ammattitaitoista ja kokenutta

RASKAAN KALUSTON MEKAANIKKOA

Scanian mekaanikkona toimenkuvaasi kuuluvat kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja niiden päällirakenteiden huollot ja korjaukset. Mekaanikkona olet keskeisessä roolissa asiakastyytyväisyyden, tuottavuuden sekä liikenneturvallisuuden varmistamisessa. Jos monipuolinen ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoa vaativa työ raskaan kaluston huippubrändin parissa kuulostaa hyvältä, voisi tämä olla paikka sinulle!

Toivomme sinulta
- tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta
- vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
- vähintään B-luokan ajo-oikeutta
- nykyaikaisten IT-taitojen hallitsemista
- joukkuehenkisyyttä ja halua oppia uutta
- eduksi katsomme vastaavan kokemuksen sekä autosähköosaamisen

Ennen kaikkea toivomme hakijoilta motivaatiota ja halua kehittyä huollon ja korjauksen moniosaajaksi nykyaikaisessa korjaamoympäristössä. Ja jotta onnistut tehtävässä, saat kattavan perehdytyksen, käyttöösi modernit työvälineet sekä tueksesi huipputiimin sekä koko Scania-verkoston taustavoiman.

Tarjoamme sinulle
- mahdollisuuden työskennellä tunnetun ja vahvan brändin parissa
- haasteellisen ja samalla vastuullisen työn
- Laadukkaat työtilat ja viihtyisän työympäristön uudessa Scania-keskuksessa Vantaan Tuupakassa
- mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan kehitykseen; panostamme työntekijöidemme koulutukseen ja työhyvinvointiin
- kilpailukykyiset henkilöstöedut, sisältäen muun muassa lounasedun, laajan virike-edun, sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Team Leader Joni Kainulainen. Tavoitat Jonin puhelimitse numerosta 010 555 2045 tai sähköpostilla joni.kainulainen@scania.com. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 30.8.2026 mennessä oheisen hakulinkin kautta. Liitäthän hakemukseesi myös hakukirjeen. Haethan pian, sillä etenemme haussa heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Henkilöstö on Scanian arvokkain voimavara ja yhtenä joukkueena autamme asiakkaitamme menestymään. Haemme jatkuvasti uusia Scanialaisia eri tehtäviin ympäri Suomen. Jos olet motivoitunut ja valmis ottamaan vastuuta, tarjolla on lukuisia mahdollisuuksia. Scania on oikea paikka kaikille – huollon ammattilaisille, myynnin osaajille, asiantuntijoille ja johtajille. Liittymällä osaksi matkaamme, edistät koko kuljetusalan tulevaisuutta, jossa Scania toimii suunnannäyttäjänä matkalla kohti kestävää liikennejärjestelmää.

Scania-konserni on maailman johtavia kuorma- ja linja-autojen sekä meri- ja teollisuusmoottoreiden valmistajia. Suomessa Scania on alansa edelläkävijä. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme heidän liiketoimintaansa tukevia palveluja ja kokonaisratkaisuja. Scania Suomella on 19 Scania-palvelukeskusta, joita tukee seitsemän sopimustoimipistettä. www.scania.fi

title: Senior Coordinator - Proposal
description:
WSP is currently seeking a Senior Coordinator - Proposal to support our Strategic Growth Team, US, who can, under direct supervision, assist other marketing professionals and managers in the administrative functions involved in preparing proposals, qualifications, and other marketing materials. We’re looking for is someone with a collaborative, can-do attitude who has a special knack for creativity and storytelling. The right candidate is an empathetic colleague who works to build community through positivity and who can bring home the win!

This role will be based in the Noida/ Bengaluru office.

  • Own the end-to-end proposal lifecycle, including kickoff, planning, content integration, compliance checks, submission, and post-submission archiving/debrief.

  • Coordinate with technical SMEs, business, graphics, and support functions to gather inputs, drive alignment, and ensure timely delivery of all proposal components.

  • Develop and refine high-quality proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, and resumes, ensuring alignment with client requirements, win themes, and strategic messaging.

  • Ensure strict compliance with RFP/RFQ requirements, including formatting, branding, document accuracy, and completeness, while maintaining high standards of quality control.

  • Manage and maintain proposal knowledge assets, including templates, resumes, project sheets, and content repositories, to enable consistency and reuse across proposals.

  • Identify and escalate proposal risks, gaps, and compliance issues early, enabling timely resolution.

  • Facilitate collaboration between US and GCC teams, ensuring seamless communication, time zone coordination, and efficient delivery of proposal milestones.

  • Drive process improvement, standardization, and efficiency initiatives, while mentoring junior team members and providing quality oversight on proposal deliverables

Key Competencies / Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree, with a preference for a degree in Engineering, journalism or English
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in proposal development and coordination or a similar environment
  • Strong proposal/bid management and coordination skills
  • Excellent writing, editing, and communication abilities
  • High attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe InDesign, and SharePoint
  • A self-motivated team member, who demonstrates initiative to go above and beyond the task at hand, and can effectively multitask
  • Cultural awareness, conscientious and open mind
  • Experience in engineering/ AEC industry, and exposure to US proposals / global stakeholders preferred.
  • Able to work during US timezone.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Intern
description:
Job Summary

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level and make a real impact?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.​

The role is based in Melbourne, Australia (onsite role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

Where You'll Make a Difference

  • Assist in conducting pilot plant trials for plant-based barista beverage formulations.
  • Prepare and test beverage samples using different recipes and processing conditions.
  • Evaluate coffee application performance, including barista-related attributes such as foam quality, stability, and sensory characteristics.
  • Record experimental data and summarize trial results.
  • Support laboratory and pilot plant activities, including sample preparation and equipment clean-up.
  • Collaborate with the Application team to analyze findings and recommend formulation improvements.
  • Prepare a final internship report and deliver a presentation summarizing project outcomes and key learnings.

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Nutrition, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Interest in food and beverage product development, especially plant-based products.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Why Choose Us?

  • Hands-on experience in plant-based beverage formulation and application development.
  • Exposure to pilot plant operations and product evaluation techniques.
  • Opportunity to work with experienced food scientists and application specialists.
  • Practical project experience through final report and presentation delivery.

For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Intake and Assessment Worker - Part time
description:
Number of Positions Available:

1

ABOUT US

The Salvation Army is a Christian movement and one of Australia's largest and most-loved charities. We believe in doing good that transforms lives and futures for the better. It is this belief which drives us to find new ways and places where we can make a difference. From times of personal crisis to moments of national grief, we are always here — providing support, safety, community, and opportunity.

Why the role matters

The Salvation Army Australia’s (TSA) Homelessness Stream provides high-quality, person-centered services to people at risk, and or experiencing homelessness. Foster House offers a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment to some of the most vulnerable and disadvantaged people experiencing homelessness in the inner city of Sydney. The 24/7-hour service supports fifty single men in a residential setting. The team works in line with Trauma Informed Care principles, the No Wrong Door Policy, and The Salvation Army’s Mission, Vision & Values at all times.

About the role

We are seeking a values-driven and proactive Intake and Assessment Worker to conduct needs-based assessments in a prompt, empathetic and collaborative manner. This is a permanent part-time (24 Hours Per Week) position based in Surry Hills, NSW. Salary and conditions are in accordance with SCHADS Crisis Level 1. The successful applicant will be reporting to the Residential Services Team Leader.

How you will make an impact

  • Support the implementation of the Homelessness Stream Model of Care that underpins services, defines expectations and standards for those we serve.

  • Perform the role in line with Trauma Informed Care principles.

  • Work with Team Leaders and Case Managers to identify and respond to client needs and requests in a prompt, empathetic and collaborative way.

  • Create a safe space for anyone that presents seeking support/assistance.

  • Update and maintain case notes in a timely fashion.

  • Complete reports for incidents, near misses and address potential high-risk situations and other work hazards.

  • Acquire and maintain professional relationships with local providers and internal stakeholders.

  • Identify service gaps and risks, make recommendations for service delivery to the Leadership Team.

  • Participate in ongoing professional and skill development to enhance service delivery and practice .

What you will bring

  • A Working With Children Check.

  • Senior First Aid Certificate.

  • Minimum Cert IV in Community Services (required).

  • Good oral and written communication skills.

  • Understanding of Trauma Informed care framework is desirable.

What we offer

As a registered NFP we offer our eligible employees real and meaningful benefits such as;

  • NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit ($2,650)

  • Flexible working conditions

  • Health, fitness and financial discounts / benefits

  • Paid parental leave - 12 weeks

  • Up to 8 weeks leave per year through our purchase leave scheme

  • Up to 5 days paid leave per year to ‘volunteer’ in a TSA program or activity

  • Purpose driven career which has positive social and sustainable outcomes

  • Employee Assistance Program - Independent confidential counselling service;

  • Opportunity for career development;

  • An inclusive culture of dedicated, passionate and professional team members

  • Positively supporting and impacting the lives of others through your career contribution

How to Apply

If you're excited by this unique opportunity, the above sounds like you, and you have a heart for working for an organisation that truly does transform lives, we would love to speak to you.

Applications will close as soon as a suitable candidate is secured.

The Salvation Army is an Equal Opportunity Employer who provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people. We value people of all cultures, languages, capacities, sexual orientations, gender identities and/or expressions. We are committed to achieving a diverse workforce and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal people and Torres Strait Islander people.

The Salvation Army is a child safe organisation and is committed to protecting children and young people from harm. All child facing roles will require the successful completion of a Working with Children Check. Applicants for all roles require a mandatory Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.

We value Integrity, Compassion, Respect, Diversity, and Collaboration

title: Säsonga på Halloween & Jul på Liseberg
description:
Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie! Sedan 1923 har vi fått människor att mötas, skratta och trivas tillsammans. Snart är det din tur att vara med. Hos oss jobbar du inte bara i en nöjespark – du jobbar i en hel värld av upplevelser: Karuseller, musik, god mat, hotell, show, trädgårdar, camping – och snart en helt ny vattenvärld. Vi har öppet året om, i olika säsonger och olika tempo – men glädjen finns alltid där. Och det är just du som är med och skapar den. Här är jobbet både stort och smått, vardagligt och wiiie, fullt av fart men med plats för eftertanke. Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie!

Vi ger dig detta (och lite till!)

  • Vardag och wiiie. Här är jobbet både kul och på riktigt. Du gör skillnad – oavsett om du jobbar mitt i pulsen eller bakom kulisserna.

  • Kollegor och kvarterskänsla. Här finns experter på allt från snurrande åk till smarta excel-dokument. Olika jobb, olika hörn av samma varma kvarter.

  • Värde före vinst. Vi ägs av staden. Det du gör bidrar till något större än oss själva.

  • Mod och metod. Vi testar nytt – men alltid med hållbarhet i fokus. Att ligga i framkant kräver både idéer och eftertanke. Här finns båda.

Du är en i gänget Rollen som Lisebergare innebär att du är med och gör skillnad för både gäster och kollegor. Hos oss kommer du tillhöra ett gott gäng av arbetskamrater som tillsammans bidrar till Liseberg som helhetsupplevelse. Oavsett om du arbetar direkt mot gäst eller bakom kulisserna är målet alltid att bidra till våra gästers livslånga upplevelser och minnen.

Så ser en vaaanlig dag ut Hos oss får du arbeta med service när den är som bäst i en av Europas ledande Nöjesparker, på våra familjevänliga campingar och på Sveriges mest fantasifulla hotell - Liseberg Grand Curiosa.

Dagens to-do: skapa magi, Det gör du genom att:

  • Alltid sträva efter att göra skillnad, såväl för gäster som för kollegor

  • Leverera service i världsklass

  • Har teamkänsla som naturlig drivkraft

  • Är en kollega av rang!

  • Vågar ta initiativ och leva Lisebergs varumärke

Passar vi ihop

Hos oss på Liseberg är ensam inte stark och att sätta kollegor och gäster i första rummet är för dig en självklarhet. Vi söker dig som delar våra värdeord; omtanke, kreativitet, säkerhet, kvalitet och glädje och med dessa vill du vara med och skapa Liseberg.

Har du vad som krävs för åkturen?

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska

  • För vissa tjänster är det meriterande med körkort/och eller truckkort

Bra att veta

  • Säsongsanställning eller särskild visstidsanställning

  • Varierande sysselsättningsgrad

  • Avtalsområde Kommunal alt. HRF

  • Sista ansökningsdag 27 september- men vi rekryterar löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart du kan!

  • Bakgrundskontroller kan bli aktuellt senare i processen

Fackliga kontakter

  • Kommunal: Bosse Nordlander, kommunal.vast@liseberg.se

  • HRF: hrf-gc@liseberg.se

På vår hemsida www.liseberg.se kan du läsa mer om oss som arbetsplats.

Ta första steget och skicka in din ansökan!

title: Kock
description:
Billingehus är destinationen med själ och hjärta som rymmer hela livet i ett hus. Med rum för boende, möten, restauranger, barer, bad, bastur och återhämtning erbjuder vi en fristad för rekreation, oförglömliga nöjen och spännande aktiviteter. Utanför knuten väntar ett berg av upplevelser året runt, med bland annat längdskidåkning, cykling och vandring.

Välkommen till vårt kök

Vårt kök serverar vällagad, klassisk mat med en gnutta attityd och glimten i ögat. Vår inspiration bottnar i Västgötaslättens matkultur och följer det skafferi som årstiderna har att erbjuda. Dina arbetsdagar är omväxlande då vi erbjuder lunch och middag alla dagar i veckan. I huset finner du flera unika restauranger med olika inriktningar – alla med samma fokus på kvalitet & service.

Öga för smaker & samarbete

  • Du har erfarenhet av att laga mat med god kvalité och gillar att arbeta i ett kök med högt tempo.
  • Du är noga med smaker, har ett öga för detaljer och drivs av att utvecklas.
  • Är lösningsorienterad, prestigelös och gillar att jobba i team.
  • Du har goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska.

Du är en rutinerad kock med flerårig yrkesvana av både à la carte och lunch. Rekrytering sker löpande och kan komma att avslutas före sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi söker nu dig som är intresserad av

  • Heltidanställning
  • Extra anställning för dig som vill jobba extra timmar för julbord, event, högsäsong etc.

Förmåner

Som anställd på Billingehus får du en rad förmåner i form av friskvårdsbidrag, rabatter och tillgång till gym och spa i mån av plats. Du får arbeta i en utvecklande miljö och har en trygg anställning då företaget är anslutet till Visita och har kollektivavtal med Unionen och HRF.

LOTUS HOTEL GROUP

Billingehus är en del av Lotus Hotel Group – en hotellfamilj där vi skapar fantastiska upplevelser för våra gäster. Våra hotell bjuder på fyra unika destinationer – Varbergs Stadshotell & Asia Spa, Arken Hotel & Art Garden Spa, Hôtel Eggers & Billingehus – men gemensamt är vår passion. Vi brinner för att skapa upplevelser utöver det vanliga och att få gästen att längta till nästa gång. Vi verkar i lokalt starka, historiska och spännande miljöer. Här finner du miljöer för avkoppling, god mat och dryck, evenemang, konferens och spännande möten – platser där vardagen alltid känns avlägsen.

Genom vårt eget gästserviceprogram Proud with Passion, arbetar vi med passion och yrkesstolthet för att tillsammans leverera bästa kvalité. Vi är även stolta över att vi inspirerar, tar ansvar och aktivt bidrar till ett hållbart och bättre samhälle. Bland annat genom att årligen utmana oss själva med ökade hållbarhetskrav, Svanen-märkningar och egna vindkraftsverk.

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Tuntiopettaja (EN,RU), Niemenrannan koulu
description:
Haettavana on TUNTIOPETTAJAN määräaikainen virkasuhteinen tehtävä Niemenrannan koulussa ajalle 5.10.2026 - 5.6.2027. Opetettavina aineina englanti ja ruotsi. Työsuhteen alkaessa englannin kielen opetusta on 23 h/vko ja ruotsin kielen opetusta 2 h/vko.

Koulussamme on kaksi yksikköä ja tämä tehtävä sijoittuu Niemenrannan yksikköön. Niemenranta on pääosin kolmisarjainen alakoulu ja opetettavia tunteja (en ja ru) on 3.-6. luokille. Niemenrannassa on lisäksi lehtori (eng ja ru). Kielten opettajat tekevät yhteistyötä keskenään, luokanopettajien ja erityisopettajien kanssa.

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/1998 mukaisesti. Kelpoisuuden osoittavat alkuperäiset tutkintotodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen opetusalan virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen valinnan vahvistamista, viimeistään 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista, esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) 3 §:n mukainen rikostaustaote. Tehtävässä käytetään koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55 A. Hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/10906/2026 sekä lähetyskuoressa haettavana olevan viran nimi. Haettaessa useampia virkoja on jokaiseen virkaan toimitettava oma hakemus. Hakemus on toimitettava 31.8.2026 klo 16.15 mennessä.

title: Senior Risk Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Risk Engineer to join our growing Risk Engineering team within Risk & Analytics, based in Sydney, Australia.

Working as part of WTW's Risk Engineering practice, you will help clients manage complex property risks while contributing to the continued growth of our business across the Pacific.

This role provides the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of industrial, manufacturing, logistics, commercial property, infrastructure, construction and renewable energy clients, delivering practical engineering advice and technical risk assessments that help organisations better understand, manage and reduce property risks.

You will lead property risk engineering engagements, developing technical reports, property loss estimates and risk improvement recommendations, while becoming a trusted technical adviser to clients, insurers and brokers. Combining engineering expertise with practical, commercially balanced advice, you will help clients make informed risk management and underwriting decisions.

Joining a team recognised for its technical expertise, collaborative approach and strong client relationships, you will collaborate with colleagues across Risk & Analytics, Broking and WTW's broader network to deliver integrated solutions for complex client challenges.

As our Risk Engineering practice continues to grow, you will play an important role in strengthening our technical practice, mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the ongoing development of our business across the Pacific.

The Role

  • Lead property risk engineering engagements across a diverse portfolio of industrial, manufacturing, logistics, commercial property, infrastructure, construction and renewable energy clients throughout Australia and the Pacific.
  • Conduct property risk engineering surveys and prepare high-quality technical reports, property loss estimates and practical risk improvement recommendations in accordance with WTW methodologies.
  • Assess property loss exposures, including fire, natural hazards, business interruption and equipment-related risks, providing practical engineering solutions that support risk management and underwriting decisions.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients, brokers and insurers through professional delivery, technical expertise and commercially balanced engineering advice.
  • Mentor and support junior engineers, contributing to their technical development while fostering a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to technical quality assurance by reviewing work, sharing best practice and maintaining the high standards of WTW's Risk Engineering practice.
  • Support business development activities, including client meetings, proposals, presentations and tender responses, while identifying opportunities to strengthen client relationships and grow the business.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Risk & Analytics, Broking and WTW's broader network to deliver integrated client solutions and contribute to regional initiatives across the Pacific.

The Requirement

We are looking for an experienced property risk engineer with strong technical capability, commercial judgement and the ability to build trusted client relationships. You will be passionate about delivering practical engineering solutions, mentoring others and contributing to the continued growth of a high-performing technical practice.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • A degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience in property risk engineering, fire protection engineering, loss prevention or a related engineering field.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial property risks, fire protection systems and property loss prevention principles.
  • Experience conducting property risk engineering surveys and preparing high-quality technical reports, property loss estimates and risk improvement recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with clients, brokers, insurers and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to a range of stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of junior engineers or technical professionals is highly regarded.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple client engagements.
  • Willingness to undertake regular domestic travel, with occasional international travel where required.

Why Join Us?

  • Join a growing Risk Engineering team at an exciting stage of its evolution, where you'll have the opportunity to influence our technical practice, mentor the next generation of engineers and work on diverse and technically challenging property risk engagements across the Pacific.
  • Be part of one of the world's leading risk advisory businesses, working alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about technical excellence and delivering outstanding client outcomes.
  • Lead diverse and technically challenging engagements across industrial, manufacturing, logistics, commercial property, infrastructure, construction and renewable energy sectors.
  • Collaborate with experienced specialists across Risk & Analytics, Broking and WTW's international network to deliver integrated solutions for clients.
  • Build long-term relationships with leading organisations while delivering practical engineering solutions that make a meaningful difference to their resilience and risk profile.
  • Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive and supportive culture that values innovation, continuous learning and professional development.
  • Benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing professional development and opportunities to contribute to the continued growth of our Pacific Risk Engineering practice.

At WTW, we believe that a culture of inclusion and diversity is critical to our business. It's not a separate initiative – rather it’s fundamental to everything we do. We are an equal-opportunity employer who is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and embrace diversity including gender, nationality, disability, age, marital/parental status, ethnicity, gender identity and sexual orientation. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds.

In the spirit of reconciliation Willis Towers Watson acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their Elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidate.helpdesk@willistowerswatson.com

title: Lead Compliance Engineer
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
  • Own environmental compliance for existing and new products, ensuring adherence to global regulations including RoHS, REACH (SVHC), SCIP, WEEE, TSCA, Prop 65, Battery, Packaging, and other applicable requirements.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory changes and translate them into actionable plans for Engineering, Sourcing, and Component Engineering teams.
  • Lead supplier compliance activities, including collection, validation, and maintenance of material declarations, RoHS/REACH declarations, CMRTs, battery and packaging data, and full material disclosures.
  • Drive transition plans for non-compliant components, proactively managing RoHS exemption expirations and qualification of compliant alternatives.
  • Review ECOs and product BOMs for environmental compliance risks, hazardous substances, and regulatory gaps.
  • Oversee compliance data management activities, including declaration uploads, compliance dashboards, and data quality governance.
  • Lead external regulatory submissions and customer environmental reporting, including SCIP, WEEE, Battery, TSCA, China RoHS, and related requirements.
  • Manage CE marking compliance activities, ensuring applicable EU directives and regulations are identified, assessed, documented, and maintained throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, test laboratories, and regulatory teams to support conformity assessments, technical documentation, and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
  • Work closely with third-party compliance service providers to ensure compliance data remains accurate and current.
  • Prepare and present periodic compliance status updates, compliance risks, exemption timelines, and regulatory readiness plans to senior leadership.
  • Represent the business in corporate compliance forums and drive implementation of regulatory, process, and system updates.

Who You Are:
  • A proactive leader who can effectively manage complex global compliance requirements across multiple product families.
  • A strong collaborator who works seamlessly with Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Product Management, and Corporate stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for regulatory compliance, data accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • An effective communicator capable of translating complex regulations into clear business actions and executive-level updates.

For This Role, You Will Need:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • 8-12 years of experience in environmental compliance, component engineering, product stewardship, or a related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of RoHS, REACH, SCIP, WEEE, TSCA, Prop 65, Battery, Packaging, and other global environmental regulations.
  • Working knowledge of CE marking requirements, applicable EU directives/regulations, conformity assessment processes, technical documentation, and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
  • Experience reviewing material declarations, identifying compliance risks, and driving supplier compliance activities.
  • Experience managing exemption expiry reviews and driving corrective actions to ensure continued product compliance.
  • Familiarity with BOM-level compliance assessments, material compliance tools, and compliance management databases.
  • Experience leading regulatory submissions, customer declarations, and environmental reporting activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate globally distributed teams.
  • Strong analytical, project management, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
  • Experience in the electronics, industrial automation, instrumentation, or embedded systems industry.
  • Knowledge of emerging regulations such as PFAS, UK REACH, China RoHS, and evolving sustainability requirements.
  • Experience with CMAP, Agile PLM, SiliconExpert, or similar compliance and lifecycle management tools.
  • Familiarity with CMRT, IPC-1752, IEC 62474, and material disclosure standards.
  • Experience managing CE marking programs and supporting compliance with applicable directives such as EMC, Low Voltage, RoHS, and related product regulations.
  • Familiarity with technical file preparation, conformity assessment processes, and interactions with testing and certification bodies.
  • Experience presenting compliance strategies, risks, and regulatory road maps to senior leadership.
  • Proven success in driving compliance improvements and regulatory readiness across a global product portfolio.

Our Culture & Commitment to You:
  • At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  • We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, an Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation, and holiday leave.

title: Isännöitsijä
description:
TEKNINEN ISÄNNÖITSIJÄ, KEMIJÄRVI

Haluatko nähdä oman työsi jäljen?

Kontio Isännöinti Oy etsii teknistä isännöitsijää vahvistamaan tiimiään Kemijärvelle. Jos pidät käytännön ongelmien ratkaisemisesta, haluat tehdä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen vaikutus taloyhtiöiden arkeen, ja arvostat työpaikkaa, jossa päätöksiä ei tarvitse odottaa viikkokausia, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan, ottamaan vastuuta ja viemään asioita aidosti maaliin. Työsuhde on vakituinen, kokoaikainen ja siihen sovelletaan Kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöitä koskevaa työehtosopimusta. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan — paikka täytetään sopivan hakijan löydyttyä, joten kannattaa hakea pikaisesti.

*** Haemme ensisijaisesti teknistä isännöitsijää. Jos isännöinnin osaamisesi on vahvaa, mutta tekninen puoli on vielä kehittymässä - kannustamme hakemaan siitä huolimatta. ***

Mitä pääset tekemään? Työsi koostuu monipuolisista teknisen isännöinnin tehtävistä, kuten

  • taloyhtiöiden huolto-, korjaus- ja kunnossapitotarpeiden koordinoinnista

  • urakoiden valmistelusta, kilpailuttamisesta ja toteutuksen valvonnasta

  • teknisiin tarkastuksiin ja kuntokartoituksiin osallistumisesta

  • yhteistyöstä taloyhtiöiden hallitusten, osakkaiden, asukkaiden ja urakoitsijoiden kanssa

  • teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta ja viestinnästä

  • osallistumisesta tarvittaessa yhtiö- ja hallituskokouksiin

Työssä käytät nykyaikaisia digitaalisia työkaluja sekä Confirma Disponent -isännöintijärjestelmää

Toivomme sinulta Sinulla ei tarvitse olla juuri tietynlaista taustaa, mutta uskomme, että tehtävässä onnistumista tukevat esimerkiksi

  • tekninen ymmärrys kiinteistöjen ylläpidosta tai rakennustekniikasta

  • soveltuva tekninen tai kaupallinen koulutus

  • hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot

  • oma-aloitteinen, järjestelmällinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote

  • kyky pitää useampi asia hallinnassa samanaikaisesti

  • hyvät digitaidot ja Microsoft 365 -ympäristön sujuva käyttö

  • kyky toimia rauhallisesti myös kiireellisissä ja muuttuvissa tilanteissa

Eduksi katsomme

  • aiemman kokemuksen isännöinnistä tai kiinteistöalalta

  • IAT-tutkinnon tai halun suorittaa se myöhemmin

Miksi meille?

title: Engineer 2, Quality Engineering
description:
Engineer 2, Quality Engineering

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew, we craft and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

The Quality Engineer is responsible for supporting engineering projects and ensuring the quality, reliability, and continuous improvement of products and manufacturing processes. The role applies quality engineering principles, risk management, and problem-solving techniques throughout the product lifecycle to maintain compliance and drive operational excellence.

The position also reviews and approves Device History Records (DHR) for product shipment, investigates non-conformances and customer complaints, and supports root cause analysis and corrective actions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the engineer helps improve process capability and product quality while supporting day-to-day manufacturing operations.

In addition, the role promotes compliance with Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), Sustainability, and Energy policies. This includes preventing workplace injuries, environmental incidents, and energy wastage, as well as reporting HSE incidents and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

What will you be doing?
Business Improvements

Supports continuous improvement initiatives by applying quality tools such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and PDCA to enhance product quality, process efficiency, and cost effectiveness. Also benchmarks best practices and develops quality engineering capabilities to support business growth.

Compliance / Regulatory

Ensures products and manufacturing processes comply with global regulatory requirements and quality standards. Supports audits, conducts production line assessments, and drives corrective and preventive actions to maintain compliance.

New Product / Process Introduction

Works closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to support new product introductions and design transfers, ensuring appropriate design controls, risk management, and product quality requirements are met.

Product Quality, Control & Disposition

Leads material review activities and manages non-conformances, CAPAs, and customer complaints. Responsible for root cause investigations, quality metrics, defect management, and maintaining Device History Records (DHR) to ensure product quality and compliance.

Product / Process Qualification

Supports process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, PQ, TMV, and software validation. Develops control plans, sampling plans, measurement systems, and process monitoring methods to ensure process capability and product quality.

Risk Mitigation

Evaluates process changes and quality risks to prevent non-compliance and product failures. Applies risk management principles to assess controls, implement mitigation measures, and ensure ongoing product safety and quality.

Strategic

Develops and supports quality strategies for product, process, and test method validation. Participates in strategic initiatives and special projects assigned by management to support business objectives and continuous improvement efforts.

What will you need to be successful?

  • The Quality Engineer is responsible for leading sustaining quality activities and supporting new product transfers by ensuring manufacturing processes are capable, compliant, and deliver consistent product quality. The role focuses on process validation, risk management, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement while supporting production and meeting customer quality expectations.

  • The ideal candidate should hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field, with experience in manufacturing and regulated environments such as FDA and European standards. Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, statistics, risk management, process validation, and GMP/ISO requirements is essential, along with proven problem-solving, project leadership, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

description:
Company Description

Unimedia Technology is a dynamic technology consultancy based in Castelldefels, near Barcelona, at the Mediterranean Technology Park (PMT), a vibrant hub of innovation. What We Offer

  • Mentorship and learning opportunities from a skilled data and engineering team.
  • Exposure to major European clients and large-scale data workflows.
  • Trainee / Junior salary: €18,000 gross per year (full-time)

description:

Marsh

Description:

Marsh India Knowledge Service is seeking a skilled professional to join our Property Risk Consulting team, based in Mumbai or Gurugram. This hybrid role requires a minimum of three days per week working onsite / in the office.

As a part of the Marsh Risk Consulting team in Knowledge Services function, we are seeking a professional to support a broad spectrum of projects for the Property Risk Consulting, Pacific team. The selected candidate would help in identification, quantification and management of property / physical assets related risks.

The services offered by this practice are focused on risk engineering / risk management, including the use of property / infrastructure engineering fundamentals and natural catastrophe loss modelling analysis to support risk analysis and risk action planning activities.

We will count on you to:

  • Manage administrative follow-up on Opportunities for Improvement (OFIs) by coordinating with clients to monitor progress at individual sites.

  • Identify and address team development needs by compiling training materials, facilitating knowledge sharing, conducting research by preparing summary reports, and enhancing resources with visual aids.

  • Strictly adhere to all established Property Risk Consulting standard operating procedures to maintain compliance, quality assurance, and operational excellence throughout all consulting activities.

What you need to have:

  • A graduate with a degree in Engineering (e.g. Structural, Mechanical, Chemical, Fire) or related discipline.

  • 4-6 years of experience working within a risk and/or insurance environment.

  • Exposure in managing/coordinating in Property Risk Consulting projects/activities.

What makes you stand out?

  • Prior experience in the property risk and/or insurance environment is desirable.

  • Knowledge of NFPA and FM standards.

  • Knowledge of, or prior experience, in Natural Catastrophe Loss Modelling.

  • Commitment to providing high-level client service.

  • Ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Medium to Advanced technical property risk expertise, including conducting inspections, performing research, and preparing detailed reports.

  • Excellent time management capabilities to prioritise tasks and ensure timely project completion.

  • Proven interpersonal and stakeholder management skills to foster collaborative working relationships.

  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • High levels of enthusiasm and self-motivation to drive continuous improvement and achieve objectives.

Why join our team:

  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact on colleagues, clients and communities.

title: Vanhempi harjoitusmestari, Pelastuskoulu
description:
Tule osaksi Helsingin Pelastuskoulun huippuosaavaa tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja töitä tehdään hyvällä sykkeellä sekä ammattitaitoisella otteella. Etsimme nyt vanhempaa harjoitusmestaria määräaikaiseen virkaan (14.9.2026-31.12.2027) pelastajatutkintokoulutukseen. Työn aloitusajankohta on sovittavissa.

Työ tarjoaa monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan pedagogisen tehtäväkentän pelastajakoulutuksen ytimessä. Vanhempana harjoitusmestarina vastaat opetuksen suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, arvioinnista ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä sekä opiskelijoiden ohjauksesta heidän oppimisensa eri vaiheissa. Pääset osallistumaan syksyllä 2027 alkavien pelastajakurssien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen sekä kehittämään pelastajakoulutusta yhteistyössä työelämän kanssa, jotta koulutus vastaa alan nykyisiin ja tulevaisuuden osaamistarpeisiin.

Vanhempi harjoitusmestari toimii arvostettuna tiimin jäsenenä. Teet töitä yhdessä osaavien kollegoiden ja moniammatillisen henkilöstön kanssa sekä huolehdit opiskelijoiden oppimispoluista ja tuet heidän kehittymistään kohti pelastajan ammattia.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia sekä suunnitella ja organisoida työskentelyä sujuvasti.
Innostunutta, positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta.
Erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja, asiakaslähtöisyyttä ja tiimipelisilmää.
Kokemusta kouluttamisesta ja pelastusalan käytännön osaamista.

Aikaisempi kouluttajakokemus, monipuolinen pelastusalan osaaminen ja työkokemus ovat merkittäviä vahvuuksia tässä tehtävässä. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden tuoda esiin omia ideoitasi - arvostamme innovatiivisuutta erityisesti oppimisympäristöjen ja opetuksen kehittämisessä.

Miksi meille?
Pekolaisuus merkitsee innostavaa työyhteisöä, jossa inhimillisyys, huumorintaju ja vahva ammattiosaaminen kulkevat käsi kädessä.

Helsingin Pelastuskoulu on pieni ja yhteisöllinen oppilaitos, jossa opettajien, kouluttajien ja opiskelijoiden yhteistyö on tiivistä ja lämminhenkistä. Meillä on hyvät edellytykset huomioida opiskelijoiden yksilölliset tarpeet, ja koko henkilöstö on sitoutunut yhteiseen päämäärään: tukea opiskelijoita kannustavassa ja monipuolisessa oppimisympäristössä kohti pelastajan ammattia.

Uudelle työntekijälle tarjoamme huolellisen perehdytyksen tehtävään ja toimintaympäristöömme.

Helsingin kaupungin työntekijänä pääset lisäksi hyödyntämään kaupungin laajat henkilöstöedut - Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden sisältäen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Etua voi saada korkeintaan 550 euroa kalenterivuodelta. Lisäksi käytettävissäsi on lounasetu sekä kaupunkipyörä. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea vuokra-asuntoa Auroranlinnalta, jonka asunnot ovat markkinatasoa edullisempia ja työntekijöidemme asuntohakemukset etusijalla.

Hakemusten perusteella kutsumme osan hakijoista haastatteluihin. Järjestämme haastattelut torstaina 3.9. Pelastuskoulussa osoitteessa Tyynenmerenkatu 1, 00220 Helsinki.


Kelpoisuusehto:

Viran kelpoisuusehtona on pelastusalan alipäällystö- tai päällystötutkinto sekä laaja työkokemus ja perehtyneisyys pelastusalaan yleensä sekä pelastajan ammatin perusteellinen tuntemus. Lisäksi edellytetään savusukelluskelpoisuus koulutustehtäviin.

Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen hyvää suullista sekä kirjallista taitoa, tiimityötaitoja, innostunutta ja joustavaa työotetta sekä digiosaamista.

Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään hänen suostumuksellaan henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Tehtävään valitseminen edellyttää, että henkilöturvallisuusselvityksessä ei ilmene estettä. Lisätietoja menettelystä löytyy osoitteesta www.supo.fi/turvallisuusselvitykset.

Luemme eduksi:
suoritetut ammatillisen opettajan pedagogiset opinnot,
tietoteknisen osaamisen sekä keskeisten sovellusten hallinnan (MS365: Word, PP, Excel, Teams, Outlook sekä Wilma -järjestelmä),
Moodle -oppimisympäristön käyttökokemuksen ja
ruotsinkielen taidon.

title: Project Coordinator- Research and Insights
description:
Project Coordinator- Research and Insights

<br>

Job Description

<br>

Job Summary

As a Project Coordinator for the Research and Insights team, you will play a key role in supporting the delivery, coordination and amplification of insight-led initiatives across the Insights team.

Reporting to the Insights Director and sitting within Marketing, you will support research, analytics and thought leadership activities spanning Residential Economics, Customer Insights and Commercial Real Estate (CRE). You will act as a central point of coordination across projects, stakeholders, events and business requests, helping ensure insights are delivered efficiently and translated into value for customers, clients, media and internal teams.

This role combines project coordination, stakeholder management and operational support, while providing exposure to a broad range of research and analytics activities across the business.

Responsibilities:

Research & Insights Coordination

  • Coordinate the delivery of research, analytics and insight projects across Residential Economics, Customer Insights and Commercial Real Estate.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones and stakeholder communications to support successful delivery of initiatives.
  • Manage incoming requests for data, research and insights from internal stakeholders and external audiences.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of reports, presentations, briefing materials, visualisations and other insight outputs.
  • Track and report on the impact of research and insight activities, including media outcomes, content engagement, marketing performance and stakeholder utilisation.
  • Maintain documentation, processes and systems that improve visibility, efficiency and coordination across the Insights team.

Stakeholder & Business Support

  • Act as a central point of coordination between Insights, Marketing, PR, Content, Sales, Product and Commercial teams.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration across stakeholders to ensure projects remain aligned and on schedule.
  • Support ad hoc insight, research and data requests from internal teams, customers, clients and media.
  • Coordinate stakeholder meetings, project updates and follow-up actions.

Events, Thought Leadership & Communications

  • Support the planning and delivery of conferences, webinars, client events and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Coordinate schedules, logistics and briefing materials for Insights team spokespeople.
  • Assist with the preparation of presentations, speaking engagements, customer meetings and industry events.
  • Work with Marketing, PR and Content teams to maximise the reach and impact of insight-led campaigns and initiatives.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, project management practices and stakeholder engagement.
  • Support the adoption of new tools, reporting frameworks and workflows that enhance team effectiveness.

About You

  • Degree qualified in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Sciences or a related field.
  • Highly organised with strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines and competing priorities.
  • Curious, proactive and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in research, data and insights.
  • Confident working across a broad range of stakeholders and business functions.
  • Strong Microsoft Office and presentation skills, with experience preparing reports and presentations.
  • Passionate about helping teams turn insights into meaningful business outcomes.

About Domain, part of the CoStar Group

Domain is one of Australia's most trusted and loved property brands, helping millions of Australians find their dream home and stay informed about the property market. Now, Domain has joined forces with CoStar Group, a global leader in real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces to take the next big leap in property technology and data innovation.

As part of CoStar Group, an S&P 500 company with more than 35 years of experience transforming how people understand and transact real estate, Domain is entering an exciting new era of growth. CoStar is investing heavily in new products, technology, and people to revolutionise how Australians access property data, insights, and marketplaces.
