title: Campus Graduate Masters Summer Internship Program - 2027 Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services- New York, NY
description:
Business Unit/Role Specific Information

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.


At American Express, we empower future technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll join a 10-week Summer Internship Program and contribute to real-world technology projects that support seamless customer and colleague experiences. You’ll build software, collaborate with Agile teams, and learn how products are designed, developed, tested, and delivered in a global enterprise environment. These skills will give you the tools to accelerate in your studies and future career!


Enterprise Technology Services teams build and operate technology that helps American Express deliver trusted, secure, and customer first products and services. Interns may be aligned to scrum teams across backend engineering, frontend engineering, cloud engineering, mobile, AI/machine learning, data oriented engineering,
or full-stack product development. The role family is Software Engineering which means designing, coding, testing, and improving applications and services that help customers, colleagues, and partners get work done reliably and securely.

Responsibilities & What Type of Work to Expect?
• Discover and apply new technologies to solve real-world business challenges.
• Contribute to an Agile scrum team by developing, testing, and improving software applications.
• Write clean, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and create unit tests with coaching from experienced engineers.
• Explore and experiment with emerging AI-powered developer tools, automation capabilities, and machine learning concepts while learning how to build software responsibly, securely, and at enterprise scale.
• Partner with Product Managers, Senior Engineers, Quality Engineers, and Architects to understand requirements, prioritize features, and deliver value.
• Build confidence working across different parts of the technology stack, such as APIs, services, microservices, user interfaces, mobile experiences, cloud platforms, or data driven solutions.
• Participate in social events, community service opportunities, learning sessions, and collaborative initiatives with fellow interns.


What You’ll Learn
• How software is built and delivered “the Amex Way,” including structured onboarding, developer bootcamp concepts, code quality, testing, and secure engineering practices.
• How Product, Engineering, Quality, Security, and business partners collaborate from idea to production.
• How to translate customer or business needs into technical solutions while balancing quality, resilience, usability, and risk.
• How to communicate progress, ask effective questions, and share technical work with both technical and non-technical partners.
• How to grow your career through mentorship, feedback, community, and continuous learning.

Minimum Qualifications
• Currently enrolled in a full-time graduate master's degree program
• Graduate master's degree candidates with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
• Demonstrated experience through coursework, projects, research, or extracurricular activities using one or more programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, C#, Go, Kotlin, or similar technologies.
• Foundational understanding of computer science concepts including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, and problem solving.
• Interest in building software applications across web, mobile, backend, cloud, API, or full-stack environments.
• Familiarity with modern software development practices such as version control, testing, code reviews, Agile methodologies, and collaborative development workflows.
• Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, intelligent automation, and AI-powered developer tools.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills with the ability to learn quickly, seek feedback, and work effectively in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Preferred Qualifications
• A curious, collaborative problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies and applying them to practical challenges.
• Understanding and experience leveraging AI powered development tools, generative AI, intelligent automation, responsible AI, and machine learning fundamentals.
• Ability to collaborate with Product, Engineering, Quality, Security, and business partners from idea through delivery.
• Ability to translate customer or business needs into technical solutions while balancing quality, resilience, usability, and risk.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to share progress, ask effective questions, and explain technical work to technical and non-technical partners.
• A student who has built and programmed software through academic, personal, internship, open-source, hackathon, or project-based experiences.
• Someone who communicates clearly, welcomes feedback, and brings an inclusive, customer first mindset to team environments.

Technology Areas for Software Engineers
American Express Software Engineering Interns may be aligned to different technology teams based on business needs, project requirements, and individual strengths.


Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:


• Back-End Engineering: Java, Python, Golang, APIs, microservices, Big Data, or Data Engineering concepts.
• Front-End Engineering: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, accessibility, and user experience principles.
• Cloud Engineering: Java, Python, cloud-native development, microservices, CI/CD, containerization, and DevOps practices.
• Site Reliability Engineer: Knowledge of observability tools and methodologies, including experience with logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance analysis platforms
• AI & Machine Learning Engineering: Java, Python, machine learning fundamentals, AI powered development tools, agentic workflows, AI agents, data processing, automation, and responsible AI concepts.
• Mobile Engineering: Swift, Kotlin, API integration, mobile testing frameworks, mobile architecture, and UI/UX fundamentals.
• Core Skills Across All Areas: Strong problem-solving abilities, computer science fundamentals, communication and collaboration skills, experience working in team environments, and curiosity for emerging technologies including Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.


Our team reviews applications on a rolling basis. We appreciate your patience while we consider your application and we will contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.


Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

description:
Disclosure (Remove if Not Applicable)

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Project Manager/Site Lead to support the Department of the Interior (DOI) Bureau of Trust Funds Administration’s (BTFA) at the American Indian Records Repository (AIRR) in Lenexa, KS. This role oversees daily operations, staff assignments, and workflow related to digitization support services, including project management, document preparation, digitization, quality control, and reassembly management. The PM/Site Lead ensures that all work aligns with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), BTFA policies, and records management requirements.


Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

• Lead and coordinate contractor staff performing digitization support functions across AIRR and BTFA sites.
• Work directly with the DCE Supervisor to prioritize and balance day-to-day and special project workloads.
• Oversee project management tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion of digitization services.
• Ensure team adherence to SOPs for document preparation, reassembly, digitization, and quality control.
• Assist in coordinating staffing assignments among preparation, digitization, quality control, and reassembly activities.
• Maintain compliance with National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) and DOI records policies.
• Support communication between contractor staff and BTFA personnel; provide reporting and performance updates.


Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• Five years of relevant experience in document preparation, digitization operations, quality control, and reassembly management.

• Knowledge of NARA records policies and federal records management guidelines.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Public Trust adjudication and a PIV card.

• Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport to undergo commercial airfare travel

• Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license


Working Environment

This position primarily operates in a professional office setting with standard office equipment and a quiet, climate-controlled environment. While in the office, there is no regular exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery.


This role also requires periodic travel to project sites, including locations undergoing renovation or active construction. During site visits, the employee may be exposed to non-temperature-controlled environments, construction noise, dust, and other typical conditions found on job sites. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required during these visits, depending on site conditions. While on site visits, an individual in this role will be required to work atypical hours at the request of the client or role demands.


Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This is not a sedentary role. This role requires the ability to be on your feet moving around a construction site for most of the day interacting with contractors, contractor representatives, and inspecting the construction work that is being performed.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about outside in various geographic and building terrains to access a construction site to provide quality assurance services.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: This role requires stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and ladder climbing to inspect all aspects of building construction to foundations, crawlspaces, and roofs.

Using Hands/Fingers: This role constantly operates technological office equipment such as laptop, mouse, keyboard, computer monitors, telephones, and scanners, copiers, and fax machines.

Talking/Hearing: This role requires constant communication with others in the organization to exchange information, review information, and make decisions about information.

Seeing: This role requires the ability to see, view, and distinguish all aspects of construction to ensure quality control.

Carrying/Lifting: This role requires lifting up to 30 lbs to transport technological office equipment, safety equipment, and other needed construction items to and from various workspaces.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.


Bodwé Group Companies engage in federal contracting. Therefore, we would be thrilled to accept applications or referrals to hire veterans.

Native American Hiring Preference

Our parent company, Mno-Bmadsen, prefers to hire Pokagon citizens who are qualified and suitable for available positions. For purposes of this section, “qualified” means that the applicant meets the technical and experiential needs for employment; and “suitable” means that the candidate appears to be the best fit considering present circumstances and conditions. Targeted preference is in the following order:


  • First, to qualified Pokagon Band citizens; and
  • Second, to qualified spouses and qualified custodial parents; and
  • Third, to other qualified Native Americans; and
  • Fourth, to all other qualified applicants


Any determinations as to the applicability of the Pokagon hiring preference are at the discretion of each Company President.


Home Office Connectivity Requirements for Hybrid & Remote Positions

To ensure reliable collaboration, client service, and secure access to company systems, the Company requires minimum connectivity standards to be eligible or remain eligible to work in a hybrid or remote capacity. Employees working remotely must maintain broadband internet service capable of consistently supporting video conferencing, VPN connectivity, and cloud-based applications. Hybrid or remote work eligibility may be reassessed if connectivity standards are not met. This includes:

Cellular hotspot or fixed wireless cellular services (e.g., T-Mobile Home Internet) may not be used as a primary connection. title: Project Manager
description:
Opus Magnum is a design-led, employee-owned manufacturer of bespoke contract furniture based in Wandsworth. We work with leading architects, designers, corporate clients and institutions across the UK, delivering high-quality furniture that combines creative design with precision making. We are a business with a strong reputation, a skilled and committed team, and real ambition for what comes next.

We're looking for a Project Manager to take ownership of projects from quotation through to delivery, working closely with both our outreach and design teams to ensure every client gets the best possible solution.

The role

This is a genuinely varied position. You'll be closely involved in the technical quoting and proposal process, working directly with our director team to price projects. You'll coordinate the project through design development, out to site, and through to handover, staying close to the client relationship the whole way.

You'll work hand in hand with the Outreach team on client-facing matters such as material and sample sign-off, and with the design team to make sure drawings and technical requirements are properly understood and followed through.

What you'll be doing

Preparing quotations and solutions using our in house developed quoting system and presenting clear proposals to clients. Attending briefing meetings with the Outreach team to understand project scope, budget and programme. Working closely with the design team through the design development stage, coordinating manufacturing drawings and ensuring technical requirements are properly understood. Supporting the outreach team with client liaison, including sign-off on materials and samples. Visiting sites to confirm access and requirements and attending client and contractor meetings. Recording and agreeing any variations with the client. Managing Day 2 requirements and any remedial work.

What we're looking for

Experience in estimating, quoting or project management within the bespoke or contract furniture industry, or a related manufacturing environment. Confidence preparing quotations and proposal documents and liaising with all parties involved in bringing a project together. A working knowledge of manufacturing drawings and a strong eye for detail and good design, alongside a solid commercial outlook. Excellent organisational skills and the flexibility to manage several projects at once. A clear, confident communicator, comfortable working with clients, designers and all project stakeholders alike.

What we offer

A collaborative, employee-owned business with real craftsmanship at its core. The opportunity to see projects through from quotation to completion, with genuine ownership along the way. Competitive salary, pension, EOT bonus scheme, and 23 days holiday plus Bank holidays.

The role is based at our Wandsworth workshop and offices. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Opus Magnum is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Health & Safety Consultant
description:
What if you could shape built and natural environments, and the future of those that use them?

With us, you can.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Health & Safety Consultant to join our team and contribute to our Perth-based and national projects.

You'll assist clients in navigating the contemporary health and safety landscape, adapting to evolving work and organisational settings, and achieving positive outcomes for frontline teams, organizations, stakeholders, and the community.

You will support clients in diverse industries through a range of HSE consulting activities, including, but not limited to:

  • Contractor management assurance activities (both onsite and desktop) in construction, renewable energy, government & non-government and other high risk industry settings
  • Management system evaluation, design, decluttering and implementation support aligned with WHS legislative and recognised best practice standards (ISO 45001, ISO 45003, ISO 14001, ISO 9001)
  • Applying contemporary WHS management approaches to diverse industry and operational settings
  • Support our construction and geotechnical field work supervisors in providing periodic onsite health and safety support and advice in meeting legislative and client obligations.
  • Technical WHS advisory and consulting support

We work hybrid which means you will have the opportunity to work between our Perth office and from home for up to two days per week when not required at site, ensuring a healthy work-life balance.

What you’ll do

  • Contribute to a thriving team culture dedicated to deliver technical excellence and positive client outcomes
  • Conduct desktop and onsite contractor assurance reviews to support our clients in their desired approach to contractor safety management
  • Evaluate HSE plans, systems, onsite arrangements across a range of contexts and industry settings (such as construction, renewable energy, government, manufacturing, insurance, defence and more)
  • Provide in-field safety and project support for our Principal Contractor construction activities (predominantly geotechnical site investigations and contaminated land remediation)
  • Work with diverse range of HSE consultants and partners to explore and deliver contemporary health and safety consulting and compliance solutions.

About you

You are likely to have 3+ years of experience in the health and safety consultant profession, and looking to make a positive impact to health and safety for front line workers and communities.

You will ideally bring the following:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risks and propose effective solutions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with stakeholders across all organisational levels
  • Prior experience in performing onsite inspections and audits (ISO 45001, ISO 14001 Lead Auditor certification would be highly advantageous)
  • Experience advising on contemporary approaches to H&S management, including psycho-social risk management
  • Understanding or willingness to develop understanding of consulting and project lifecycles, and proactively building client relationships while upholding high service delivery standards especially for government clients.
  • Australian Driver's License
  • Tertiary qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a Cert IV in WHS as a minimum.

The role will require the ability to travel for short periods and at times after-hours work (not extensive and suitably remunerated) where required for specific projects.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 73,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

An employee Share Purchase Plan is available to all our permanent employees who wish to become owners and vested partners in WSP’s collective success. To find out more about our commitment to the health and wellbeing of our people, and the programs we’ve designed to help you thrive, go to our Employee Benefits page.

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

title: Chief Information Officer – Telge och Södertälje kommun
description:
Välj Telge – här får du kombinera affärsmässighet med samhällsnytta och som medarbetare får du frihet under ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.

Så här säger Karin Medin, rekryterande chef, om rollen:

"Är du en visionär ledare som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan komplexa organisationer och modern teknisk innovation? Nu söker vi en strategisk CIO till vår gemensamma IT-funktion, DigIT. I rollen leder du den digitala utvecklingen för både Telgebolagen och Södertälje kommun. Det här är en unik möjlighet för dig som vill driva digital transformation, stärka en gemensam IT-kultur och skapa samhällsnytta. Du får en central roll när vi tillsammans tar nästa steg mot en ny nivå av säker och framtidsinriktad digital verksamhet."

Uppdrag och kompetenskrav

Som CIO verkar du i en miljö präglad av både affärsmässighet och offentlig förvaltning. Rollen kräver en diplomatisk men orädd ledare som kan navigera mellan nio bolag och sju kommunala kontor. Du bygger förtoendefulla relationer med bolagsledningar, kontorschefer, medarbetare och externa partners för att skapa samsyn kring gemensamma mål och prioriteringar. Du arbetar nära koncernchef och stadsdirektören med ett brett mandat att etablera en gemensam portföljstyrning.

Din vardag innebär att översätta tekniska möjligheter, såsom AI och avancerad dataanalys, till konkret affärsnytta, samtidigt som du säkerställer regelefterlevnad inom ett säkerhetskänsligt område. Du blir en nyckelperson i att harmonisera vår "One IT"-kultur och i att skapa en infrastruktur som stöder en framåtlutad organisation.

Telgekoncernen och Södertälje kommun har en omfattande IT-miljö med cirka 8 000 användare. Det ställer höga krav på oss som organisation och är en viktig del av vår digitalisering. Vi samarbetar med kollegor från alla hörn av vår stora organisation.

I rollen som CIO ansvarar du för att samla kommunkoncernen kring en gemensam digital agenda med gemensamma prioriteringar. Du skapar förutsättningar för att verksamheterna arbetar mot samma mål genom styrning, samordning och tydliga beslutsprocesser.

Du leder och utvecklar DigIT-organisationen i nära samarbete med medarbetare och externa partners. Vidare ansvarar du för att utforma och implementera en gemensam portföljstyrningsmodell för koncernen och kommunen. Du driver strategiska initiativ inom digitalisering, med särskilt fokus på AI och datadriven verksamhetsutveckling.

Som CIO säkerställer du att IT-miljön uppfyller högt ställda krav på säkerhet och regulatorisk efterlevnad. Du agerar rådgivare till koncernchef och stadsdirektör för att säkerställa att IT-beslut stöder våra långsiktiga mål. Du navigerar också mellan affärsledning och förvaltning för att skapa en enhetlig teknisk strategi.

Din bakgrund

Vi söker en erfaren ledare med förmåga att driva förändring genom förtroende och strategisk höjd. För att passa i rollen behöver du ha:

  • En akademisk examen inom IT/teknik eller industriell ekonomi, alternativt annan utbildning och yrkeserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
  • Gedigen erfarenhet av ledande IT-roller i matrisartade eller delade organisationer.
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att etablera och styra komplexa portföljmodeller och stora transformationer.
  • Förståelse för beslutsprocesser och regulatoriska krav inom offentlig sektor(exempelvis NIS2, AI Act och GDPR).
  • Strategisk förståelse för teknikens risker och möjligheter, inklusive modern AI-utveckling.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet och dina ledaregenskaper. Vi söker en trygg och samlande ledare som navigerar med personlig mognad i dynamiska miljöer och bygger starka samarbeten. Som strategisk förändringsledare har du förmågan att göra tekniskt utmanande IT-frågor begripliga för icke-tekniska beslutsfattare.

Välj Telge

Inom Telge finns alla möjligheter för dig att själv forma din framtid. Här finns det plats att växa, både i din yrkesroll och som människa. Telge är en arbetsplats med trygga anställningsvillkor. Du som anställd hos oss omfattas av kollektivavtal där viktiga saker som försäkringar och pension ingår.

Här får du mindre pussel och mer liv. Att ha balans mellan arbetslivet och den privata sfären är viktig för ett hållbart liv. Så långt det är möjligt har vi flexibla arbetstider där var och en styr över sin tid. Vi erbjuder flera förmåner som gör vardagen lite lättare – som 3 000 kronor i friskvårdsbidrag per år, föräldrapenningtillägg och utökad sjuklön. Hos oss får du trygghet, balans och möjligheten att må bra – både på och utanför jobbet.

Läs mer om några av våra medarbetare som valt Telge: https://www.telge.se/jobba-hos-oss/vi-valde-telge/

Mångfald inkludering och trygghet

Vi på Telge arbetar aktivt för mångfald och inkludering och välkomnar därför medarbetare med olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och kompetenser. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är vår högsta prioritet. Arbetspsykologiska tester ingår i våra rekryteringsprocesser till chefs- och specialisttjänster och vi genomför återkommande, slumpmässiga drogtester bland alla våra medarbetare.

Sista ansökningsdatum

6 september 2026. Vi tillämpar inte löpande urval i den här tjänsten. Alla ansökningar granskas sammanhållet efter sista ansökningsdatum.

Några frågor?

Vill du veta mer om tjänsten eller har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? Då är det Karin Medin, vd Telge AB och koncernchef, du ska kontakta, på 08-550 220 00. Fackliga kontakter är vision@telge.se för Vision, Magnus Enderin för SACO, Jessica Borgen för Kommunal. Dessa nås på 08-550 220 00.

Är du nyfiken på att läsa mer om oss?

title: Terveyskeskuslääkäri, Avoterveydenhuolto, Loimaa
description:
Haemme uuteen terveyskeskuslääkärin virkaan erityisesti ikääntyneiden hoidosta kiinnostunutta kollegaa, jolle potilaan kokonaisvaltainen hoito on sydäntä lähellä.

Tehtäväsi

Loimaan terveyskeskuksessa on 15 lääkärinvirkaa. Lääkärit työskentelevät Loimaan pääterveysasemalla. Toiminnallisesti lääkärit ja hoitajat on jaettu kolmeen hoitotiimiin. Työ voi koostua esimerkiksi työstä Loimaan uudessa arviointiyksikössä, kotihoidossa ja vastaanotolla. Työ vastaanotoilla on kiireetöntä ja kiireellistä ajanvarausvastaanottoa. Työ on monipuolista ja kokonaisvaltaista potilaiden asioiden hoitoa.

Työnkuva ja työaika ovat joustavasti sovittavissa.

Virassa aloittamisen ajankohta on sovittavissa. Viran täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Hyvät edellytykset ammatilliselle kehittymiselle mm. erilaisten täydennyskoulutusten avulla
- Vaikutusmahdollisuuden työhösi - yhdessä luomme tulevaisuuden työpaikkaamme
- Päivätyön säännöllisellä työajalla
- Mahdollisuuden osa-aikatyöhön ja etätyöhön, jos se sopii paremmin tämänhetkiseen elämäntilanteeseesi.

Loimaalla on hyvin toimiva työyhteisö, joka koetaan tärkeäksi. Loimaalla arvostetaan omaa sekä toisten työtä ja tehdään yhdessä töitä työyhteisön hyväksi. Pienessä työyhteisössä opit tuntemaan työtoverisi nopeasti, mikä helpottaa yhteistyötä. Meillä toimii erinomaisesti sairaanhoitajien oma vastaanottotoiminta ja fysioterapeuttien suoravastaanotto. Loimaan terveyskeskuksessa on päivittäin konsulttina kokeneempi kollega helposti tavoitettavissa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Toivomme tulevalta kollegalta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja työn sujuvuuden takaamiseksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on Terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa 559/94 säädetty laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä. Kielitaitovaatimuksena hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito ja tyydyttävä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Eduksi luemme yleislääketieteen tai geriatrian erikoislääkärin tutkinnon tai toissijaisesti erikoistumisoikeuden yleislääketieteeseen tai geriatriaan.

Hae tehtävään ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Loimaan terveyskeskuksen tulevaisuutta!

To protect football from match-fixing and safeguard the integrity of European football matches and competitions, UEFA's Anti-Match-Fixing unit works closely with the football family and broader sports community to promote integrity, raise awareness of the threat of match-fixing and identify, investigate and sanction any match-fixing offences.

The Data Analyst, part of the Integrity and Regulatory Division and working within the Anti-Match-Fixing unit, identifies means of improving the unit's key processes and drives new efficiencies across all unit pillars. In addition to ensuring the quality and consistency of all unit data, they contribute actionable insights to multiple large-scale projects while serving as a trusted analytical partner within the unit and UEFA, supporting evidence-based decision-making and driving innovative approaches to protecting football integrity.

Key responsibilities

  • Identifying, accessing and cleaning a large variety of datasets, ensuring data quality and consistency
  • Converting, integrating and structuring data sources to support projects related to the detection, prevention and analysis of match manipulation, player performance analysis initiatives and other strategic priorities, identifying actionable insights and opportunities
  • Creating, maintaining and continuously improving dashboards, data visualisations and analytical products that support operational, strategic and executive decision-making across the unit, division and among UEFA stakeholders
  • Developing innovative methods to improve processes and automating data delivery and input within the approved UEFA data environment
  • Acting as a driver of innovation within the unit, leveraging advances in data science, machine learning and analytical technologies to enhance operational effectiveness and strengthen the fight against match-fixing
  • Leading and supporting player performance analysis projects, including the development and application of analytical methodologies to support expert assessments and integrity-related investigations
  • Producing recurring intelligence products, including risk assessments, status reports and strategic analyses, translating complex data into clear and actionable intelligence

  • Collaborating closely with colleagues across UEFA and external stakeholders to understand business requirements, develop analytical solutions and promote data-driven decision-making

I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av några inledande urvalsfrågor för att få veta mer om dig och dina förutsättningar att passa in i rollen.
 
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning på 6 månader. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning.
 
Välkommen med din ansökan!
 
Alla former av direktkontakt som inte berör frågor om tjänsten, till exempel från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag eller annonssäljare, undanbedes vänligen men bestämt.


Vi är ett genuint familjeföretag som startades som ett snickeri i Sikfors i Norrbotten 1947. En by omgiven av skog, en skog som vi brukat och förädlat sedan dess. Det är ingen överdrift att säga att vi är hemma i skogen och att vi verkligen brinner för vår hembygd.

Det är kanske därför vi allt sedan starten alltid jobbat för att nyttja den skog vi tar i anspråk så ansvarsfullt som möjligt. Utnyttja alla delar. Optimera uttaget. I dag är vi 562 anställda på 22 verksamhetsorter som omsätter 2,3 miljarder.

Vi har utvecklats till en koncern, från sågkedja till butikskedja. Idag äger Stenvalls 12 XL-BYGG-butiker. I koncernen har vi också utvecklat flera andra bolag inom olika specialområden, bland annat Kallax Flyg och Genesis IT. En utvecklingsresa som vi bara börjat. För entreprenörskapet är vår livsnerv, att hela tiden utvecklas och bli bättre.

title: Senior Health & Safety Consultant
description:
What if you could shape built and natural environments, and the future of those that use them?

With us, you can.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Health & Safety Consultant to join our team and contribute to our Perth-based and national projects.

You'll assist clients in navigating the contemporary health and safety landscape, adapting to evolving work and organisational settings, and achieving positive outcomes for frontline teams, organizations, stakeholders, and the community.

You will support clients in diverse industries through a range of HSE consulting activities, including, but not limited to:

  • Contractor management assurance activities (both onsite and desktop) in construction, renewable energy, government & non-government and other high risk industry settings
  • Management system evaluation, design, decluttering and implementation support aligned with WHS legislative and recognised best practice standards (ISO 45001, ISO 45003, ISO 14001, ISO 9001)
  • Applying contemporary WHS management approaches to diverse industry and operational settings
  • Support our construction and geotechnical field work supervisors in providing periodic onsite health and safety support and advice in meeting legislative and client obligations.
  • Technical WHS advisory and consulting support

We work hybrid which means you will have the opportunity to work between our Perth office and from home for up to two days per week when not required at site, ensuring a healthy work-life balance.

What you’ll do

  • Contribute to a thriving team culture dedicated to deliver technical excellence and positive client outcomes
  • Conduct desktop and onsite contractor assurance reviews to support our clients in their desired approach to contractor safety management
  • Evaluate HSE plans, systems, onsite arrangements across a range of contexts and industry settings (such as construction, renewable energy, government, manufacturing, insurance, defence and more)
  • Provide in-field safety and project support for our Principal Contractor construction activities (predominantly geotechnical site investigations and contaminated land remediation)
  • Work with diverse range of HSE consultants and partners to explore and deliver contemporary health and safety consulting and compliance solutions.
  • Research, analyse, and recommend best practice HSE approaches and deliverables, tailored to your clients’ needs

About you

You are likely to have 3+ years of experience in the health and safety consultant profession, and looking to make a positive impact to health and safety for front line workers and communities.

You will ideally bring the following:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risks and propose effective solutions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with stakeholders across all organisational levels
  • Prior experience in performing onsite inspections and audits (ISO 45001, ISO 14001 Lead Auditor certification would be highly advantageous)
  • Experience advising on contemporary approaches to H&S management, including psycho-social risk management
  • Understanding or willingness to develop understanding of consulting and project lifecycles, and proactively building client relationships while upholding high service delivery standards especially for government clients.
  • Australian Driver's License
  • Tertiary qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a Cert IV in WHS as a minimum.

The role will require the ability to travel for short periods and at times after-hours work (not extensive and suitably remunerated) where required for specific projects.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 73,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

An employee Share Purchase Plan is available to all our permanent employees who wish to become owners and vested partners in WSP’s collective success. To find out more about our commitment to the health and wellbeing of our people, and the programs we’ve designed to help you thrive, go to our Employee Benefits page.

With us, you can. Apply today.

Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join a technology engineering team supporting enterprise-scale platforms and advanced analytics environments. The role will focus on building and managing automated CI/CD pipelines, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, security integration, and production engineering across highly available and regulated environments.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Docker, Helm, Terraform, Ansible, Groovy, Python, Linux, and Git, with a strong understanding of DevOps, SRE, Infrastructure as Code, security engineering, and Agile delivery practices.

We are looking for someone who enjoys collaboration, experimentation, solving problems, and continuously learning.

Requirements

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize automated CI/CD pipelines for Python-based applications and microservices.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD.
  • Build and maintain microservices CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices.
  • Develop and maintain Helm-based deployment pipelines for containerized applications.
  • Automate application deployment, configuration management, infrastructure provisioning, and operational processes.
  • Implement and maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using tools such as ArgoCD.
  • Automate security, compliance, and regulatory checks within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Integrate DevSecOps tools into CI/CD pipelines, including tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Sysdig, Nexus, Nexus IQ, Cosign, and related security/quality tooling.
  • Implement automated patching and configuration management across environments.
  • Design, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Podman.
  • Work with Terraform, Ansible, and other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools to provision and manage environments.
  • Develop automation scripts using Groovy, Python, and Linux shell scripting.
  • Support API development and integration within deployment and automation pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, application, deployment, and pipeline-related issues.
  • Provide production support and participate in on-call/production support rotations where required.
  • Monitor application and platform health using tools such as ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Implement and maintain secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for microservices.
  • Collaborate with development, security, infrastructure, platform, and product teams to ensure successful delivery and adoption of technology platforms.
  • Support application and platform onboarding through self-service and automation.
  • Work with teams to ensure smooth transition, adoption, and consumption of platform services.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions, engineering standards, automation strategies, and platform improvements.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve engineering efficiency and platform capabilities.

Required Technical Skills

CI/CD & DevOps

  • Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with ArgoCD / GitOps.
  • Strong understanding of pipeline automation using Groovy, Python, or Pipeline-as-Code.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines for microservices and Python-based applications.
  • Experience with Helm-based deployment pipelines.
  • Understanding of DevOps and SRE principles.
  • Strong understanding of 12-Factor application principles.

Containers & Orchestration

  • Strong hands-on experience with Docker.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift.
  • Exposure to Podman.
  • Experience deploying and managing containerized applications in enterprise environments.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Ansible.
  • Strong scripting experience using:
    • Groovy
    • Python
    • Linux Shell/Bash

Security & DevSecOps

  • Experience integrating security and compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and security engineering.
  • Exposure to tools such as:
    • SonarQube
    • Checkmarx
    • Sysdig
    • Nexus
    • Nexus IQ
    • Cosign
  • Understanding of secure software delivery and regulatory requirements.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure, networking, and cloud computing concepts.
  • Hands-on or working experience with public cloud platforms such as:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • AWS
    • OCI
  • Understanding of cloud services across compute, storage, and networking.

Operating Systems & Source Control

  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems.
  • Good experience with Linux shell scripting.
  • Strong experience with Git and source-control practices.
  • Working knowledge of Windows environments is desirable.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Experience with logging, monitoring, and observability platforms such as:
    • ELK
    • Prometheus
    • Grafana

APIs & Microservices

  • Understanding of REST/API development and integration.
  • Experience working with microservices architectures.
  • Understanding of microservice authentication and authorization.
  • Experience integrating APIs into CI/CD and automation workflows.

Required Experience

  • 3–5+ years of engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or operational experience.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar DevOps/Platform Engineering role.
  • Experience working within large, complex, highly available enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with high availability, transaction volumes, and geographically distributed environments is preferred.
  • Strong experience in CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure automation, and production support.

Domain Experience

Candidates from the following environments are preferred:

  • Banking
  • Financial Services
  • FinTech
  • Insurance
  • Telecommunications
  • Healthcare
  • Government
  • Or other highly regulated / enterprise environments

Nice to Have

  • Public cloud experience with Azure, AWS, or OCI.
  • Experience supporting Machine Learning / ML projects or analytics platforms.
  • Python programming experience.
  • Experience with advanced analytics or data engineering platforms.
  • Exposure to enterprise platform engineering and self-service infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing cost optimization and platform efficiency initiatives.

Agile & Delivery

  • Experience working in Agile engineering environments.
  • Understanding of Agile/DevOps delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to work across development, operations, security, infrastructure, and product teams.
  • Experience managing delivery from inception through production.
  • Strong understanding of operational support within a DevOps/SRE model.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and problem-solving skills.

Key Behavioral Competencies

We are looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys collaboration and cross-functional teamwork.

  • Is a self-starter with strong initiative.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate/Fellow
description:
• Full time, 1-year fixed term position with possibility of extension

  • Be part of the development of novel quantum magnetometer-based navigation tools for autonomous marine systems

  • Base Salary $117,936 - $137,500 + 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

The University of Sydney’s Australian Centre for Robotics (ACFR) is one of Australia’s leading robotics research groups and undertakes fundamental and applied research in the area of field robotics. Our marine systems group is focused on the development of autonomous marine vehicle systems for marine survey. We also explore tools for the visualisation, clustering and classification of extensive marine-based image archives,
characterisation of change in multi-year surveys and adaptive mission planning for multi-vehicle systems. We undertake marine surveys using robotic systems at sites around Australia and overseas in collaboration with a range of partners.

In partnership with University of Melbourne, RMIT University, Swinburne University, the University of Tasmania and Phasor Quantum and Quantum Brilliance, we have secured funding through an Australian Defence Sciences and Universities Network (ADSUN) and Defence Innovation Network (DIN) project to conduct underwater trial using a sovereign quantum vector magnetometer. The objective of the project is to use the gathered survey data to explore advanced platform compensation techniques, map matching and magnetic navigation solutions. This project aims to investigate the advantages of multi-sensor fusion (inertial, acoustic, visual, and magnetic) for underwater sensing and long-range navigation for autonomous underwater vehicles. We will explore advanced non-parametric mapping techniques based on our prior work in the area of Gaussian Process based Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping (SLAM) and recent advances in non-parametric, 3D environment modelling. We will assess the utility of these tools for map-building using magnetometer data as well as exploring the potential for existing geospatial maps to enable long range, covert and autonomous navigation in underwater environments.

We are seeking a postdoctoral research fellow interested in leading the development of these tools using a combination of simulation and real-world data collected by an AUV. The successful candidate will work closely with our project partners in assessing their utility using data collected by an AUV system and providing advice on future long autonomous navigation techniques.

About you

  • a PhD in a relevant field or near completion

  • extensive knowledge of robotic navigation, machine learning or other relevant fields

  • experience working with marine robotic systems or the data they collect, including inertial, acoustic, visual and magnetometer data

  • field experience deploying underwater or other advanced robotic systems are desirable

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to be eligible to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

title: Prosessiturvallisuusinsinööri
description:
Job Summary

Turvallisuus ei synny sattumalta. Se rakennetaan osaamisella, ennakoivalla ajattelulla ja jatkuvalla kehittämisellä.

Etsimme nyt Prosessiturvallisuusinsinööriä Jämsänkosken tehtaalle varmistamaan, että toimintamme täyttää korkeimmat prosessi- ja kemikaaliturvallisuuden standardit sekä tänään että tulevaisuudessa. Tässä monipuolisessa asiantuntijaroolissa pääset vaikuttamaan koko tehtaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin, riskienhallintaan ja toimintatapojen kehittämiseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon, kunnossapidon, teknisten asiantuntijoiden, viranomaisten ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa sekä toimit keskeisessä roolissa turvallisen ja vastuullisen toiminnan edistäjänä. Jos innostut turvallisuuden kehittämisestä, haluat nähdä työsi konkreettiset vaikutukset ja nautit yhteistyöstä eri toimintojen kanssa, tämä rooli tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä osana kansainvälistä organisaatiota.

Rooli, jossa vaikutat aidosti

  • Kehität tehtaan prosessi- ja kemikaaliturvallisuutta sekä siihen liittyviä toimintatapoja
  • Koordinoit prosessiturvallisuuden hallintajärjestelmän (PSM) keskeisiä prosesseja ja kehitystoimenpiteitä
  • Vastaat onnettomuuksien, vaaratilanteiden ja läheltä piti -tapausten tutkinnan koordinoinnista ja raportoinnista
  • Johdat teknisten muutosten hallintaan (Management of Change) liittyviä prosesseja
  • Tuet turvallisia käyttöönottoprosesseja ja riskienhallintaa osana tuotannon kehitystä
  • Toimit kemikaalien käytönvalvojana sekä osallistut kemikaaliturvallisuuden kehittämiseen
  • Suunnittelet ja toteutat prosessi- ja kemikaaliturvallisuuteen liittyviä koulutuksia henkilöstölle
  • Osallistut riskinarviointeihin, turvallisuusanalyysien toteuttamiseen sekä kehitystoimenpiteiden määrittelyyn
  • Toimit yhteistyössä viranomaisten, sisäisten sidosryhmien ja ulkopuolisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa
  • Edistät energiatehokkuutta sekä osallistut auditointeihin ja jatkuvan parantamisen hankkeisiin
  • Tuet ja kehität tuotannon suorituskykyä prosessikehityksen kautta

Mikä tekee sinusta sopivan tähän rooliin?

  • Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto esimerkiksi kemiantekniikan, prosessitekniikan tai muun teknisen alan parista
  • Ymmärrys prosessi-, kemikaali- tai työturvallisuuteen liittyvistä vaatimuksista ja käytännöistä
  • Kokemusta teollisesta tuotantoympäristöstä tai prosessiteollisuudesta
  • Kyky tunnistaa riskejä sekä kehittää turvallisia toimintatapoja
  • Analyyttinen ja järjestelmällinen työskentelyote
  • Hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot eri sidosryhmien kanssa työskentelyyn
  • Halua kouluttaa, ohjata ja tukea organisaatiota turvallisuuskysymyksissä
  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito
  • Kyky viedä kehityshankkeita eteenpäin itsenäisesti ja määrätietoisesti

Miten erotut eduksesi?

  • Kokemus prosessiturvallisuuden hallintajärjestelmistä (PSM)
  • Osaaminen riskinarvioinneista, PHA-analyyseistä tai teknisten muutosten hallinnasta (MOC)
  • Kokemus kemikaaliturvallisuuteen, viranomaisyhteistyöhön tai auditointeihin liittyvistä tehtävistä

Miksi juuri me?

  • Pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja vakavaraisessa alan johtavassa yrityksessä
  • Vaikutat konkreettisesti turvallisuuden, vastuullisuuden ja toiminnan jatkuvan kehittämisen edistämiseen
  • Saat mahdollisuuden laaja-alaiseen asiantuntijarooliin ja merkittävään vastuuseen
  • Työskentelet osaavien ja sitoutuneiden kollegoiden kanssa
  • Kehität osaamistasi kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä
  • Rakennat turvallisempaa tulevaisuutta osana innovatiivista ja kestävää liiketoimintaa

Jämsänkosken tehtaamme on ollut suomalaisen bioteknologian kulmakivi jo vuosikymmenten ajan. Entsyymituotanto nousi keskiöön vuonna 1986, ja perinne jatkuu vahvana tänäkin päivänä. Jämsänkoski on osa IFF Health & Biosciences -liiketoimintayksikköä, joka tunnetaan globaalisti tieteeseen perustuvista innovaatioista ja vastuullisista ratkaisuista.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi liitteineen meille mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin 6.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi niiden saapumisjärjestyksessä ja saatamme edetä haastatteluihin potentiaalisimpien hakijoiden kanssa jo hakuajan puitteissa.

Huomioithan, että hakemukset tulee jättää yksinomaan Workday-rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Investigations Specialist
description:
Job Description

Why Patients Need You

Every day, everything we do is driven by an unwavering commitment to delivering safe and effective products to patients. Our quality culture, which is both science and risk-based, is designed to be flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented. Whether your role involves development, production, compliance, your contribution is crucial and will have a direct impact on patients. Our dedication to quality and safety ensures that we consistently meet the highest standards, making a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will be responsible for addressing site deviations by conducting thorough investigations and root cause analyses to identify effective Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPAs). Your efforts will help reduce the number of repeat deviations at the site. Additionally, you will be responsible for driving improvements through independent proactive CAPAs and Continuous Improvement (CI) ideas from production. Your role includes implementing strategies to enhance performance and reduce waste, driven by proactive CAPAs and CI initiatives, and reporting performance against established standards in line with company objectives.

You will be accountable for meeting department, site, and corporate goals and will be expected to report and communicate progress on deviations, status, and closure plans to key stakeholders across the business.

How You Will Achieve It

  • Lead complex investigations and create effective project plans to ensure timely closure, engaging site Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), managing meetings, and reporting investigation updates to key personnel across the site.
  • Serve as an Operations technical SME in cross-functional Method 1 (M1) investigations.
  • Utilize Six Sigma investigation tools, including MiniTab, Fishbone, and 5 Whys methodologies, for true root cause identification and effective CAPA implementation.
  • Drive timely closure and quality improvements to reduce repeat deviations, increase performance, and reduce waste and costs.
  • Proactively engage with Operations staff to identify CI initiatives, focusing on safety, quality, compliance, and Materials Usage Variance (MUV)/cost reduction.
  • Provide continued education and mentoring to Operations staff on the importance of proactive data analysis, investigation methods, CI identification, and root cause and CAPA determination, fostering a positive working environment and resilience.
  • Initiate and deliver Change Controls (CC) related to CAPAs and CI initiatives, ensuring timely closures.
  • Present Operations investigation findings during Regulatory inspections and Contract Customer Audits.
  • Monitor and report deviation performance metrics as directed.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by the Production Compliance Lead.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in the pharmaceutical or allied industry.
  • 3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing/Quality.
  • 1-3 years of experience in facilitating investigations using Six Sigma tools, Fishbone, and 5 Whys methodologies for root cause analysis and effective CAPA identification.
  • Knowledge and application of Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).
  • Experience with compliance issues resulting from cGMP deviations or product defects.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and leadership skills (both verbal and written).
  • Results-focused with demonstrated Project Management skills, the ability to manage multiple projects, and meet business targets and delivery timelines.
  • Attention to detail, technical knowledge, innovative thinking, and problem-solving abilities, including implementation of resolutions.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet agreed timelines with high attention to detail.
  • Understanding of quality systems, including the management of deviation investigations, change controls, and quality records.
  • Proficiency with computer packages, including the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Permanent rights to work within Australia.
  • Deviation investigation experience within the pharmaceutical cGMP environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in sterile manufacturing, Process Validation, Engineering, or Quality.
  • Method 1 (M1) & Pfizer Human Performance (PHP) certification.
  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow/Green/Black Belt certification.
  • Experience with MiniTab and TrackWise Quality Management System.

Build the platform behind secure and reliable software delivery

  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira administration and governance.

  • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong understanding of Git-based workflows and pull request practices.

  • Ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and improve ways of working across teams.

  • Good communication skills in English.

It is a plus if you have

  • Experience supporting multiple teams through shared platform services and standards.

  • Meaningful work in a security-conscious SaaS environment.

  • Support for continuous learning and professional growth.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

Vitec Raisoft develops SaaS solutions for healthcare and social care organizations around the globe. Our products help professionals assess care needs, support decision-making, improve quality of care, and create better outcomes for individuals. We work closely with our customers to develop solutions that are reliable, user-friendly, and make a meaningful difference in society. Read more at .

title: Team Lead
description:
Haemme Kajaanin Motonet-tavarataloon


TEAM LEADIA

Haemme tiimiin myynnillistä ja esihenkilötyöstä innostuvaa Team Leadia.Team Leadina toimit osana tavaratalon arkea ja vastaat omalta osaltasi myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja päivittäisten toimintojen sujuvuudesta. Rooli voi painottua esimerkiksi myymälän, kassan, asiakaspalvelun tai varaosamyynnin ja autoilun tuoteryhmien pariin valittavan henkilön osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vahvuuksien mukaan. Tärkeintä on, että sinulta löytyy aikaisempaa esihenkilökokemusta, kaupallista ajattelua ja halua saada tiimi onnistumaan.

Työsuhde on kokoaikainen 37,5h/vko ja vakituinen
Työn luonteen vuoksi hakijoilta edellytetään 18 vuoden ikää
Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan. Palkka määräytyy tehtävään valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.

Työssäsi johdat tiimiäsi valmentavalla otteella, tuet tiimiläisten osaamisen kehittymistä ja varmistat, että ketjuohjeistusten mukainen toiminta toteutuu arjessa. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua muun muassa myymälän yleiskunnosta ja esillepanoista huolehtimista, kampanjoiden, hinta- ja hyllymuutosten sekä sesonkivaihtojen toteutuksen varmistamista, kassatoimintojen ja rahaliikenteen sujuvuuden tukemista sekä varaosa- ja autoilumyynnin päivittäisten toimintojen edistämistä.

Team Lead osallistuu myös tavaratalon työhön kaikissa vuoroissa, ja tehtävään kuuluu joustavasti myös muita tavaratalon tehtäviä. Arjessa olet mukana asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityössä, toimit esimerkkinä tiimillesi ja huolehdit siitä, että tekemisessä näkyvät hyvä palveluasenne, aktiivinen myynti ja halu tehdä kauppaa.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sytyt myynnistä, asiakaskohtaamisista ja tiimin valmentamisesta. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy kaupallista nälkää, myynnillistä pilkettä silmäkulmassa ja aitoa halua kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi tekemistä.

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 16-20 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

Competitive salary, dependent on experience

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

Why join Street Group?

Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

£500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

Regular well-being initiatives

Flexible working hours

Public transport season ticket loans

Paid menopause leave

Holiday buying scheme

Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

‍ A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

Cycle to work scheme

Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc. a Design & AI Task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

title: AI Experience Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Experience Engineer based in the United States.

This is a full-stack engineering role focused on building the human-facing layer of AI-powered and agentic systems.
You’ll turn concepts and prototypes into polished, production-quality experiences that make sophisticated AI capabilities intuitive, trustworthy, and useful.
The role spans backend services, APIs, data integration, frontend engineering, design systems, and AI-specific interaction patterns.
A major focus will be creating observability interfaces that allow people to inspect agent behavior, understand outputs, identify anomalies, and intervene when necessary.
You’ll help establish reusable patterns for AI assistants, copilots, real-time intelligence, and human-on-the-loop workflows across the organization.
Your work will be highly visible to engineering leaders, executives, and potentially external customers, making product quality and usability essential.
You’ll operate within an innovation-focused environment where experimentation, accessibility, thoughtful design, and modern AI engineering come together.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the full-stack design and engineering quality of AI pilots and prototypes, taking concepts from briefs or wireframes through backend services, APIs, data integrations, and polished production-quality interfaces.
  • Build intuitive, accessible, and visually consistent experiences that make complex AI capabilities immediately understandable to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Design and implement human-on-the-loop interaction patterns that allow users to inspect agent traces, review outputs, adjust parameters, identify anomalies, and intervene when appropriate without becoming bottlenecks in every AI workflow.
  • Develop and maintain a shared design system and component library featuring AI-specific patterns such as streaming outputs, agent status indicators, progress states, trace inspection views, confidence surfaces, and human-review interfaces.
  • Establish UX and interaction standards for AI assistants and copilots, including contextual assistance, real-time knowledge retrieval, AI-generated content, and role-specific intelligence dashboards.

  • Apply established brand and design standards to customer-facing and externally visible experiences.
  • Contribute to frontend technology evaluations and emerging technology assessments, helping define technical direction for AI interaction patterns.
  • Create and document reusable architectural and interaction patterns so successful AI experiences can be adopted by broader engineering teams and carried into production.
  • Establish strong foundations early, including auditing existing design systems, shipping initial agent interaction components, building observability interfaces, and documenting design-system foundations for production teams.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong experience with React or an equivalent modern frontend framework and contemporary design-system practices.
    • Ability to move fluidly between UX design and implementation, including working with tools such as Figma and translating interaction concepts directly into production code.
    • Experience designing interfaces for complex technical information while maintaining clarity and usability for non-technical audiences.

    • Knowledge of data visualization, WCAG accessibility standards, and performance engineering is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks, eval harnesses, or LLM-as-judge approaches is a plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, design, and business teams.
    • Comfortable operating in an innovation environment where requirements evolve quickly and prototypes must balance experimentation with production-quality standards.
    • Ability to take ownership of highly visible work, challenge assumptions constructively, and maintain a high bar for quality and usability.

title: Commi
description:

Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met

• Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.

• Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.

• Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.

• Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.

• Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

• Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.

• Knows and implements brand’s Safety Standards.

• Supervises kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.

• Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.

• Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.

• Supports procedures for food & beverage portion and waste controls.

• Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.

• Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.

Leading Team

• Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.

• Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.

Maintaining Culinary Goals

• Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

• Handles guest problems and complaints.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Identifies the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.

• Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.

• Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Participates in training the Restaurant and Catering staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

title: Intern
description:
Job Summary

Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.​

The role is based in Melbourne, Australia (onsite role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

Where You'll Make a Difference

  • Assist in conducting pilot plant trials for plant-based barista beverage formulations.
  • Prepare and test beverage samples using different recipes and processing conditions.
  • Evaluate coffee application performance, including barista-related attributes such as foam quality, stability, and sensory characteristics.
  • Record experimental data and summarize trial results.
  • Support laboratory and pilot plant activities, including sample preparation and equipment clean-up.
  • Collaborate with the Application team to analyze findings and recommend formulation improvements.
  • Prepare a final internship report and deliver a presentation summarizing project outcomes and key learnings.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Why Choose Us?

  • Hands-on experience in plant-based beverage formulation and application development.
  • Exposure to pilot plant operations and product evaluation techniques.
  • Opportunity to work with experienced food scientists and application specialists.
  • Practical project experience through final report and presentation delivery.

For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy.
