title: QA Specialist
description:
About Invarion

Invarion builds specialist software for the traffic control and road safety industry. Our products are used around the world to design traffic control plans, road layouts, sign arrangements, and other safety-critical visual documentation. We are a small company combining a startup-like culture and ambitious expansion plans with the stability of a mature product and a large existing customer base.

We are actively exploring AI tools and practical ways to improve team effectiveness. We would like new team members to share this curiosity and be open to using modern tools responsibly.

Our engineering team is located in a modern, easily accessible office space in Gdańsk Oliwa.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced QA specialist to join our team in Gdańsk. This role is broader than a standard testing position. You will be expected to:

  • Test bug fixes and new features in our desktop, web and mobile applications.

  • Contribute to improving our QA processes and documentation in close cooperation with developers and product stakeholders.

  • Help maintain our global library of traffic control signs and templates by checking quality, identifying content that needs adjustments, and using internal tools to update or create library items.

  • Oversee our customer support process: verify reported issues and feedback, validate quality of documentation and ensure smooth communication between technical support and development teams.

Our software is CAD-like, visual, and detail-heavy, so QA requires more than following scripts. It requires curiosity, product understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to think through real user workflows. A strong sense of responsibility for product quality is crucial.

Please note that this is an office-based role, with limited flexibility for occasional remote work (up to 20% of working time).

Key Responsibilities

  • Test desktop, web, and mobile applications. Perform exploratory testing, reproduce bugs, validate fixes, and identify quality risks before release.

  • Help design and improve QA processes, test cases, regression areas, release checklists, etc.

  • Maintain traffic control sign and template libraries, including quality checks, regulatory updates, and new content creation.

  • Review, reproduce and validate user-reported issues and feedback to ****ensure users receive appropriate support.

  • Review feature and bug documentation for clarity, completeness, and testability.

Requirements

  • Experience in manual software testing (desktop, web or mobile).

  • Strong attention to detail, especially with visual elements and layouts.

  • Ability to think beyond individual test cases and understand broader product quality risks.

  • Solid understanding of QA processes and experience with improving them.

  • Curiosity about modern tools, including AI-assisted workflows.

  • Clear communication and confidence working with the development team.

  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CAD-like applications, vector graphics, mapping tools, GIS or other technical software.

  • Experience maintaining structured content libraries, templates, symbols or regulatory content.

  • Interest in traffic management, road safety, transportation and related areas.

What We Offer

  • Work on a globally used specialist product with unusual and interesting testing challenges.

  • Real ownership over product quality and QA processes.

  • A small, collaborative and supportive team.

  • Flexible working hours and a healthy work-life balance.

  • Long term B2B contract with 26 days paid annual leave included.

title: Senior Insights Analyst
description:
As a Senior Insights Analyst, you will serve as a strategic analytics partner to Reuters Editorial, Product, Agency Sales, and AI teams. You will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that improve content performance, customer engagement, product strategy, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. ​

About the Role

  • Partner with Editorial, Product, Sales, AI, Technology, Data Science, Customer Success, and Commercial teams to support strategic decision-making.
  • Analyze large-scale structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets, including content, text, metadata, customer usage, digital product, and operational data.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, risks, anomalies, and measurable business impacts across products, workflows, and customer segments.
  • Develop and maintain KPI frameworks, dashboards, executive reporting, and self-service analytics solutions.
  • Define success metrics, measurement methodologies, and reporting standards for products, workflows, automation, and AI-enabled initiatives.
  • Conduct exploratory, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analysis to answer complex business questions.
  • Use advanced analytical approaches such as NLP, text mining, semantic search, metadata analysis, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, and machine learning where appropriate.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools and Large Language Models—including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini—to improve research, analysis, reporting, and insight-generation workflows.
  • Design and execute benchmarking studies, proof-of-concept analyses, product evaluations, and performance assessments for emerging technologies and business initiatives.
  • Monitor product adoption, customer usage patterns, metadata quality, productivity gains, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.
  • Perform detailed content and metadata quality assessments to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Build scalable analytical processes and reporting frameworks that enable stakeholders to access timely, reliable insights independently.
  • Translate complex technical analyses into concise, executive-level recommendations and compelling data stories.
  • Ensure data integrity through validation, governance, quality assurance, and ongoing monitoring processes.
  • Support ad hoc business questions, operational reporting, and strategic projects with accuracy, speed, and attention to detail.

title: Sr. Systems Engineer - Windows Platform Engineer
description:
About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

https://www.williams-sonoma.com/

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Windows Platform Engineer responsible for the engineering, operational ownership, automation, standardization, security, and lifecycle management of Williams-Sonoma’s Windows Server platform and Microsoft infrastructure services.

This role extends beyond traditional Windows administration. It is an operational engineering role focused on designing, improving, automating, and operating secure, highly available Windows platforms that support Williams-Sonoma’s global business operations.

You will partner closely with Senior Engineers, Architects, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Networking, Linux, Storage, and Enterprise Tools teams to operationalize new platform capabilities, improve system reliability, reduce operational complexity, and continuously mature the Windows platform through automation, engineering best practices, and operational excellence.

This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Engineering Operations.

Impact of the Role

• Engineer secure, resilient, and highly available Windows platforms supporting global enterprise operations.
• Improve platform reliability, operational scalability, and engineering efficiency through automation and standardization.
• Strengthen enterprise security, operational compliance, and infrastructure resilience.
• Drive continuous operational improvement across enterprise Windows infrastructure services.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• Microsoft Windows Server (2016/2019/2022 or newer)
• Microsoft Azure and Hybrid Windows environments
• Active Directory Domain Services
• Microsoft Entra ID and Azure AD Connect
• Group Policy
• DNS
• DHCP
• DFS
• PowerShell
• Infrastructure-as-Code
• MOVEit Transfer
• MOVEit Automation
• VMware vSphere
• Microsoft Hyper-V
• WSUS
• MECM/SCCM
• Tanium
• Git-based workflows
• APIs
• Windows Failover Clustering
• PKI and Enterprise Certificate Management
• Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Platforms

Key Responsibilities

• Engineer, implement, and maintain enterprise standards for Windows Server platforms, Microsoft Azure services, Active Directory, Group Policy, and related Microsoft infrastructure technologies.
• Own operational engineering activities across the Windows platform including incident response, platform reliability, lifecycle management, patching, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, automation, and continuous service improvement.
• Design, engineer, standardize, and continuously improve enterprise Windows services including Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, authentication, authorization, replication health, and hybrid identity integration.
• Engineer secure Windows platforms by implementing operating system hardening, enterprise security baselines, vulnerability remediation, certificate management, privileged access controls, and operational compliance standards.
• Drive PowerShell-based automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to improve provisioning, configuration management, compliance, operational consistency, and engineering productivity.
• Design, implement, and maintain secure Managed File Transfer platforms including MOVEit Transfer and MOVEit Automation to support secure enterprise data exchange.
• Execute approved infrastructure changes while ensuring operational readiness, implementation quality, rollback planning, validation, and documentation.
• Contribute to Problem Management by performing root cause analysis, identifying recurring issues, recommending platform improvements, and driving continuous operational improvement initiatives.
• Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, operational reporting, log analysis, and engineering productivity.
• Partner closely with Linux, Storage, Networking, Cloud, Enterprise Tools, Security, and Application Engineering teams to deliver resilient enterprise infrastructure solutions.
• Participate in engineering projects to ensure new platform capabilities are operationally ready, supportable, observable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Develop reusable automation, engineering standards, operational runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
• Analyze platform health, operational metrics, capacity trends, reliability risks, and performance data to recommend engineering improvements.
• Lead technical troubleshooting during major incidents, coordinate restoration activities, perform root cause analysis, and identify long-term improvements that enhance platform resilience.
• Mentor engineers by sharing technical knowledge, engineering best practices, automation techniques, and operational experience.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 7+ years of enterprise Windows platform engineering or systems engineering experience.
• Deep expertise designing, engineering, and supporting enterprise Windows Server platforms within large-scale production environments.
• Deep expertise designing, engineering, and operating Microsoft Windows Server platforms (2016/2019/2022 or newer) within highly available enterprise environments.
• Strong experience with Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, DFS, and enterprise authentication services.
• Expert knowledge of Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, authentication, authorization, and enterprise identity services.
• Experience supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure and hybrid Windows environments.
• Strong experience managing Windows operating system lifecycle, vulnerability remediation, patch management, platform hardening, and security compliance.
• Hands-on expertise with PowerShell scripting and automation to improve operational efficiency and engineering consistency.
• Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Hybrid Services, or Microsoft Entra ID is desirable.

title: Lead Product Designer - Builder
description:

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.


Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.


Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts


About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer (P4) for our Builder pod who can elevate HighLevel's creator tools through exceptional craft, product vision and systems thinking. The Builder pod owns the visual creation tools that help customers build websites, funnels, landing pages, emails, forms, templates, and future AI-powered experiences without code.


This is a Lead Individual Contributor role. You will influence product direction through exceptional design craft, product thinking, and cross-functional leadership rather than direct people management.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of HighLevel's builder experiences. You will help teams make complex creation workflows feel approachable, powerful and polished for agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs who need to move quickly and produce high-quality customer-facing work.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional design craft and consistently raise the quality bar across the teams they work with. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility, and the details that make builder experiences feel precise, trustworthy, and fast.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape HighLevel's most important product experiences by defining how customers create and publish digital experiences.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across visual editing, templates, canvas interactions, publishing flows and AI-assisted creation.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • Work in a 100% remote environment where thoughtful collaboration across US and India time zones is part of everyday work.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in creator tools, WYSIWYG editors, drag-and-drop editors, no-code builders, SaaS, B2B, platform or workflow-heavy product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing visual creation workflows such as drag-and-drop editing, page or email composition, responsive layout controls, asset management, templates, previews, publishing flows or versioning.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including AI-assisted creation, recommendations, automation or guided editing workflows.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, customer-facing teams, stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for Builder pod experiences from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction for creator workflows.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Design and refine complex editing experiences, including canvases, controls, templates, responsive behaviors, previews, publishing states and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move clearly.

How You Work

  • You raise the quality bar across every project you contribute to.

  • You excel at framing the right problems before exploring solutions, designing experiences that feel intuitive for first-time users while remaining efficient and powerful for experienced users.

  • You build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, Data, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to align on problems, make informed decisions, and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

  • You care about the difference between a tool that merely works and a tool that makes creators feel capable, fast and in control.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates.

  • You enjoy collaborating across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical product design.

title: Pedadogy Expert
description:
Wadhwani AI is looking for a Literacy Specialist to support the design, implementation, and scale-up of foundational literacy interventions across government school systems. The role will provide academic and technical expertise in literacy pedagogy, curriculum development, teacher professional development, assessment design, and program implementation, while working closely with state governments and internal product, AI, and technology teams.

The Literacy Specialist will contribute to the development of evidence-based literacy solutions aligned with NEP 2020 and NIPUN Bharat, and support the integration of AI-enabled innovations to improve reading fluency, comprehension, writing, and foundational language skills at scale.

Program Design & Academic Support

  • Support the design and strengthening of foundational literacy frameworks aligned with NEP 2020 and NIPUN Bharat.
  • Develop and review teaching-learning materials, lesson plans, teacher guides, student workbooks, and digital learning resources.
  • Contribute to competency-based learning progressions covering oral language, phonics, fluency, comprehension, writing, and foundational literacy skills.
  • Review state curriculum and instructional materials and recommend improvements where required.
  • Support the development of AI-enabled literacy products and classroom interventions.

Teacher Capacity Building

  • Design and support teacher training programmes, Training of Trainers (ToT), and professional development modules.
  • Develop coaching and mentoring resources for teachers, academic mentors, and school leaders.
  • Facilitate teacher training, workshops, and academic capacity-building sessions.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with State Education Departments, SCERTs, DIETs, Samagra Shiksha, and district officials to support implementation.
  • Provide technical inputs during government consultations, curriculum reviews, and implementation planning.
  • Support integration of Wadhwani AI's literacy solutions into government education systems.

Assessment, Monitoring & Learning

  • Support the design and validation of literacy assessments and classroom observation tools.
  • Analyze student learning and assessment data to identify trends and inform program improvements.
  • Contribute to monitoring frameworks, dashboards, and implementation quality standards.

Program Implementation

  • Provide academic support during pilot implementation and state deployments.
  • Conduct field visits to schools and provide implementation guidance to state teams.
  • Identify implementation challenges and recommend course corrections.

Product & Content Development

  • Collaborate with Product, AI, and Engineering teams to develop technology-enabled literacy solutions.
  • Review and validate digital learning content for pedagogical quality and learner engagement.
  • Support the development of adaptive and AI-assisted literacy interventions.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Document implementation learnings, case studies, and best practices.
  • Contribute to reports, presentations, technical documentation, and donor updates.
  • Support development of knowledge resources for internal and external stakeholders.


Requirements

Education

  • Master's degree in Education, Literacy Education, Language Education, Curriculum & Instruction, Linguistics, English, Hindi, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Language, Linguistics, English, Hindi, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in foundational literacy, language education, curriculum development, teacher professional development, or education program implementation.
  • Experience working with government education systems, including State Education Departments, SCERTs, DIETs, or large-scale education programs.
  • Experience designing literacy curricula, teaching-learning materials, teacher training programs, and assessment frameworks.

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Strong understanding of NEP 2020, NIPUN Bharat, FLN, and competency-based education.
  • Sound knowledge of evidence-based reading instruction, multilingual education, language development, and literacy pedagogy.
  • Familiarity with literacy assessments, monitoring and evaluation, and remediation approaches.
  • Understanding of EdTech, AI-enabled learning solutions, or digital education products is desirable.

Skills

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to interpret student learning data and translate insights into program improvements.
  • Strong writing, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across Program, Product, AI, Engineering, and Government stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across project locations.

title: Downer T&I Cadet Program 2027 - Maintenance & ITS
description:
Downer is committed to developing the next generation of industry leaders. Our Transport & Infrastructure Cadet Program offers first and second year university students the opportunity to gain hands-on industry experience while completing their studies.

We are looking for a motivated university student to join our 2027 Cadet Program, initially commencing their first placement with our Regional Maintenance & ITS team in Victoria. Through structured rotations across Downer's Transport & Infrastructure business, you'll gain practical experience, develop industry skills, and build a strong foundation for your future career.

Our cadet program offers:

  • Paid placement aligned to your degree
  • Structured rotations across multiple teams
  • Full-time summer work, with optional casual work during semesters
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Opportunities across Australia


About the Cadet Program

Our Cadet Program is designed to give first and second year undergraduate students meaningful industry experience while completing their studies.

Over the course of the program, you'll gain exposure to different areas of Downer's Transport & Infrastructure business through a series of structured placements. These rotations are designed to broaden your understanding of the infrastructure industry, develop practical skills aligned to your field of study, and provide insight into the diverse career opportunities available within Downer.

The program typically runs for three years and includes a compulsory block of full-time work during the summer university break, with opportunities for casual work throughout the academic year. Throughout the program, you'll gain hands-on experience, work alongside experienced professionals, and contribute to live projects across the business.

Placements may include:

  • Onsite contracting projects with delivery crews
  • Project engineering and management
  • Contract and commercial management
  • Asphalt production
  • Major infrastructure projects (e.g., airports)
  • Laboratory testing and innovation
  • Finance and business operations


When does the Program commence?

Our Cadet Induction is scheduled for Monday 30th November and Tuesday 1st December 2026, kicking off the first structured rotation. All successful candidates must be available for this mandatory Induction.


Program eligibility

  • You must be available on Monday 30th November and Tuesday 1st December 2026 for the Cadet Induction.
  • You must be available for full-time work from the Induction days through to late February 2027 prior to the recommencement of university semester - note: you must be available for full-time work for the same period each subsequent year of the Cadet Program (i.e. late November to late February).
  • You must have permanent working rights in Australia.
  • You must hold a current Australian Driver’s Licence.
  • You must be enrolled in your first or second year of an undergraduate degree, studying in discipline/s of:
    • Engineering
    • Finance (Accounting)
    • Commerce
    • Occupational Health & Safety
    • Science


What we look for

Key competencies assessed through our recruitment process include:

  • Self awareness
  • Resilience and the ability to embrace change
  • Ability to learn and apply new learning quickly
  • Willingness to work within a team
  • Organisation skills
  • Problem solving, you love to think outside the square!
  • Communication skills


How we hire

Applications for the Cadet Program will close on Friday 18th September 2026. If you’re successful in progressing to the next stage of the recruitment process, our team will be in contact with you.

Candidates selected to progress through the recruitment process. Including:

  • Participating in interviews (video and face-to-face).
  • Provide university transcripts.
  • Complete a pre-employment medical.
  • Share professional references.


Downer Group is an employer that acknowledges and embraces the importance of our people's diverse experiences, talents, and cultures. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from everyone.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Mäntylän ryhmäkoti
description:
Sairaanhoitaja, miltä tuntuisi tehdä työtä, jossa tiedät olevasi tärkeä toiselle ihmiselle? Tule tekemään merkityksellistä työtä meille Mäntylän ryhmäkotiin! Mäntylän ryhmäkoti on yhdeksän ikääntyvän kehitysvammaisen henkilö koti, jossa henkilökunta on paikalla ympäri vuorokauden.

Haemme sairaanhoitajaa vahvistamaan tiimiämme 1.10.2026 alkaen.

Mitä työ meillä on?

Työ vammaispalveluissa on vaihtelevaa, elämänmakuista ja meillä yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen. Meillä pääset käyttämään monipuolista osaamistasi. Ja toisaalta, jos olet vasta aloittamassa sairaanhoitajan töitä, niin meillä pääset oppimaan uutta joka päivä ja kartuttamaan osaamistasi. Tukenasi on työkaverisi ja esihenkilösi sekä lisäksi myös koko vammaispalvelujen laaja sairaanhoitajien verkosto. Pääset tekemään yhteistyötä mm. terveyspalvelujen, sosiaalityön, terapeuttien, edunvalvonnan sekä erilaisten tukipalvelujen kanssa. Meillä on mukava porukka varmistamassa, että sinä onnistut työssäsi ja asiakkaamme saavat heille kuuluvan palvelun.

Työ on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä, mutta toivomme sinulta valmiutta myös ilta-, viikonloppu- ja yötyöhön.

Millaista työtä pääset tekemään?

- toimit tiimin sairaanhoidollisena asiantuntijana ja vastaat hoidon suunnittelusta yhdessä ohjaajiemme kanssa
- osallistut asiakkaiden päivittäiseen perushoitoon ja seuraat asiakkaiden vointia ja arvioit hoidon tarpeita
- toteutat sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä sekä lääkehoitoa
- huolehdit hoidon laadusta, turvallisuudesta ja asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn tukemisesta
- teet yhteistyötä eri yhteistyötahojen kanssa varmistaen asiakaslähtöisen ja näyttöön perustuvan hoidon
- osallistut aktiivisesti toiminnan kehittämiseen ja henkilöstön osaamisen vahvistamiseen, mm. lääkehoidon osalta
- lisäksi toimit toisen asumisyksikön sairaanhoidollisena asiantuntijana, osallistuen turvallisen lääkehoidon toteuttamiseen organisaation ohjeiden mukaisesti, mm. lääkenäyttöjä vastaanottamalla.

Me kuuntelemme ja arvostamme toisiamme ja teemme asioita yhdessä. Oletpa kokenut konkari tai vasta-alkaja, me perehdytämme sinut tehtävääsi. Periaatteemme on, että emme kaada kaikkea tietoa kerralla vaan kerromme asiat sitä mukaan kuin on tarpeellista.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Tärkeimmät asiat, mitä odotamme sinulta, on innostus ja halu tehdä töitä juuri vammaispalveluissa.

Toivomme myös, että:
sinulla on kykyä ja halua joustaa, jos tilanne niin vaatii
pystyt näkemään yksittäiset asiat osana kokonaisuutta ja osaat asettaa asiat tärkeysjärjestykseen
olet empaattinen ja säteilet ympärillesi lämpöä, olet eloisa, positiivinen ja auttavainen sekä että sinulla on huumorintajua.

Haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten älä epäröi laittaa hakemusta meille.

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn lisäksi laajat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea vuokra-asuntoa Auroranlinnalta, jonka asunnot ovat markkinatasoa edullisempia ja työntekijöidemme asuntohakemukset etusijalla.

Koska elämä ei ole pelkkää työtä, meillä huolehditaan myös työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainosta. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden sisältäen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Etua voi saada korkeintaan 550 euroa kalenterivuodelta. Käytettävissä oleva saldo määräytyy työsuhteesi pituuden perusteella. Lisäksi käytettävissäsi on lounasetu. Saat käyttöösi henkilöstöetuna myös kaupunkipyörän ja voit halutessasi vierailla kaupungin työntekijöiden omalla virkistyssaarella.

Kelpoisuusehto:

Sairaanhoitajan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai aiempi opistotason tutkinto tai erikoissairaanhoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhoitajan tai kätilön tutkinto, johon sisältyy laillistus sairaanhoitajaksi.

Tehtävässä edellytetään terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain (559/1994, 1200/2007) mukaista laillistusta Suomessa.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsuhteen alkamista esitettävä työnantajalle huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään LOP/LOVe LOP-lääkeluvan hyväksytty suorittaminen viimeistään koeajan kuluessa.

Tehtävässä edellytetään vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Luemme eduksi:

- kokemuksen kehitysvammaisten kanssa työskentelystä
- Apotti-osaamisen

title: Cell Culture Modality Leader Central and SoutheastUS
description:
Be part of something altogether life-changing!

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. With associates across 40+ countries, Cytiva is a place where every day is a learning opportunity – so you can grow your career and expand your skills in the long term.

Forming part of the Biotechnology segment at Danaher, we bring together dedicated technical expertise and talent to develop the next generation of life-changing therapeutics.

Cell Culture Commercial Modality Leader Central US

Location: Remote within territory with travel required for customer engagement, team leadership, and business support.

Accelerate the Future of Biotherapeutics

At Cytiva, our vision is to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery. Our technologies, expertise, and people help accelerate the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies worldwide.

As a Commercial Leader for Mammalian Cell Culture, you will drive growth in one of the most critical and fastest-growing areas of bioprocessing. You will lead a team of Cell Culture Sales Specialists and Field Application Scientists, helping customers succeed through innovative media, supplements, and process liquid solutions.

This role is ideal for a commercial leader who combines scientific knowledge, strategic thinking, and customer focus to drive business growth and accelerate therapeutic innovation.

What You Will Do

Lead and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to Cell Culture Sales Specialists and Field Application Scientists.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop talent and capabilities that support long-term growth.

Drive Commercial Growth

  • Execute the mammalian cell culture commercial strategy across media, supplements, and process liquids.
  • Deliver and exceed sales and order objectives through effective planning, pipeline management, and business development.
  • Identify new opportunities aligned with customer process development and manufacturing goals.

Partner with Customers and the Business

  • Build trusted relationships with biotechnology, vaccine, and biopharmaceutical customers.
  • Support customer initiatives including process development, manufacturing optimization, facility expansions, technology transfers, and capital projects.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Cytiva, BioProcess, GenMed, Discovery & Medical, and Biotechnology Integrated Solutions to deliver integrated customer solutions.
  • Partner with marketing, applications, product management, and leadership teams to execute growth strategies.

Shape the Future of Bioprocessing

  • Serve as a commercial and technical leader for upstream mammalian cell culture technologies.
  • Monitor industry trends and emerging modalities to identify growth opportunities.
  • Apply data-driven problem solving and continuous improvement principles to accelerate results.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field; MBA a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in Biotehcnology/Biopharma or life sciences.
  • Proven success leading teams and driving growth in complex matrix organizations.
  • Strong understanding of upstream bioprocessing from R&D through commercial manufacturing.
  • Experience supporting process development, manufacturing optimization, facility expansions, technology transfers, and capital investments.
  • Consultative sales experience using Miller Heiman, SPIN, or similar methodologies.
  • Skilled at building executive relationships, influencing stakeholders, and leading cross-functional collaboration.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, strategic planning, and Lean problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce.com (SFDC) experience.
  • Knowledge of Danaher Business System (DBS).
  • Expertise in mammalian cell culture media, customized formulations, and upstream bioprocessing technologies.
  • Experience supporting biologics and vaccine manufacturing from development through commercial production.

Why Join Cytiva?

You will have the opportunity to influence the future of biotechnology, lead a talented team, drive business growth, and help customers deliver therapies that improve and save lives worldwide.

At Cytiva we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cytiva can provide.

The base salary range for this role is $130,000-$160,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

title: Technical Superintendent
description:
Make your mark as technical superintendent at our Abu Dhabi branch office by making the rolling forecast for project vessels repairs. Our technical superintendent will make sure that all work orders are up to date so that the maintenance cell can have the right information at the right time for long-term maintenance planning.

You will be working from our Abu Dhabi office and will be part of our Middle East technical team. Responsible for day-to-day operations of the vessels by implementing and maintaining a safe, cost efficient and environmentally sound operation. You will be required to prepare dry-dockings and carry out regular inspections of the vessels to ensure compliance with regulations.

It is essential for technical superintendent to have the ability to work in a planned and independent way. You must have an eye for detail, but you should certainly never lose sight of the bigger picture.

Your responsibilities as a technical superintendent are:

  • The primary focus of this role is the preparation, engineering, scoping, and work package development of repair and maintenance projects. Participation in project execution and attendance during repairs or dry-dockings is secondary and will be determined based on project complexity, business needs, and resource requirements.
  • Lead the preparation and engineering of planned and unplanned maintenance, repair, modification, and docking projects across the fleet, ensuring all technical, operational, and commercial requirements are clearly defined prior to execution.
  • Conduct vessel inspections and technical assessments to identify repair requirements, verify compliance with statutory, class, and company requirements, and develop optimized repair scopes and execution strategies.
  • Develop tender-ready work packages, work orders, and technical specifications, including scope definitions, repair methodologies, material requirements, acceptance criteria, risk assessments, cost estimates, and schedule inputs.
  • Coordinate project preparation activities between vessel teams, shipyards, suppliers, contractors, classification societies, OEMs, and internal stakeholders to ensure project readiness and successful execution.
  • Act as the technical focal point during project preparation, providing technical support, troubleshooting, and specialist guidance to Fleet Teams and execution teams as required.
  • Manage technical and commercial interfaces with shipyards and contractors, including planning assumptions, schedules, quotations, technical clarifications, tender evaluations, and scope alignment.
  • Promote and embed Safety throughout project preparation and execution by applying Risk Assessments, Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Work Methods, Toolbox Talks, Yes-Scan principles, and visible safety leadership.
  • Support and, where required, participate in repair and docking execution activities, monitoring safety, quality, progress, costs, and technical performance while ensuring adherence to the engineered scope and agreed objectives.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation and reporting, including scope development, project readiness reviews, technical evaluations, budgets, lessons learned, and stakeholder updates.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of docking, repair, and maintenance processes by collaborating with Planning, Cost Estimating, SHE-Q, Procurement, and other specialist disciplines.
  • Maintain and actively promote Boskalis' SHEQ standards, NINA principles, and corporate values throughout all activities.

Your qualities
You can make your mark as technical superintendent engineer if you have:

  • A vocational or higher vocational degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture or a similar technical discipline;
  • Experience as a Technical Superintendent, Chief Engineer, Works Manager, Project Manager, Yard Manager, Repair Superintendent, or in a comparable technical role within the maritime, dredging, offshore, or ship repair industry;
  • Experience preparing and executing dry-dockings, repair and maintenance projects;
  • Strong technical knowledge of vessel machinery, systems and equipment;
  • Experience working with shipyards, suppliers and contractors;
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to balance operational requirements with cost-effective solutions;
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SMMS;
  • Knowledge of relevant safety, environmental and quality standards;
  • A good command of written and spoken English;
  • Willingness to travel regularly and irregular to vessels, shipyards and project locations worldwide.

What you can expect

  • Career opportunities: We challenge you every day to get better. Together we realize your full personal and professional career by creating development opportunities.
  • Warm welcome: We warmly welcome our new colleagues, so they feel at home as soon as possible. During your online onboarding program, we give you all the ins and outs of Boskalis!
  • Career development: Plenty of opportunities to realize your full potential. Challenge yourself with (online) courses in our Boskalis academy.

Extra information

  • Your team: You will be part of the technical team based in Abu Dhabi.
  • Full/part-time job: The function of a Technical Superintendent is a fulltime position.
  • Procedure: All you need to do to apply for a job is to complete the online application form and send it to us along with your CV and cover letter. As soon as you have sent your application, you will receive a confirmation email. Depending on the job, we will invite you for two or more interviews via Microsoft Teams or at our office. If both sides are happy to proceed after interviews, we will make you an offer to join Boskalis. After successfully completing all the steps in the procedure, we warmly welcome you to our organization.

We’ll be happy to answer your questions about the position of Technical Superintendent. Please contact Catherine Buenaagua, corporate recruiter via our careers page.

Interested? Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.

Disclaimer for recruitment and selection agencies
We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions

title: Intern
description:
Job Summary

Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.​

The role is based in Melbourne, Australia (onsite role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

  • Prepare and test beverage samples using different recipes and processing conditions.
  • Evaluate coffee application performance, including barista-related attributes such as foam quality, stability, and sensory characteristics.
  • Record experimental data and summarize trial results.
  • Support laboratory and pilot plant activities, including sample preparation and equipment clean-up.
  • Collaborate with the Application team to analyze findings and recommend formulation improvements.
  • Prepare a final internship report and deliver a presentation summarizing project outcomes and key learnings.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Why Choose Us?

  • Hands-on experience in plant-based beverage formulation and application development.
  • Exposure to pilot plant operations and product evaluation techniques.
  • Opportunity to work with experienced food scientists and application specialists.
  • Practical project experience through final report and presentation delivery.

For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. title: Principal .Net Engineer (Azure Data Factory+Angular)
description:
Principal Software Engineer
Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Hybrid, 3 Days WFO (Cab Facility Provided)

Job Description

With 54 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.

Behind the scenes, BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications like Eurofins Quality Management System(eQMS). eQMS is sophisticated web application that will be used by our scientists, engineers, and technicians to manage several quality and compliance management processes.

This role reports to an Engineering Manager and is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable full stack applications using Angular, .NET Core, and Azure Cosmos DB, with additional involvement in Azure Data Factory-based integrations and data migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack web applications using Angular, .NET Core, Web API, and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly front-end components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern UI development practices.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and maintainable backend services using .NET Core, REST APIs, microservices principles, and cloud-native design patterns.
  • Design and optimize Cosmos DB data models, queries, partitioning strategies, and performance patterns for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, business analysts, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality application features.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Contribute to CI/CD, release readiness, application support, defect resolution, and production stabilization activities.
  • Support responsibilities related to Azure Data Factory pipelines, data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and integration activities.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and promote clean code, secure development, and maintainable architecture practices.

Technical Skills & Experience

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Operations team as a package handler.

Who we are:
FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. Join us and let's write our next chapter together.

• Employee reduced-rate shipping
• Great career opportunities
• FedEx is one of the worlds most admired companies and trusted brands year after year

Bring your ideas, individuality, and dreams to our global community. Feel good about where you work. Choose your career path - we’re ready to invest in your development. Join FedEx.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce in which we provide growth opportunities for all

Our Company
FedEx Express is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

Our Philosophy
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people.
Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

Our Culture
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Business Controller to Atlas Copco
description:
Do you want to work in the intersection between finance and production? We are looking for an Business Controller to join us at the Tierp Works finance department.

Tierp Works is the main production plant for the Motor Vehicle and General Industry divisions of Atlas Copco Industrial Technique. The plant consists of a machining workshop, final tool assembly, and a special production workshop. Among our 500 employees are the diverse skills, expertise, and support functions needed to run such a complex operation.

Mission

You will work together with and report to the Tierp Works Business Controller but also closely cooperate with the rest of the Product Company finance team and the wider Tierp Works organization.

You will actively participate in the continuous development towards a well-structured, resilient, and efficient finance department with low waste processes and a sustainable working environment. In preparing accurate, relevant, and timely business & financial analysis to support general management and assembly management in making effective business decisions.

You will over time gain the necessary understanding of Atlas Copco processes to assist in larger systems development projects. You will also identify opportunities for improvement and development within the systems. You will be part of our digitalization journey and will get the opportunity to drive digitalization projes to work even more efficiently.

The Business Controller will also actively participate and understand, assembly´s operations and operational supply chain and both our own and our customers’ requirements. Factory visits and close support for our people in production are therefore critical to getting a holistic view of our operations and the needs of the business.

We offer:

  • An international manufacturing setting with a broad contact network

  • A business controlling environment with opportunities for learning and development

  • A role that combines process improvement with technical operation controlling and high-level accounting and reporting.

At Atlas Copco we have a friendly, family-like atmosphere and a culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behavior, and integrity. We offer plenty of opportunities to grow and develop, as well as potential to see your ideas realized and make an impact. You have plenty of occasions to international interaction and, as part of the Atlas Copco Group, you also have access to global job opportunities.

Experience requirements

A university degree in Business Administration and a couple of years (or more) of experience from similar role with a good understanding of financial controlling. Since we are an international company, you need to have good level of English, both written and spoken. To be successful, you will also need:

  • Excellent Excel skills

  • Experience from ERP systems is an advantage and SAP more specifically.

  • Experience from Microsoft Power BI is an advantage.

  • Experience from Business Intelligence systems is an advantage.

  • Accounting skills

  • Good analytical capability and a concern for quality and accuracy

Who are we looking for?

To be successful in this role you have strong communication skills and have an open-minded and inclusive approach to people. You can build and maintain a structured workplace that enables efficiency in reoccurring tasks and flexibility for ad-hoc requests. As a person you are curious, unpretentious, and like to explore the underlying causes of events and results.

Location & On-Site Requirement

The office is in Tierp, Sweden. To develop a strong understanding of the production environment and work closely with the operations team, the role is fully on-site. Working from the office full time is therefore a requirement.

description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme ammattitaitoista ja oma-aloitteista kirvesmiestä Kuusamoon pitkäkestoiseen rakennusprojektiin.

Työmaa käynnistyy perustustöillä, jonka jälkeen rakennuskohde etenee hirsirungon rakentamiseen ja muihin yleisiin rakennusvaiheisiin eli pääset olemaan työmaalla heti alusta asti. Tarjolla on monipuolista tekemistä tekijälle, jolla pysyy työkalut kädessä ja rakentamisen kokonaisuus hallussa.

Töitä on alustavasti vuoden loppuun asti, joten tässä on hyvä mahdollisuus päästä mukaan pitkäkestoiseen projektiin.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Kirvesmiehen tehtävät määräytyvät työmaan etenemisen mukaan. Työ voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
-Perustuksiin liittyviä kirvesmiehen töitä
-Runkotöitä ja hirsirungon rakentamiseen liittyviä tehtäviä
-Erilaisia muotti- ja levytystöitä
-Kattorakenteisiin liittyviä töitä
-Mittaamista ja materiaalien työstämistä
-Muita yleisiä rakennus- ja kirvesmiehen tehtäviä

Etsimme ennen kaikkea monipuolista rakentajaa, joka ei tarvitse jokaiseen työvaiheeseen valmista kädestä pitäen -ohjausta.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Tärkeintä on, että sinulta löytyy yleistä rakentamisen osaamista ja kykyä tehdä töitä itsenäisesti.

Sinulta odotamme:
-Useamman vuoden kokemusta kirvesmiehen tehtävistä
-Monipuolista rakentamisen osaamista
-Hyvää kuvienlukutaitoa ja kykyä tehdä työt piirustusten perusteella
-Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta
-Huolellisuutta ja hyvää työnjälkeä
-Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana työryhmää
-Sitoutumista työturvalliseen työskentelyyn

Hirsirakentamisen aikaisempi kokemus on etu, mutta tärkeämpää on vahva yleinen rakentamisen osaaminen.

Myös reissumiehelle mahdollisuus!

Ensisijaisesti haemme paikallista tekijää Kuusamon alueelta, mutta paikka sopii myös reissutyöntekijälle.

Reissupaikan osalta huomioimme lähtökohtaisesti työntekijät enintään 300 kilometrin etäisyydeltä Kuusamosta.

Reissaajalle tarjoamme:
-Majoituksen
-Päivärahat

Myös esimerkiksi Oulusta on mahdollista lähteä projektiin reissutyönä.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Töitä alustavasti vuoden loppuun asti
Monipuolisen rakennusprojektin
Mahdollisuuden päästä tekemään töitä hirsirakenteisen kohteen parissa
Reissutyöntekijälle majoituksen ja päivärahat
Reilun palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan
Laadukkaat työvarusteet ja turvallisen työympäristön
Bolt.Worksin toimihenkilön tuen koko työsuhteen ajan

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos olet monipuolinen kirvesmies, osaat lukea piirustuksia ja haluat päästä tekemään kunnollista rakennustyötä pitkässä projektissa, laita hakemus tulemaan!

title: Workers Compensation Consultant
description:
Company:

Marsh

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Workers Compensation team at Marsh. This role will be based in our Sydney office in Barangaroo. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office (one of these days on a client site).

This role provides outsourced return-to-work and claims consulting services to Marsh clients. You will work closely with injured workers, employers, insurers and internal colleagues to manage claims, develop return-to-work plans and support injury management outcomes. The role also involves reporting, stakeholder liaison and administration across selected client accounts.

We will count on you to:

  • Provide outsourced return-to-work and claims consulting services to Marsh clients
  • Triaging and lodging new claims and supporting the administration of injury management matters
  • Develop and maintain return-to-work plans and support employers to meet return-to-work obligations
  • Liaise with injured workers, employers, insurers and other stakeholders to provide updates and manage claims activity
  • Measure and track claim outcomes
  • Prepare reports, invoices, correspondence and other documentation, and maintain files, databases and spreadsheets
  • Support workers compensation payroll and wage reimbursements where required

What you need to have:

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Well-developed attention to detail and accuracy
  • Tier 1 compliance, which will be required and facilitated by Marsh on commencement

What makes you stand out:

  • Experience as a RTW Coordinator or Occupational Rehabilitation Provider (desired)
  • Tertiary qualifications in allied health (desired)
  • Experience in workers compensation, claims management or injury management systems such as SolvInjury or DoneSafe
  • Experience supporting payroll, wage reimbursements or invoice processing

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being

Applications can be considered from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia. Successful applicants will be required to complete a criminal & bankruptcy check prior to commencement of employment.

Marsh Risk is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Marsh Risk, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applications will only be considered from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia. Successful applicants will be required to complete a Criminal & Bankruptcy check prior to commencing of employment.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Team Leader Visstid & Vikariat
description:
Vill du bli vår framtida retailstjärna?
Letar du efter en arbetsplats där du kan växa, utvecklas och bygga en karriär inom en dynamisk bransch? Vill du ha ett spännande jobb i en social och aktiv miljö? Hos oss är utveckling mer än bara ett ord – det är en del av vår kultur. Hos oss jobbar du i en inspirerande och energifylld miljö. Join the Movement!

Stadium erbjuder dig:

  • Ett meningsfullt jobb: Vi är ett familjeföretag som har vuxit till att bli en av Nordens största sportkedjor. Vi når resultat tillsammans genom engagemang, energi, innovation och enkelhet. Vi erbjuder dig en plats i vårt team, där du får möjligheten att växa och bli en del av vår mission: Att inspirera till en aktivt liv för alla!
  • Personlig utveckling: Vi erbjuder en tydlig personlig utvecklingsplan. Du kan utvecklas från Team Leader till roller som butikschef, regionchef eller varför inte en karriär på något av våra Servicekontor.
  • Gemenskap och glädje: Vi är ett sammansvetsat team som arbetar för att nå resultat – och har kul på vägen! Vi anordnar aktiviteter som stärker gemenskapen både på och utanför jobbet. Två gånger per år anordnar vi vår Staff Challenge, där alla team som vill tränar och tävlar tillsammans under några intensiva veckor.

Vad innebär jobbet som Team Leader på Stadium?

Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna till Stadium, de ska bli inbjudna till en kundupplevelse runt hela löparbanan - en upplevelse som kännetecknas av service i världsklass.

Som Team Leader är du en tydlig sidekick till butikschefen, där ni tillsammans driver våra kärnprocesser för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för den totala kundupplevelsen. Det gör du genom att coacha, ge feedback och kontinuerligt utveckla övrig personal i butiken. Vi tycker att förändring är positivt och vi ser att du har ett affärsmässigt ledarskap där du driver försäljningen mot budgeterade mål och nyckeltal. Planering, rekrytering och schemaläggning tillhör vardagen. Du ingår i ledningsgruppen och är ansvarig för butiken när butikschefen inte är på plats.

Vi tror att nyckeln till framgång ligger i hur vi som medarbetare trivs på jobbet och vilken atmosfär vi skapar i butiken. Där har du en nyckelroll att genom god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga, nyfikenhet och energi skapa en positiv och inspirerande arbetsmiljö med våra värderingar i centrum. Då bidrar du också till butikens och hela företagets framgång.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som har en brinnande passion för sport och försäljning och motiveras av att se andra lyckas. Ditt sätt att leda har fokus på coachning och feedback. Du har 1–2 års tidigare erfarenhet från försäljning i butik och goda digitala kunskaper och erfarenhet av att jobba med MS Office-paketet. Om du tidigare har jobbat i en ledande befattning inom detaljhandeln är det meriterande.

Du är en lagspelare som trivs i en operativ roll, på golvet tillsammans med kollegor och kunder. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är drivande, självgående och med innovativa, enkla sätt ständigt vill utveckla dig själv och verksamheten, vilket bidrar till en kundupplevelse i världsklass.

Vi värdesätter personliga egenskaper som hög samarbetsförmåga, att du är lyhörd och lösningsorienterad, samt har god kommunikationsförmåga både internt med medarbetare, externt med leverantörer, samarbetspartners och våra kunder.

För rollen krävs att du kan göra dig förstådd på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Läs mer om vårt lag på vår Karriärsida, på Instagram eller på Linkedin.

Klicka på länken här för att komma till ett av våra poddavsnitt och på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium.

Varaktighet/arbetstid Tjänsten är på 75% med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan Som en del i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du att få en inbjudan till din e-mail till att besvara ett personlighetstest och ett kapacitetstest. Det tar ca 30 minuter att besvara testen. Vi kommunicerar mestadels genom mail så se till att hålla koll på din inkorg, håll även koll på skräpposten för säkerhets skull.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt, är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Come join the movement!

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Principal Software Engineer
Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Hybrid, 3 Days WFO (Cab Facility Provided)

Job Description

With 54 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.

Behind the scenes, BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications like Eurofins Quality Management System(eQMS). eQMS is sophisticated web application that will be used by our scientists, engineers, and technicians to manage several quality and compliance management processes.

This role reports to an Engineering Manager and is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable full stack applications using Angular, .NET Core, and Azure Cosmos DB, with additional involvement in Azure Data Factory-based integrations and data migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack web applications using Angular, .NET Core, Web API, and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly front-end components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern UI development practices.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and maintainable backend services using .NET Core, REST APIs, microservices principles, and cloud-native design patterns.
  • Design and optimize Cosmos DB data models, queries, partitioning strategies, and performance patterns for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, business analysts, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality application features.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Contribute to CI/CD, release readiness, application support, defect resolution, and production stabilization activities.
  • Support responsibilities related to Azure Data Factory pipelines, data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and integration activities.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and promote clean code, secure development, and maintainable architecture practices.

Technical Skills & Experience

Proven experience delivering full stack application development using Angular, .NET Core, and Azure Cosmos DB, with exposure to Azure Data Factory and enterprise data migration activities.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web application development.
  • Strong backend development experience using .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, RESTful services, and microservices-based architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Cosmos DB, including data modelling, indexing, partitioning, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Good understanding of SQL, NoSQL databases, cloud-native application design, integration patterns, and secure coding practices.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT concepts, data pipelines, data transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration frameworks.
  • Experience with unit testing, code quality tools, debugging, application performance optimization, and production issue resolution.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments with strong collaboration across engineering, QA, DevOps, and business teams.
  • Good communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Key Competencies

  • Strong full stack engineering mindset with ownership across front-end, backend, database, and integration layers.
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills for complex application and data-related issues.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across business and technology functions.
  • High attention to detail with a strong focus on application quality, performance, security, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Passion for building scalable, reliable, and high-quality enterprise applications using modern cloud technologies.

MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

Personal Skills:

  • Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude;
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
  • Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
  • Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
  • Structured and clear writing skills;
  • Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
  • Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player.

PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.
