title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
1.Role Purpose

As a Senior Automation Engineer for the manufacturing plant, this position is responsible for the technical support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of plant control systems. The role requires a solid understanding of ISA-95 architecture to ensure seamless system integration and optimization. The engineer will solve complex production process control challenges through advanced automation technologies (DCS/PLC/SCADA), ensuring high availability, data integrity, and compliance of production systems, particularly under GxP compliance requirements in biopharmaceutical media production environments.

2. Key Responsibilities

● Architecture & Design: Based on ISA-95 standards, lead the design, development, and deployment of plant automation architecture (IT/OT convergence) to ensure system scalability and security.

● System Management: Responsible for engineering design and maintenance of mainstream control systems, must be proficient in at least one mainstream DCS (e.g., ABB 800xA) or PLC (e.g., Siemens S7-1500/300/400) system hardware architecture, control principles, and programming (Ladder Logic, SCL, FBD).

● Hands-on experience in diagnosing and resolving complex OT system issues:on the shop floor, including troubleshooting PLC control loops, identifying root causes of equipment malfunctions, and restoring production continuity with minimal downtime.

● Technical Leadership: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in automation to provide daily technical support to production departments, solve complex equipment, process, and material issues, conduct root cause analysis , and implement corrective and preventive actions.

● Project Technical Support: Provide expert technical oversight during the installation, commissioning, and qualification (including FAT/SAT/IQ/OQ) of equipment and production lines, ensuring technical compliance and smooth handover for daily operations.

● Compliance & Data Integrity: Ensure all automation systems comply with biopharmaceutical industry regulations (e.g., GAMP, 21 CFR Part 11), guaranteeing data integrity and traceability of production processes.

● Personnel Development: Provide advanced training to operators and technicians to enhance team capabilities in operating and maintaining new equipment and processes.

3.Experiences/Education - Required

● Education: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related engineering fields.

● Experience: Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on automation engineering experience in manufacturing environments, with a preference for candidates with experience from biopharmaceutical, life sciences, or fine chemical industries.

● Technical Skills:

○ In-depth understanding of automation pyramid and ISA-95 architecture.

○ Must be proficient in at least one mainstream control system:

■ DCS: Proficient in ABB systems (e.g.,800xA) configuration, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

■ PLC: Proficient in Siemens systems (e.g., Step 7, TIA Portal) programming and architecture.

○ Extensive hands-on field commissioning and troubleshooting experience, capable of independently resolving complex control loop and communication issues.

● Industry Background: Experience with automation systems in bioreactors, chromatography systems, or resin media production lines is preferred.

4.Experiences/Education - Desired

● Possess shift supervisory experience and ability to adapt to shift support requirements in production environments.

● Cross-functional Communication: Strong experience in coordinating with cross-departmental teams and providing technical leadership within project groups.

title: BIM Projectcoördinator
description:
Geef vorm aan de toekomst van onze complexe infrastructuurprojecten bij Boskalis Nederland.

Als BIM Projectcoördinator richt je de projectomgeving in en zorg je voor het soepel laten verlopen van integrale projecten binnen het ontwerpteam. Je begeleidt ontwerpsessies en het stap voor stap efficiënter maken van het projectproces is daarbij essentieel. Je vindt het leuk om het 3D‑coördinatiemodel op te zetten en verschillende disciplines samen te brengen. Dit model gebruik je om het integrale ontwerp te ondersteunen en via issues actueel te houden. Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt en vervult daarmee een signalerende en faciliterende rol binnen de projectorganisatie. Ga het maar doen!

Je komt terecht in een jong team van BIM Projectcoördinatoren & 4D BIM Coördinatoren binnen het Cluster Geografisch Ontwerp, waar je samenwerkt met waterbouw-, weg- en constructief ontwerpers. Binnen dit team draag je niet alleen bij aan projecten, maar werk je ook mee aan innovaties op het gebied van data-integratie en automatisering om het ontwerpproces continu te verbeteren. Spreekt dit je aan? Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou!

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit:

Als BIM Projectcoördinator heb je een proactieve houding en zorg je voor een soepele en continue afstemming tussen de verschillende disciplines (bijvoorbeeld bruggenbouw). Je schakelt makkelijk tussen stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen aangesloten blijft en dezelfde koers volgt. Daarbij neem je initiatief, signaleer je knelpunten tijdig en anticipeer je op wat het project nodig heeft om efficiënt door te kunnen blijven lopen.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het inrichten van het modelmanagementsysteem, het opstellen van werkafspraken voor informatielevering en het uitvoeren van clashdetectie.

Concreet betekent dit dat je je gaat bezighouden met:

  • Het coördineren en vastleggen van afspraken in het BIM‑uitvoeringsplan en het actueel houden hiervan in samenspraak met de informatiemanager, ontwerpleider en hoofdontwerper. Als rechterhand van de ontwerpleider zie je erop toe dat deze afspraken worden nageleefd.

  • Het volgen van marktontwikkelingen op het gebied van 3D‑ontwerp en modelcoördinatie, het onderzoeken van behoeften binnen de organisatie en het bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het cluster.

Dit maakt jouw toekomstige collega trots....

"Integraal samenwerken geeft mij dagelijks energie. Door ontwerp en uitvoering te verbinden, werk ik samen aan sterke resultaten. Ik krijg het vertrouwen en de ruimte om kansen te benutten en richting te geven, waardoor ik me continu ontwikkel, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Een plek waar ik mij echt betrokken voel en graag deel van uitmaak."

Marco, Vakgroephoofd Modelbeheer

Bekijk meer collega’s en projecten waar we trots op zijn! Boskalis job stories | Boskalis

Herken je jezelf hierin?

Herken jij jezelf in het onderstaande profiel en word je enthousiast van het begeleiden van ontwerpsessies en het stap voor stap efficiënter maken van het projectproces en vind je het leuk om het 3D‑coördinatiemodel op te zetten en verschillende disciplines samen te brengen en heb je:

  • Een afgeronde relevante hbo-opleiding.
  • Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring als modelleur, ontwerper of BIM-coördinator op integrale projecten.
  • Kennis van 3D-modelleersoftware, zoals Revit. - Je hebt ervaring met het samenbrengen van verschillende disciplines binnen een ontwerpproces.
  • Sterke communicatieve en coachende vaardigheden.
  • Onzettend veel zin om door Nederland te reizen en verschillende projectlocaties te bezoeken.

Jij helpt Nederland vooruit, wij jou

Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

  • Een 4‑wekelijkse uitbetaling van € 3374,-- tot € 5503,-- bij een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur). Je ontvangt maar liefst 13 betalingen per jaar.
  • 26 verlofdagen bij een fulltime dienstverband plús een variabel aantal roostervrije dagen per jaar. Daarnaast kun je extra vrije dagen bijkopen.
  • Een leaseauto.
  • Een laptop en telefoon.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waaraan Boskalis Nederland (grotendeels) meebetaalt zodat je netto meer salaris overhoudt.
  • Volop ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden. Denk aan opleidingen via onze eigen Boskalis Academy, Performance & Development-gesprekken én boeiende events – van webinars tot career-events met trainingen en collega’s die vertellen over hun loopbaanstappen binnen Boskalis.
  • Projecten op locaties door het hele land. De Boskalis-campus in Papendrecht is de uitvalsbasis – hier vind je restaurants, een sportveld mét wekelijkse sportlessen, een state-of-the-art auditorium, een hippe koffieplek én een prachtig uitzicht op onze eigen scheepskade.
  • Waardevolle ontmoetingen met collega’s. Bijvoorbeeld via netwerk- en kennissessies en andere events. Of de activiteiten van onze community’s, zoals Young Boskalis en Women@Boskalis.

Houd je inbox of telefoon in de gaten: binnen 5 dagen ontvang je een persoonlijke reactie.

title: Painter - 1st Shift
description:
About McNeilus, an Oshkosh Company

McNeilus Truck and Manufacturing Inc. is committed to serving everyday heroes and is an industry leading designer and manufacturer of refuse truck bodies. McNeilus produces a complete line of high-performance rear load, front load, and automated side load refuse bodies to augment any refuse collection fleet. Our team members are critical in our mission of supporting waste warriors and keeping communities safe and clean.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Painter is responsible for the application of paint and other coatings using electrostatic / air assist paint guns and other automotive type paint application devices on Company products including military spec paint. This position has the knowledge and skills to perform in any and each area of the paint process.

Pay Range: $20 - $28.34

YOUR IMAPCT:

These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.

  • Prime, paint, and touchup vehicles with power spray equipment and brushes. Flush tanks, hoses, and guns prior to color changeovers. Mix all types of paints for proper color, formula, conditions, viscosity, and consistency. Perform titrations and mix or adjust chemicals as needed.

  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment in compliance with safety procedures, rules, and proper 6S standards. Demonstrate best practices to follow all safe procedures in assembling and testing of all models/products in assigned job function.

  • Upkeep of work area and equipment which may include preventative maintenance tasks. Inspect product before, during, after paint process to ensure specifications are being met.

  • Sand, wash, and condition parts as necessary. Light bodywork may be required.

  • Inspection of completed parts for quality, validate components meet.

  • Team member has the knowledge and skills to perform in every area of the paint process.

  • Assist training new team members on processes and equipment functions.

  • Ability to start training to perform touch-up.

  • Participate in onboarding training and annual training related to being a hazardous waste handler as required by the EPA RCRA hazardous waste rules. This will include ability to understand what waste hazards are, storage time limits, satellite accumulation, marking, labeling, weekly inspections, aisle space, storage, manifest shipping, use and location of emergency equipment, response to spills and fires, evacuation routes, etc.

  • Disassemble, clean, repair, adjust and reassemble painting equipment, such as pumps, paint heaters, tanks, spray guns, etc. for proper operation (Repairs are only required in Dodge Center).

  • Apply decals, stencils, and rust-proofing as required (Dodge Center only).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Six (6) months of industrial painting experience or completion of internal paint training program or an evaluated equivalent.

  • Must be able to read checklists, paint codes, Safety logs, JSA's, SWI's etc.

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma or GED.

  • Automotive paint experience.

  • Willingness to train in multiple areas to obtain a Painter ll level Able to proficiently paint in single assigned area.

  • Able to proficiently paint in single assigned area.

  • Must be able to perform mill checks and readings and help with paint prep (Riceville only).

  • Able to perform fine line painting technique (Riceville only).

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Internal Contacts: Contact with peers and others involving explanation of information (these contacts may be within or outside department or division), and the gathering of factual information; may include the communication of sensitive or confidential information.

  • External Contacts: Limited external contact to: gather information, answer queries, or ask assistance.

  • Communication Skills: Read, write and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence and memos. Read and interpret safety rules, operating/maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Read, analyze and interpret business manuals, technical procedures and/or government regulations.

  • Decision-Making: Requires minimal decision-making responsibility.

  • Complexity, Judgment and Problem Solving: Work of a relatively routine nature. Requires the ability to understand the follow instructions.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Physical Demands: Frequent: Standing, Walking/Running, Sitting, Reaching, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing; Occasional: Climbing, Driving, Bending/Kneeling, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing, Fine Dexterity, Manual Dexterity; Upper Extremity Repetitive Motion, Lifting/Carrying 25lbs., Pushing/Pulling 25llbs.

  • Non-Physical Demands: Occasional: Analysis/Reasoning, Communication/Interpretation, Math/Mental Computation, Reading, Sustained Mental Activity (i.e. auditing, problem solving, grant writing, composing reports), Writing.

  • Environmental Demands: Occasional: Work Alone, Frequent Task Changes, Tedious/Exacting Work, Dust, Temperature Extremes, Loud Noises.

  • Work Schedule: Routine shift hours. Infrequent overtime, weekend, or shift rotation.

  • Demands/Deadlines: Occasional stress due to deadlines or workload because of intermittent or cyclical work pressures, or occasional exposure to distressed individuals within the immediate work environment.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About SiFive

As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits.

At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.

Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.

Are you ready?

To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.

Job Description:

The Role

This position is for a Technical Program Manager (TPM), within the Program Management Office (PMO) at SiFive. The primary charter for this group is to plan and manage the execution of processor core IP development programs from initial engineering scoping through product release. As a TPM at SiFive, you will work with engineers passionate about designing industry-leading CPU cores and the tools, software and infrastructure to realize that vision, as well as a product marketing team focused on bringing RISC-V to new markets. SiFive is a fast-paced, dynamic environment with lots of opportunities, and we are looking for people who are as excited as we are about bringing new IP and complete solutions to market predictably, quickly, and at a high level of quality. An ideal candidate will have experience with bringing processor IP to production, as well as familiarity with the software development and release process. Experience managing hardware development programs using AGILE methodology is a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders/technical leads in cross-functional teams to develop schedule, resourcing allocation, and overall plan to meet program goals.

  • Build a plan for effective execution, monitoring/tracking and identifying critical paths, program risks and issues, from planning through execution, delivery, and support phases.

  • Co-ordinate cross-functional group activities, track dependencies. Drive teams to meet schedules and goals.

  • Participate in technical discussions, be able to resolve high-level project issues.

  • Lead tasks, issues reporting and resolution.

  • Responsible for effective and consistent communication and reporting of overall program status.

  • Participate in developing, improving project, program management, and product life cycle processes.

Requirements:

  • Experience with CPU technology and associated software and tools development.

  • Ability to facilitate technical discussions and can drive engineering decisions.

  • Proficiency with Git/Github, JIRA, Confluence.

  • Excellent organization, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

  • Experience with project and program management tools and processes for effective, efficient planning and execution is a strong plus.

  • BS/MS degree in EE, CE, CS or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

Additional Information:

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

Taiwan

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Hygiene Coordinator
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

In the heart of Worli - the business hub of India’s largest city and close to the entertainment and commercial district of Lower Parel, Four Seasons Hotel Mumbai is a chic urban oasis with an intimate, boutique atmosphere. The brand's first hotel in India, Four Seasons Hotel Mumbai echoes 'Powerhouse Luxury' in the city that never sleeps. Known for unparalleled food & beverage options such as those at AER Mumbai, an award-winning rooftop bar, as well as San:Qi, a city-favourite pan-Asian restaurant with wine bar, private dining rooms, four open-style kitchens overseen by master craftsmen and an extensive menu offering Indian, Chinese, Thai and Japanese delicacies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Hygiene Standards & Compliance:

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive hygiene and sanitation standards across all hotel departments.

Conduct routine and surprise inspections to monitor compliance with hygiene policies and procedures.

Identify areas of concern, implement corrective actions, and follow up to ensure resolution.

Stay updated with industry best practices, emerging hygiene technologies, and regulatory changes.

2. Training & Awareness:

Conduct regular training sessions for staff on hygiene best practices, including cleaning techniques, chemical handling, food safety, and waste management.

Develop educational materials and ensure employees understand and adhere to hygiene protocols.

Organize refresher courses and audits to reinforce a culture of hygiene awareness among employees.

3. Hygiene Policies & Documentation:

Develop, update, and enforce hygiene policies, procedures, and checklists in accordance with local health regulations and global hospitality standards.

Ensure all employees are familiar with and adhere to hygiene manuals and operational guidelines.

Maintain accurate records of hygiene practices, training, audits, and inspections for internal and external review.

Implement necessary changes to meet new regulatory requirements and prepare for compliance certifications.

Conduct risk assessments to identify potential hygiene hazards and implement preventive measures.

Investigate and manage hygiene-related incidents, such as foodborne illnesses or pest control issues, ensuring swift resolution.

Implement robust incident response procedures, documenting corrective and preventive actions.

7. Collaboration & Guest Interaction:

Work closely with Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering, and other departments to ensure a unified approach to hygiene and sanitation.

Address guest concerns and complaints related to hygiene, ensuring a prompt and professional resolution.

Assist in the implementation of guest hygiene initiatives, such as enhanced cleaning protocols and in-room sanitation measures.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Environmental Health, Food Safety, or a related field (preferred).

Experience: Prior experience in hygiene, quality control, or safety management in hospitality, F&B, or healthcare.

Knowledge: Strong understanding of hygiene regulations, HACCP principles, and industry best practices.

Skills:

Excellent communication and training abilities.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Detail-oriented with the ability to multitask.

Familiarity with hygiene inspection tools, reporting software, and compliance documentation.

Certifications (Preferred): HACCP, ISO 22000, or other relevant food safety and hygiene certifications.

title: Koulunkäynninohjaaja
description:
Monitoimitalo Loistossa toimiva Rakokiven peruskoulu on noin 430 oppilaan alakoulu, joka sijaitsee hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä Rakokiven liikekeskuksessa. Monitoimitalo Loistossa toimii koulun lisäksi Rakokiven päiväkoti ja Nastolan kirjasto sekä joukko muita käyttäjiä. Käytettävissämme upean uuden talon lisäksi ovat erinomaiset urheilu- ja liikuntamahdollisuudet kävelyetäisyydellä. Koulullamme on vahvaa oppimisen tuen osaamista.

Koulunkäynninohjaajan tehtävä täytetään ajalle 31.8.2026 - 5.6.2027. Työaika on 29 tuntia viikossa, joten työaikaprosentti on 75,82. Vaativan erityisopetuksen tiimiin kuuluu erityisluokanopettaja ja useita koulunkäynninohjaajia.

Koulutuksen lisäksi arvostamme hakijan halua ja kykyä tiimityöhön. Vuorovaikutustaidot, joustavuus sekä soveltuvuus työyhteisöön vaikuttavat valintapäätökseen. Valinta tehdään soveltuvuuden ja koulutuksen perusteella. Työhön voi sisältyä myös lääkinnällisiä tehtäviä.

Odotamme hakijalta vähintään soveltuvaa keskiasteen tutkintoa (esim. koulunkäyntiavustajan, lähihoitajan erikoistumisala lapset ja nuoret, nuoriso-ohjaajan tai lasten ja nuorten erityisohjaajan koulutus) tai koulunkäynninohjaajan erikoisammattitutkintoa.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 edellyttämä rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista. Tehtävään valittavalta voidaan pyytää huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 4 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Kouluvuoden ajalle asettuvina loma-aikoina työnantajalla ei ole osoittaa työtä. Nämä koulujen loma-ajat ovat palkatonta vapaata.

Hakemukset Kuntarekry.fi -järjestelmän kautta viimeistään 25.8.2026 klo 15.00. Haastattelut pidetään perjantaina 28.8.2026.

https://www.lahti.fi/tyo-ja-yrittaminen/lahti-tyonantajana/tyontekijatarinoita/

Lahden kaupunki on vastuullinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuolisesti henkilöstöetuja. Käytössäsi on hyvinvoinnin tukemiseen liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, olet oikeutettu työsuhdematkaetuun sekä sovittuihin lounastarjouksiin.

Lahden kaupungin perusopetuspalvelut kuuluvat sivistyksen palvelualueelle. Sivistyksen palvelualue on uudistuva, osaamista arvostava ja aktiivinen yhteistyökumppani. Perusopetusta järjestetään 20 koulussa. Oppilaita on reilu 10 000, opettajia ja koulunkäynninohjaajia noin 1 200.

title: Senior Quality Assurance and Test Engineering Specialist
description:
Senior Specialist - Quality Assurance (QA) and Test Engineering

Location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

Workplace: on_site

Description

JOB PURPOSE

The Senior Specialist – QA and Test Engineering will play a critical role in the Quality Assurance, Software Testing and Testing Automation practice in CBUAE and embed a robust quality assurance framework across all critical financial systems and applications, thereby ensuring the unwavering reliability, security, and integrity of national monetary policy, payment infrastructure, and regulatory oversight tools. This role is paramount for mitigating systemic risks, safeguarding financial stability, and upholding public trust by implementing the efficient and effective validation of complex software, executing advanced test automation, and fostering a culture of stringent quality excellence aligned with the central bank's unique mandate to manage the nation's financial backbone and adhere to the highest standards of governance and resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Design and Development is responsible for leading the design, development, testing and implementation of innovative solutions and services that meet business needs. This role involves strategically defining and implementing the overarching quality assurance/testing vision and roadmap for all software systems, ensuring the highest standards of reliability, security, performance, and regulatory compliance for CBUAE applications, systems and infrastructure platforms.

  • Quality Assurance and Test Engineering for Financial Applications and Infrastructure: Implement the overarching QA and test engineering and automation strategy, policies, and frameworks to ensure the absolute reliability, security, and performance of all mission-critical national payment systems, monetary policy tools, and financial market infrastructure.
  • Mitigating Systemic Risk through Rigorous Testing: Establish and enforce a robust testing regime for all software systems, including comprehensive unit, systems integration, user acceptance, regression, performance, resilience, security, and disaster recovery testing, to safeguard financial stability and prevent systemic vulnerabilities from manifesting.
  • Implement Advanced Test Automation for Efficiency and Integrity: Perform the design, development, and continuous improvement of highly sophisticated test automation frameworks and practices, focusing on enhancing testing efficiency, coverage, and speed for complex, high-volume, and critical central bank applications.
  • Ensuring Regulatory Compliance and Data Integrity: Carry out testing activities and collaborate with developers to guarantee strict adherence to national and international financial regulations, internal policies, and audit requirements, ensuring impeccable data integrity, privacy, and traceability for sensitive financial information.

Self-Management Responsibilities

  • Defines performance goals at the start of the year in discussion with the reporting manager and ensures that the goals are achieved during the course of the year
  • Identifies the training and development requirements for self and agrees on them with the reporting manager to ensure that the required trainings are arranged and attended
  • Strives to achieve the highest levels of proficiency on all the competencies and skills required to perform the role.
  • Keeps abreast of professional developments, new techniques and current issues through continued education and professional growth.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Threshold Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • Deep expertise and mastery in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise-grade test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, UiPath, Selenium, Appium) for various application types (web, mobile, API, desktop).
  • Strong understanding and practical experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling) for high-volume, real-time transaction systems, and expertise in security testing methodologies and tools (e.g., OWASP Top 10, penetration testing tools, vulnerability scanners) to protect against cyber threats to national financial data.
    • In-depth understanding of various SDLC models, particularly Agile and DevOps, with practical experience in integrating quality assurance processes and automation into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. This includes familiarity with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps.
    • Strong SQL expertise and experience with diverse database systems (relational, NoSQL) to ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across critical financial data repositories, including complex data migration and reconciliation testing.
    • Knowledge of complex enterprise system architectures, including microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, Oracle), along with the ability to design testing strategies that account for their unique challenges and ensure end-to-end quality.
    • In-depth understanding of the technical intricacies of core banking systems, financial market infrastructure, national payment systems (e.g., RTGS, ACH), SupTech and regulatory reporting systems to design relevant and effective test scenarios.
    • Proven track record in implementing and overseeing specialized testing such as chaos engineering, blockchain testing (if applicable to central bank initiatives), big data testing, and AI/ML model validation.
  • Years & Nature of Experience
    • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading a Software QA and Testing team. Value-add if candidate has built a QA and Test team from scratch.
    • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in performing Software QA and Testing or any related roles.
    • Extensive hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise-grade test automation frameworks for front-end and back-end applications.
    • Understanding of test-driven development (TDD) and behavior-driven development (BDD) and how to implement them with software engineers.
    • Proficiency in programming languages like Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript for automation scripting and framework development.
    • Proficiency in Agile development and DevSecOps practices to ensure rapid iteration and responsiveness to changing requirements.
    • Relevant professional certifications in QA and software testing tools and platforms will be an advantage.

Competencies

Behavioural

  • Drives High Performance: Assigns challenging goals for self and team and ensures efficient delivery, keeping in mind the objectives, goals and vision for the department and organization.
  • Manages Stakeholders: Builds and maintains professional networks and personal relationships with relevant stakeholders who are, or might become, important in ensuring individual as well as organisational success.
  • Innovates and Steers Change: Prioritises creativity and innovation, striving to constantly come up with better or unique ways of doing things. Remains focused and optimistic through challenging situations, adapting quickly and demonstrating agility to changing circumstances to deliver required objectives.
  • Builds Capability: Believes in the capability of oneself and others and invests in strengthening them. Provides resources and support required for individuals to develop critical skill and knowledge to achieve their full potential.
  • Driving Business Value: Reviews situations, opportunities, plans and information in great detail measuring impact on business success. Identifies potential setbacks and creates risk mitigation strategies to reduce risk of failure.

Technical

  • Software Testing: Understanding of software testing principles and practices, including unit testing, integration testing and automated testing.
  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in two or more programming languages.
  • Development Frameworks and Libraries: Familiarity with development frameworks and libraries relevant to their programming languages.
  • Software Development Methodologies: Understanding of different software development methodologies like waterfall, scrum, agile.
  • Database Management: Relational Databases, Database Design and Optimization, Data modeling, indexing, query optimization.
  • Debugging and Troubleshooting: Strong debugging skills to identify issues in software applications and design test cases to simulate and resolve those issues.

Job Description:

The Performance Tester supports the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program for the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (AO) by designing, executing, and analyzing performance, load, and scalability tests for enterprise-class applications deployed in the AWS cloud. Working as part of Agile DevSecOps teams, this role ensures that CMM applications built using React, NodeJS, and AWS meet or exceed defined performance, reliability, and capacity objectives. The Performance Tester identifies performance bottlenecks, validates system resilience, and collaborates closely with development and infrastructure teams to optimize end-to-end system performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests to validate system scalability and responsiveness.
  • Define performance benchmarks and KPIs based on application SLAs, SOW requirements, and user load models.
  • Build, configure, and maintain performance test environments in AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Design test scripts using JMeter, LoadRunner, or K6, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance monitoring.
  • Conduct baseline performance analysis and capacity planning for major CMM components.
  • Collaborate with developers, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to identify performance bottlenecks and tune system configurations.
  • Analyze test results and prepare detailed performance reports, recommending optimization strategies.
  • Validate that application releases meet federal performance and reliability standards prior to production deployment.
  • Support failover and stress testing scenarios to verify system fault tolerance and scalability under load.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide performance insights during sprint planning and retrospectives.

Tools & Technologies:

  • Performance testing: JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, K6.
  • Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack.
  • CI/CD integration: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions.
  • Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, or Grafana dashboards.
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, MS Teams.

Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or relevant field)
  • 5+ years of experience with integration, regression, and system testing using automated testing tools in web-based applications
  • 5+ years of experience in software performance testing and engineering, with 3+ years in cloud-based or distributed systems.
  • Experience in writing test cases, test plans, executing test scripts, reporting defects and preparing test results reports
  • Experience in the entire QA Life Cycle, including designing, developing and execution on the entire QA process and documentation of test plans, test cases, test procedures and test scripts
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript for scripting, test development, and automation across modern performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or K6.
  • Strong knowledge of performance engineering principles, including concurrency modeling, resource utilization, and tuning.
  • Experience testing applications in AWS cloud environments (EC2, ECS, CloudWatch, RDS).
  • Working understanding of NodeJS, REST APIs, microservices, and front-end frameworks such as ReactJS.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration for automated performance test execution.
  • Ability to interpret system logs, metrics, and profiling data to diagnose bottlenecks.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, ELK Stack, or Grafana.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience with federal or enterprise-scale application performance testing.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Understanding of network performance testing and distributed tracing techniques.
  • Exposure to AI-driven performance analytics or predictive capacity modeling.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cost optimization for cloud-based performance tuning.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

Certifications:

  • ISTQB Performance Testing Certification (CT-PT) – preferred.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or DevOps Engineer – preferred.
  • SAFe Practitioner (SPC/SSM) – beneficial.
  • Performance Engineering Certification – a plus.

title: Software Engineer / Sr. Software Engineer, Planning Selection (Autonomy)
description:
About the Company

DiDi's autonomous driving unit was established in 2016 with the mission of developing Level 4 autonomous driving (AD) technology to make transportation safer and more efficient. In August 2019, the unit became an independent company, DiDi Autonomous Driving, dedicated to advanced AD R&D, product application, and business expansion. We believe integrating AD technology into a shared-mobility fleet will generate immense social value. By leveraging DiDi's specialized technology, operational expertise, and integrated ecosystem, we are positioned to build and operate a highly efficient, user-oriented autonomous fleet.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and mission-driven Software Engineer / Sr. Software Engineer, Planning Selection to contribute to the development of our core planner engine for decision-making, trajectory generation, and trajectory evaluation. In this role, you will apply both classic robotics behavior planning and modern machine learning algorithms to evaluate candidate trajectories, build multi-objective cost functions, and help select safe, comfortable, and efficient trajectories for our autonomous vehicles. You will play a key role in refining our data-driven methods to enable smooth and scalable unmanned operations in dense urban environments.

Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, production-grade C++ software for trajectory candidate generation and scoring.
  • Apply probabilistic, statistical, and machine learning methods to assess dynamic trajectory risk, calculate maneuver probabilities, and perform trajectory evaluation under uncertainty.
  • Profile, optimize, and test online planning software to ensure low-latency execution and memory efficiency on embedded production platforms.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Perception, Prediction, Motion Control, and Safety teams to refine scenario evaluation metrics and validate closed-loop planning behavior.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related technical field.
  • 2–5+ years of software engineering experience writing production-grade C++ in autonomous driving, robotics, or complex real-time systems.
  • Strong understanding of behavior planning, decision-making, and trajectory generation algorithms.
  • Solid understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning fundamentals (e.g., classification, regression, scoring models).
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to decompose complex driving behaviors into clear, executable algorithms.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Demonstrated track record of deploying online planning or trajectory evaluation modules onto real-world autonomous platforms.
  • Familiarity with closed-loop simulation, automated data logging, and planning validation workflows.
  • Experience applying Learning-to-Rank (LTR), preference learning, or reward modeling to trajectory selection or robotic decision-making.

The base salary range for the Software Engineer position is $141,463–$235,182 annually, and for the Senior Software Engineer position is $169,783–$282,264 annually, in addition to bonus, equity, and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by the role, level, and location. Within the applicable range, individual compensation is based on the work location as well as other factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and training.

title: Speciallärare i matematik sökes till Västra Ramlösa skola
description:
Vill du vara med och göra skillnad på riktigt?

Brinner du för matematik och för att hitta vägar som får elever att lyckas? Då vill vi gärna träffa dig!

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Om arbetsplatsen

Helsingborgs stads skolor är en resursstark och värdestyrd organisation. Här blir du som medarbetare en viktig del i vår gemensamma vision att skapa den bästa skolan för varje barn och elev.

Västra Ramlösa skola är en F-6-skola med cirka 600 elever och ligger i ett lugnt och trivsamt område i södra Helsingborg. Vi arbetar för att våra elever ska känna glädje i att gå i skolan, känna sig trygga och samtidigt nå goda resultat.

Vår vision är:

Vi Vågar

Vi Lär

Vi Kan

Tillsammans!

Hos oss är lärande, trygghet och utveckling nära sammankopplade. Vi har höga ambitioner för alla våra elever och arbetar aktivt för att varje elev ska utvecklas så långt som möjligt utifrån sina förutsättningar.

Vi är en skola som tycker om att utvecklas. Vi håller oss uppdaterade kring aktuell pedagogisk forskning och arbetar kontinuerligt med att utveckla vår undervisning. Bland annat har vi under flera år arbetat aktivt med kooperativt lärande.

Nu söker vi dig som vill bli en viktig del av vårt Spec-team och vara med och ytterligare utveckla skolans arbete med matematik.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som speciallärare med inriktning matematik får du ett viktigt och utvecklande uppdrag på vår skola.

Du kommer att arbeta både förebyggande och främjande, på individ-, grupp- och organisationsnivå. Tillsammans med skolans övriga speciallärare och specialpedagogiska kompetenser arbetar du för att undanröja hinder för lärande och skapa goda förutsättningar för alla elever att lyckas.

Ditt huvudsakliga fokus kommer att vara matematik och matematikutveckling.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:

  • identifiera elever i behov av stöd i matematik och planera insatser utifrån deras behov,
  • genomföra och följa upp pedagogiska kartläggningar och screeningar,
  • arbeta med riktade specialpedagogiska insatser för elever och elevgrupper,
  • vara ett stöd för lärare i arbetet med extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd,
  • bidra till utvecklingen av undervisningen i matematik,
  • handleda och samarbeta med lärare kring matematikdidaktik och tillgängliga lärmiljöer,
  • bidra till analys av elevernas kunskapsutveckling och skolans resultat,
  • delta aktivt i skolans systematiska kvalitetsarbete,
  • bidra med specialpedagogisk kompetens i elevhälsoteamet.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat spec-team där det idag finns tre speciallärare, varav två med inriktning svenska och en med inriktning matematik. Tillsammans arbetar ni nära skolans ledning, elevhälsa och pedagoger.

Hos oss finns stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla uppdraget tillsammans med kollegor.'

Vad vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande, ansvarsfullt och stimulerande arbete där du får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad för elevernas lärande och utveckling.

Du blir en del av en skola med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor, där samarbete och utveckling står högt på agendan.

Som anställd får du ett friskvårdsbidrag på 3000 kronor per år.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare och utbildad speciallärare med inriktning matematik.

Även du som är under utbildning till speciallärare med inriktning matematik är varmt välkommen att söka. För rätt person kan vi tillsammans hitta en bra väg in i uppdraget.

Som person är du en relationsskapande och lösningsorienterad lagspelare. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och ser möjligheter snarare än begränsningar.

Du har ett genuint intresse för elevernas lärande och tror på att alla elever kan utvecklas när undervisningen och stödet utformas utifrån deras behov.

Du är nyfiken, engagerad och prestigelös och tycker om att tillsammans med andra pröva, utvärdera och utveckla arbetssätt.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Att jobba i Helsingborgs stad

Vill du vara med och skapa en bättre stad tillsammans med helsingborgarna? Då ska du jobba i Helsingborgs stad. Här kan du använda din kreativitet och drivkraft till att göra livet lättare och tryggare för våra invånare, besökare och näringsliv. Tillsammans med nyfikna och hjälpsamma kollegor gör du skillnad i människors liv, både idag och i framtiden. Ett bra jobb idag, en bättre stad imorgon.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att jobba i staden: https://helsingborg.se/arbete/sa-ar-det-att-jobba-i-staden/

Övrig information

Sista ansökningsdag: 260901

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning

Omfattning: 100%

Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse

Varaktighet: Heltid

Antal tjänster: 1

I Helsingborgs stad gillar vi olika. Vi strävar efter att våra medarbetare ska spegla våra invånare och värnar om det värde som jämn könsfördelning samt mångfald tillför våra verksamheter.Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att tjänsten inte behöver tas i anspråk för redan tillsvidareanställda medarbetare.Om du blir erbjuden tjänst inom förskola och skola eller öppen fritidsverksamhet ska du uppvisa giltigt utdrag från polisens belastningsregisterFör att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Helsingborgs stad använder vi rekryteringsverktyget ReachMee. Därför ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan via ReachMee genom att klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. I ansökan ska CV och övriga för tjänsten relevanta handlingar bifogas, exempelvis utbildningsbevis eller yrkeslegitimation. Du kommer även få besvara urvalsfrågor.Du som söker jobb och har skyddade personuppgifter ska kontakta rekryterande chef i annonsen som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess. Du ska inte ansöka digitalt via ansökningslänken. Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss vänligen men bestämt att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

title: Campus Graduate Masters Summer Internship Program - 2027 Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services- Charlotte, NC
description:
Business Unit/Role Specific Information

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.


At American Express, we empower future technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll join a 10-week Summer Internship Program and contribute to real-world technology projects that support seamless customer and colleague experiences. You’ll build software, collaborate with Agile teams, and learn how products are designed, developed, tested, and delivered in a global enterprise environment. These skills will give you the tools to accelerate in your studies and future career!


Enterprise Technology Services teams build and operate technology that helps American Express deliver trusted, secure, and customer first products and services. Interns may be aligned to scrum teams across backend engineering, frontend engineering, cloud engineering, mobile, AI/machine learning, data oriented engineering,
or full-stack product development. The role family is Software Engineering which means designing, coding, testing, and improving applications and services that help customers, colleagues, and partners get work done reliably and securely.

Responsibilities & What Type of Work to Expect?
• Discover and apply new technologies to solve real-world business challenges.
• Contribute to an Agile scrum team by developing, testing, and improving software applications.
• Write clean, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and create unit tests with coaching from experienced engineers.
• Explore and experiment with emerging AI-powered developer tools, automation capabilities, and machine learning concepts while learning how to build software responsibly, securely, and at enterprise scale.
• Partner with Product Managers, Senior Engineers, Quality Engineers, and Architects to understand requirements, prioritize features, and deliver value.
• Build confidence working across different parts of the technology stack, such as APIs, services, microservices, user interfaces, mobile experiences, cloud platforms, or data driven solutions.
• Participate in social events, community service opportunities, learning sessions, and collaborative initiatives with fellow interns.


What You’ll Learn
• How software is built and delivered “the Amex Way,” including structured onboarding, developer bootcamp concepts, code quality, testing, and secure engineering practices.
• How Product, Engineering, Quality, Security, and business partners collaborate from idea to production.
• How to translate customer or business needs into technical solutions while balancing quality, resilience, usability, and risk.
• How to communicate progress, ask effective questions, and share technical work with both technical and non-technical partners.
• How to grow your career through mentorship, feedback, community, and continuous learning.

Minimum Qualifications
• Currently enrolled in a full-time graduate master's degree program
• Graduate master's degree candidates with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
• Demonstrated experience through coursework, projects, research, or extracurricular activities using one or more programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, C#, Go, Kotlin, or similar technologies.
• Foundational understanding of computer science concepts including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, and problem solving.
• Interest in building software applications across web, mobile, backend, cloud, API, or full-stack environments.
• Familiarity with modern software development practices such as version control, testing, code reviews, Agile methodologies, and collaborative development workflows.
• Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, intelligent automation, and AI-powered developer tools.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills with the ability to learn quickly, seek feedback, and work effectively in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Preferred Qualifications
• A curious, collaborative problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies and applying them to practical challenges.
• Understanding and experience leveraging AI powered development tools, generative AI, intelligent automation, responsible AI, and machine learning fundamentals.
• Ability to collaborate with Product, Engineering, Quality, Security, and business partners from idea through delivery.
• Ability to translate customer or business needs into technical solutions while balancing quality, resilience, usability, and risk.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to share progress, ask effective questions, and explain technical work to technical and non-technical partners.
• A student who has built and programmed software through academic, personal, internship, open-source, hackathon, or project-based experiences.
• Someone who communicates clearly, welcomes feedback, and brings an inclusive, customer first mindset to team environments.

Technology Areas for Software Engineers
American Express Software Engineering Interns may be aligned to different technology teams based on business needs, project requirements, and individual strengths.


Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:


• Back-End Engineering: Java, Python, Golang, APIs, microservices, Big Data, or Data Engineering concepts.
• Front-End Engineering: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, accessibility, and user experience principles.
• Cloud Engineering: Java, Python, cloud-native development, microservices, CI/CD, containerization, and DevOps practices.
• Site Reliability Engineer: Knowledge of observability tools and methodologies, including experience with logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance analysis platforms
• AI & Machine Learning Engineering: Java, Python, machine learning fundamentals, AI powered development tools, agentic workflows, AI agents, data processing, automation, and responsible AI concepts.
• Mobile Engineering: Swift, Kotlin, API integration, mobile testing frameworks, mobile architecture, and UI/UX fundamentals.
• Core Skills Across All Areas: Strong problem-solving abilities, computer science fundamentals, communication and collaboration skills, experience working in team environments, and curiosity for emerging technologies including Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.


Our team reviews applications on a rolling basis. We appreciate your patience while we consider your application and we will contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.


Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

title: Digital IT Apprentice
description:
Launch Your Career in Digital & Technology at the Port of Dover
Are you passionate about technology, curious about Artificial Intelligence, and eager to build a career in IT and Digital Services?
The Port of Dover is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Digital Apprentice to join our IT team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience while working towards a recognised apprenticeship qualification, developing valuable skills across IT Operations, Business Systems, Software Development and Digital Project Delivery.
As a Digital Apprentice, you'll combine formal learning with practical workplace experience, working alongside experienced professionals and supporting technologies that enable our people and business to operate effectively, securely and efficiently.
This role is perfect for someone who enjoys problem solving, learning new technologies and wants to be at the forefront of digital innovation, including Artificial Intelligence, automation and Microsoft's modern workplace technologies.

This is a Level 3 apprenticeship and the expected duration is 16 months plus end point assessment.

What You'll Be Doing
During your apprenticeship, you'll have the opportunity to:
* Participate in a structured apprenticeship programme combining learning with real-world experience.
* Gain exposure to multiple technology disciplines including IT Operations, Business Systems and Development.
* Provide first-line IT support to colleagues, helping resolve technical issues and service requests.
* Support the administration and maintenance of Microsoft 365, SaaS applications and business systems.
* Develop practical experience using Microsoft Copilot, Artificial Intelligence and automation technologies.
* Assist with the testing, implementation and support of new systems and technology enhancements.
* Contribute to digital transformation and business improvement projects.
* Create user guides, knowledge articles and training materials.
* Help manage IT assets and technology equipment throughout their lifecycle.
* Develop knowledge of cyber security, information governance and data protection.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation.
* Continuously develop your skills through mentoring, training and professional development opportunities.


What We're Looking For
Essential
* GCSEs (or equivalent) including English and Mathematics at Grade 4/C or above.
* A genuine interest in Information Technology, Digital Services and emerging technologies.
* Strong enthusiasm for learning and developing new skills.
* Good problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Comfortable using digital tools and technology.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a busy environment.
* An interest in Artificial Intelligence and how technology can improve the workplace.
* Awareness of the importance of cyber security and responsible technology use.
Desirable
* Experience using Microsoft 365 applications such as Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Awareness of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.
* Basic understanding of software, applications or website development.
* Previous experience in a customer service, technology or support environment.

What You'll Gain
This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to:

  • Gain experience across multiple technology disciplines
  • Work with modern Microsoft technologies and AI tools
  • Learn from experienced IT and Digital professionals
  • Develop skills in Microsoft 365, cloud technologies, automation and digital transformation
  • Build practical experience supporting real business systems and users
  • Contribute to meaningful projects that help shape the future of the Port of Dover
  • Achieve a recognised apprenticeship qualification
  • Create a strong foundation for a long-term career in Digital and Technology

Our Values
At the Port of Dover, we're committed to creating a workplace built on integrity, respect, collaboration and continuous improvement. We're looking for someone who shares our enthusiasm for innovation, embraces learning opportunities and enjoys working as part of a team.
If you're ready to start your technology career and play a role in shaping the digital future of one of the UK's most important ports, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

  • Working within a very diverse multi-disciplined environment​
  • Exciting place to work
  • Working with a fantastic team​
  • You will have your own mentor that will help you in achieving your goals
  • ​You will have your own training plan to grow your own skills set​

Plus

  • 5 weeks annual leave + bank holidays (pro rata)
  • Generous contributory pension scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • 3rd party discounts
  • Benefits and reward platform
  • Free Parking

Hours of work: Monday - Friday 37.5 per week
Salary: £16,575p/a

All offers of employment are subject to us obtaining satisfactory references (covering all education, training, employment and unemployment in the preceding 5 years) and there will be a pre-employment medical including a Drug and Alcohol test. We need to satisfy your Right to Work in the UK.

Please be aware that all employees will be subject to background security checks in order to obtain a Dock Pass.

We value the unique differences that each of our colleagues bring to work every day and are committed to creating an environment where everyone is looking after each other and respected, included and able to perform at their best.

All applications are reviewed by our team - we do not use AI for screening.

Closing date: 11 September 2026 at 5pm

title: Säsonga som servis och hovmästare på Liseberg
description:
Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie! Sedan 1923 har vi fått människor att mötas, skratta och trivas tillsammans. Snart är det din tur att vara med. Hos oss jobbar du inte bara i en nöjespark – du jobbar i en hel värld av upplevelser: Karuseller, musik, god mat, hotell, show, trädgårdar, camping – och snart ett helt nytt vattenvärld. Vi har öppet året om, i olika säsonger och olika tempo – men glädjen finns alltid där. Och det är just du som är med och skapar den. Här är jobbet både stort och smått, vardagligt och wiiie, fullt av fart men med plats för eftertanke. Ett vanligt jobb. Fast mer wiiie!

Vi ger dig detta (och lite till!)

  • Vardag och wiiie. Här är jobbet både kul och på riktigt. Du gör skillnad – oavsett om du jobbar mitt i pulsen eller bakom kulisserna.

  • Kollegor och kvarterskänsla. Här finns experter på allt från snurrande åk till smarta excel-dokument. Olika jobb, olika hörn av samma varma kvarter.

  • Värde före vinst. Vi ägs av staden. Det du gör bidrar till något större än oss själva.

  • Mod och metod. Vi testar nytt – men alltid med hållbarhet i fokus. Att ligga i framkant kräver både idéer och eftertanke. Här finns båda.

Du är en i gänget Som medarbetare på Lisebergs restauranger blir du en del av ett stort engagerat team som skapar minnesvärda upplevelser för våra hungriga och törstiga gäster.

Till våra restauranger välkomnar vi dig som har lång erfarenhet eller kanske utbildning inom restaurang, men också dig som är nyfiken och vill ta dina allra första steg in i yrket. På våra restauranger finns alla möjliga roller; allt från restaurangbiträden och runners, till serviser, bartendrar och hovmästare.

Du arbetar i en unik miljö med service i toppklass och samarbetar dagligen med kollegor inom kök, servering, disk och värdskap – alla med samma mål: att skapa minnesvärda upplevelser för alla våra gäster.

Så ser en vaaanlig dag ut Dagens to-do: skapa magi. Det gör du genom att:

  • Ge varje gäst ett varmt välkomnande och leverera service i toppklass från första mötet till sista intrycket.

  • Servera mat och dryck med professionalism, känsla för detaljer och ett genuint fokus på gästens upplevelse.

  • Samarbeta tätt med servisen, baren och köket för att säkerställa ett smidigt flöde och en hög servicekvalitet, även när tempot är högt.

  • Hålla restaurangen välorganiserad, inbjudande och välkomnande för både gäster och kollegor.

  • Bidra med positiv energi, ta initiativ och hjälpa till där det behövs för att skapa en härlig stämning i teamet.

Passar vi ihop? Hos oss på Liseberg är ensam inte stark och att sätta kollegor och gäster i första rummet är för dig en självklarhet. Vi söker dig som delar våra värdeord; omtanke, kreativitet, säkerhet, kvalitet och glädje och med dessa vill du vara med och skapa Liseberg.

Har du vad som krävs för åkturen?

  • Du har ett genuint intresse för service, restaurangbranschen och att skapa minnesvärda upplevelser för våra gäster.

  • Du trivs i ett högt tempo, är flexibel och har förmågan att behålla ett positivt och professionellt bemötande även under intensiva arbetspass.

  • Du är ansvarstagande, initiativrik och ser till att det du påbörjar blir gjort.

  • Du uppskattar att arbeta i team och bidrar till ett gott samarbete med både kollegor och gäster.

Bra att veta

  • Anställningsform: Särskild visstidsanställning, alt. säsongsanställning med varierande sysselsättningsgrad

  • Kollektivavtal: HRF

  • Bakgrundskontroller kan bli aktuellt senare i processen

  • Sista ansökningsdag är 27 september men vi rekryterar löpande hela säsongen - så skicka in din ansökan redan nu!

Fackliga kontakter

  • HRF: hrf-gc@liseberg.se

  • Unionen: Ewa Woldemar - unionen@liseberg.se

Om du har frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Lisebergs TA team via jobb@liseberg.se.

På vår hemsida www.liseberg.se kan du läsa mer om oss som arbetsplats.

Ta första steget och skicka in din ansökan!

title: Data Engineer
description:
High-impact strategic project Small dynamic team culture Permanent role based in Melbourne

We're REA With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home. Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.

Where the team fits in The Data Engineering role sits within the Modernisation tribe (CuPID) and is part of the broader Customer Product & Experience group within REA Group. The CuPID Squad is responsible for designing and operating the pipelines and core customer datasets that provides customer insights from multiple systems into consistent, reliable data that are used by teams across REA. You will join a dynamic team who owns all customer data across the business and is working to consolidate data from multiple legacy systems into a unified customer profile platform. The aim for this team is to improve data accuracy and enable personalization and machine learning capabilities for AI products at REA. This role will suit someone with strong technical rigour who thrives in cross team coordination.

What the role is all about Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and datasets; participate in data transformation requests coming through a team board; collaborate with team members on implementation approach and determining the most efficient ways to tackle work. The role is approximately 70-80% data engineering with opportunities to build out software engineering capabilities as Cupid's functionality expands. The team works with many unknowns, requiring comfort with ambiguity and collaborative problem-solving rather than clear, predefined solutions. Works closely with the senior and mid-level data engineers within the Cupid squad; collaborates with the data analyst on requirements; engages with other software engineering squads on cross-functional needs; interacts with Salesforce team and customer support team for data remediation. The role involves determining accuracy of aggregated data and managing remediation across multiple source systems and customer teams, which requires strong technical rigor and cross-team coordination.

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and datasets
  • Participate in data transformation requests coming through a team board
  • Collaborate with team members on implementation approach and determining the most efficient ways to tackle work
  • Work closely with senior and mid-level data engineers within the Cupid squad
  • Collaborate with the data analyst on requirements
  • Engage with other software engineering squads on cross-functional needs
  • Interact with Salesforce team and customer support team for data remediation
  • Determine accuracy of aggregated data and manage remediation across multiple source systems and customer teams

Who we’re looking for Someone with a strong knowledge of SQL, ideally with hands‑on experience designing and building robust data pipelines. Experience with data pipeline design and implementation. Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools. BigQuery or equivalent data warehouse. DBT or similar data transformation tool. Strong data modelling skills and disciplined data quality practices. A collaborative mindset- comfortable contributing ideas and shaping direction. AWS or GCP cloud platform experience. Experience from smaller teams were wearing multiple hats is required.

  • Someone with a strong knowledge of SQL, ideally with hands‑on experience designing and building robust data pipelines
  • Experience with data pipeline design and implementation
  • Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools
  • BigQuery or equivalent data warehouse
  • DBT or similar data transformation tool
  • Strong data modelling skills and disciplined data quality practices
  • A collaborative mindset- comfortable contributing ideas and shaping direction
  • AWS or GCP cloud platform experience
  • Experience from smaller teams wearing multiple hats is required

The REA experience The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow. Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking.

We are an Australian-based digital media company with a passion for real estate. Our leading brand is Australia’s biggest property resource, . We also operate the number one commercial property site, realcommercial.com.au, and have businesses that help property developers and other brands advertise with us. Whilst we live in Australia, we’ve also got ventures in Asia and North America, and have the vision of expanding our footprint further. title: Senior Trainee, vero- ja lakipalvelut | Kevät 2027 & Syksy 2027
description:
SENIOR TRAINEE, VERO- JA LAKIPALVELUT | Svalner Atlas (Helsinki)

Oletko oikeus- tai kauppatieteen, tai muun soveltuvan alan (kuten hallintotieteiden) loppuvaiheen opiskelija tai valmistumisen kynnyksellä oleva asiantuntija, joka haluaa syventää osaamistaan ja ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan? Innostut asiantuntijatyöstä, vastuullisista tehtävistä ja laadukkaasta asiakastyöstä.

Mahtavaa, hae osaksi trainee-ohjelmiamme ja timanttista ihmeporukkaamme! 💙

Ketä etsimme osaksi ihmeporukkaa?

Etsimme vero- ja lakipalveluiden asiantuntijatiimiimme tammi–elokuulle 2027 tai syyskuusta 2027–huhtikuuhun 2028 Senior Traineeta, joka on trainee-jakson ajankohtana kauppa- tai oikeustieteiden, tai muun soveltuvan alan, kuten hallintotieteiden, loppuvaiheen opiskelija tai valmistumisen kynnyksellä oleva ja haluaa syventää osaamistaan korkeatasoisessa asiantuntijatyössä.

Sinulla on mieluusti jo jonkin verran oman alan kokemusta, mutta ennen kaikkea olet motivoitunut, itseohjautuva ja analyyttinen tekijä, joka tarttuu toimeen aktiivisesti ja kehittää osaamistaan tavoitteellisesti kokeneiden huippuasiantuntijoiden tukemana. Arvostat laadukasta asiakastyötä ja haluat nähdä, millaista asiantuntijatyö on osana kasvavaa ja kansainvälistä vero-, laki- ja yritysjärjestelyiden asiantuntijaorganisaatiota.

Trainee-ohjelmista

Trainee-ohjelmamme ovat suunnattu opintojensa eri vaiheissa oleville korkeakouluopiskelijoille, lähtökohtaisesti oikeus- ja kauppatieteiden tai muun soveltuvan alan, kuten hallintotieteiden, yliopisto-opiskelijoille. Opiskelutaustaa tärkeämpiä ovat asenne työntekoon, kiinnostus alaan ja halukkuus kehittyä kohti asiantuntija-ammattia.

Tavoitteenamme on tarjota tulevaisuuden huippuosaajille mahdollisuus:

  • tutustua korkeatasoisen asiantuntijatyön arkeen käytännössä

  • oppia ja kehittyä vastuullisena ja luotettavana työntekijänä monipuolisten avustavien tehtävien hoitamisen kautta

  • saada inspiraatiota oman urapolun rakentamiseen

  • päästä osaksi Svalner Atlaksen jännittävää kasvutarinaa

Kolme trainee-ohjelmaamme Junior Trainee, Trainee sekä Senior Trainee, pyörivät läpi vuoden. Junior Trainee- sekä Trainee-ohjelmat ovat kestoltaan neljän (4) kuukauden mittaisia ja Senior Trainee-ohjelma on kahdeksan (8) kuukauden mittainen.

Tarjoamme jokaisessa trainee-ohjelmassa opintojen vaiheeseen nähden sopivia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä osana kansainvälistä asiantuntijaorganisaatiota, jatkuvaa tukea arjessa menestymiseen sekä kilpailukykyisen palkan. Lue lisää trainee-ohjelmista verkkosivuiltamme.

Mitä Senior Traineen työtehtäviin kuuluu?

Senior Traineena työskentelet ensisijaisesti yhdessä (1) vero- ja lakipalveluiden praktiikassamme ja osallistut asiantuntijoidemme tukemana asiantuntijatyöhön. Pääset syventämään osaamistasi asiakastoimeksiannoissa ja ottamaan vastuuta osana kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden tiimiä.

Praktiikat Senior Trainee, vero- ja lakipalvelut -tehtävässä:

  • Domestic Corporate Tax

  • International Corporate Tax

  • Indirect Tax

  • Personal Taxation & Private Clients

  • M&A Tax

  • Legal

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat ensisijaisesti:

  • Asiantuntijoiden laaja-alainen avustaminen toimeksiantotyössä

  • Tiedonhankinta- ja analyysityö

  • Selvitystöiden tekeminen ja materiaalien valmistelu

  • Esitys- ja raportointimateriaalien laatiminen

  • Yhteydenpito viranomaisiin

Voit tutustua palveluihimme tarkemmin nettisivuillamme.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Roolin, jossa pääset kehittämään asiantuntijuuttasi kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden tukemana

  • Kokoaikaisen (37,5 h / viikko), määräaikaisen harjoittelupaikan kahdeksan (8) kuukauden ajaksi

  • Innostavan työympäristön viihtyisässä toimistossamme loistosijainnilla Helsingin ydinkeskustassa Eteläesplanadilla

  • Aidosti positiivisen ja rennon työyhteisön, jossa sinut otetaan lämpimästi vastaan

  • Matalan hierarkian ja yhteistyötä korostavan toimintakulttuurin

  • Lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työmatkaedut, laajan työterveyshuollon sekä hyvinvointia ja yhteisöllisyyttä edistäviä mahdollisuuksia.

Senior Traineen palkka ohjelman aikana on 3.490 euroa kuukaudessa.

Tätä toivomme sinulta:

  • Oikeus- tai kauppatieteiden, tai muun soveltuvan alan (esim. hallintotieteet) loppuvaiheen opinnot siten, että olet trainee-jakson alkaessa opintojesi loppusuoralla tai valmistumisen kynnyksellä

  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

  • Aitoa kiinnostusta asiantuntijatyöhön ja laadukkaaseen asiakaspalveluun

  • Itseohjautuvaa ja proaktiivista asennetta sekä kykyä ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä

  • Halua syventää osaamistaan ja kehittyä asiantuntijana

  • Innostusta oppia

  • Jonkin verran oman alan työkokemusta

Svalner Atlas työnantajana

Svalner Atlaksella rakennamme yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa suomalaisia menestystarinoita sekä vaalimme ja kehitämme vahvaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi kasvaa täyteen ammatilliseen potentiaaliinsa.

Työarjessasi hyppäät osaksi noin 70 hengen vero-, laki- ja yritysjärjestelyiden asiantuntijajoukkoa ja pääset kasvattamaan uraasi kansainvälisessä ympäristössä Svalner Atlaksen huippuosaajien kanssa.
